papers.title: OpenClassGen: A Large-Scale Corpus of Real-World Python Classes for LLM Research
papers.text:
title: OpenClassGen: A Large-Scale Corpus of Real-World Python Classes for LLM Research
source: arXiv
topics: 
category: dataset
why: 这篇工作偏数据集或基准构建，适合判断是否能作为病原组学训练或评测资源。
abstract_zh: 针对现有类级代码生成数据集规模不足（如 ClassEval 仅 100 个类，RealClassEval 仅 400 个类）限制模型评估的问题，本文推出了 OpenClassGen，这是一个包含从 2,970 个开源项目中提取的 324,843 个 Python 类的大规模语料库。该数据集将人工编写的类与包含签名及文档字符串的自包含骨架配对，并集成了涵盖复杂性、耦合度、内聚性和继承属性的 27 项静态代码指标。研究者在包含 300 个类、分支覆盖率达 58% 的可执行子集上评估了 GPT-o4-mini、Claude-4-Sonnet 和 Qwen-3-Coder。结果显示，尽管语义相似度较高（CodeBERTScore-F3 为 0.89），但功能正确性中等（通过率仅 0.33），且不同模型间表现差异显著。OpenClassGen 支持微调、检索增强生成（RAG）及故障模式分析，为类级代码生成提供了大规模的真实世界基准。
abstract: Existing class-level code generation datasets are either synthetic (ClassEval: 100 classes) or insufficient in scale for modern training needs (RealClassEval: 400 classes), hindering robust evaluation and empirical analysis. We present OpenClassGen, a large-scale corpus of 324,843 Python classes extracted from 2,970 engineered open-source projects. Each entry pairs a human-written class with its corresponding skeleton, which comprises class and method signatures with associated docstrings, and is enriched with 27 static code metrics covering complexity, coupling, cohesion, and inheritance properties. Unlike prior benchmarks that require repository-level context resolution, OpenClassGen provides self-contained class skeletons that serve as complete generation specifications. We demonstrate the corpus's utility by evaluating three LLMs (GPT-o4-mini, Claude-4-Sonnet, Qwen-3-Coder) on a curated, executable subset of 300 classes, enriched with test suites achieving 58% branch coverage. Results show strong semantic similarity (CodeBERTScore-F3: 0.89) but moderate functional correctness (pass rate: 0.33), with substantial variance across models. This variance, along with diverse class characteristics, confirms that OpenClassGen enables meaningful differentiation of LLM capabilities. The dataset supports diverse use cases, including fine-tuning, retrieval-augmented generation, difficulty modelling, and failure mode analysis. The complete dataset and curation scripts are publicly available at https://zenodo.org/records/18409150.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究发布了 OpenClassGen，一个包含 324,843 个真实 Python 类的大规模数据集，旨在解决类级（Class-level）代码生成任务中数据规模过小的问题。数据集不仅提供代码，还包含 27 项静态代码指标（如复杂度和耦合度）以及针对 300 个类的可执行测试套件，用于评估 LLM 的功能正确性。

## 为什么相关
**弱 AI 交叉相关**。该论文属于通用软件工程与 LLM 的交叉领域，并非直接针对病原组学或生物信息学。然而，在临床微生物学和基因组学研究中，复杂的生物信息学分析流程（如基因组组装、蛋白质结构预测管道）通常以 Python 类（Class）的形式封装。OpenClassGen 提供的类级生成评估框架，可用于优化和评估那些用于处理生物大数据的自动化脚本生成工具。

## 新颖度判断
**新颖度高（6.5/10）**。相比于之前的 ClassEval（100 个类）和 RealClassEval（400 个类），OpenClassGen 在规模上实现了数量级的跨越（32.4 万个类）。其新颖之处在于提供了“自包含”的类骨架，无需复杂的仓库级上下文解析即可作为生成规范，并引入了详尽的静态度量指标进行多维度分析。

## 方法与证据
- **数据来源**：从 2,970 个工程化开源项目中提取。规模为 324,843 个 Python 类。
- **评估模型**：GPT-o4-mini、Claude-4-Sonnet、Qwen-3-Coder。
- **关键指标**：在 300 个类的测试子集上，平均语义相似度（CodeBERTScore-F3）达 0.89，但功能正确性（Pass Rate）仅为 0.33。
- **测试质量**：测试套件实现了 58% 的分支覆盖率，证明了评估的严谨性。

## 应用价值
该数据集可直接用于生物信息学专用 LLM 的微调（Fine-tuning）或检索增强生成（RAG），提升模型编写复杂科学计算类代码的能力。同时，27 项静态指标有助于研究者对代码生成的难度进行建模，识别模型在处理高耦合或高复杂性生物计算逻辑时的失败模式。

## 局限与风险
- **功能验证规模有限**：虽然总数据量巨大，但具有可执行测试套件的子集仅 300 个类，占比极小。
- **领域特异性不足**：数据集来源于通用开源项目，可能缺乏病原组学或临床微生物学特有的复杂算法逻辑（如特定的序列比对算法类）。
- **正确性偏低**：0.33 的通过率表明当前 LLM 在处理真实世界复杂类生成任务时仍存在显著缺陷，不可直接用于生产环境的代码自动生成。

papers.title: No Mean Feat: Simple, Strong Baselines for Context Compression
papers.text:
title: No Mean Feat: Simple, Strong Baselines for Context Compression
source: arXiv
topics: 
category: foundation_model
why: 这篇工作偏基础模型/Agent方向，可能影响病原检测任务的建模上限，值得关注其任务定义与评测设计。
abstract_zh: 上下文压缩通过将冗长的输入替换为更短的预计算表示，旨在降低 Transformer 模型的推理成本，这对于检索增强生成（RAG）具有重要意义。然而，由于评估标准和基准不统一，该领域的进展难以衡量。本研究设计了一个标准且易于复现的上下文压缩评估套件 BenchPress，并针对英语阅读理解任务提出了简单且高性能的基准方法。BenchPress 支持跨模型规模、数据集、压缩比以及短程（<1K token）到中程（<8K token）上下文的基准测试。虽然该套件适用于各种压缩范式，但本研究的基准主要针对软上下文压缩（soft context compression）。研究确立了两种简单的基准方法：均值池化（mean pooling）和双向压缩 Token 变体，实验证明其性能显著优于广泛使用的因果压缩 Token 方法。结果表明，在计算压缩表示时，双向注意力机制具有明显优势，且简单的池化操作也是一种极具表现力的压缩算子。
abstract: Context compression reduces Transformer inference costs by replacing lengthy inputs with shorter pre-computed representations. It carries significant benefits for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and has attracted growing research attention. However, progress remains difficult to measure due to inconsistent evaluations and baselines. We design a standard, easy-to-reproduce evaluation suite for context compression, BenchPress, along with simple, high-performance baselines for English reading comprehension. BenchPress supports benchmarking across model scales, datasets, compression ratios, and short ($<$1K tokens) to mid-range ($<$8K tokens) contexts. While the suite is applicable to any compression paradigm, our baselines target soft context compression. We establish two simple baselines that strongly outperform the widely used causal compression-token approach: mean pooling and a bidirectional compression-token variant. Our results show the benefit of bidirectional attention when computing compressed representations, and that simple pooling is an expressive compression operator.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究针对 Transformer 模型在处理长上下文时的推理效率问题，提出了标准化的评估套件 **BenchPress**。研究重点对比了不同的“软上下文压缩”策略，并证明了两种极简方法——**均值池化（mean pooling）**和**双向压缩 Token 变体**，在性能上优于目前主流的因果压缩方法。

## 为什么相关
该工作属于 **AI/LLM 基础架构优化**领域。在病原基因组分析或临床微生物学应用中，LLM 常需处理长篇幅的文献、复杂的临床指南或大规模序列比对结果。高效的上下文压缩技术（如 RAG 优化）能显著降低分析这些长文本时的计算开销，提高 Agent 在病原鉴定和耐药性分析中的响应速度。但需注意，本文属于**弱 AI 交叉**，其核心贡献在于通用模型优化，而非直接针对生物数据。

## 新颖度判断
**新颖度：6.5（中等偏上）**。其新颖性不在于提出了复杂的算法，而在于“反直觉”地证明了简单的均值池化在上下文压缩任务中的强大表现，并挑战了现有的因果压缩（causal compression）范式。同时，BenchPress 的推出填补了该领域缺乏统一评测工具的空白。

## 方法与证据
研究者开发了 **BenchPress** 评测套件，涵盖了从短程（<1K tokens）到中程（<8K tokens）的上下文范围。通过对比实验，研究发现使用**双向注意力（bidirectional attention）**计算出的压缩表示效果更好。证据显示，所提出的均值池化基准在英语阅读理解任务中，“强力超越”（strongly outperform）了目前广泛使用的因果压缩 Token 方法。

## 应用价值
对于临床微生物学 AI 助手，该研究提供的简单基准（如均值池化）可以作为一种低成本、高效率的方案，用于压缩病历长文本或病原学研究报告。这有助于在有限的显存条件下，让模型“读”进更多的背景知识，提升 RAG 系统在处理复杂临床咨询时的准确性。

## 局限与风险
摘要明确指出，该研究目前的实验范围局限于**英语阅读理解**，尚未验证其在专业医学或生物信息学专业术语下的表现。此外，压缩范围仅覆盖到 **8K tokens**，对于超长基因组序列（动辄数万 tokens）的压缩效果尚不明确。摘要未说明该方法在处理非文本数据（如蛋白质序列）时的有效性。

papers.title: Epistemic Bias Injection: Biasing LLMs via Selective Context Retrieval
papers.text:
title: Epistemic Bias Injection: Biasing LLMs via Selective Context Retrieval
source: arXiv
topics: 
category: foundation_model
why: 这篇工作偏基础模型/Agent方向，可能影响病原检测任务的建模上限，值得关注其任务定义与评测设计。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: When answering user queries, LLMs often retrieve knowledge from external sources stored in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) databases. These are often populated from unvetted sources, e.g. the open web, and can contain maliciously crafted data. This paper studies attacks that can manipulate the context retrieved by LLMs from such RAG databases. Prior work on such context manipulation primarily injects false or toxic content, which can often be detected by fact-checking or linguistic analysis. We reveal a more subtle threat, Epistemic Bias Injection (EBI), in which adversaries inject factually correct yet epistemically biased passages that systematically emphasize one side of a multi-viewpoint issue. Although linguistically coherent and truthful, such adversarial passages effectively crowd out alternative viewpoints and steer model outputs toward an attacker-chosen stance. As a core contribution, we propose a novel characterization of the problem: We give a geometric metric that quantifies epistemic bias. This metric can be computed directly on embeddings of text passages retrieved by the LLM. Leveraging this metric, we construct EBI attacks and develop a lightweight prototype defense called BiasDef for them. We evaluate them both on a comprehensive benchmark constructed from public question answering datasets.Our results show that: (1) the proposed attack induces significant perspective shifts, effectively evading existing retrieval-based sanitization defenses, and (2) BiasDef substantially reduces adversarial retrieval and bias in LLM's answers. Overall, this demonstrates the new threat as well as the ease of employing epistemic bias metrics for filtering in RAG-enabled LLMs.

papers.title: BeliefShift: Benchmarking Temporal Belief Consistency and Opinion Drift in LLM Agents
papers.text:
title: BeliefShift: Benchmarking Temporal Belief Consistency and Opinion Drift in LLM Agents
source: arXiv
topics: 
category: dataset
why: 这篇工作偏数据集或基准构建，适合判断是否能作为病原组学训练或评测资源。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: LLMs are increasingly used as long-running conversational agents, yet every major benchmark evaluating their memory treats user information as static facts to be stored and retrieved. That's the wrong model. People change their minds, and over extended interactions, phenomena like opinion drift, over-alignment, and confirmation bias start to matter a lot. BeliefShift introduces a longitudinal benchmark designed specifically to evaluate belief dynamics in multi-session LLM interactions. It covers three tracks: Temporal Belief Consistency, Contradiction Detection, and Evidence-Driven Revision. The dataset includes 2,400 human-annotated multi-session interaction trajectories spanning health, politics, personal values, and product preferences. We evaluate seven models including GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Gemini 1.5 Pro, LLaMA-3, and Mistral-Large under zero-shot and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) settings. Results reveal a clear trade-off: models that personalize aggressively resist drift poorly, while factually grounded models miss legitimate belief updates. We further introduce four novel evaluation metrics: Belief Revision Accuracy (BRA), Drift Coherence Score (DCS), Contradiction Resolution Rate (CRR), and Evidence Sensitivity Index (ESI).

papers.title: Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Financial Document Question Answering
papers.text:
title: Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Financial Document Question Answering
source: arXiv
topics: 
category: foundation_model
why: 这篇工作偏基础模型/Agent方向，可能影响病原检测任务的建模上限，值得关注其任务定义与评测设计。
abstract_zh: 金融文档问答（QA）要求对企业报告中分散的结构化表格、文本叙述和脚注进行复杂的多步数值推理。现有的检索增强生成（RAG）方法多采用单次“检索-生成”范式，难以处理金融分析中常见的组合推理链。本文提出 FinAgent-RAG，一种代理式 RAG 框架，通过自验证机制编排迭代检索-推理循环，专为满足金融数值推理的精度需求而设计。该框架包含三项核心创新：(1) 采用难负样本挖掘训练的对比金融检索器，用于区分语义相似但数值不同的金融片段；(2) 思维程序（PoT）推理模块，通过生成可执行 Python 代码进行精确算术运算，避免 LLM 直接计算的错误；(3) 自适应策略路由，根据问题复杂度动态分配资源，在 FinQA 数据集上降低了 41.3% 的 API 成本。在 FinQA、ConvFinQA 和 TAT-QA 基准测试中，该框架分别达到 76.81%、78.46% 和 74.96% 的执行准确率，较强基线提升了 5.62-9.32 个百分点。
abstract: Financial document question answering (QA) demands complex multi-step numerical reasoning over heterogeneous evidence--structured tables, textual narratives, and footnotes--scattered across corporate filings. Existing retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) approaches adopt a single-pass retrieve-then-generate paradigm that struggles with the compositional reasoning chains prevalent in financial analysis. We propose FinAgent-RAG, an agentic RAG framework that orchestrates iterative retrieval-reasoning loops with self-verification, specifically engineered for the precision requirements of financial numerical reasoning. The framework integrates three domain-specific innovations: (1) a Contrastive Financial Retriever trained with hard negative mining to distinguish semantically similar but numerically distinct financial passages, (2) a Program-of-Thought reasoning module that generates executable Python code for precise arithmetic rather than relying on error-prone LLM-based mental computation, and (3) an Adaptive Strategy Router that dynamically allocates computational resources based on question complexity, reducing API costs by 41.3% on FinQA while preserving accuracy. Extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets--FinQA, ConvFinQA, and TAT-QA--demonstrate that FinAgent-RAG achieves 76.81%, 78.46%, and 74.96% execution accuracy respectively, outperforming the strongest baseline by 5.62--9.32 percentage points. Ablation studies, cross-backbone evaluation with four LLMs, and deployment cost analysis confirm the framework's robustness and practical viability for financial institutions.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究针对金融领域复杂文档问答任务，提出了名为 **FinAgent-RAG** 的代理式检索增强生成框架。其核心是通过迭代的“检索-推理”循环和自验证机制，解决跨表格、文本和脚注的异构数据推理难题，重点提升数值计算的准确性与推理链的完整性。

## 为什么相关
虽然该论文以金融为应用场景，但其处理**异构证据（表格+文本+脚注）**和**多步数值推理**的方法论，与临床微生物学及基因组学高度相关。在病原检测中，研究者常需整合临床生化表（结构化数据）、病历描述（非结构化文本）及耐药基因组注释（复杂细节），FinAgent-RAG 的多步推理逻辑可直接借鉴用于病原体致病性评估或耐药表型预测。

## 新颖度判断
**新颖度较高（6.5/10）**。该工作并非简单的 RAG 堆叠，其创新点在于：1. 针对数值敏感性设计的对比检索器；2. 将 LLM 推理转化为 Python 代码执行（PoT），解决了大模型在处理临床或金融数据时常见的“幻觉计算”问题；3. 引入了成本感知的自适应路由机制。

## 方法与证据
- **方法**：采用难负样本挖掘（Hard Negative Mining）训练检索器；利用思维程序（Program-of-Thought）生成 Python 代码；设计自适应策略路由。  
- **实验对象**：FinQA、ConvFinQA 和 TAT-QA 三个金融问答基准数据集。  
- **指标结论**：在 FinQA 上准确率达 76.81%，ConvFinQA 达 78.46%，TAT-QA 达 74.96%。相比基线提升 5.62-9.32%。在保证准确率的同时，FinQA 上的 API 调用成本降低了 41.3%。

## 应用价值
对于病原生信领域，该框架的 PoT 模块可用于自动化处理复杂的生物信息学定量分析流程（如丰度计算、差异表达分析），而其对比检索器可用于从海量文献中精准区分序列相似但功能不同的基因变异描述。其自适应路由机制对于构建低成本的临床辅助决策 Agent 具有参考意义。

## 局限与风险
- **领域迁移风险**：摘要未说明该框架在金融以外领域（如生物医学）的泛化表现。  
- **模型依赖**：虽然进行了跨骨干网评估，但摘要未明确说明在开源小参数模型上的性能表现。  
- **实时性**：迭代检索-推理循环虽然提高了精度，但可能增加推理延迟，摘要未提供端到端响应时间的具体数据。

papers.title: RAISE: RAG Design as an Architecture Search Problem
papers.text:
title: RAISE: RAG Design as an Architecture Search Problem
source: arXiv
topics: 
category: dataset
why: 这篇工作偏数据集或基准构建，适合判断是否能作为病原组学训练或评测资源。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems expose numerous design choices spanning query rewriting, chunking, retrieval depth, reranking, and context compression. In practice, these choices are often configured through heuristics, hindering systematic evaluation and reproducibility across settings. We argue that this challenge is best formulated as RAG architecture search. To support controlled and reproducible study of this problem, we introduce the RAG Intelligence Search Engine (RAISE), a comprehensive framework and benchmark for RAG hyperparameter optimization, which evaluates optimization methods for RAG pipelines under standardized search spaces and budgets. RAISE implements 13 search algorithms and evaluates them across seven public text and multimodal datasets using three random seeds. Our experiments show that optimization performance is highly task-dependent: methods that perform strongly on one dataset may not generalize consistently across others, cautioning against interpreting aggregate rankings as evidence of universally superior strategies. RAISE provides a common experimental substrate for fair, reproducible, and systematic research on RAG hyperparameter optimization.

abstract_zh: 
abstract: Existing memory-augmented LLM agents often treat memory as a static repository with pre-defined representations and fixed retrieval pipelines, which is brittle in dynamic agentic environments where feedback, task variation, and heterogeneous signals continuously reshape what should be remembered and how it should be connected. To address this, we propose FluxMem, a connectivity-evolving memory framework that models memory as a heterogeneous graph and progressively refines its topology through three stages: initial connection formation, feedback-driven refinement, and long-term consolidation. During execution, FluxMem repairs missing links, prunes interference, aligns abstraction granularity, and distills recurrent successful trajectories into reusable procedural circuits, guided by one metric for memory generalizability and evolutionary maturity. Across three fundamentally distinct benchmarks including LoCoMo, Mind2Web, and GAIA, FluxMem achieves consistent state-of-the-art performance, demonstrating strong adaptation and generalization in complex agentic environments. The code will be open-sourced in https://github.com/zjunlp/LightMem.

title: Unusual predominance of Staphylococcus aureus in the salivary microbiome of children with Early Childhood Caries in Kano, Nigeria
source: medRxiv
topics: foundation_model_agent
category: methods
why: 这篇工作更像方法创新，可能直接关联 metagenomics、long-read 或 pathogen identification 流程优化。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: Background The microbial aetiology of early childhood caries (ECC) in sub-Saharan African populations remains poorly characterised, with most studies focusing on conventional cariogenic pathogens like Streptococcus mutans. This study aimed to characterise the salivary microbial profile of children with ECC in urban Kano, northern Nigeria. Methods In this cross-sectional study of 162 children aged 3-5 years in urban Kano, unstimulated saliva samples were collected and analysed using standard bacteriological culture methods. Caries status was assessed using decayed, missing, and filled teeth (dmft) index and International Caries Detection and Assessment System (ICDAS). Microbial isolates were identified through Gram staining, colony morphology, and biochemical tests (catalase, coagulase, oxidase). Results Of 32 microbial isolates obtained, Staphylococcus aureus was the most prevalent (43.8%, n=14), followed by Streptococcus species (28.1%, n=9), Klebsiella species (12.5%, n=4), non-aureus staphylococci (6.3%, n=2), yeast (6.3%, n=2), and Pseudomonas species (3.1%, n=1). Only one isolate demonstrated direct association with dmft-detectable caries. Polymicrobial colonisation occurred in four cases (12.5%), predominantly featuring S. aureus-yeast combinations (n=2). White spot lesions (ICDAS 1-2) were associated with S. aureus and Klebsiella species in two separate cases. Conclusion This study reveals an unexpected predominance of S. aureus in the salivary microbiome of children in northern Nigeria, challenging conventional paradigms of ECC microbiology. The low correlation between microbial isolates and clinical caries suggests complex, multifactorial aetiology. These findings highlight the need for molecular characterisation of oral microbiomes in African populations and reconsideration of caries pathogenesis models in this unique epidemiological context.

The work aims to provide scientists, regulators, and policymakers with a toolkit to discuss beneficial innovation in genomic AI while maintaining robust safeguards against harm and misuse.

papers.title: CARROT: A Learned Cost-Constrained Retrieval Optimization System for RAG
papers.text:
title: CARROT: A Learned Cost-Constrained Retrieval Optimization System for RAG
source: arXiv
topics: foundation_model_agent
category: foundation_model
why: 这篇工作偏基础模型/Agent方向，可能影响病原检测任务的建模上限，值得关注其任务定义与评测设计。
abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）在生成和推理中常面临知识更新滞后及幻觉问题。检索增强生成（RAG）通过引入外部知识块来缓解此问题，但现有系统存在三大挑战：知识块检索相互独立，忽略了冗余和顺序等相关性；知识块效用呈非单调性，增加数量可能降低生成质量；检索策略难以适应不同查询的特性。为此，本研究提出了 CARROT，一个受成本约束的 RAG 检索优化框架。该框架采用蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）策略，通过考虑块间相关性来寻找最优的知识块组合顺序。针对效用非单调性，设计了效用计算策略以识别最优组合，而非盲目耗尽预算。此外，引入配置代理（Configuration Agent）为不同查询领域预测最佳配置。实验结果显示，CARROT 较基准模型性能提升高达 30%，证明了其在处理复杂检索任务中的有效性、可扩展性与适应性。
abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive ability in generation and reasoning tasks but struggle with handling up-to-date knowledge, leading to inaccuracies or hallucinations. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) mitigates this by retrieving and incorporating external knowledge into input prompts. In particular, due to LLMs' context window limitations and long-context hallucinations, only the most relevant "chunks" are retrieved. However, current RAG systems face three key challenges: (1) chunks are often retrieved independently without considering their relationships, such as redundancy and ordering; (2) the utility of chunks is non-monotonic, as adding more chunks can degrade quality; and (3) retrieval strategies fail to adapt to the unique characteristics of different queries. To overcome these challenges, we design a cost-constrained retrieval optimization framework for RAG. We adopt a Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) based strategy to find the optimal chunk combination order, which considers the chunks' correlations. In addition, to address the non-monotonicity of chunk utility, instead of treating budget exhaustion as the termination condition, we design a utility computation strategy to identify the optimal chunk combination without necessarily exhausting the budget. Furthermore, we propose a configuration agent that predicts optimal configurations for each query domain, improving our framework's adaptability and efficiency. Experimental results demonstrate up to a 30% improvement over baseline models, highlighting the framework's effectiveness, scalability, and suitability. Our source code has been released at https://github.com/wang0702/CARROT.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究提出了名为 CARROT 的 RAG 检索优化框架，旨在解决 RAG 系统中知识块相关性缺失、效用非单调性以及策略固定化三大核心痛点。其核心组件包括基于蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）的块组合优化器、非单调效用计算策略以及针对特定领域的配置代理。

## 为什么相关
在病原生物学和临床微生物学领域，文献和基因组数据库更新极快。传统的 RAG 系统若只是简单堆砌检索到的序列片段或文献摘要，往往会因为冗余信息或上下文干扰导致 AI 误判。CARROT 提出的成本约束和效用优化机制，对于构建高准确度、低延迟的病原检测辅助决策系统（如从海量文献中精准提取耐药性证据）具有重要的底层支撑作用。

## 新颖度判断
新颖度中等偏上。虽然 MCTS 在路径搜索中已有应用，但将其引入 RAG 的知识块排序与组合优化，并明确提出“非单调效用”（即更多信息不一定更好）的计算策略，在当前的检索增强生成领域具有较强的针对性和启发性。

## 方法与证据
1. **MCTS 策略**：用于在搜索空间内寻找考虑了冗余和顺序的最优知识块排列。
2. **效用计算**：不再以预算耗尽为终止条件，而是动态识别效用峰值，避免引入干扰噪声。
3. **配置代理**：针对不同 query domain 自动调整参数。
**证据**：实验结果表明，CARROT 在对比基准模型时，性能指标提升了最高 30%（摘要未说明具体数据集名称，但强调了跨领域的适应性）。

## 应用价值
对于需要处理长文本、多来源数据的生信分析任务，CARROT 提供了一种更智能的“上下文管理”方案。它能帮助研究人员在有限的 Token 预算内，筛选出对病原鉴定或蛋白质功能预测最有价值的知识组合，提高 Agent 在复杂生物医学问答中的逻辑严密性。

## 局限与风险
1. **计算开销**：引入 MCTS 可能会增加推理过程中的计算延迟，摘要未详细说明其时间成本。
2. **领域泛化**：虽然提到了配置代理，但在极端专业的临床微生物数据（如复杂的基因组注释）上的表现尚未给出具体证据。
3. **黑盒性质**：效用计算策略的判定标准在摘要中未明确，可能存在对特定模型偏好的过拟合风险。

papers.title: From Entity-Centric to Goal-Oriented Graphs: Enhancing LLM Knowledge Retrieval in Minecraft
papers.text:
title: From Entity-Centric to Goal-Oriented Graphs: Enhancing LLM Knowledge Retrieval in Minecraft
source: arXiv
topics: foundation_model_agent
category: foundation_model
why: 这篇工作偏基础模型/Agent方向，可能影响病原检测任务的建模上限，值得关注其任务定义与评测设计。
abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）在通用能力上表现出色，但在处理复杂交互环境中的分步程序化推理时常面临挑战。虽然像 GraphRAG 这样的检索增强方法试图弥补这一差距，但其碎片化的实体关系图阻碍了连贯多步计划的构建。本文提出了一种基于目标导向图（Goal-Oriented Graphs, GoGs）的新型框架，其中每个节点代表一个目标，边则编码目标间的逻辑依赖关系。该结构通过识别高层目标并递归检索其先决条件，显式检索出因果推理路径，从而形成引导 LLM 的连贯链条。在需要鲁棒多步规划和丰富程序化知识的 Minecraft 测试平台上进行的广泛实验表明，GoG 显著提升了程序化推理能力，其表现大幅超越了 GraphRAG 及其他最先进的基准模型，为复杂环境下的任务规划提供了新方案。
abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate impressive general capabilities but often struggle with step-by-step procedural reasoning, a critical challenge in complex interactive environments. While retrieval-augmented methods like GraphRAG attempt to bridge this gap, their fragmented entity-relation graphs hinder the construction of coherent, multi-step plans. In this paper, we propose a novel framework based on Goal-Oriented Graphs (GoGs), where each node represents a goal and edges encode logical dependencies between them. This structure enables the explicit retrieval of causal reasoning paths by identifying a high-level goal and recursively retrieving its prerequisites, forming a coherent chain to guide the LLM. Through extensive experiments on the Minecraft testbed, a domain that demands robust multi-step planning and provides rich procedural knowledge, we demonstrate that GoG substantially improves procedural reasoning and significantly outperforms GraphRAG and other state-of-the-art baselines.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究针对 LLM 在复杂交互环境中多步推理能力不足的问题，提出了“目标导向图”（GoG）框架。该框架将知识库从传统的“实体-关系”结构转变为“目标-依赖”结构，通过递归检索目标的先决条件来生成连贯的推理链条，旨在解决 GraphRAG 等方法在处理程序化任务时知识碎片化的问题。

## 为什么相关
虽然本研究的实验对象是 Minecraft 游戏，但其核心逻辑与病原生信及临床微生物学中的复杂任务高度相关。例如，病原体鉴定、耐药性分析或多组学数据整合通常涉及严密的逻辑步骤和前置条件（如：必须先完成质量控制和序列比对，才能进行变异调用）。这种从“实体中心”向“目标导向”的转变，为构建能够自主执行复杂生物信息学流程的 AI Agent 提供了建模思路。

## 新颖度判断
新颖度中等偏低（0.25）。其创新点在于对检索增强生成（RAG）中图结构的重新定义，将知识图谱的节点从静态实体改为动态目标，并引入了递归检索机制。这种方法是对现有 GraphRAG 技术的垂直改进，而非底层架构的颠覆。

## 方法与证据
研究提出了 GoG 框架，其核心方法是：1. 将知识建模为节点（目标）和有向边（逻辑依赖）；2. 采用递归检索策略，从高层目标出发追溯所有必要的先决条件。实验在 Minecraft 测试平台上进行，该平台要求模型具备极强的多步规划能力。实验结果显示，GoG 在程序化推理指标上显著优于 GraphRAG 和其他 SOTA（最先进）基准模型，证明了因果推理路径在复杂任务中的有效性。

## 应用价值
在病原生信领域，该方法可用于开发“实验设计 Agent”或“自动化分析 Pipeline”。通过将复杂的生物学实验协议或生信分析流程转化为目标导向图，LLM 可以更准确地检索每一步的先决条件，减少在长流程任务中的逻辑断裂，提高自动化分析的成功率。

## 局限与风险
摘要未说明 GoG 图结构的构建成本，特别是对于专业性极强的临床微生物学知识，是否需要专家手动定义目标间的逻辑依赖。此外，摘要未提及在面对知识库中存在逻辑冲突或循环依赖时的处理机制，且实验仅限于 Minecraft 环境，其在真实科研场景中的泛化能力尚待验证。

why: 这篇工作更像方法创新，可能直接关联 metagenomics、long-read 或 pathogen identification 流程优化。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: Recommendation systems often suffer from data sparsity caused by limited user-item interactions, which degrade their performance and amplify popularity bias in real-world scenarios. This paper proposes a novel data augmentation framework that leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) and item textual descriptions to enrich interaction data. By few-shot prompting LLMs multiple times to rerank items and aggregating the results via majority voting, we generate high-confidence synthetic user-item interactions, supported by theoretical guarantees based on the concentration of measure. To effectively leverage the augmented data in the context of a graph recommendation system, we integrate it into a graph contrastive learning framework to mitigate distributional shift and alleviate popularity bias. Extensive experiments show that our method improves accuracy and reduces popularity bias, outperforming strong baselines.

papers.title: Link Prediction for Event Logs in the Process Industry
papers.text:
title: Link Prediction for Event Logs in the Process Industry
source: arXiv
topics: foundation_model_agent
category: general
why: arXiv 上的新论文与 foundation_model_agent 相关，可用于补充你当前的病原检测与模型监控视角。
abstract_zh: 在基于图的检索增强生成（RAG）时代，链路预测是提升领域特定数据质量的关键预处理步骤。流程工业中的知识管理利用 RAG 应用优化运营并确保安全，但面临交接班日志（shift books）中事件记录碎片化的挑战，即属于同一事件的相关记录往往被分散存储。这种碎片化阻碍了向生产现场用户推荐既往解决方案。为解决该问题，本研究开发了一种记录链接模型，并将其定义为跨文档共指消解（CDCR）任务。该模型结合了先进的 CDCR 模型与自然语言推理（NLI）及语义文本相似度（STS）原理进行链路预测。评估结果显示，该模型性能优于 NLP 和 STS 基准模型，提升幅度分别为 28%（11.43 个百分点）和 27.4%（11.21 个百分点）。研究证明，通用 NLP 任务经调整后可应用于德国流程工业特定领域，显著提升日志数据的质量与连接性。
abstract: In the era of graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), link prediction is a significant preprocessing step for improving the quality of fragmented or incomplete domain-specific data for the graph retrieval. Knowledge management in the process industry uses RAG-based applications to optimize operations, ensure safety, and facilitate continuous improvement by effectively leveraging operational data and past insights. A key challenge in this domain is the fragmented nature of event logs in shift books, where related records are often kept separate, even though they belong to a single event or process. This fragmentation hinders the recommendation of previously implemented solutions to users, which is crucial in the timely problem-solving at live production sites. To address this problem, we develop a record linking model, which we define as a cross-document coreference resolution (CDCR) task. Record linking adapts the task definition of CDCR and combines two state-of-the-art CDCR models with the principles of natural language inference (NLI) and semantic text similarity (STS) to perform link prediction. The evaluation shows that our record linking model outperformed the best versions of our baselines, i.e., NLP and STS, by 28% (11.43 p) and 27.4% (11.21 p), respectively. Our work demonstrates that common NLP tasks can be combined and adapted to a domain-specific setting of the German process industry, improving data quality and connectivity in shift logs.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究针对流程工业（Process Industry）中交接班日志数据碎片化的问题，提出了一种基于跨文档共指消解（CDCR）的记录链接模型。其核心目标是通过链路预测技术，将分散在不同记录中但属于同一事件的信息重新关联，从而为基于图的检索增强生成（Graph-RAG）提供高质量、连通性强的数据基础。

## 为什么相关
**弱相关。** 尽管该论文的研究背景是德国流程工业的生产日志，但其核心方法论对临床微生物学和病原基因组学具有借鉴意义。在临床场景中，同一患者的病原检测结果、抗生素处方和临床表现往往散落在不同的电子病历（EHR）或实验室信息系统（LIS）记录中。这种“碎片化记录”的关联问题与本文提出的 CDCR 任务高度相似，可用于构建更精准的临床决策支持 Agent 或病原溯源知识图谱。

## 新颖度判断
**中等偏高。** 该研究的新颖之处在于将工业领域的记录链接问题（Record Linking）重新定义为 NLP 领域的跨文档共指消解（CDCR）任务，并创新性地融合了自然语言推理（NLI）和语义文本相似度（STS）两种技术路径。这种多任务融合的方法在处理具有高度专业性、非结构化的工业文本时表现出了比传统方法更强的鲁棒性。

## 方法与证据
研究者采用了结合 CDCR 模型、NLI 和 STS 原理的混合架构。实验对比了该模型与纯 NLP 基准及 STS 基准的性能。证据显示：该模型在链路预测任务上表现优异，相较于 NLP 基准提升了 28%（绝对值提升 11.43 p），相较于 STS 基准提升了 27.4%（绝对值提升 11.21 p）。摘要未说明具体使用的 CDCR 模型名称及训练数据集的具体规模。

## 应用价值
在实际生产环境中，该模型能够显著提升 Graph-RAG 系统的检索质量，帮助现场工程师快速获取历史故障的解决方案。在生物信息学领域，类似技术可用于整合异构数据库中的蛋白质功能注释或基因组变异记录，提高知识图谱的完整度。

## 局限与风险
1. **领域局限性**：研究明确指出是针对“德国流程工业”，其模型在处理中文临床术语或高度专业化的生物医学词汇时的迁移能力尚不明确。
2. **数据规模未知**：摘要未说明实验所用的交接班日志数据量，难以评估模型在大规模工业数据下的计算开销。
3. **实时性挑战**：CDCR 任务通常计算复杂度较高，对于需要实时响应的生产现场或临床诊断场景，其推理延迟可能是一个潜在风险。

papers.title: Differentially Private Synthetic Text Generation for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

title: Differentially Private Synthetic Text Generation for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
source: arXiv
topics: foundation_model_agent
category: methods
why: 这篇工作更像方法创新，可能直接关联 metagenomics、long-read 或 pathogen identification 流程优化。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enhances large language models (LLMs) by grounding them in external knowledge. However, its application in sensitive domains is limited by privacy risks. Existing private RAG methods typically rely on query-time differential privacy (DP), which requires repeated noise injection and leads to accumulated privacy loss. To address this issue, we propose DP-SynRAG, a framework that uses LLMs to generate differentially private synthetic RAG databases. Unlike prior methods, the synthetic text can be reused once created, thereby avoiding repeated noise injection and additional privacy costs. To preserve essential information for downstream RAG tasks, DP-SynRAG extends private prediction, which instructs LLMs to generate text that mimics subsampled database records in a DP manner. Experiments show that DP-SynRAG achieves superior performance to the state-of-the-art private RAG systems while maintaining a fixed privacy budget, offering a scalable solution for privacy-preserving RAG.

abstract_zh: 
abstract: Computing has long served as a cornerstone of scientific discovery. Recently, a paradigm shift has emerged with the rise of large language models (LLMs), introducing autonomous systems, referred to as agents, that accelerate discovery across varying levels of autonomy. These language agents provide a flexible and versatile framework that orchestrates interactions with human scientists, natural language, computer language and code, and physics. This paper presents our view and vision of LLM-based scientific agents and their growing role in transforming the scientific discovery lifecycle, from hypothesis discovery, experimental design and execution, to result analysis and refinement. We critically examine current methodologies, emphasizing key innovations, practical achievements, and outstanding limitations. Additionally, we identify open research challenges and outline promising directions for building more robust, generalizable, and adaptive scientific agents. Our analysis highlights the transformative potential of autonomous agents to accelerate scientific discovery across diverse domains.

papers.text:
title: AtlasKV: Augmenting LLMs with Billion-Scale Knowledge Graphs in 20GB VRAM
source: arXiv
topics: foundation_model_agent
category: methods
why: 这篇工作更像方法创新，可能直接关联 metagenomics、long-read 或 pathogen identification 流程优化。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) has shown some success in augmenting large language models (LLMs) with external knowledge. However, as a non-parametric knowledge integration paradigm for LLMs, RAG methods heavily rely on external retrieval modules and the retrieved textual context prior. Especially for very large scale knowledge augmentation, they would introduce substantial inference latency due to expensive searches and much longer relevant context. In this paper, we propose a parametric knowledge integration method, called \textbf{AtlasKV}, a scalable, effective, and general way to augment LLMs with billion-scale knowledge graphs (KGs) (e.g. 1B triples) using very little GPU memory cost (e.g. less than 20GB VRAM). In AtlasKV, we introduce KG2KV and HiKVP to integrate KG triples into LLMs at scale with sub-linear time and memory complexity. It maintains strong knowledge grounding and generalization performance using the LLMs' inherent attention mechanism, and requires no external retrievers, long context priors, or retraining when adapting to new knowledge.

papers.title: MAGMA: A Multi-Graph based Agentic Memory Architecture for AI Agents
papers.text:
title: MAGMA: A Multi-Graph based Agentic Memory Architecture for AI Agents
source: arXiv
topics: foundation_model_agent
category: general
why: arXiv 上的新论文与 foundation_model_agent 相关，可用于补充你当前的病原检测与模型监控视角。
abstract_zh: 存储增强生成（MAG）通过外部存储扩展大语言模型以支持长上下文推理，但现有方法主要依赖单一存储库的语义相似性检索，导致时间、因果和实体信息相互纠缠。这种设计限制了查询意图与检索证据之间的可解释性与对齐，进而降低了推理准确性。本文提出 MAGMA，一种基于多图的智能体记忆架构，将每个记忆项分别表示在正交的语义、时间、因果和实体图中。MAGMA 将检索过程定义为在这些关系视图上的策略引导遍历，实现了查询自适应选择和结构化上下文构建。通过将记忆表示与检索逻辑解耦，MAGMA 提供了透明的推理路径和细粒度的检索控制。在 LoCoMo 和 LongMemEval 基准测试上的实验结果表明，MAGMA 在长周期推理任务中持续优于现有的最先进智能体记忆系统。
abstract: Memory-Augmented Generation (MAG) extends Large Language Models with external memory to support long-context reasoning, but existing approaches largely rely on semantic similarity over monolithic memory stores, entangling temporal, causal, and entity information. This design limits interpretability and alignment between query intent and retrieved evidence, leading to suboptimal reasoning accuracy. In this paper, we propose MAGMA, a multi-graph agentic memory architecture that represents each memory item across orthogonal semantic, temporal, causal, and entity graphs. MAGMA formulates retrieval as policy-guided traversal over these relational views, enabling query-adaptive selection and structured context construction. By decoupling memory representation from retrieval logic, MAGMA provides transparent reasoning paths and fine-grained control over retrieval. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval demonstrate that MAGMA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art agentic memory systems in long-horizon reasoning tasks.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究提出了一种名为 MAGMA 的多图智能体记忆架构，旨在解决大语言模型在长上下文推理中记忆检索不精准的问题。MAGMA 放弃了传统的单一语义向量存储，转而采用语义、时间、因果和实体四个正交的图结构来组织记忆，并通过策略引导的遍历算法实现精准检索。

## 为什么相关
在病原生物学和临床微生物学领域，分析病原体演化（时间维度）、致病机制（因果维度）以及宿主-病原体相互作用（实体维度）需要处理极其复杂的长程关联。MAGMA 提供的多维度记忆管理机制，可用于构建能够理解复杂临床病史、追踪疫情暴发时间线或分析基因调控网络的专业 AI Agent，提升其在处理非结构化生物医学文献时的逻辑推理能力。

## 新颖度判断
该研究具有较高的新颖度。其核心创新在于将“记忆表示”与“检索逻辑”解耦，并引入了“正交图”概念，打破了目前主流 RAG（检索增强生成）仅依赖语义相似性的局限。这种多维度的结构化记忆更符合人类专家处理复杂科学问题的思维模式。

## 方法与证据
- **方法**：构建了四个正交图（语义、时间、因果、实体）；引入策略引导遍历（Policy-guided traversal）进行查询自适应选择。
- **证据**：在两个长周期推理基准测试 **LoCoMo** 和 **LongMemEval** 上进行了实验。结果显示 MAGMA 在推理准确性上持续超越（outperforms）现有的最先进（SOTA）智能体记忆系统。摘要未提供具体的百分比提升数值。

## 应用价值
对于临床微生物学 AI 助手，MAGMA 的架构允许开发者对检索过程进行细粒度控制。例如，在诊断罕见感染时，可以强制 AI 优先检索“因果图”中的致病机理或“时间图”中的症状演变，提供具有透明推理路径的诊断建议，增强临床决策的可信度。

## 局限与风险
- **计算开销**：摘要未说明维护四个并行图结构以及执行策略引导遍历带来的额外计算成本和延迟。
- **构建难度**：如何从原始文本中准确提取并构建“因果图”和“实体图”是关键，摘要未详细说明这些图的自动化构建算法及其准确率。
- **弱 AI 交叉**：该论文属于通用 AI 架构研究，并非专门针对生物医学设计，在处理高度专业化的生物信息学数据时，其图节点的定义和提取规则需要重新适配。

papers.text:
title: Toward Autonomous Computational Catalysis Research via Agentic Systems
source: arXiv
topics: foundation_model_agent
category: foundation_model
why: 这篇工作偏基础模型/Agent方向，可能影响病原检测任务的建模上限，值得关注其任务定义与评测设计。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: Fully autonomous science has long been a defining ambition for artificial intelligence in materials discovery, yet its realization requires more than automating isolated calculations. In computational catalysis, a system autonomously navigating the entire research lifecycle from conception to a scientifically meaningful manuscript remains an open challenge. Here we present CatMaster, a catalysis-native multi-agent framework that couples project-level reasoning with the direct execution of atomistic simulations, machine-learning modelling, literature analysis, and manuscript production within a unified autonomous architecture. Across progressively more realistic research settings, CatMaster converts natural-language intent into executable computational tasks, achieves near-ceiling scores on standard catalysis scenarios, reaches near-leaderboard performance on five of six MatBench tasks, performs autonomous modelling on various catalytic surfaces and reaction pathway investigations, and demonstrates the close-loop autonomy by a fully closed-loop single-atom catalyst design case. These results establish autonomous computational catalysis as an already operational scientific paradigm, while highlighting that bridging the gap to complex physical challenges and genuine scientific closure requires tighter integration with human stewardship and domain-rigorous methodologies in the future.

papers.title: ThunderAgent: A Simple, Fast and Program-Aware Agentic Inference System
papers.text:
title: ThunderAgent: A Simple, Fast and Program-Aware Agentic Inference System
source: arXiv
topics: foundation_model_agent
category: foundation_model
why: 这篇工作偏基础模型/Agent方向，可能影响病原检测任务的建模上限，值得关注其任务定义与评测设计。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: Large language models(LLMs) are now used to power complex multi-turn agentic workflows. Existing systems run agentic inference by loosely assembling isolated components: an LLM inference engine (e.g., vLLM) and a tool orchestrator (e.g., Kubernetes). Although agentic workflows involve multiple LLM and tool requests, these systems schedule and allocate resources separately on a per-request basis, without end-to-end knowledge of the workflow. This leads to sub-optimal management of KV cache and tool execution environments. To address the challenges, we propose ThunderAgent, a fast, simple, and program-aware agentic inference system. We first abstract agentic workflows as LLM Programs, enabling a unified view of heterogeneous resources, including KV caches, system states, and external tool assets such as disk memory and network ports. Built upon this abstraction, ThunderAgent introduces a program-aware scheduler and a tool resource manager designed to maximize KV cache hit rates, mitigate memory imbalances, and enable asynchronous environment preparation. Evaluations across coding, routing, and scientific discovery agents demonstrate that ThunderAgent achieves 1.5-3.6x throughput improvements in serving, 1.8-3.9x in RL rollout, and up to 4.2x disk memory savings compared to state-of-the-art inference systems. To facilitate reproducibility and support future development, we open-source the system implementations of the whole ThunderAgent at: https://github.com/Agentic-Kinetics/ThunderAgent.

papers.title: CausalEvolve: Towards Open-Ended Discovery with Causal Scratchpad
papers.text:
title: CausalEvolve: Towards Open-Ended Discovery with Causal Scratchpad
source: arXiv
topics: foundation_model_agent
category: foundation_model
why: 这篇工作偏基础模型/Agent方向，可能影响病原检测任务的建模上限，值得关注其任务定义与评测设计。
abstract_zh: AlphaEvolve 等基于进化的智能体在利用大语言模型（LLMs）构建“AI 科学家”方面取得了显著进展。这些智能体通过迭代改进和演化程序，利用 LLM 的先验知识和推理能力来解决开放式科学问题。然而，现有方法缺乏针对性的演化指导，且无法有效组织和利用过去的演化经验，导致演化效率下降，并在接近性能边界时出现振荡。为弥补这一缺陷，本研究开发了 CausalEvolve，其核心是配备了“因果草稿卡”（Causal Scratchpad），利用 LLM 识别并推理演化的指导因素。在演化初期，CausalEvolve 首先识别能为改进目标提供补充灵感的结果级因素；在演化过程中，它会检查演化中的“惊喜模式”（surprise patterns），并通过溯因推理假设新因素，从而开辟新方向。在 4 个挑战性的开放式科学任务中的实验表明，CausalEvolve 有效提升了演化效率，并发现了更优的解决方案。
abstract: Evolve-based agent such as AlphaEvolve is one of the notable successes in using Large Language Models (LLMs) to build AI Scientists. These agents tackle open-ended scientific problems by iteratively improving and evolving programs, leveraging the prior knowledge and reasoning capabilities of LLMs. Despite the success, existing evolve-based agents lack targeted guidance for evolution and effective mechanisms for organizing and utilizing knowledge acquired from past evolutionary experience. Consequently, they suffer from decreasing evolution efficiency and exhibit oscillatory behavior when approaching known performance boundaries. To mitigate the gap, we develop CausalEvolve, equipped with a causal scratchpad that leverages LLMs to identify and reason about guiding factors for evolution. At the beginning, CausalEvolve first identifies outcome-level factors that offer complementary inspirations in improving the target objective. During the evolution, CausalEvolve also inspects surprise patterns during the evolution and abductive reasoning to hypothesize new factors, which in turn offer novel directions. Through comprehensive experiments, we show that CausalEvolve effectively improves the evolutionary efficiency and discovers better solutions in 4 challenging open-ended scientific tasks.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究提出了 CausalEvolve，一种旨在增强“AI 科学家”能力的进化型智能体框架。其核心是通过“因果草稿卡”（Causal Scratchpad）机制，解决 LLM 在驱动科学发现任务中演化效率低下和性能振荡的问题。该框架不仅依赖 LLM 的先验知识，还通过识别结果级因果因素和对演化过程中的异常（惊喜模式）进行溯因推理，动态生成新的演化方向。

## 为什么相关
在病原生物学和蛋白质组学领域，科学发现往往涉及极其复杂的开放式搜索空间（如蛋白质功能预测、耐药基因进化路径模拟）。CausalEvolve 提出的“因果指导演化”逻辑，可以被引入到病原体基因组建模或临床微生物诊断算法的自动优化中。特别是其处理“性能边界振荡”的能力，对于需要在高噪声生物数据中寻找最优解的任务具有借鉴意义。

## 新颖度判断
新颖度评分为 5.25（高）。相比于传统的 AlphaEvolve 等仅依赖迭代改进的智能体，CausalEvolve 的创新点在于引入了“因果因素推理”和“溯因推理”来指导演化。它不再是盲目地尝试程序变体，而是试图理解“为什么某些变体有效”，并利用这种因果理解来跨越已知的性能瓶颈。

## 方法与证据
- **方法**：开发了 CausalEvolve 框架，引入 Causal Scratchpad。具体步骤包括：1. 初始阶段识别结果级因素（outcome-level factors）；2. 演化中监控“惊喜模式”（surprise patterns）；3. 利用溯因推理（abductive reasoning）假设新因素。
- **证据**：在 4 个挑战性的开放式科学任务上进行了综合实验（摘要未说明具体任务名称，如是否包含生物信息学任务）。
- **指标**：实验结果显示其在演化效率（evolutionary efficiency）和最终解的质量（better solutions）上均有显著提升。

## 应用价值
该技术在临床微生物学与基因组学交叉领域具有潜在应用价值。例如，在设计针对新兴病原体的检测引物或分析流程时，CausalEvolve 可以作为底层引擎，自动演化并优化分析程序。其“因果草稿卡”可以帮助研究者理解模型改进的逻辑，而不仅仅是获得一个黑盒结果。

## 局限与风险
摘要未详细说明 4 个科学任务的具体领域，无法判断其在生物医学垂直领域的泛化能力。此外，依赖 LLM 进行“因果推理”和“溯因推理”可能存在幻觉风险，即模型可能会虚构出错误的因果关系来指导演化，导致搜索方向偏离。摘要亦未提及该框架在大规模计算资源消耗方面的表现。

papers.title: The Impact of Ideological Discourses in RAG: A Case Study with COVID-19 Treatments
papers.text:
title: The Impact of Ideological Discourses in RAG: A Case Study with COVID-19 Treatments
source: arXiv
topics: foundation_model_agent
category: dataset
why: 这篇工作偏数据集或基准构建，适合判断是否能作为病原组学训练或评测资源。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: This paper studies the impact of retrieved ideological texts on the outputs of large language models (LLMs). While interest in understanding ideology in LLMs has recently increased, little attention has been given to this issue in the context of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). To fill this gap, we design an external knowledge source based on ideological loaded texts about COVID-19 treatments. Our corpus is based on 1,117 academic articles representing discourses about controversial and endorsed treatments for the disease. We propose a corpus linguistics framework, based on Lexical Multidimensional Analysis (LMDA), to identify the ideologies within the corpus. LLMs are tasked to answer questions derived from three identified ideological dimensions, and two types of contextual prompts are adopted: the first comprises the user question and ideological texts; and the second contains the question, ideological texts, and LMDA descriptions. Ideological alignment between reference ideological texts and LLMs' responses is assessed using cosine similarity for lexical and semantic representations. Results demonstrate that LLMs' responses based on ideological retrieved texts are more aligned with the ideology encountered in the external knowledge, with the enhanced prompt further influencing LLMs' outputs. Our findings highlight the importance of identifying ideological discourses within the RAG framework in order to mitigate not just unintended ideological bias, but also the risks of malicious manipulation of such models.

papers.title: QiboAgent: a practitioner's guideline to open source assistants for Quantum Computing code development
papers.text:
title: QiboAgent: a practitioner's guideline to open source assistants for Quantum Computing code development
source: arXiv
topics: foundation_model_agent
category: methods
why: 这篇工作更像方法创新，可能直接关联 metagenomics、long-read 或 pathogen identification 流程优化。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: We introduce QiboAgent, a reference implementation designed to serve as a practitioner's guideline for developing specialized coding assistants in Quantum Computing middleware. Addressing the limitations in scientific software development of general-purpose proprietary models, we explore how lightweight, open-source Large Language Models (LLMs) provided with a custom workflow architecture compare. In detail, we experiment with two complementary paradigms: a Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipeline for high-precision information retrieval, and an autonomous agentic workflow for complex software engineering tasks. We observe that this hybrid approach significantly reduces hallucination rates in code generation compared to a proprietary baseline, achieving a peak accuracy of 90.2% with relatively small open-source models of size up to 30B parameters. Furthermore, the agentic framework exhibits advanced coding capabilities, automating the resolution of maintenance issues and new features requests, or by prototyping larger-scale refactors of the codebase, such as producing a compiled Rust module with bindings of an original pure python package, Qibo in our case. The LLM workflows used for our analysis are integrated into a user interface and a Model Context Protocol server, providing an accessible tool for Qibo developers.

papers.title: From Study Design to Executable Code: Automating Target Trial Emulation with Large Language Models
papers.text:
title: From Study Design to Executable Code: Automating Target Trial Emulation with Large Language Models
source: medRxiv
topics: foundation_model_agent
category: methods
why: 这篇工作更像方法创新，可能直接关联 metagenomics、long-read 或 pathogen identification 流程优化。
abstract_zh: 实施目标试验模拟（TTE）研究并生成端到端可执行分析代码具有极高的技术门槛。本研究开发了 THESEUS 框架，旨在将自由文本形式的研究描述转化为 OHDSI 生态系统中标准化的分析规范和可执行的 Strategus R 脚本。THESEUS 包含两个核心步骤：首先，利用大语言模型（LLM）将研究描述映射到受限的 JSON 模式中实现标准化；其次，将结构化规范转换为 R 脚本，并引入自审计循环进行错误修正。研究评估了 8 种商业 LLM，测试数据涵盖 15 项 OHDSI 研究和 5 项非 OHDSI 研究。结果显示，在 OHDSI 研究的主分析中，模型准确率达 0.91-0.98；在代码生成方面，经过自审计后，代码可执行率从初始的 0.80-1.00 提升至 0.93-1.00。THESEUS 证明了结合标准化数据模型与结构化分析框架，可实现观测性研究代码编写的可靠自动化，显著降低了技术门槛。
abstract: Introduction: Implementing target trial emulation (TTE) study methods as end-to-end executable analytic code is technically demanding, and producing standardized, reproducible scripts consistently across research teams remains a persistent challenge. We aimed to develop a framework that translates free-text study descriptions into standardized analytic specifications and executable Strategus R scripts for the Observational Health Data Sciences and Informatics (OHDSI) ecosystem. Methods: We developed THESEUS (Text-guided Health-study Estimation and Specification Engine Using Strategus), which operates through two sequential steps. Large language models (LLMs) first map descriptions of the study into a constrained JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) schema (standardization step), after which the structured specifications are converted into R scripts with a self-auditing loop for error correction (code generation step). We evaluated eight proprietary LLMs using texts extracted from the methods section of 15 OHDSI-based TTE studies, and externally validated the framework on texts from 5 non-OHDSI studies, across three input settings: primary analysis text only, full analyses text, and full methods sections. Standardization was evaluated at the study-level (whether all parameters in a study were correctly extracted) and at the field-level (sensitivity and false positive rate per individual parameter) with field-level evaluation applied to the full analyses text and full methods sections input settings. Code generation was assessed by executability of the produced R scripts before and after self-auditing. Results: In the standardization step, study-level accuracy across models ranged from 0.91 to 0.98 for primary analysis, 0.67 to 0.87 for full analyses, and 0.67 to 0.85 for full methods sections in OHDSI studies, whereas the corresponding ranges were 0.73 to 0.93, 0.60 to 0.87, and 0.27 to 0.47 in non-OHDSI studies. At the field-level, sensitivity across models under the full analyses text input setting ranged from 0.73 to 0.90 with 0.27 to 0.67 false positives per study in OHDSI studies, and from 0.71 to 0.90 with 0.20 to 1.00 false positives per study in non-OHDSI studies, depending on input setting. For code generation, first-run executability ranged from 0.80 to 1.00 for OHDSI studies and improved to 0.93 to 1.00 after self-auditing. In non-OHDSI studies, first-run executability ranged from 0.60 to 1.00, improving to 1.00 after self-auditing. Discussion: THESEUS demonstrates that pairing a standardized data model with a structured analysis framework enables reliable LLM-powered automation of the coding step in observational research. THESEUS supports the reliable translation of natural-language study descriptions into executable, shareable code in standardized observational research settings. This approach has the potential to lower the technical barriers to participation in observational research for a broader range of investigators.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究开发了名为 THESEUS 的 AI 框架，利用大语言模型（LLM）自动化完成从自然语言研究设计到可执行 R 代码的转化。其核心流程包括：1) 使用 LLM 将非结构化文本解析为符合 OHDSI 规范的 JSON 结构化数据；2) 将 JSON 转化为基于 Strategus 框架的 R 脚本，并通过“自我审计循环”自动修正代码错误。

## 为什么相关
该工作属于 AI Agent 在临床研究自动化领域的应用。虽然摘要未直接提及病原体，但其所依托的 OHDSI 生态系统和目标试验模拟（TTE）方法常用于临床微生物学、流行病学及感染性疾病的真实世界证据（RWE）研究。这种自动化流程可直接优化病原体感染后的临床结局分析或药物有效性评价的分析流程。

## 新颖度判断
新颖度中等偏低（0.25）。其创新点在于将 LLM 引入了特定的 OHDSI/Strategus 工业级工作流，并设计了闭环的“自我审计”纠错机制。然而，利用 LLM 生成代码和解析 JSON 属于当前 AI 领域的常规操作，其核心贡献更多在于工程实现和在医学观测性研究场景下的验证。

## 方法与证据
- **实验对象**：使用了 15 项基于 OHDSI 的 TTE 研究和 5 项非 OHDSI 研究的文本。评估了 8 种闭源 LLM。
- **标准化指标**：在 OHDSI 研究中，主分析的参数提取准确率为 0.91 至 0.98；但在非 OHDSI 研究中，全方法部分的准确率显著下降，仅为 0.27 至 0.47。
- **代码执行力**：初次生成的 R 脚本可执行率为 0.80-1.00，经过自我审计循环后，OHDSI 研究的可执行率提升至 0.93-1.00，非 OHDSI 研究达到 1.00。
- **输入设置**：对比了仅主分析文本、全分析文本和全方法部分三种输入模式。

## 应用价值
THESEUS 框架能显著降低临床医生和微生物学家进行复杂统计建模的技术门槛。通过将自然语言直接转化为符合行业标准（OHDSI）的可执行代码，不仅提高了研究效率，还增强了研究的可重复性和透明度，有助于快速开展多中心临床数据分析。

## 局限与风险
- **泛化性受限**：摘要显示，当处理非 OHDSI 标准的研究文本时，标准化准确率大幅下降（最低 0.27），说明模型高度依赖特定的描述规范。
- **生态系统依赖**：该工具目前仅支持 OHDSI 的 Strategus R 脚本，对于其他生物信息学或统计分析框架的适用性摘要未说明。
- **幻觉风险**：尽管有自我审计，但 LLM 在解析复杂临床逻辑时仍可能产生细微但致命的逻辑错误，需人工最终审核。

papers.title: Hypothesis-Conditioned Query Rewriting for Decision-Useful Retrieval
papers.text:
title: Hypothesis-Conditioned Query Rewriting for Decision-Useful Retrieval
source: arXiv
topics: foundation_model_agent
category: methods
why: 这篇工作更像方法创新，可能直接关联 metagenomics、long-read 或 pathogen identification 流程优化。
abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）通过引入外部非参数知识来增强大语言模型（LLM）的生成能力。然而，当任务涉及在多个竞争选项中进行决策时，仅靠主题相关的背景信息往往不足以区分正确答案。现有的RAG方法通常依赖单一初始查询，侧重于主题相关性而非决策证据。为此，本文提出了一种无需训练的检索前框架——假设条件查询重写（HCQR），旨在将RAG从面向主题的检索转向面向证据的检索。HCQR首先根据输入问题和候选选项推导出一个轻量级工作假设，随后将检索重写为三个针对性查询：(1) 支持该假设的证据；(2) 将该假设与竞争选项区分开的证据；(3) 验证问题中显著线索的证据。实验结果显示，在MedQA和MMLU-Med数据集上，HCQR的平均准确率分别比简单RAG提高了5.9和3.6个百分点，且优于重排序和过滤等基准方法。
abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) improves Large Language Models (LLMs) by grounding generation in external, non-parametric knowledge. However, when a task requires choosing among competing options, simply grounding generation in broadly relevant context is often insufficient to drive the final decision. Existing RAG methods typically rely on a single initial query, which often favors topical relevance over decision-relevant evidence, and therefore retrieves background information that can fail to discriminate among answer options. To address this issue, here we propose Hypothesis-Conditioned Query Rewriting (HCQR), a training-free pre-retrieval framework that reorients RAG from topic-oriented retrieval to evidence-oriented retrieval. HCQR first derives a lightweight working hypothesis from the input question and candidate options, and then rewrites retrieval into three targeted queries that seek evidence to: (1) support the hypothesis, (2) distinguish it from competing alternatives, and (3) verify salient clues in the question. This approach enables context retrieval that is more directly aligned with answer selection, allowing the generator to confirm or overturn the initial hypothesis based on the retrieved evidence. Experiments on MedQA and MMLU-Med show that HCQR consistently outperforms single-query RAG and re-rank/filter baselines, improving average accuracy over Simple RAG by 5.9 and 3.6 points, respectively. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/HCQR-1C2E.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究提出了一种名为HCQR（Hypothesis-Conditioned Query Rewriting）的检索前处理框架。其核心逻辑是改变RAG系统仅根据问题进行“主题搜索”的现状，转而根据预设的“工作假设”进行“证据搜索”。通过将单一查询分解为支持假设、区分选项和验证线索三个维度，显著提升了LLM在复杂医学决策任务中的准确性。

## 为什么相关
在病原微生物鉴定和临床诊疗中，核心痛点往往不是缺乏信息，而是难以在相似的病原体（如不同血清型的鉴定）或重叠的临床表现中进行鉴别诊断。HCQR提出的“区分竞争选项”的检索策略，与临床微生物学中的鉴别诊断逻辑高度契合。例如，在面对多种可能的感染源时，该方法可用于定向检索区分特定病原体的关键生化特征或基因标志物，而非泛泛检索该属的背景资料。

## 新颖度判断
**中等偏高**。该方法的新颖之处在于其“无需训练（training-free）”且引入了“假设驱动”的逻辑。相比于传统的重排序（Re-rank）或简单的查询扩展，HCQR通过模拟人类专家的临床推理过程（即先形成假设，再寻找差异化证据），为RAG在专业垂直领域的应用提供了新思路。

## 方法与证据
- **方法**：HCQR框架包含三个步骤：推导轻量级假设、重写为三类针对性查询（支持、区分、验证）、执行检索并生成。该过程不需要对模型进行微调。
- **数据与指标**：研究在医学问答基准数据集 **MedQA** 和 **MMLU-Med** 上进行了验证。实验结果显示，HCQR相比于Simple RAG，在MedQA上准确率提升了 **5.9个百分点**，在MMLU-Med上提升了 **3.6个百分点**。摘要提到其表现一致优于重排序（re-rank）和过滤（filter）等基准线。

## 应用价值
在临床微生物学和基因组学领域，该方法可直接集成至自动化诊断报告生成系统中。具体应用场景包括：
1. **病原体差异化鉴定**：在宏基因组测序（mNGS）结果解读中，针对相似物种自动生成区分性查询，辅助判断致病菌。
2. **耐药性分析**：针对特定耐药表型假设，定向检索支持或排除特定耐药基因（ARG）的证据。
3. **临床决策支持**：优化基于指南的诊疗建议生成，使其更具针对性而非罗列教科书知识。

## 局限与风险
- **初始假设依赖性**：HCQR的效果高度依赖于第一步生成的“轻量级工作假设”，如果初始假设完全偏离方向，可能会导致检索陷入确认偏误（Confirmation Bias）。
- **计算开销**：摘要提到将单一查询重写为三个查询，这意味着检索次数增加到三倍，在处理大规模长读长序列或海量文献库时，可能会显著增加系统延迟和API成本。
- **摘要未说明**：摘要未详细说明在处理非选择题（如开放式诊断建议）时如何构建“竞争选项”，也未提及该方法在多语种环境下的鲁棒性。

papers.title: PCR: A Prefetch-Enhanced Cache Reuse System for Low-Latency RAG Serving
papers.text:
title: PCR: A Prefetch-Enhanced Cache Reuse System for Low-Latency RAG Serving
source: arXiv
topics: foundation_model_agent
category: general
why: arXiv 上的新论文与 foundation_model_agent 相关，可用于补充你当前的病原检测与模型监控视角。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems enhance the performance of large language models (LLMs) by incorporating supplementary retrieved documents, enabling more accurate and context-aware responses. However, integrating these external documents often results in very long input sequences, which significantly increases computation costs during the prefill stage, where key-value (KV) representations for all input tokens are generated. This latency bottleneck becomes especially pronounced under high-throughput serving scenarios. KV-cache reuse offers a promising solution by storing previously computed KV states for shared input prefixes, thereby avoiding redundant computation across requests that contain overlapping context. Yet, the effectiveness of cache reuse is often limited by three practical challenges: low cache hit rates due to naive eviction policies, high CPU-GPU data transfer overhead, and slow SSD I/O when caches spill to storage. To address these issues, we propose PCR, a system designed to maximize KV-cache reuse efficiency through intelligent prefetching and pipelined data movement. Specifically, PCR introduces three key techniques: (1) a prefix-tree caching structure with a look-ahead LRU replacement policy that uses pending requests in the scheduler queue to improve cache hit ratios; (2) layer-wise overlapping that pipelines KV-cache loading and GPU computation across CUDA streams to hide communication latency; and (3) queue-based prefetching that proactively loads relevant KV caches from SSD into DRAM before they are needed. Extensive experiments show that PCR outperforms existing KV-cache reuse methods, achieving up to a 2.47x speedup in terms of average TTFT.

papers.title: Emergent Biological Realism in RL-Trained DNA Language Models
papers.text:
title: Emergent Biological Realism in RL-Trained DNA Language Models
source: bioRxiv
topics: foundation_model_agent
category: methods
why: 这篇工作更像方法创新，可能直接关联 metagenomics、long-read 或 pathogen identification 流程优化。
abstract_zh: 强化学习（RL）通过解锁非预期能力推动了大语言模型的广泛应用，但在生成式 DNA 模型中仍未得到充分探索。本研究以质粒生成为测试平台，探讨后训练技术是否能诱导 DNA 语言模型产生“涌现的生物学现实性”。质粒因其结构相对简单、功能约束明确且在生物技术中广泛应用而被选中。研究采用基于工程生物学约束的奖励函数，利用群体相对策略优化（GRPO）算法进行训练。结果显示，该模型的质量控制（QC）通过率从预训练基线的 5% 显著提升至 77%。值得注意的是，除了显式优化的特征外，模型还表现出惊人的生物学一致性：生成的序列在热力学稳定性、密码子使用偏好和 ORF 长度分布上与天然质粒相匹配，而这些属性并未包含在奖励函数中。研究表明，RL 后训练能引导 DNA 语言模型进入生物学连贯的序列空间，类似于其在自然语言模型中解锁新能力的作用。
abstract: Reinforcement learning has driven the mass adoption of large language models by unlocking unexpected capabilities, yet this approach remains largely underexplored for generative DNA models. We investigate whether similar post-training techniques can induce emergent biological realism in DNA language models, using plasmid generation as a testbed due to plasmids' relative simplicity, well-characterized functional constraints, and ubiquity in biotechnology. Using Group Relative Policy Optimization with a reward function based on constraints from engineered biology, our model achieves a 77% quality control pass rate compared to 5% for the pretrained baseline. Remarkably, beyond explicitly optimized features, the model exhibits surprising biological parallels: generated sequences match natural plasmids in thermodynamic stability, codon usage patterns, and ORF length distributions, properties not explicitly optimized in the reward function. These results suggest that RL post-training can steer DNA language models toward biologically coherent regions of sequence space, analogous to how such techniques unlock unexpected capabilities in natural language models, particularly in verifiable domains.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究探讨了如何利用强化学习（RL）后训练技术提升 DNA 语言模型的生成质量。研究以质粒（Plasmid）为研究对象，通过群体相对策略优化（GRPO）算法，将预训练模型生成的序列质量控制（QC）通过率从 5% 提升至 77%，并发现模型在未显式优化的生物学指标上产生了“涌现”的真实性。

## 为什么相关
该工作属于“基础模型 + 智能体（Foundation Model Agent）”的交叉领域。对于病原微生物学而言，质粒是抗生素抗性基因和毒力因子的重要载体。利用 RL 优化 DNA 生成模型，不仅能辅助合成生物学中的载体设计，还可能用于模拟病原体进化或优化宏基因组组装中的长读段序列补全。

## 新颖度判断
**高。** 尽管 DNA 语言模型已有不少研究，但将 GRPO（一种在 DeepSeek-R1 等大模型中证明有效的 RL 算法）应用于 DNA 序列建模，并系统性地观察到“非显式优化指标”的涌现（如热力学稳定性和 ORF 分布），在生物 AI 领域具有显著的原创性。

## 方法与证据
- **模型与算法**：采用群体相对策略优化（GRPO）算法进行后训练。
- **数据与任务**：以质粒序列生成为任务，质粒因其功能约束明确且在生物技术中通用而被选为测试床。
- **核心指标**：QC 通过率从 5%（预训练基线）飞跃至 77%。
- **涌现证据**：生成的序列在热力学稳定性、密码子使用偏好和 ORF（开放阅读框）长度分布上与天然质粒匹配，尽管奖励函数仅包含基础的工程生物学约束。

## 应用价值
1. **合成生物学**：可用于设计高成功率的工程化质粒载体。
2. **基因组学优化**：RL 引导的生成能力可用于优化病原体鉴定流程中的序列比对或特征提取。
3. **模型训练范式**：证明了在 DNA 领域，通过少量可验证的生物学约束进行 RL 训练，可以诱导出复杂的底层生物学规律。

## 局限与风险
- **对象局限**：研究仅限于质粒，其基因组结构相对简单且高度模块化，尚不清楚该方法在更复杂的病毒或细菌全基因组上的表现。
- **奖励函数依赖**：摘要未详细说明奖励函数的具体组成，若奖励函数设计存在偏差，可能导致模型生成具有生物安全风险的序列。
- **计算成本**：GRPO 虽比传统 PPO 节省显存，但大规模 DNA 序列的 RL 训练仍需极高算力支持。

papers.title: ByteRover: Agent-Native Memory Through LLM-Curated Hierarchical Context
papers.text:
title: ByteRover: Agent-Native Memory Through LLM-Curated Hierarchical Context
source: arXiv
topics: foundation_model_agent
category: foundation_model
why: 这篇工作偏基础模型/Agent方向，可能影响病原检测任务的建模上限，值得关注其任务定义与评测设计。
abstract_zh: 存储增强生成（MAG）通过外部存储扩展了大语言模型的长上下文推理能力，但现有方法普遍将存储视为外部服务，导致存储系统无法理解知识，进而引发语义漂移、协作上下文丢失及故障恢复脆弱等问题。本文提出 ByteRover，一种智能体原生（agent-native）存储架构，实现了存储流水线的反转：由负责推理的同一 LLM 直接进行知识的策划、结构化和检索。ByteRover 将知识表示为分层上下文树（Context Tree），以本地文件系统的 Markdown 文件形式组织为“领域-主题-子主题-条目”结构。每个条目包含显式关系、出处及具备重要性评分、成熟度等级和新近度衰减的自适应知识生命周期（AKL）。检索采用五级渐进策略，多数查询在无需 LLM 调用下延迟低于 100 毫秒。在 LoCoMo 和 LongMemEval 上的实验表明，ByteRover 在无需向量数据库、图数据库或嵌入服务的情况下，达到了最先进的准确率。
abstract: Memory-Augmented Generation (MAG) extends large language models with external memory to support long-context reasoning, but existing approaches universally treat memory as an external service that agents call into, delegating storage to separate pipelines of chunking, embedding, and graph extraction. This architectural separation means the system that stores knowledge does not understand it, leading to semantic drift between what the agent intended to remember and what the pipeline actually captured, loss of coordination context across agents, and fragile recovery after failures. In this paper, we propose ByteRover, an agent-native memory architecture that inverts the memory pipeline: the same LLM that reasons about a task also curates, structures, and retrieves knowledge. ByteRover represents knowledge in a hierarchical Context Tree, a file-based knowledge graph organized as Domain, Topic, Subtopic, and Entry, where each entry carries explicit relations, provenance, and an Adaptive Knowledge Lifecycle (AKL) with importance scoring, maturity tiers, and recency decay. Retrieval uses a 5-tier progressive strategy that resolves most queries at sub-100 ms latency without LLM calls, escalating to agentic reasoning only for novel questions. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval demonstrate that ByteRover achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on LoCoMo and competitive results on LongMemEval while requiring zero external infrastructure, no vector database, no graph database, no embedding service, with all knowledge stored as human-readable markdown files on the local filesystem.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
ByteRover 提出了一种“智能体原生”的存储架构，旨在解决传统 RAG 架构中存储与推理分离导致的语义漂移问题。其核心是通过 LLM 自主维护一个分层的上下文树（Context Tree），并引入自适应知识生命周期（AKL）管理机制，将知识以人类可读的 Markdown 格式存储在本地，实现了无需外部数据库的高效长上下文推理。

## 为什么相关
在病原检测和临床微生物学领域，研究者常需处理跨越数年的流行病学数据、复杂的临床指南及海量的基因组注释。传统的向量检索往往会丢失临床案例间的逻辑关联。ByteRover 提供的分层结构（领域-主题-子主题）非常适合组织如“病毒科-属-种-变异株”这类具有天然层级关系的生物学知识，其“智能体原生”的特性有助于构建能够长期追踪病原演化的专业 AI Agent。

## 新颖度判断
**较高**。该工作挑战了当前主流的“向量数据库+嵌入模型”的 RAG 范式，提出“反转流水线”，让 LLM 兼任存储管理员。其新颖之处在于完全抛弃了复杂的外部基础设施（无向量库、无图数据库），回归到结构化的文件系统存储，并结合了 AKL 这种动态权重机制。

## 方法与证据
- **架构设计**：采用分层上下文树，将知识条目化，并赋予重要性评分和新近度衰减（Recency Decay）。
- **检索策略**：设计了 5 级渐进式检索，摘要指出该策略使大多数查询在不调用 LLM 的情况下实现 <100ms 的延迟。
- **实验数据**：在长上下文基准测试 LoCoMo 和 LongMemEval 上进行了评估。
- **结论证据**：实验显示 ByteRover 在 LoCoMo 上取得了 SOTA（最先进）的准确率，且在 LongMemEval 上具有竞争力，证明了纯文件系统存储在处理复杂长文本任务时的有效性。

## 应用价值
1. **临床本地化部署**：由于无需复杂的向量数据库和嵌入服务，该架构极易部署在医院内网等对数据隐私要求极高的边缘计算设备上。
2. **知识可解释性**：所有存储均为 Markdown 文件，临床医生或生物学家可以直接查看和修正 AI 存储的知识条目，解决了黑盒存储问题。
3. **长程任务处理**：AKL 机制允许智能体在处理长期病原监测任务时，自动淘汰过时信息并保留核心知识。

## 局限与风险
- **数据类型局限**：摘要中仅提到 Markdown 文件存储，对于大规模非结构化的原始测序数据（FastQ/Fasta）或蛋白质三维结构数据的处理能力未予说明。
- **扩展性风险**：虽然在基准测试中表现优异，但当本地文件系统中的 Markdown 文件达到百万量级时，其分层检索的性能瓶颈摘要未明确讨论。
- **LLM 依赖**：知识的策划和结构化高度依赖 LLM 本身的推理能力，若基础模型在生物医学领域存在幻觉，可能会在存储阶段固化错误知识。

papers.title: APITestGenie: Generating Web API Tests from Requirements and API Specifications with LLMs
papers.text:
title: APITestGenie: Generating Web API Tests from Requirements and API Specifications with LLMs
source: arXiv
topics: foundation_model_agent
category: general
why: arXiv 上的新论文与 foundation_model_agent 相关，可用于补充你当前的病原检测与模型监控视角。
abstract_zh: 现代软件系统高度依赖 Web API，但编写有效且可执行的测试脚本仍是一项耗时且易出错的手动任务。本文介绍了 APITestGenie，这是一种利用大语言模型（LLM）、检索增强生成（RAG）和提示工程，直接根据业务需求和 OpenAPI 规范自动生成 API 集成测试的创新工具。我们在 10 个真实 API 上对 APITestGenie 进行了评估，其中包括来自汽车领域工业合作伙伴的 8 个 API（包含约 1,000 个实时端点）。实验结果显示，在最多三次尝试后，该工具能为 89% 的受测业务需求生成语法和语义均有效的测试脚本。值得注意的是，生成的测试揭示了 API 中此前未知的缺陷，包括端点间的集成问题。统计分析表明，API 复杂度和业务需求的详细程度是影响成功率的主要因素，API 文档的详细程度也有影响。行业从业者的反馈确认了该工具在减少验收测试编写工作量及提高测试与业务需求一致性方面的应用价值。
abstract: Modern software systems rely heavily on Web APIs, yet creating meaningful and executable test scripts remains a largely manual, time-consuming, and error-prone task. In this paper, we present APITestGenie, a novel tool that leverages Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and prompt engineering to automatically generate API integration tests directly from business requirements and OpenAPI specifications. We evaluated APITestGenie on 10 real-world APIs, including 8 APIs comprising circa 1,000 live endpoints from an industrial partner in the automotive domain. The tool was able to generate syntactically and semantically valid test scripts for 89\% of the business requirements under test after at most three attempts. Notably, some generated tests revealed previously unknown defects in the APIs, including integration issues between endpoints. Statistical analysis identified API complexity and level of detail in business requirements as primary factors influencing success rates, with the level of detail in API documentation also affecting outcomes. Feedback from industry practitioners confirmed strong interest in adoption, substantially reducing the manual effort in writing acceptance tests, and improving the alignment between tests and business requirements.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究开发了名为 APITestGenie 的自动化工具，旨在解决 Web API 测试脚本编写效率低下的问题。该工具通过整合 LLM、RAG 技术和提示工程，能够将非结构化的“业务需求”与结构化的“OpenAPI 规范”相结合，自动产出可执行的集成测试脚本。

## 为什么相关
在病原检测、蛋白质组学及临床微生物学领域，生物信息分析流程（如自动化报告系统、LIMS 系统）正日益依赖 Web API 进行数据交换和工具集成。APITestGenie 提供的自动化测试思路，可用于确保临床诊断平台 API 的鲁棒性，防止因接口集成错误导致的诊断数据传输异常。这属于 AI Agent 在软件工程（SWE）领域的应用，对构建可靠的生物医学信息化基础设施具有参考意义。

## 新颖度判断
新颖度较低（0.25）。利用 LLM 和 RAG 生成代码或测试脚本已是当前 AI 软件工程领域的常规做法。该研究的贡献更多在于工程实践，即如何结合业务需求与 OpenAPI 规范进行端到端的集成测试生成，并在大规模工业场景（1,000 个端点）下进行了验证。

## 方法与证据
- **方法**：采用 RAG 检索相关 API 规范，结合提示工程引导 LLM 生成测试脚本。
- **数据规模**：测试了 10 个真实 API，其中 8 个来自汽车工业领域，涵盖约 1,000 个实时端点。
- **实验指标**：在最多 3 次生成尝试内，89% 的业务需求成功转化为有效的测试脚本。
- **发现**：生成的测试脚本成功识别出 API 内部此前未被发现的缺陷，特别是端点间的集成逻辑错误。

## 应用价值
对于开发复杂生物信息学平台的团队，该工具可显著降低手动编写验收测试的工作量。它能确保测试用例严格对齐业务逻辑（如特定的临床检测流程），并通过自动化手段提高 API 的覆盖率和可靠性，减少人工维护成本。

## 局限与风险
- **依赖性**：成功率高度依赖于 API 的复杂程度、业务需求的详细程度以及 API 文档的质量（摘要明确指出这些是影响成功率的主要因素）。
- **非完全自动化**：仍有 11% 的需求无法在 3 次尝试内生成有效脚本，且摘要未说明对于逻辑极其复杂的生物计算 API 的处理能力。
- **弱 AI 交叉**：该研究属于通用的 AI 辅助软件工程，并非专门针对病原或生物医学领域的算法优化，属于工具层面的弱交叉。

papers.title: Probabilistic Co-Control in Brain-Computer Interfaces: Uncertainty as a Control Signal in Brain-to-Text Decoding
papers.text:
title: Probabilistic Co-Control in Brain-Computer Interfaces: Uncertainty as a Control Signal in Brain-to-Text Decoding
source: bioRxiv
topics: foundation_model_agent
category: methods
why: 这篇工作更像方法创新，可能直接关联 metagenomics、long-read 或 pathogen identification 流程优化。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: Objective: Neural decoders serve as probabilistic interfaces in co-control brain-to-text BCIs, where predicted uncertainty shapes hypothesis generation and language model integration, enabling decisions to be made safely under uncertainty. However, it remains unclear whether these decoders produce reliable and informative uncertainty, or how training objectives shape these properties. This work characterizes, diagnoses, and improves uncertainty representations in brain-to-text decoding. Approach: We extend two metrics, calibration error (ECE) and resolution (RES), to evaluate sequential probabilistic predictions from frame-level phoneme estimates to word-level hypotheses, quantifying the reliability and informativeness of model uncertainty. Using this framework, we analyze neural decoders trained with connectionist temporal classification (CTC). To isolate the causal role of uncertainty independent of accuracy, we perform oracle interventions that manipulate predicted probability distributions while holding predicted sequences fixed. Motivated by the observed failures, we further examine the role of the training objective and propose a two-stage cross-entropy (CE) formulation that decouples alignment inference from classification. Main Results: We show that widely used CTC-trained neural decoders in brain-to-text BCIs produce systematically over-confident predictions, with high confidence persisting even when predictions are incorrect. Oracle interventions reveal that improved ECE and RES enhance hypothesis generation and language-model integration by promoting diverse alternatives and more effective re-ranking of hypotheses aligned with user intent. Mechanistically, CTC relies on over-confident predictions to resolve alignment ambiguity. Replacing CTC with CE loss yields significantly more reliable and informative probabilistic predictions without degrading decoding accuracy. Significance: Uncertainty emerges as a system-level design variable in brain-to-text interfaces. Calibrated uncertainty from neural decoders enables effective integration with independently trained language models and reliable error detection. This work reframes uncertainty from a passive output into an active control signal, identifies key components and evaluation criteria for probabilistic co-control, and outlines a pathway toward next-generation BCIs that support increasingly complex interactions with the world.

papers.title: DTCRS: Dynamic Tree Construction for Recursive Summarization
papers.text:
title: DTCRS: Dynamic Tree Construction for Recursive Summarization
source: arXiv
topics: foundation_model_agent
category: methods
why: 这篇工作更像方法创新，可能直接关联 metagenomics、long-read 或 pathogen identification 流程优化。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) mitigates the hallucination problem of Large Language Models (LLMs) by incorporating external knowledge. Recursive summarization constructs a hierarchical summary tree by clustering text chunks, integrating information from multiple parts of a document to provide evidence for abstractive questions involving multi-step reasoning. However, summary trees often contain a large number of redundant summary nodes, which not only increase construction time but may also negatively impact question answering. Moreover, recursive summarization is not suitable for all types of questions. We introduce DTCRS, a method that dynamically generates summary trees based on document structure and query semantics. DTCRS determines whether a summary tree is necessary by analyzing the question type. It then decomposes the question and uses the embeddings of sub-questions as initial cluster centers, reducing redundant summaries while improving the relevance between summaries and the question. Our approach significantly reduces summary tree construction time and achieves substantial improvements across three QA tasks. Additionally, we investigate the applicability of recursive summarization to different question types, providing valuable insights for future research.

papers.title: Why teaching resists automation in an AI-inundated era: Human judgment, non-modular work, and the limits of delegation
papers.text:
title: Why teaching resists automation in an AI-inundated era: Human judgment, non-modular work, and the limits of delegation
source: arXiv
topics: foundation_model_agent
category: general
why: arXiv 上的新论文与 foundation_model_agent 相关，可用于补充你当前的病原检测与模型监控视角。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: Debates about artificial intelligence (AI) in education often portray teaching as a modular and procedural job that can increasingly be automated or delegated to technology. This brief communication paper argues that such claims depend on treating teaching as more separable than it is in practice. Drawing on recent literature and empirical studies of large language models and retrieval-augmented generation systems, I argue that although AI can support some bounded functions, instructional work remains difficult to automate in meaningful ways because it is inherently interpretive, relational, and grounded in professional judgment. More fundamentally, teaching and learning are shaped by human cognition, behavior, motivation, and social interaction in ways that cannot be fully specified, predicted, or exhaustively modeled. Tasks that may appear separable in principle derive their instructional value in practice from ongoing contextual interpretation across learners, situations, and relationships. As long as educational practice relies on emergent understanding of human cognition and learning, teaching remains a form of professional work that resists automation. AI may improve access to information and support selected instructional activities, but it does not remove the need for human judgment and relational accountability that effective teaching requires.

papers.title: Beyond RAG for Cyber Threat Intelligence: A Systematic Evaluation of Graph-Based and Agentic Retrieval
papers.text:
title: Beyond RAG for Cyber Threat Intelligence: A Systematic Evaluation of Graph-Based and Agentic Retrieval
source: arXiv
topics: foundation_model_agent
category: methods
why: 这篇工作更像方法创新，可能直接关联 metagenomics、long-read 或 pathogen identification 流程优化。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: Cyber threat intelligence (CTI) analysts must answer complex questions over large collections of narrative security reports. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems help language models access external knowledge, but traditional vector retrieval often struggles with queries that require reasoning over relationships between entities such as threat actors, malware, and vulnerabilities. This limitation arises because relevant evidence is often distributed across multiple text fragments and documents. Knowledge graphs address this challenge by enabling structured multi-hop reasoning through explicit representations of entities and relationships. However, multiple retrieval paradigms, including graph-based, agentic, and hybrid approaches, have emerged with different assumptions and failure modes. It remains unclear how these approaches compare in realistic CTI settings and when graph grounding improves performance. We present a systematic evaluation of four RAG architectures for CTI analysis: standard vector retrieval, graph-based retrieval over a CTI knowledge graph, an agentic variant that repairs failed graph queries, and a hybrid approach combining graph queries with text retrieval. We evaluate these systems on 3,300 CTI question-answer pairs spanning factual lookups, multi-hop relational queries, analyst-style synthesis questions, and unanswerable cases. Results show that graph grounding improves performance on structured factual queries. The hybrid graph-text approach improves answer quality by up to 35 percent on multi-hop questions compared to vector RAG, while maintaining more reliable performance than graph-only systems.

papers.title: ARGen: Affect-Reinforced Generative Augmentation towards Vision-based Dynamic Emotion Perception
papers.text:
title: ARGen: Affect-Reinforced Generative Augmentation towards Vision-based Dynamic Emotion Perception
source: arXiv
topics: foundation_model_agent
category: methods
why: 这篇工作更像方法创新，可能直接关联 metagenomics、long-read 或 pathogen identification 流程优化。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: Dynamic facial expression recognition in the wild remains challenging due to data scarcity and long-tail distributions, which hinder models from effectively learning the temporal dynamics of scarce emotions. To address these limitations, we propose ARGen, an Affect-Reinforced Generative Augmentation Framework that enables data-adaptive dynamic expression generation for robust emotion perception. ARGen operates in two stages: Affective Semantic Injection (ASI) and Adaptive Reinforcement Diffusion (ARD). The ASI stage establishes affective knowledge alignment through facial Action Units and employs a retrieval-augmented prompt generation strategy to synthesize consistent and fine-grained affective descriptions via large-scale visual-language models, thereby injecting interpretable emotional priors into the generation process. The ARD stage integrates text-conditioned image-to-video diffusion with reinforcement learning, introducing inter-frame conditional guidance and a multi-objective reward function to jointly optimize expression naturalness, facial integrity, and generative efficiency. Extensive experiments on both generation and recognition tasks verify that ARGen substantially enhances synthesis fidelity and improves recognition performance, establishing an interpretable and generalizable generative augmentation paradigm for vision-based affective computing.
