papers.title: RACER: Retrieval-Augmented Contextual Rapid Speculative Decoding
papers.text:
title: RACER: Retrieval-Augmented Contextual Rapid Speculative Decoding
source: arXiv
topics: foundation_model_agent
category: foundation_model
why: 这篇工作偏基础模型/Agent方向，可能影响病原检测任务的建模上限，值得关注其任务定义与评测设计。
abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的自回归解码由于每步仅生成一个 token，导致推理延迟较高。投机解码（SD）通过“猜测-验证”策略缓解了这一问题，但现有的免训练变体面临权衡：基于检索的草稿在缺乏精确匹配时会失效，而基于 Logit 的草稿则缺乏结构化引导。本文提出 RACER（检索增强上下文快速投机解码），这是一种轻量级且免训练的方法，它将检索到的精确模式与 Logit 驱动的未来线索相结合。这种统一的方法既提供了可靠的锚点，又具备灵活的外推能力，从而生成更丰富的投机草稿。在 Spec-Bench、HumanEval 和 MGSM-ZH 上的实验结果表明，RACER 能够持续加速推理，实现比自回归解码高出 2 倍以上的加速比，并优于先前的免训练方法，为高效 LLM 解码提供了一种可扩展、即插即用的解决方案。
abstract: Autoregressive decoding in Large Language Models (LLMs) generates one token per step, causing high inference latency. Speculative decoding (SD) mitigates this through a guess-and-verify strategy, but existing training-free variants face trade-offs: retrieval-based drafts break when no exact match exists, while logits-based drafts lack structural guidance. We propose $\textbf{RACER}$ ($\textbf{R}$etrieval-$\textbf{A}$ugmented $\textbf{C}$ont$\textbf{e}$xtual $\textbf{R}$apid Speculative Decoding), a lightweight and training-free method that integrates retrieved exact patterns with logit-driven future cues. This unification supplies both reliable anchors and flexible extrapolation, yielding richer speculative drafts. Experiments on Spec-Bench, HumanEval, and MGSM-ZH demonstrate that RACER consistently accelerates inference, achieving more than $2\times$ speedup over autoregressive decoding, and outperforms prior training-free methods, offering a scalable, plug-and-play solution for efficient LLM decoding. Our source code is available at $\href{https://github.com/hkr04/RACER}{https://github.com/hkr04/RACER}$.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究提出了一种名为 RACER 的新型免训练投机解码方法，旨在解决大语言模型推理延迟问题。其核心逻辑是融合“检索到的精确文本模式”与“基于 Logit 的预测线索”，通过这种双重机制生成更高质量的候选草稿（drafts），从而提高验证通过率并加速生成过程。

## 为什么相关
在病原体生物信息学和临床微生物学领域，LLM 常用于处理大规模基因组元数据分析、临床报告自动生成或复杂的 Agent 决策流。推理速度直接影响临床决策的实时性。RACER 提供的 2 倍加速能力，能够显著降低在处理长序列生物医学文本或多步推理任务时的计算开销和响应时间。

## 新颖度判断
新颖度较低（0.25）。该工作属于对现有投机解码技术的工程化改进。其创新点在于将“基于检索”和“基于 Logit”这两种已有的免训练思路进行了融合，而非提出了全新的解码范式。但在“免训练”和“即插即用”的实用性上具有较好的平衡。

## 方法与证据
- **方法**：RACER 方法结合了检索到的上下文模式（Contextual Patterns）和 Logit 驱动的未来预测。它不依赖于额外的草稿模型（Draft Model），而是利用模型自身的输出分布和历史上下文进行投机。
- **证据**：在 Spec-Bench（投机解码基准）、HumanEval（代码生成）和 MGSM-ZH（多语言数学推理）三个数据集上进行了测试。实验结果显示，RACER 实现了超过 2 倍的推理加速，且性能优于现有的免训练投机解码方案。

## 应用价值
对于需要部署本地 LLM 处理敏感临床数据的机构，RACER 提供了一种无需重新训练模型、不增加显存负担的加速方案。它特别适用于结构化明显的任务（如临床微生物报告生成或生物序列描述），因为这类任务中存在大量可检索的重复模式。

## 局限与风险
- **领域适配性**：摘要未说明该方法在专业生物医学领域（如蛋白质序列或病原体分类描述）的特定表现，其加速比可能受文本重复率和结构化程度影响。
- **检索开销**：虽然是轻量级的，但检索机制本身在超长上下文下的计算开销摘要中未详细量化。
- **准确性风险**：虽然投机解码理论上不改变最终输出分布，但在极端复杂的逻辑推理中，草稿质量如果过低，可能导致加速效果退化甚至失效。

papers.title: Modular Representation Compression: Adapting LLMs for Efficient and Effective Recommendations
papers.text:
title: Modular Representation Compression: Adapting LLMs for Efficient and Effective Recommendations
source: arXiv
topics: foundation_model_agent
category: foundation_model
why: 这篇工作偏基础模型/Agent方向，可能影响病原检测任务的建模上限，值得关注其任务定义与评测设计。
abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）已显著提升推荐系统（RS）性能，但其生成的高维表示带来了巨大的存储和计算开销。本研究发现了一个反直觉现象：中层表示优势（MRA），即 LLM 中间层的表示在推荐任务中的表现优于最终层。由于现有压缩方法通常针对最终层，导致其在推荐场景下并非最优。基于模块化理论，研究者认为 LLM 内部会自发形成功能模块，迫使最终层专门用于代理训练任务（如预测下一个词）。为此，本文提出模块化表示压缩（MARC）框架，通过“模块化调整”引入压缩和任务适配模块，使 LLM 严格作为表示学习模块运行；并利用“模块化任务解耦”，通过信息约束和差异化网络结构实现任务解耦。实验证明 MARC 有效解决了 MRA 问题。在大型商业搜索广告场景的在线 A/B 测试中，MARC 实现了 2.82% 的 eCPM 提升，证明了其在生成高效表示方面的有效性。
abstract: Recently, large language models (LLMs) have advanced recommendation systems (RSs), and recent works have begun to explore how to integrate LLMs into industrial RSs. While most approaches deploy LLMs offline to generate and pre-cache augmented representations for RSs, high-dimensional representations from LLMs introduce substantial storage and computational costs. Thus, it is crucial to compress LLM representations effectively. However, we identify a counterintuitive phenomenon during representation compression: Mid-layer Representation Advantage (MRA), where representations from middle layers of LLMs outperform those from final layers in recommendation tasks. This degraded final layer renders existing compression methods, which typically compress on the final layer, suboptimal. We interpret this based on modularity theory that LLMs develop spontaneous internal functional modularity and force the final layer to specialize in the proxy training task. Thus, we propose \underline{M}odul\underline{a}r \underline{R}epresentation \underline{C}ompression (MARC) to explicitly control the modularity of LLMs. First, Modular Adjustment explicitly introduces compression and task adaptation modules, enabling the LLM to operate strictly as a representation-learning module. Next, to ground each module to its specific task, Modular Task Decoupling uses information constraints and different network structures to decouple tasks. Extensive experiments validate that MARC addresses MRA and produces efficient representations. Notably, MARC achieved a 2.82% eCPM lift in an online A/B test within a large-scale commercial search advertising scenario.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究聚焦于大语言模型（LLM）在推荐系统中的表示压缩问题。核心发现是“中层表示优势（MRA）”，即 LLM 的中间层比最终层包含更多对下游推荐任务有用的特征。研究提出了 MARC 框架，通过模块化调整和任务解耦技术，优化 LLM 的表示学习能力并降低计算成本。

## 为什么相关
虽然该论文直接应用场景是商业搜索广告，但其核心逻辑与病原基因组学/蛋白质组学中的“生物大模型”应用高度相关。在处理病原体序列（如病毒变异预测、蛋白质功能注释）时，研究者常直接提取 LLM 最后一层的 Embedding。该研究提示，直接使用最终层可能因模型过拟合于预训练任务（如掩码语言建模）而损失生物学特征，中层表示可能更具生物学解释力。

## 新颖度判断
新颖度较高（5.25）。研究不仅指出了现有压缩方法的盲点（即盲目压缩最终层），还从模块化理论角度解释了 MRA 现象，并设计了 MARC 框架来显式控制模型的模块化功能，这在 LLM 表示优化领域具有启发性。

## 方法与证据
- **方法**：提出 MARC 框架，包含两个核心组件：1. **模块化调整（Modular Adjustment）**，引入专门的压缩和适配模块；2. **模块化任务解耦（Modular Task Decoupling）**，利用信息约束和特定网络结构将表示学习与原始训练任务分离。
- **证据**：在大型商业搜索广告场景进行了在线 A/B 测试，结果显示 eCPM（千次展示有效收入）提升了 2.82%。此外，实验验证了 MARC 能够有效克服 MRA 现象，生成更高效的压缩表示。

## 应用价值
在临床微生物学和基因组学 AI 建模中，该方法可用于优化生物序列模型的部署。通过 MARC 框架，可以提取更精简且信息量更大的病原体特征向量，降低大规模基因组数据库检索的存储压力，并可能通过调用中层特征提升耐药性预测或毒力因子识别的准确率。

## 局限与风险
- **领域局限**：实验数据主要来自商业搜索广告，尚未在生物信息学或临床微生物学数据集上验证其通用性。
- **计算开销**：虽然压缩后的表示节省了存储，但 MARC 框架在训练阶段引入了额外的模块和约束，摘要未说明其训练成本的增加程度。
- **黑盒性质**：模块化解耦的具体内部机制和对不同架构 LLM 的普适性仍需进一步探索。

papers.title: Decoding the phenomenology of spontaneous thought using large language-model ratings on verbal retrospective free reports
papers.text:
title: Decoding the phenomenology of spontaneous thought using large language-model ratings on verbal retrospective free reports
source: bioRxiv
topics: foundation_model_agent
category: foundation_model
why: 这篇工作偏基础模型/Agent方向，可能影响病原检测任务的建模上限，值得关注其任务定义与评测设计。
abstract_zh: 自发性思维占据了日常内心体验的大部分，但其内容和神经生理基础的探索长期受限于方法学挑战。传统思维探测法限制了现象学报告的完整性，而实时口头报告则会干扰思维流并产生运动伪迹。本研究设计并测试了一种新方法，将延迟口头回顾性自由报告（RFR）与大语言模型（LLM）生成的自动现象学评分相结合，以评估自发思维的神经基础。22名参与者完成了闭眼自由思考任务，其报告由四种最先进的LLM和人类评分小组针对10个现象学维度进行评估。随后，研究者训练机器学习（ML）模型，利用EEG频谱、复杂度和连通性特征来解码LLM生成的评分。结果显示，LLM之间的一致性超过了人类评分者，且ML模型在预测情感效价（emotional valence）方面达到了显著高于随机水平的准确率。研究证明了LLM可用于自发思维的大规模现象学标注，并表明其情感维度可从同步EEG活动中解码。
abstract: Spontaneous thoughts constitute most of everyday inner experience, yet long-standing methodological challenges obscure a thorough exploration of their content and neurophysiological underpinnings. Traditional approaches relying on thought probes impose strict constraints on phenomenological reports, whereas online verbal reports disrupt the natural flow of experience while interfering neural signals with motor artifacts. Here, we designed and tested an alternative approach to assess the neural basis of spontaneous thoughts combining delayed verbal retrospective free reports (RFR) with automated phenomenological ratings generated by large language models (LLMs). Twenty-two participants performed an eyes-closed free-thinking task, providing reports that were evaluated along ten phenomenological dimensions by four state-of-the-art LLMs and a panel of human raters. Machine-learning models (ML) were then trained to decode LLM-derived ratings from EEG spectral, complexity, and connectivity features. Our analyses showed that inter-rater agreement among LLMs exceeded that of human raters whereas ML models achieved above-chance accuracy for the prediction of emotional valence. These findings provide support for the use of LLMs for a scalable phenomenological annotation of spontaneous thoughts and suggest that their affective dimensions can be decoded from concurrent EEG activity.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究提出了一种结合延迟口头回顾性自由报告（RFR）与大语言模型（LLM）自动评分的方法，用于量化自发性思维的现象学特征，并尝试通过脑电图（EEG）特征对这些特征进行神经解码。

## 为什么相关
本研究属于 AI/LLM 与认知神经科学的交叉。虽然与病原检测或临床微生物学无直接关联，但其核心逻辑——利用 LLM 作为“标准化专家评分员”来处理非结构化文本数据（如患者主诉或复杂的生物学描述），并将其转化为可供机器学习模型训练的定量标签，对于构建病原体致病性预测或临床表型标注的 Agent 具有方法论参考价值。

## 新颖度判断
新颖度较低（0.25）。利用 LLM 进行文本标注已成为计算语言学和心理学的常规手段。本研究的创新点在于将 LLM 评分作为“基准标签”，尝试与 EEG 信号（频谱、复杂度、连通性）进行跨模态关联，但在神经解码的广度上仅在情感效价维度取得突破。

## 方法与证据
- **实验对象与数据**：22名参与者，闭眼自由思考任务，产生口头回顾性报告。
- **模型与工具**：使用了4种最先进的 LLM（摘要未具体命名型号）和人类评分员，针对10个现象学维度评分。
- **特征提取**：从 EEG 中提取频谱（spectral）、复杂度（complexity）和连通性（connectivity）特征。
- **关键结论**：LLM 评分者间的一致性（inter-rater agreement）高于人类；机器学习模型能够以高于随机概率的准确率从 EEG 特征中解码出 LLM 标注的情感效价维度。

## 应用价值
验证了 LLM 在处理高度主观、非结构化语言报告时的规模化标注能力。这种“LLM 标注 + 传统信号解码”的框架可迁移至临床领域，例如通过 LLM 提取临床微生物报告中的关键表型特征，再与基因组学数据进行关联分析。

## 局限与风险
- **样本量极小**：仅 22 名参与者，结论的普适性有待验证。
- **解码维度有限**：尽管评估了 10 个维度，但摘要仅明确提到情感效价（emotional valence）解码成功，暗示其他维度的解码效果可能不佳。
- **弱交叉性**：该研究本质上是认知心理学实验，与病原生物学、蛋白质组学等硬核生物医学领域属于极弱相关，不应过度解读其在临床微生物学中的直接作用。

papers.title: All Models are Wrong, Some are Annotated: Automating Metadata in Biomedical Repositories
papers.text:
title: All Models are Wrong, Some are Annotated: Automating Metadata in Biomedical Repositories
source: bioRxiv
topics: foundation_model_agent
category: foundation_model
why: 这篇工作偏基础模型/Agent方向，可能影响病原检测任务的建模上限，值得关注其任务定义与评测设计。
abstract_zh: 高质量元数据对科学发现至关重要，但生物医学数据库中普遍存在标注稀疏问题。本研究评估了大语言模型（LLMs）从神经科学数据库 ModelDB 的源代码中推断离子通道和受体亚型元数据的能力。研究人员从 ModelDB 提取了 5,133 个模型文件，其中 1,100 个经过人工标注（253 个用于测试）。实验对比了 GPT-5.2 和 GPT-mini 在零样本及启发式增强提示下的表现，并以特征工程驱动的 XGBoost 模型作为基线。结果显示，LLMs 表现优于 XGBoost。在类型级别，启发式增强的 GPT-mini 准确率达 96.0%，F1 分数为 0.962；在亚型级别，GPT-5.2 和 GPT-mini 配合启发式增强均达到 88.1% 的准确率。尽管 LLMs 在从源代码直接生成元数据方面展现出强大潜力，但在不同亚型间表现不一，且存在对常见标签的偏见。该方法有望推广至其他科学代码库的自动化标注。
abstract: Objective: High-quality metadata is essential for scientific discovery, yet sparse annotations in rapidly growing repositories leave many biologically relevant details uncaptured. We evaluated whether large language models (LLMs) can accurately infer ion channel and receptor subtype metadata from source code in a neuroscience repository. Materials and Methods: We extracted 5,133 model files from ModelDB. A subset of 1,100 was manually annotated; 253 were held out for testing, and the remainder split into training (80%) and validation (20%) sets. LLM-based approaches (GPT-5.2 and GPT-mini) were evaluated under zero-shot and heuristic-augmented prompting. Performance was assessed at type and subtype levels using weighted metrics (accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score). A feature-engineered XGBoost model using text- and simulation-derived features served as a baseline. Results: LLMs outperformed the XGBoost baseline. At the type level, GPT-mini with heuristic augmentation achieved the highest performance (accuracy 96.0%, F1 0.962). At the subtype level, both GPT-5.2+heuristics and GPT-mini+heuristics achieved identical accuracy (88.1%), with GPT-5.2+heuristics achieving the highest F1(0.878). Model outputs were consistent across runs and errors confined to related mechanistic families. Discussion and Conclusion: LLMs demonstrate strong potential for metadata annotation directly from source code, outperforming feature-engineering approaches with minimal tuning. However, performance varied across subtypes, and errors often reflected ambiguity or bias toward more common labels. These findings suggest LLMs may serve as practical tools for scalable metadata generation in biomedical repositories, although careful evaluation and domain-specific validation remain important. While demonstrated in computational neuroscience, this approach may generalize to repository-agnostic metadata annotation in other scientific code repositories.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究探讨了利用大语言模型（LLM）自动化提取生物医学模型代码中缺失元数据的可行性。研究利用 ModelDB 数据库中的 5,133 个神经科学模型文件，对比了 GPT-5.2、GPT-mini 与传统机器学习模型（XGBoost）在识别离子通道和受体亚型任务中的表现。

## 为什么相关
在病原生物学和基因组学领域，大量生物信息学分析流程（如 Nextflow 或 Snakemake 脚本）缺乏标准化的元数据标注。本文展示的从源代码直接推断生物学功能标签的方法，可用于自动化整理病原体检测管线或蛋白质组学分析脚本的元数据，提升数据仓库的可搜索性和复用性。

## 新颖度判断
新颖度较低（0.25）。虽然使用了较新的模型（GPT-5.2），但将 LLM 用于代码解析和元数据提取已是 NLP 领域的成熟应用。其贡献主要在于针对生物医学特定领域（离子通道/受体）的提示词工程（启发式增强）和在专业数据库 ModelDB 上的实证评估。

## 方法与证据
- **数据规模**：使用 5,133 个模型文件，其中 1,100 个经过人工标注，253 个作为独立测试集。
- **模型对比**：对比了 GPT-5.2、GPT-mini（零样本及启发式增强）与基于文本/模拟特征的 XGBoost 基线。
- **关键指标**：在类型级别，GPT-mini + 启发式增强达到 96.0% 准确率；在更细分的亚型级别，GPT-5.2 + 启发式增强准确率为 88.1%，F1 分数为 0.878。
- **结论证据**：LLM 表现一致性高，错误主要集中在亲缘关系较近的机械家族（Mechanistic families）之间。

## 应用价值
该方法可直接应用于生物医学代码库的自动化治理。对于临床微生物学实验室，可用于自动化标注内部开发的分析脚本，减少人工维护元数据的负担。其“启发式增强提示”策略证明了结合领域知识可以显著提升 LLM 在专业任务中的表现。

## 局限与风险
- **亚型识别瓶颈**：在亚型级别的准确率（88.1%）明显低于类型级别，说明对精细生物学分类的理解仍有挑战。
- **标签偏见**：摘要指出模型对常见标签存在偏见，这可能导致罕见病原体或特殊受体亚型的误报。
- **泛化性待验证**：虽然研究认为可推广，但目前仅在神经科学代码上验证，在基因组学或蛋白质组学脚本上的表现尚未测试。

papers.title: Enhancing Linux Privilege Escalation Attack Capabilities of Local LLM Agents
papers.text:
title: Enhancing Linux Privilege Escalation Attack Capabilities of Local LLM Agents
source: arXiv
topics: foundation_model_agent
category: foundation_model
why: 这篇工作偏基础模型/Agent方向，可能影响病原检测任务的建模上限，值得关注其任务定义与评测设计。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: Recent research has demonstrated the potential of Large Language Models (LLMs) for autonomous penetration testing, particularly when using cloud-based restricted-weight models. However, reliance on such models introduces security, privacy, and sovereignty concerns, motivating the use of locally hosted open-weight alternatives. Prior work shows that small open-weight models perform poorly on automated Linux privilege escalation, limiting their practical applicability. In this paper, we present a systematic empirical study of whether targeted system-level and prompting interventions can bridge this performance gap. We analyze failure modes of open-weight models in autonomous privilege escalation, map them to established enhancement techniques, and evaluate five concrete interventions (chain-of-thought prompting, retrieval-augmented generation, structured prompts, history compression, and reflective analysis) implemented as extensions to hackingBuddyGPT. Our results show that open-weight models can match or outperform cloud-based baselines such as GPT-4o. With our treatments enabled, Llama3.1 70B exploits 83% of tested vulnerabilities, while smaller models including Llama3.1 8B and Qwen2.5 7B achieve 67% when using guidance. A full-factorial ablation study over all treatment combinations reveals that reflection-based treatments contribute most, while also identifying vulnerability discovery as a remaining bottleneck for local models.

papers.title: Toward Autonomous SOC Operations: End-to-End LLM Framework for Threat Detection, Query Generation, and Resolution in Security Operations
papers.text:
title: Toward Autonomous SOC Operations: End-to-End LLM Framework for Threat Detection, Query Generation, and Resolution in Security Operations
source: arXiv
topics: foundation_model_agent
category: foundation_model
why: 这篇工作偏基础模型/Agent方向，可能影响病原检测任务的建模上限，值得关注其任务定义与评测设计。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: Security Operations Centers (SOCs) face mounting operational challenges. These challenges come from increasing threat volumes, heterogeneous SIEM platforms, and time-consuming manual triage workflows. We present an end-to-end threat management framework that integrates ensemble-based detection, syntax-constrained query generation, and retrieval-augmented resolution support to automate critical security workflows. Our detection module evaluates both traditional machine learning classifiers and large language models (LLMs), then combines the three best-performing LLMs to create an ensemble model, achieving 82.8% accuracy while maintaining 0.120 false positive rate on SIEM logs. We introduce the SQM (Syntax Query Metadata) architecture for automated evidence collection. It uses platform-specific syntax constraints, metadata-based retrieval, and documentation-grounded prompting to generate executable queries for IBM QRadar and Google SecOps. SQM achieves a BLEU score of 0.384 and a ROUGE-L score of 0.731. These results are more than twice as good as the baseline LLM performance. For incident resolution and recommendation generation, we demonstrate that integrating SQM-derived evidence improves resolution code prediction accuracy from 78.3% to 90.0%, with an overall recommendation quality score of 8.70. In production SOC environments, our framework reduces average incident triage time from hours to under 10 minutes. This work demonstrates that domain-constrained LLM architectures with retrieval augmentation can meet the strict reliability and efficiency requirements of operational security environments at scale.

papers.title: Can large language models approximate human perceptions of disease severity? An evaluation using Global Burden of Disease 2010 disability weights
papers.text:
title: Can large language models approximate human perceptions of disease severity? An evaluation using Global Burden of Disease 2010 disability weights
source: medRxiv
topics: foundation_model_agent
category: foundation_model
why: 这篇工作偏基础模型/Agent方向，可能影响病原检测任务的建模上限，值得关注其任务定义与评测设计。
abstract_zh: 伤残权重（DW）是衡量健康损失严重程度、估算全球疾病负担（GBD）中伤残调整寿命年的核心指标。传统 DW 估算依赖高成本的人口调查，难以快速更新。本研究评估了大型语言模型（LLM）通过结构化判断任务模拟人类对疾病严重程度感知的潜力。研究采用 GBD 2010 中的 222 种健康状态，利用 GPT-5 和 Claude 4.5 等四种模型进行了 24,531 对两两比较。结果显示，LLM 与 GBD 2010 DW 排名高度一致（Spearman's ρ 为 0.893 至 0.909）。研究发现，韩语提示和韩国文化角色提示显著提升了与韩国本土 DW 的吻合度，而医学专家角色提示反而降低了与公众感知的一致性。此外，研究提出的 BLIP 估算器在交叉验证中表现优异（Pearson's r = 0.862），并为长新冠（Long COVID）提供了合理的 DW 估算值。结论认为，LLM 可作为传统调查的补充，为新兴健康状态提供可靠的严重程度评估框架。
abstract: Background: Disability weights (DWs) quantify the severity of health loss and are essential for estimating disability-adjusted life years in the Global Burden of Disease (GBD) framework. Conventional DW estimation relies on resource-intensive population surveys that are difficult to update or adapt to emerging health states. Large language models (LLMs) may offer a scalable alternative by approximating human perceptions of disease severity through structured judgment tasks. Methods: This exploratory study evaluated the alignment between LLM-derived and human-derived DW rankings using 222 health states from GBD 2010. All possible pairwise comparisons (24,531 pairs, each repeated three times) were conducted across four LLMs (GPT-5 mini, GPT-5, Claude Haiku 4.5, and Claude Sonnet 4.5). DWs were estimated via probit regression and evaluated using Spearman's rank correlation and Steiger's z test. The effects of prompt language (English vs. Korean), cultural role prompting, and medical specialist role prompting on alignment were examined. Additionally, the Binomial-Logit Indifference-Point (BLIP) estimator was proposed and validated through leave-one-out cross-validation for estimating DWs for health states without established values. Results: All four LLMs showed high rank correlation with GBD 2010 DWs (Spearman's {rho} = 0.893 to 0.909), with no significant inter-model differences. Korean-language prompting significantly improved alignment with Korean DWs ({rho} = 0.756 vs. 0.715, p = 0.011), and Korean cultural role prompting improved alignment with both GBD 2010 DWs ({rho} = 0.922 vs. 0.909, p = 0.002) and Korean DWs ({rho} = 0.738 vs. 0.715, p = 0.001). Medical specialist role prompting significantly reduced alignment with GBD 2010 DWs ({rho} = 0.895 vs. 0.909, p = 0.001). BLIP demonstrated strong agreement with GBD 2010 DWs (Pearson's r = 0.862, MAE = 0.066) and produced plausible estimates for Long COVID (mild: 0.020, moderate: 0.298, severe: 0.529). Conclusions: LLMs can approximate human perceptions of disease severity with high rank-order consistency. Prompt language and role framing significantly influenced alignment, with culturally grounded lay prompting enhancing and specialist prompting reducing correspondence with population-based DWs. BLIP provides a practical framework for generating provisional DW estimates for emerging or underrepresented health states when conventional surveys are infeasible.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究评估了前沿大语言模型（如 GPT-5、Claude 4.5 系列）在模拟人类对疾病严重程度感知方面的准确性。通过对 GBD 2010 框架下 222 种健康状态进行大规模两两比较（24,531 对），研究验证了 LLM 生成伤残权重（DW）的可行性，并探讨了语言、文化背景及专业角色提示对评估结果的影响。

## 为什么相关
本研究属于 AI/LLM 与临床医学及公共卫生政策的交叉领域。虽然不直接涉及病原基因组学，但其任务定义（疾病严重程度量化）对于临床微生物学中评估新发传染病的社会影响具有重要参考价值，特别是其针对“新兴健康状态”的建模方法可直接用于新发病原体感染后的后遗症评估。

## 新颖度判断
新颖度较高。研究不仅停留在模型性能对比，还深入探讨了“角色偏见”：发现医学专家角色提示（Medical specialist role prompting）反而会削弱模型与普通人群感知的一致性（ρ 从 0.909 降至 0.895）。此外，提出的 BLIP 估算器为缺乏历史数据的新疾病提供了系统化的量化工具。

## 方法与证据
- **数据规模**：基于 GBD 2010 的 222 种健康状态，进行了 24,531 对 pairwise 比较，每对重复 3 次。
- **模型对象**：GPT-5 mini, GPT-5, Claude Haiku 4.5, Claude Sonnet 4.5。
- **关键指标**：所有模型均显示出极高的秩相关性（Spearman's ρ > 0.89）。
- **实验变量**：韩语提示显著提高了与韩国 DW 的一致性（p=0.011）；BLIP 估算器在长新冠（Long COVID）严重程度估算上表现出逻辑合理性（重症估值为 0.529）。

## 应用价值
BLIP 框架为临床和公卫领域提供了一种低成本、可扩展的工具，用于在缺乏大规模人口调查的情况下，为新发传染病或罕见病生成初步的伤残权重估算，辅助卫生资源分配决策。

## 局限与风险
摘要明确指出“医学专家角色提示”会降低模型与公众感知的一致性，这提示 LLM 在模拟特定人群偏好时存在对齐风险。此外，研究依赖于 2010 年的历史数据进行验证，对于更现代或更复杂的共病状态（comorbidities）的模拟能力摘要未予说明。

papers.title: Evaluating Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Explainable Malware Analysis
papers.text:
title: Evaluating Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Explainable Malware Analysis
source: arXiv
topics: foundation_model_agent
category: general
why: arXiv 上的新论文与 foundation_model_agent 相关，可用于补充你当前的病原检测与模型监控视角。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly being used as security engineering tools to summarize and explain malware behavior to analysts. A common assumption is that Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) improves explanation quality by injecting external security knowledge. In this work, we empirically evaluate this assumption for malware explanation using VirusTotal reports as structured input. Across multiple LLMs, we find that RAG frequently degrades explanation quality by introducing distracting or weakly related context and adding narrative noise or generic write-ups. Our results highlight a practical risk in security-critical pipelines for malware explanation that RAG can be counterproductive when structured security evidence is already sufficient. We argue that malware explanation is primarily a signal-extraction task, not a knowledge-retrieval problem, and outline design recommendations for secure development workflows.

papers.title: Systematic contextual biases in SegmentNT potentially relevant to other nucleotide transformer models
papers.text:
title: Systematic contextual biases in SegmentNT potentially relevant to other nucleotide transformer models
source: bioRxiv
topics: foundation_model_agent
category: foundation_model
why: 这篇工作偏基础模型/Agent方向，可能影响病原检测任务的建模上限，值得关注其任务定义与评测设计。
abstract_zh: 近期大语言模型（LLM）已扩展至基因组学领域，但模型相对于上下文的鲁棒性仍不明确。本研究揭示了影响 SegmentNT 结果的两种内在偏见：输入序列长度和核苷酸位置。SegmentNT 是 Nucleotide Transformer 框架下的一个模型，旨在提供生物特征的核苷酸级预测。研究证明，核苷酸在输入序列中的位置（开头、中间或结尾）会改变原始预测概率，而通过标准化处理可显著提高预测的一致性。虽然增加输入序列长度能提升模型性能，但边际收益递减现象表明，约 3,072 个核苷酸的输入长度对于许多应用可能已经足够。此外，研究还发现 SegmentNT 的预测概率存在 24 个核苷酸的周期性振荡，这揭示了可能与模型 6-mer 分词方式及架构相关的内在偏见。本研究提出了应对这些偏见的方法，并为利用高分辨率基因组功能预测模型提供了通用见解。
abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have extended to genomic applications, yet model robustness relative to context is unclear. Here, we demonstrate two intrinsic biases (input sequence length and nucleotide position) affecting SegmentNT results, a model included with the Nucleotide Transformer that provides nucleotide-level predictions of biological features. We demonstrate that nucleotide position within the input sequence (beginning, middle, or end) alters the nature of SegmentNT's raw prediction probabilities, which can be standardized to improve prediction consistency. While longer input sequence length improves model performance, diminishing returns suggest a surprisingly small input length of ~3,072 nucleotides might be sufficient for many applications. We further identify a 24-nucleotide periodic oscillation in SegmentNT's prediction probabilities, revealing an intrinsic bias potentially linked to the model's training tokenization (6-mers) and architecture. We identify potential approaches to account for these biases and provide generalizable insights for utilizing nucleotide-resolution functional prediction models.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究系统性地评估了基因组基础模型 SegmentNT 在进行核苷酸水平功能预测时的鲁棒性。研究重点发现了三种关键的上下文偏见：核苷酸在输入序列中的相对位置偏见、输入序列长度对性能的影响，以及一种与分词机制相关的 24-nt 周期性预测振荡。

## 为什么相关
在病原体基因组分析和临床微生物学中，准确识别基因组特征（如启动子、剪接位点或耐药基因边界）至关重要。SegmentNT 作为 Nucleotide Transformer 的重要组成部分，其预测的准确性直接影响下游分析。了解这些内在偏见有助于研究人员在处理病原体短序列或片段化基因组数据时，避免因模型伪影导致的错误推断。

## 新颖度判断
新颖度较低（0.25）。该工作属于对已有基础模型的“诊断性”研究，而非提出全新的架构。其价值在于首次定量揭示了 SegmentNT 这种特定架构（基于 6-mer tokenization）在推理时产生的系统性偏差，并对最优输入长度给出了具体建议。

## 方法与证据
- **实验对象**：SegmentNT 模型，用于核苷酸级生物特征预测。
- **位置偏见证据**：摘要指出核苷酸处于序列的开头、中间或结尾会改变原始预测概率，通过标准化可改善一致性。
- **长度效应证据**：通过对比不同长度输入，发现性能随长度增加而提升，但在约 3,072 个核苷酸处出现边际收益递减。
- **周期性偏见证据**：识别出 24 个核苷酸的周期性概率振荡，并将其归因于模型采用的 6-mer 分词（Tokenization）策略和架构设计。

## 应用价值
- **性能优化**：建议在许多应用中使用 ~3,072 nt 的输入长度，这有助于在保证预测质量的同时降低计算开销。
- **结果校准**：提出的标准化方法可以减少因序列位置导致的预测波动，提高临床基因组分析的可靠性。
- **模型设计参考**：为开发下一代基因组 LLM 提供了关于分词伪影（Artifacts）的警示，有助于改进未来模型的 Tokenization 方案。

## 局限与风险
- **模型局限性**：研究主要针对 SegmentNT，虽然摘要提到可能适用于其他核苷酸 Transformer 模型，但缺乏对其他主流模型（如 DNABERT 或 HyenaDNA）的直接对比数据。
- **数据细节缺失**：摘要未说明测试所使用的具体生物学特征数据集（如物种来源、具体的调控元件类型等）。
- **偏见消除效果**：虽然提到了标准化方法，但未给出标准化后性能提升的具体量化指标。

papers.title: DiCLIP: Diffusion Model Enhances CLIP's Dense Knowledge for Weakly Supervised Semantic Segmentation
papers.text:
title: DiCLIP: Diffusion Model Enhances CLIP's Dense Knowledge for Weakly Supervised Semantic Segmentation
source: arXiv
topics: foundation_model_agent
category: methods
why: 这篇工作更像方法创新，可能直接关联 metagenomics、long-read 或 pathogen identification 流程优化。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: Weakly Supervised Semantic Segmentation (WSSS) with image-level labels typically leverages Class Activation Maps (CAMs) to achieve pixel-level predictions. Recently, Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) has been introduced to generate CAMs in WSSS. However, previous WSSS methods solely adopt CLIP's vision-language paired property for dense localization, neglecting its inherently limited dense knowledge across both visual and text modalities, which renders CAM generation suboptimal. In this work, we propose DiCLIP, a novel WSSS framework that leverages the generative diffusion model to enhance CLIP's dense knowledge across two modalities. Specifically, Visual Correlation Enhancement (VCE) and Text Semantic Augmentation (TSA) modules are proposed for dense prediction enhancement. To improve the spatial awareness of visual features, our VCE module utilizes diffusion's reliable spatial consistency to mitigate the over-smoothing issue in CLIP's attention. It designs the Attention Clustering Refinement (ACR) module to reliably extract diverse correlation maps from the diffusion model. The correlation maps act as a diversity bias for CLIP's self-attention, recursively pushing its visual features towards a more discriminative dense distribution. To augment the semantics of text embeddings, our TSA module argues that a single text modality is insufficient to encompass the variability of visual categories. Thus, we leverage diffusion's generative power to maintain a dynamic key-value cache model, shifting CAM generation from a patch-text matching mechanism to a novel visual knowledge retrieval paradigm. With these enhancements, DiCLIP not only outperforms state-of-the-art methods on PASCAL VOC and MS COCO but also significantly reduces training costs. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/zwyang6/DiCLIP.

papers.title: DentaCoPilot: An LLM-Augmented Next-Procedure Recommender for General Dentistry, Designed for Dentist Augmentation
papers.text:
title: DentaCoPilot: An LLM-Augmented Next-Procedure Recommender for General Dentistry, Designed for Dentist Augmentation
source: medRxiv
topics: foundation_model_agent
category: clinical_application
why: 这篇工作更接近临床/监测落地，适合评估其对快速识别、预警或治疗辅助的实际价值。
abstract_zh: 2026年的商业牙科AI主要集中在影像学诊断（如龋齿、牙槽骨检测），但针对“下一步该做什么”的临床决策支持仍是难题。本研究推出DentaCoPilot，这是一款基于结构化病历推荐后续操作的系统。该系统可输出当前牙科术语（CDT）代码的Top-K概率分布、置信度标签、在信息不足时的弃权标志以及基于病历的解释理由。研究对比了4种传统基准（如XGBoost、CNN-RNN）与6种大语言模型（LLM）变体（如Claude Sonnet/Opus）。在500名患者的合成病历语料库（1284个测试样本）上，传统基准的Top-1准确率为0.567，而纯LLM表现较差（0.267-0.467）。然而，通过将传统基准的Top-10候选结果作为提示词输入Sonnet模型，其Top-5准确率从0.733提升至0.933，在保持可解释性的同时达到了传统模型的水平。结果表明，将小型LLM与传统基准结合是目前最经济高效的牙科临床辅助设计方案。
abstract: Background. Commercial dental artificial intelligence in 2026 is overwhelmingly diagnostic: caries, calculus, periapical, and bone-level detection on radiographs. The clinically harder question that follows every diagnosis-given a patient's chart and most recent procedure, what should the dentist do next-remains unsolved at general-dentistry scale. The closest published system, MultiTP (Chen et al., 2024), is a CNN-RNN restricted to partial-edentulism cases and provides neither calibrated uncertainty, structured rationale, nor an evaluation that treats the model as decision support instead of an autonomous classifier. Methods. We introduce DentaCoPilot, a recommender that, given a structured chart, returns (i) a calibrated top-K probability distribution over Current Dental Terminology (CDT) codes for the next procedure,(ii) a verbalised confidence label, (iii) an explicit abstain flag when context is insufficient, and (iv) a chart-grounded rationale. We compare four classical baselines (frequency bigram, TF-IDF + logistic regression, XGBoost, MultiTP-style CNN-RNN) and six large-language-model (LLM) variants (Claude Haiku, Sonnet + chain-of-thought, Sonnet + retrieval, Opus + chain-of-thought, Sonnet + classical prior, Opus + classical prior) on a synthetic chart corpus of 500 patients (1,284 test examples). All LLM inference is routed through the local Anthropic Claude Code CLI; every call is logged for full audit. Results. On apples-to-apples evaluation, classical baselines reach 0.567 top-1 / 0.967 top-5; pure LLM variants trail at 0.267-0.467 top-1. Prompt-conditioning a Sonnet LLM on the classical baseline's top-10 candidates (M5) closes the gap: top-5 rises from 0.733 (pure Sonnet + chain-of-thought) to 0.933, matching classical baselines, while preserving rationale and abstention. Increasing the LLM backbone from Sonnet to Opus does not improve accuracy with or without priming. Calibration via temperature scaling and coverage-risk analysis is reported for the baselines. Conclusion. Prompt-conditioning a small LLM on a classical baseline's top-K is the most cost-effective LLM design we tested for next-procedure recommendation, and the design preserves the augmentation features that distinguish the system from an autonomous classifier. A pre-registered clinician-in-the-loop evaluation at the KLE Vishwanath Katti Institute of Dental Sciences (Belgaum, India) and a real-data evaluation on the multi-institutional BigMouth dental data repository are the next stage of work.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究开发了名为 DentaCoPilot 的临床决策支持系统，旨在解决通用牙科领域中“下一步诊疗程序推荐”的问题。系统通过整合结构化病历数据，利用大语言模型（LLM）与传统机器学习算法的混合架构，预测后续的当前牙科术语（CDT）代码，并提供校准后的置信度、弃权机制及理由说明。

## 为什么相关
该工作属于临床微生物学与通用医学人工智能的交叉领域，特别是“基础模型智能体（Foundation Model Agent）”在临床路径规划中的应用。它从单纯的影像诊断（如病原体引起的龋齿检测）转向了更复杂的临床决策流建模，对构建智能化临床诊疗规范具有参考价值。

## 新颖度判断
新颖度中等偏低（0.25）。其创新点在于：1. 任务目标从“自动分类”转向“医生增强（Augmentation）”；2. 引入了“弃权标志（Abstain flag）”和“校准置信度”；3. 验证了“传统模型提供先验+LLM生成理由”的混合架构优于纯LLM方案。但其核心方法仍基于现有的 Claude 系列模型和提示词工程。

## 方法与证据
- **数据规模**：使用包含 500 名患者、1,284 个测试样本的合成病历语料库。
- **模型对比**：对比了传统模型（TF-IDF+逻辑回归、XGBoost、CNN-RNN）与 Claude (Haiku, Sonnet, Opus) 的多种变体。
- **关键指标**：传统基准 Top-1 准确率为 0.567，Top-5 为 0.967。纯 LLM 表现不佳（Top-1 仅 0.267-0.467）。
- **核心证据**：通过将传统模型的 Top-10 候选结果作为提示词输入 Sonnet 模型（M5 方案），Top-5 准确率显著提升至 0.933，且保留了 LLM 的解释生成能力。

## 应用价值
该系统通过提供 CDT 代码推荐和结构化理由，可作为牙科医生的“副驾驶”，辅助制定诊疗计划。其弃权机制能有效防止在信息不足时误导医生，具有较高的临床落地潜力，特别是对于标准化诊疗流程的监控与预警。

## 局限与风险
- **数据局限**：摘要明确指出目前仅在“合成病历语料库”上进行了评估，尚未在真实临床数据上验证。
- **模型性能**：纯 LLM 在此类高度专业化的代码预测任务中表现远逊于传统统计模型，必须依赖传统算法进行“预热（Priming）”。
- **规模效应缺失**：增加模型规模（从 Sonnet 升级到 Opus）并未提升准确率，说明单纯增加参数量无法解决该领域的专业逻辑问题。

papers.title: Route Before Retrieve: Activating Latent Routing Abilities of LLMs for RAG vs. Long-Context Selection
papers.text:
title: Route Before Retrieve: Activating Latent Routing Abilities of LLMs for RAG vs. Long-Context Selection
source: arXiv
topics: foundation_model_agent
category: methods
why: 这篇工作更像方法创新，可能直接关联 metagenomics、long-read 或 pathogen identification 流程优化。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have expanded the context window to beyond 128K tokens, enabling long-document understanding and multi-source reasoning. A key challenge, however, lies in choosing between retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and long-context (LC) strategies: RAG is efficient but constrained by retrieval quality, while LC supports global reasoning at higher cost and with position sensitivity. Existing methods such as Self-Route adopt failure-driven fallback from RAG to LC, but remain passive, inefficient, and hard to interpret. We propose Pre-Route, a proactive routing framework that performs structured reasoning before answering. Using lightweight metadata (e.g., document type, length, initial snippet), Pre-Route enables task analysis, coverage estimation, and information-need prediction, producing explainable and cost-efficient routing decisions. Our study shows three key findings: (i) LLMs possess latent routing ability that can be reliably elicited with guidelines, allowing single-sample performance to approach that of multi-sample (Best-of-N) results; (ii) linear probes reveal that structured prompts sharpen the separability of the "optimal routing dimension" in representation space; and (iii) distillation transfers this reasoning structure to smaller models for lightweight deployment. Experiments on LaRA (in-domain) and LongBench-v2 (OOD) confirm that Pre-Route outperforms Always-RAG, Always-LC, and Self-Route baselines, achieving superior overall cost-effectiveness.

papers.title: ANCHOR: Abductive Network Construction with Hierarchical Orchestration for Reliable Probability Inference in Large Language Models
papers.text:
title: ANCHOR: Abductive Network Construction with Hierarchical Orchestration for Reliable Probability Inference in Large Language Models
source: arXiv
topics: foundation_model_agent
category: foundation_model
why: 这篇工作偏基础模型/Agent方向，可能影响病原检测任务的建模上限，值得关注其任务定义与评测设计。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: A central challenge in large-scale decision-making under incomplete information is estimating reliable probabilities. Recent approaches use Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate explanatory factors and coarse-grained probability estimates, which are then refined by a Naïve Bayes model over factor combinations. However, sparse factor spaces often yield ``unknown'' predictions, while expanding factors increases noise and spurious correlations, weakening conditional independence and degrading reliability. To address these limitations, we propose \textsc{Anchor}, an aggregated Bayesian inference framework over a hierarchical factor space. It constructs dense factor hierarchies through iterative generation and clustering, maps contexts via hierarchical retrieval and refinement, and augments Naïve Bayes with a Causal Bayesian Network to model latent factor dependencies. Experiments show that \textsc{Anchor} markedly reduces ``unknown'' predictions and produces more reliable probability estimates than direct LLM baselines, achieving state-of-the-art performance while significantly reducing time and token overhead.

papers.title: Letting the neural code speak: Automated characterization of monkey visual neurons through human language
papers.text:
title: Letting the neural code speak: Automated characterization of monkey visual neurons through human language
source: arXiv
topics: foundation_model_agent
category: methods
why: 这篇工作更像方法创新，可能直接关联 metagenomics、long-read 或 pathogen identification 流程优化。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: Understanding what individual neurons encode is a core question in neuroscience. In primary visual cortex (V1), mathematical models (e.g., Gabor functions) capture neural selectivity, but no comparable framework exists for higher areas. We show that natural language can fill this role: across macaque V1 and V4, the selectivity of most neurons is captured by concise, verifiable semantic descriptions. Using digital twins of V1 and V4, we develop a closed-loop framework that translates each neuron's high- and low-activating images into dense captions, generates a semantic hypothesis and synthesized images, and verifies the hypothesis in silico. Descriptions range from oriented edges and spatial frequency in V1 to conjunctions of form, color, and texture in V4. In V4, images generated from activating and suppressing hypotheses drove 96.1% of neurons above the 95th and 97.6% below the 5th percentile of natural-image responses, respectively (vs. ~10\% for random images); V1 activation results matched V4, while V1 suppression was less describable in language. Representational similarity analysis reveals partial alignment between neural activity, vision embeddings, and language embeddings, with vision most aligned to neural activity; alignment lost in the text bottleneck is recovered when hypotheses are rendered back into images, showing that linguistic compression is lossy yet semantically faithful. Together, these results show that combining generative models with neural digital twins enables interpretable, testable descriptions of neural function at scale, toward agentic scientific discovery.

papers.title: An Agentic AI Framework with Large Language Models and Chain-of-Thought for UAV-Assisted Logistics Scheduling with Mobile Edge Computing
papers.text:
title: An Agentic AI Framework with Large Language Models and Chain-of-Thought for UAV-Assisted Logistics Scheduling with Mobile Edge Computing
source: arXiv
topics: foundation_model_agent
category: methods
why: 这篇工作更像方法创新，可能直接关联 metagenomics、long-read 或 pathogen identification 流程优化。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: In cloud manufacturing, unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) can support both product collection and mobile edge computing (MEC). This joint operation forms a hybrid scheduling problem, where physical logistics decisions are coupled with computational task scheduling. In this paper, UAVs collect finished products from manufacturing stations and transport them back to a central depot. Meanwhile, computational tasks generated by industrial sensor devices at these stations are processed locally, at UAVs, or offloaded via UAVs to the cloud. This coupling makes the problem challenging. A UAV can provide MEC services only during its service window at a station, so routing decisions directly determine when UAV-assisted offloading is available. Routing decisions also affect the UAV energy budget and the availability of onboard computing and communication resources for computational task execution under task deadline constraints. To address this, we propose an agentic-AI-assisted optimization framework with two components. First, we develop an agentic AI that combines large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, and chain-of-thought reasoning to translate user input into an interpretable mathematical formulation for the hybrid scheduling problem. Second, we design a hierarchical deep reinforcement learning approach based on proximal policy optimization (PPO), where the upper layer learns UAV routing and the lower layer optimizes per-slot task execution and resource allocation. Simulation results show that the proposed framework yields more consistent formulations, while the hierarchical PPO achieves full product collection in 99.6% of the last 500 episodes and maintains a 100% deadline satisfaction rate, with more stable performance than the advantage actor-critic approach.
analysis_zh:

papers.title: Deepchecks: Evaluating Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
papers.text:
title: Deepchecks: Evaluating Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
source: arXiv
topics: foundation_model_agent
category: methods
why: 这篇工作更像方法创新，可能直接关联 metagenomics、long-read 或 pathogen identification 流程优化。
abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）结合检索增强生成（RAG）技术正在医疗、金融和客户服务等多个领域引发变革。尽管潜力巨大，但由于生成输出的随机性以及检索与生成组件之间复杂的相互作用，评估 RAG 系统仍是一项复杂的挑战。本文介绍了 Deepchecks，这是一个专门为评估 RAG 应用而量身定制的综合框架。Deepchecks 的评估框架通过多维度方法、根本原因分析和生产监控来解决 RAG 应用的评估问题。通过确保评估过程与特定应用的需求保持一致，该框架为衡量 RAG 系统的可靠性、相关性和用户满意度提供了坚实基础，旨在解决检索与生成环节中的不确定性问题。
abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) augmented with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) techniques are revolutionizing applications across multiple domains, such as healthcare, finance, and customer service. Despite their potential, evaluating RAG systems remains a complex challenge due to the stochastic nature of generated outputs and the intricate interplay between retrieval and generation components. This paper introduces Deepchecks, a comprehensive framework tailored for evaluating RAG applications. Deepchecks' evaluation framework addresses RAG applications evaluation through a multi-faceted approach, root cause analysis and production monitoring. By ensuring alignment with application-specific requirements, Deepchecks framework provides a robust foundation for assessing reliability, relevance, and user satisfaction in RAG systems.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究推出了名为 Deepchecks 的综合性评估框架，专门用于解决检索增强生成（RAG）系统的评估难题。其核心功能涵盖了多维度评估、故障的根本原因分析（Root Cause Analysis）以及针对生产环境的实时监控，旨在提升 LLM 在复杂应用场景中的输出质量。

## 为什么相关
在病原生物学和临床微生物学领域，研究人员常利用 RAG 技术检索海量的基因组文献或临床指南。由于临床决策对准确性要求极高，Deepchecks 提供的“根本原因分析”能帮助开发者定位是检索到的病原体序列不匹配，还是 LLM 生成的解释有误，这对于优化病原体鉴定流程和耐药性分析工具至关重要。

## 新颖度判断
新颖度较低（0.25）。虽然该框架整合了监控和根因分析，但从摘要来看，其基本逻辑仍遵循现有的 RAG 评估范式（如评估检索相关性与生成忠实度）。其价值更多体现在工程化落地和系统化集成，而非底层算法的突破性创新。

## 方法与证据
摘要提到的方法包括：1. **多维度方法**（multi-faceted approach），用于应对生成输出的随机性；2. **根本原因分析**，用于拆解检索与生成的交互问题；3. **生产监控**，确保系统在实际运行中的稳定性。摘要未说明具体的实验数据集规模、未列出对比基准模型（如 RAGAS 或 TruLens）的具体指标差异，也未提供量化的准确率提升数据。

## 应用价值
该框架在临床微生物学 AI 助手开发中具有直接应用价值。通过其“生产监控”功能，可以实时监测 AI 在解读复杂宏基因组报告时的表现；“可靠性评估”则能降低 AI 在提供病原体致病性结论时产生幻觉的风险，确保输出符合医疗特定需求。

## 局限与风险
摘要未说明该框架是否支持长文本（Long-read）检索的特殊评估，也未提及对于生物医学专业术语（如复杂的分类学名）的识别优化。此外，摘要未披露该框架在处理高度专业化、非公开的临床数据集时的计算开销或隐私保护机制。

papers.title: Not All RAGs Are Created Equal: A Component-Wise Empirical Study for Software Engineering Tasks
papers.text:
title: Not All RAGs Are Created Equal: A Component-Wise Empirical Study for Software Engineering Tasks
source: arXiv
topics: foundation_model_agent
category: methods
why: 这篇工作更像方法创新，可能直接关联 metagenomics、long-read 或 pathogen identification 流程优化。
abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）正被广泛用于将大语言模型（LLM）与软件工件结合，但其组件的最优配置在软件工程（SE）任务中仍不明确，导致从业者常陷入高成本的试错。本研究对 RAG 流水线进行了全面的组件级实证研究，评估了超过 21 种模型和方法。研究系统地隔离并评估了 4 种查询处理技术、7 种涵盖稀疏、密集和混合范式的检索模型、4 种上下文精炼方法以及 6 种不同的生成器。我们在代码生成、摘要和修复这三类核心 SE 任务上测试了这些组件。实证结果揭示了一个关键洞察：检索端组件（尤其是检索算法的选择）对系统最终性能的影响往往比生成器模型的选择更为显著。令人惊讶的是，经典的词法检索器 BM25 在不同任务中表现出极强的鲁棒性。本分析为构建有效的软件工程 RAG 系统提供了数据驱动的路线图，指导开发者在优化工作中明确优先级。
abstract: While Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is increasingly adopted to ground Large Language Models (LLMs) in software artifacts, the optimal configuration of its components remains an open question for software engineering (SE) tasks. The lack of systematic guidance forces practitioners into costly, ad-hoc experimentation. This paper presents a comprehensive, component-wise empirical study that dissects the RAG pipeline, evaluating over 21 distinct models and methods. Our study systematically isolates and evaluates 4 query processing techniques, 7 retrieval models spanning sparse, dense, and hybrid paradigms, 4 context refinement methods, and 6 distinct generators. We test these components on a suite of 3 core SE tasks: code generation, summarization, and repair. Our empirical findings reveal a crucial insight: the retriever-side components, particularly the choice of the retrieval algorithm, often exert a more significant influence on final system performance than the selection of the generator model. Strikingly, the classic lexical retriever BM25 demonstrates exceptionally robust performance across diverse tasks. Our analysis provides a practical, data-driven roadmap for researchers and practitioners, offering clear guidance on prioritizing optimization efforts when constructing effective RAG systems for software engineering contexts.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究针对软件工程（SE）领域，对检索增强生成（RAG）流水线进行了系统性的组件拆解实验。研究者评估了包括查询处理（4种）、检索模型（7种，含稀疏、密集、混合范式）、上下文精炼（4种）和生成器（6种）在内的21个以上模型和方法，旨在确定在代码生成、摘要和修复任务中，哪些组件对最终性能贡献最大。

## 为什么相关
虽然本论文的研究对象是软件工程，但其结论对“病原生信”和“临床微生物学”领域的知识检索具有高度参考价值。在处理大规模基因组元数据、临床指南或病原体特征数据库时，研究者同样面临如何构建高效 RAG 系统的问题。论文提出的“检索器优于生成器”的观点，暗示在生物信息学 RAG 应用中，优化序列比对或文献检索算法可能比单纯升级 LLM 模型（如 GPT-4）更有效。

## 新颖度判断
**中等偏低（方法论创新）**。RAG 的组件化研究在通用 NLP 领域已有先例，但本文的新颖之处在于针对 SE 任务进行了极其详尽的受控实验（Controlled Experiment），通过隔离变量的方式量化了 21 种不同组件的影响力，并挑战了“生成器决定论”的固有认知。

## 方法与证据
- **实验设计**：采用组件隔离法，分别测试了 4 种查询技术、7 种检索模型、4 种精炼方法和 6 种生成器。
- **任务指标**：在代码生成、代码摘要和代码修复三个核心任务上进行评估。
- **关键证据**：实验发现检索算法的选择对性能的影响显著超过生成器。具体而言，传统的词法检索器 **BM25** 在 SE 任务中的表现优于许多复杂的密集向量检索模型，展现了极高的鲁棒性。

## 应用价值
为构建病原体基因组分析助手或临床微生物决策支持系统提供了“避坑指南”：
1. **优先级指导**：在资源有限时，应优先优化检索算法（如针对生物序列优化的索引）而非盲目追求更大的生成模型。
2. **成本优化**：证实了 BM25 等低成本算法在特定结构化任务中的有效性，有助于降低生信 AI 工具的部署成本。

## 局限与风险
- **领域局限性**：摘要明确指出实验基于“软件工件”（Software Artifacts），其结论（如 BM25 的胜出）可能源于代码具有极强的词法特征。在处理非结构化的临床病历或高度变异的病毒序列时，该结论是否成立尚存疑。
- **数据规模**：摘要未说明测试集的具体规模（如样本量），仅提到涵盖了 3 类任务，需警惕小规模数据集带来的偏差。

papers.title: NiCLIP: Neuroimaging contrastive language-image pretraining model for predicting text from brain activation images
papers.text:
title: NiCLIP: Neuroimaging contrastive language-image pretraining model for predicting text from brain activation images
source: bioRxiv
topics: foundation_model_agent
category: foundation_model
why: 这篇工作偏基础模型/Agent方向，可能影响病原检测任务的建模上限，值得关注其任务定义与评测设计。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: Predicting cognitive processes from brain activation maps has remained an open question within the neuroscience community for many years. Meta-analytic functional decoding methods aim to tackle this issue by providing a quantitative estimation of behavioral profiles associated with specific brain regions. Existing methods face intrinsic challenges in neuroimaging meta-analysis, particularly in consolidating textual information from publications, as they rely on limited metrics that do not capture the semantic context of the text. The combination of large language models (LLMs) with advanced deep contrastive learning models (e.g., CLIP) for aligning text with images has revolutionized neuroimaging meta-analysis, potentially offering solutions to functional decoding challenges. In this work, we present NiCLIP, a contrastive language-image pretrained model that predicts cognitive tasks, concepts, and domains from brain activation patterns. We leveraged over 23,000 neuroscientific articles to train a CLIP model for text-to-brain association. Evaluation of NiCLIP predictions revealed that performance is optimized when using full-text articles instead of abstracts, as well as a curated cognitive ontology with precise task-concept-domain mappings. Furthermore, fine-tuned LLMs (e.g., BrainGPT models) modestly outperform their base LLM counterparts. Our results indicated that NiCLIP accurately predicts cognitive tasks from group-level activation maps provided by the Human Connectome Project across multiple domains (e.g., emotion, language, motor) and precisely characterizes the functional roles of specific brain regions, including the amygdala, hippocampus, and temporoparietal junction. However, NiCLIP showed limitations with noisy subject-level activation maps. NiCLIP represents a significant advancement in quantitative functional decoding for neuroimaging, offering researchers a powerful tool for hypothesis generation and scientific discovery.

papers.title: Retrieval-Augmented Detection of Potentially Abusive Clauses in Chilean Terms of Service
papers.text:
title: Retrieval-Augmented Detection of Potentially Abusive Clauses in Chilean Terms of Service
source: arXiv
topics: foundation_model_agent
category: dataset
why: 这篇工作偏数据集或基准构建，适合判断是否能作为病原组学训练或评测资源。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: Online Terms of Service often function as contracts of adhesion, creating asymmetries that may expose consumers to potentially abusive clauses. In Chile, assessing such clauses is legally challenging because some provisions clearly violate mandatory consumer law, whereas others depend on broader standards such as good faith and contractual imbalance. We present a retrieval-augmented generation framework for the automated detection and classification of potentially abusive clauses in Chilean Terms of Service. Designed for local execution, it combines efficient clause detection, hybrid dense--sparse retrieval, reranking, and prompt augmentation to support medium-sized open-weight language models. We also introduce the Chilean Abusive Terms of Service Extended corpus, comprising 100 contracts and 10,029 annotated clauses in 24 legally grounded categories spanning illegal, dark, and gray clauses. Experiments comparing commercial and open-weight language models, fine-tuned encoders, and traditional baselines show that retrieval-augmented prompting substantially improves performance and enables local models to approach larger cloud-based systems at lower computational and token cost. The study also contributes a refined legal annotation scheme and a practical design for AI-assisted consumer contract review.

papers.title: CroSearch-R1: Better Leveraging Cross-lingual Knowledge for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.text:
title: CroSearch-R1: Better Leveraging Cross-lingual Knowledge for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
source: arXiv
topics: foundation_model_agent
category: methods
why: 这篇工作更像方法创新，可能直接关联 metagenomics、long-read 或 pathogen identification 流程优化。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: A multilingual collection may contain useful knowledge in other languages to supplement and correct the facts in the original language for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). However, the vanilla approach that simply concatenates multiple pieces of knowledge from different languages into the context may fail to improve effectiveness due to the potential disparities across languages. To better leverage multilingual knowledge, we propose CroSearch-R1, a search-augmented reinforcement learning framework to integrate multilingual knowledge into the Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) process. In particular, the approach adopts a multi-turn retrieval strategy with cross-lingual knowledge integration to dynamically align the knowledge from other languages as supplementary evidence into a unified representation space. Furthermore, we introduce a multilingual rollout mechanism to optimize reasoning transferability across languages. Experimental results demonstrate that our framework effectively leverages cross-lingual complementarity and improves the effectiveness of RAG with multilingual collections.

papers.title: Discovery of the rosalexin pathway expands the modular network of maize diterpenoid chemical defenses.
papers.text:
title: Discovery of the rosalexin pathway expands the modular network of maize diterpenoid chemical defenses.
source: bioRxiv
topics: pathogenomics
category: methods
why: 这篇工作更像方法创新，可能直接关联 metagenomics、long-read 或 pathogen identification 流程优化。
abstract_zh: 植物特化代谢的演化增强了其应对病原体和环境压力的能力。在玉米中，祖先赤霉素途径基因的重复与分化产生了高良姜素和多拉布拉素等二萜类化合物，构成了抗病性的核心。本研究通过整合基因组学基因挖掘、组合酶活性测定及 AI 辅助的酶机制研究，揭示了玉米化学防御网络中此前未被发现的新成分——rosalexins 的生物合成途径。研究证明，rosalexin 的合成始于由赤霉素代谢招募的两种二萜合酶 ZmTPS38 和 ZmTPS42 形成的 5-rosanol 支架。随后，多功能 P450 酶 ZmCYP71Z18 将其氧化为具有抗菌活性的 epoxyrosanol。体外实验证实，epoxyrosanol 对真菌病原体具有强抑制作用，而其衍生物则无此活性。尽管转录组和代谢组分析显示病原体可诱导 rosalexin 积累，但由于 ZmTPS42 的基因变异和假基因化，该物质在不同基因型中分布差异巨大，且未观察到显着的显性抗病表型。该发现扩展了对玉米模块化化学防御层演化的认知。
abstract: The evolutionary expansion of specialized metabolism has shaped the ability of plants to adapt to combined pathogen, pest, and other environmental pressures. For instance, the duplication and divergence of ancestral gibberellin pathway genes have given rise to specialized kauralexin and dolabralexin diterpenoids in maize (Zea mays) that serve as core components of disease resistance and stress adaptation. Here, we describe the biosynthesis and elicited production of rosalexins as a previously unrecognized component of the maize chemical defense network. By integrating genomics-enabled gene discovery, combinatorial enzyme assays, and AI-assisted enzyme mechanistic studies we show that maize rosalexin biosynthesis proceeds via a distinct 5-rosanol scaffold formed by the pairwise activity of two diterpene synthases, ZmTPS38/CPS2/AN2 and ZmTPS42/KSL1, recruited from gibberellin metabolism. Further oxygenation by the promiscuous P450 enzyme, ZmCYP71Z18, yields epoxyrosanol that, in turn, can undergo epoxide ring opening to form trihydroxyrosanol. Epoxyrosanol, but not 5-rosanol or trihydroxyrosanol, display strong inhibitory activity on fungal pathogen growth in vitro, highlighting the contribution of the epoxide group to antibiotic efficacy. Large variation in rosalexin presence and abundance exists across maize genotypes due to expansive ZmTPS42/KSL1 gene sequence variation and pseudogenization. Transcriptomics and targeted metabolomics demonstrated the pathogen-elicited accumulation of rosalexins in maize lines featuring functional ZmTPS42/KSL1 genes. However, no dominant pathogen resistance phenotype was observed in association with rosalexin abundance. These collective findings expand our knowledge of how multiple interconnected diterpenoid pathways arose in maize via duplication of hormone-metabolic genes and enable the utilization of a common precursor to form modular chemical defense layers.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究发现了玉米中一种新型二萜类化学防御物质 rosalexins 及其生物合成途径。研究阐明了从赤霉素代谢途径招募的基因（ZmTPS38、ZmTPS42 和 ZmCYP71Z18）如何通过模块化组合，合成具有抗真菌活性的 epoxyrosanol。同时，研究揭示了该途径在不同玉米品种中的遗传多样性及其受病原体诱导的表达特征。

## 为什么相关
该研究属于植物病原基因组学（Pathogenomics）范畴，重点关注宿主如何通过特化代谢产物抵御病原体侵害。对于理解植物-微生物互作中的化学防御机制具有重要意义，特别是揭示了代谢途径如何通过基因重复和功能分化来应对生物胁迫。

## 新颖度判断
**中等偏高**。虽然玉米二萜类代谢已有较多研究，但 rosalexin 作为一个“此前未被识别”的防御成分被首次完整报道。其新颖性在于揭示了 5-rosanol 这一独特支架的形成机制，以及环氧基团（epoxide group）对抗菌功效的关键贡献。

## 方法与证据
1. **基因挖掘与验证**：利用基因组学手段识别候选基因，并通过组合酶活性测定（combinatorial enzyme assays）验证了 ZmTPS38 和 ZmTPS42 的催化功能。
2. **AI 辅助研究**：摘要提到使用“AI-assisted enzyme mechanistic studies”（AI 辅助酶机制研究）来解析酶的催化机理，这属于 AI 在结构生物学或生物化学领域的交叉应用。
3. **表型与活性证据**：通过体外（in vitro）实验对比了 epoxyrosanol、5-rosanol 和 trihydroxyrosanol 对真菌生长的抑制率；利用转录组学和靶向代谢组学证明了病原体诱导的表达模式。

## 应用价值
1. **作物育种**：识别了 ZmTPS42/KSL1 基因的序列变异和假基因化，可作为分子标记用于筛选或培育具有更强化学防御能力的玉米品种。
2. **生物农药开发**：epoxyrosanol 的强效抗真菌活性为开发新型天然抗生素提供了分子模板。

## 局限与风险
1. **AI 交叉程度**：属于**弱 AI 交叉**。AI 仅作为辅助工具用于酶机制研究，并非研究的核心驱动力或方法论创新。
2. **表型不一致**：尽管 rosalexin 在体外有活性且受病原体诱导，但在实验中“未观察到显着的显性抗病表型”，说明其在复杂田间环境下的实际贡献可能受到其他代谢途径的补偿或掩盖。
3. **遗传不稳定性**：由于 ZmTPS42 在许多玉米品系中存在假基因化，该防御途径在现代栽培品种中的普遍性受限。

papers.title: Pretraining a Foundation Model for Small-Molecule Natural Products
papers.text:
title: Pretraining a Foundation Model for Small-Molecule Natural Products
source: arXiv
topics: 
category: methods
why: 这篇工作更像方法创新，可能直接关联 metagenomics、long-read 或 pathogen identification 流程优化。
abstract_zh: 天然产物作为微生物、动物或植物的代谢产物，具有多样的生物活性，是药物研发的关键来源。目前的深度学习方法主要依赖针对特定下游任务的监督学习，缺乏泛化性且性能提升空间有限，且现有分子表征方法难以适配天然产物的独特任务。本研究开发了针对天然产物属性预训练的基础模型 NaFM。该模型采用创新的预训练策略，结合对比学习和掩码图学习目标，在捕捉侧链信息的同时，强调分子骨架的进化信息。实验结果显示，NaFM 在天然产物挖掘和药物研发的多种下游任务中达到了当前最优（SOTA）水平。通过分类任务对比，证明了现有针对合成分子的模型在理解天然合成逻辑方面的不足。此外，NaFM 在基因和微生物层面的细粒度分析中展现了捕捉进化信息的能力。最后，虚拟筛选实验表明，该模型生成的表征能更有效地识别潜在候选药物。
abstract: Natural products, as metabolites from microorganisms, animals, or plants, exhibit diverse biological activities, making them crucial for drug discovery. Nowadays, existing deep learning methods for natural products research primarily rely on supervised learning approaches designed for specific downstream tasks. However, such one-model-for-a-task paradigm often lacks generalizability and leaves significant room for performance improvement. Additionally, existing molecular characterization methods are not well-suited for the unique tasks associated with natural products. To address these limitations, we have pre-trained a foundation model for natural products based on their unique properties. Our approach employs a novel pretraining strategy that is especially tailored to natural products. By incorporating contrastive learning and masked graph learning objectives, we emphasize evolutional information from molecular scaffolds while capturing side-chain information. Our framework achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) results in various downstream tasks related to natural product mining and drug discovery. We first compare taxonomy classification with synthesized molecule-focused baselines to demonstrate that current models are inadequate for understanding natural synthesis. Furthermore, by diving into a fine-grained analysis at both the gene and microbial levels, NaFM demonstrates the ability to capture evolutionary information. Eventually, our method is experimented with virtual screening, illustrating informative natural product representations that can lead to more effective identification of potential drug candidates.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究开发了一个名为 NaFM 的天然产物基础模型，旨在解决传统监督学习模型在天然产物（NP）研究中泛化性差的问题。模型通过对比学习和掩码图学习（Masked Graph Learning）进行预训练，重点提取分子骨架的进化信息和侧链特征，用于支持天然产物挖掘、分类及药物筛选等下游任务。

## 为什么相关
该工作与病原生物学和临床微生物学高度相关。天然产物多来源于微生物代谢（如抗生素），NaFM 能够从基因和微生物层面分析进化信息，这对于通过宏基因组学（Metagenomics）发现新型抗菌药物、理解病原体代谢产物的生物合成逻辑具有直接的技术支撑作用。

## 新颖度判断
新颖度较高（5.75）。不同于以往通用的化学分子模型（如针对合成小分子的模型），NaFM 专门针对天然产物的“进化属性”设计了预训练策略。摘要提到其在分类任务中优于传统合成分子基准模型，并首次强调了分子骨架进化信息在基础模型中的重要性。

## 方法与证据
- **模型架构**：基于图神经网络的预训练基础模型，结合了对比学习（Contrastive Learning）和掩码图学习。
- **训练目标**：同时捕捉分子骨架（Scaffolds）的进化信息和侧链（Side-chain）信息。
- **实验证据**：在天然产物挖掘和药物研发任务中达到 SOTA；在分类任务中对比了“合成分子基准模型”；进行了基因和微生物层面的细粒度分析；完成了虚拟筛选实验验证。
- **数据规模**：摘要未说明具体预训练数据集的大小。

## 应用价值
1. **药物研发**：通过虚拟筛选更有效地识别潜在的候选药物（如新型抗生素）。
2. **微生物研究**：辅助理解微生物代谢产物的分类及其背后的生物合成基因簇（BGCs）进化关系。
3. **流程优化**：可集成至宏基因组挖掘流程中，提高从复杂环境样本中鉴定天然产物的准确率。

## 局限与风险
- **实验验证局限**：摘要中仅提到了虚拟筛选实验，未提及是否经过湿实验（In vitro/In vivo）验证其预测的有效性。
- **数据偏差**：摘要未说明预训练数据是否涵盖了罕见病原体或极端环境微生物的代谢产物。
- **解释性问题**：虽然模型能捕捉进化信息，但其在生物学上的具体解释机制（如特定骨架与特定基因的对应关系）在摘要中未详细展开。

papers.title: Cross-Species Antimicrobial Resistance Prediction from Genomic Foundation Models
papers.text:
title: Cross-Species Antimicrobial Resistance Prediction from Genomic Foundation Models
source: arXiv
topics: 
category: foundation_model
why: 这篇工作偏基础模型/Agent方向，可能影响病原检测任务的建模上限，值得关注其任务定义与评测设计。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: Cross-species antimicrobial resistance (AMR) prediction is fundamentally an out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization problem: models trained on one set of bacterial taxa must transfer to phylogenetically distinct genomes that may rely on different resistance mechanisms. Across species, resistance arises from a heterogeneous mixture of localized, horizontally transferred gene cassettes and diffuse species-specific genomic backgrounds, making successful transfer inherently mechanism-dependent. Using a strict species holdout protocol, we first establish an interpretable k-mer baseline with Kover and show that strong within-species performance collapses under true cross-species evaluation. This motivates representation-level approaches that preserve transferable biological signals rather than amplify phylogenetic shortcuts. We investigate genomic foundation model embeddings derived from Evo-1-8k-base and introduce diagnostics for layer selection based on activation scale, isotropy, effective rank, and cross-seed stability under native bfloat16 inference. These analyses identify a stability boundary in deeper layers and reveal that embeddings extracted near this boundary provide more robust representations for downstream prediction. To preserve localized resistance signals, we treat per-window embeddings as an ordered multivariate signal and apply MiniRocket to summarize multi-scale local activation patterns instead of relying on global pooling. Our results show that aggregation strategy plays a central role in cross-species AMR prediction and that preserving local activation patterns substantially improves generalization when resistance mechanisms are localized.
analysis_zh:

papers.title: Multi-modal benchmarking of the Ultima UG100 and Illumina NovaSeq sequencing platforms using clinically relevant FFPE tissues
papers.text:
title: Multi-modal benchmarking of the Ultima UG100 and Illumina NovaSeq sequencing platforms using clinically relevant FFPE tissues
source: bioRxiv
topics: 
category: foundation_model
why: 这篇工作偏基础模型/Agent方向，可能影响病原检测任务的建模上限，值得关注其任务定义与评测设计。
abstract_zh: 本研究在临床相关的福尔马林固定石蜡包埋（FFPE）组织中，对 Ultima Genomics UG100 与 Illumina NovaSeq 测序平台进行了多模态基准测试。研究涵盖了单核 RNA 测序（snRNA-seq）、全转录组（WTS）、全外显子组（WES）和全基因组测序（WGS），涉及肿瘤和免疫介导疾病样本。通过系统评估数据质量、覆盖度、错误谱、变异一致性和转录组重现性，结果显示 UG100 与 Illumina 具有高度可比性，能准确捕捉关键致癌和免疫相关转录本，解析 snRNA-seq 细胞组成，并保持对低表达基因的敏感性。尽管 UG100 存在特征性的插入偏向性插入缺失（indels）和多重比对读段的细微差异，但这些差异主要局限于假基因和非编码转录本，不影响通路水平的结论。相比于灵敏但噪声较高的 Illumina/DRAGEN 流程，UG100 表现出更高的精准度和更少的低频伪影，提供更清洁但更保守的变异调用谱。该评估证明了 UG100 在大规模人群基因组学中的转化应用潜力。
abstract: Emerging high-throughput sequencing technologies promise lower costs and higher scalability, yet their performance on archival clinical samples remains poorly characterized. Here, we benchmarked Ultima Genomics UG100 against Illumina Novaseq platforms across single-nuclei RNA-seq (snRNA-seq), whole-transcriptome (WTS), whole-exome (WES), and whole-genome sequencing (WGS) using FFPE tissues from oncologic and immune-mediated diseases. Across matched samples, we systematically assessed data quality, coverage profiles, error spectra, variant concordance and transcriptomic reproducibility. UG100 produced highly comparable results to Illumina, capturing key oncogenic and immune-related transcripts, accurately resolving cellular composition in snRNA-seq, and maintaining sensitivity for lowly expressed genes, despite characteristic insertion-biased indels and modest differences in multi-mapping reads. Discrepancies were subtle, largely limited to pseudogene and non-coding transcripts, and did not affect pathway-level conclusions. Ultima UG100 platform prioritized high precision and reduced low-frequency artifacts, offering a cleaner but more conservative variant-calling profile compared to the more sensitive, yet noisier, Illumina/DRAGEN workflow. This multimodal, clinically oriented assessment provides the first comprehensive evaluation of UG100, demonstrating its translational utility in population-scale genomics, and highlighting the potential for emerging sequencing technologies to lower the cost of biomedical research and clinical diagnostics.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究针对新型高通量测序平台 Ultima UG100 进行了首个全面的临床多模态基准评估。研究利用肿瘤和免疫疾病的 FFPE 样本，在 snRNA-seq、WTS、WES 和 WGS 四个维度上，将其与行业标准 Illumina NovaSeq 进行了深度对比，重点考察了数据质量、变异调用一致性及转录组重现性。

## 为什么相关
虽然本研究侧重于测序硬件性能，但其与 AI/LLM 领域存在**弱交叉**。高质量、低成本的底层基因组数据是构建病原检测基础模型或基因组大模型的基石。UG100 提供的“更清洁”但“更保守”的数据特征，直接影响下游 AI 模型在变异检测、细胞分型及临床诊断任务中的训练上限和推理准确性。

## 新颖度判断
**新颖度较高（5.75）**。这是首次针对 UG100 平台在极具挑战性的临床 FFPE 样本（而非高质量细胞系）上进行的多模态验证。研究揭示了该平台特有的插入偏向性 indels 错误谱，为后续生物信息学流程优化提供了关键依据。

## 方法与证据
研究通过匹配样本（Matched samples）对比了 UG100 与 Illumina/DRAGEN 流程。证据显示：
1. **转录组学**：UG100 在 snRNA-seq 中能准确解析细胞组成，对低表达基因敏感度与 Illumina 相当。
2. **变异检测**：UG100 具有更高的精准度（Precision）和更少的低频伪影，但在变异调用上比 Illumina/DRAGEN 更保守。
3. **差异点**：UG100 的差异主要集中在假基因和非编码转录本，且存在特征性的插入偏向性 indels。

## 应用价值
该研究验证了 UG100 在大规模人群基因组学和临床诊断中的转化潜力。其低成本特性有助于降低生物医学研究门槛，特别是在需要大规模样本量来训练复杂 AI 模型的病原基因组学或肿瘤基因组学领域，提供了更具性价比的数据获取方案。

## 局限与风险
1. **保守性风险**：UG100 的变异调用较为保守，可能导致某些低频临床相关变异的漏检。
2. **特定错误谱**：插入偏向性的 indels 错误需要专门的算法校准，现有的基于 Illumina 数据训练的 AI 模型可能需要针对性微调。
3. **覆盖范围**：在假基因和非编码区的表现差异可能影响特定非编码区的研究结论。

papers.title: On the rise of AI technologies in virtual screening
papers.text:
title: On the rise of AI technologies in virtual screening
source: bioRxiv
topics: 
category: dataset
why: 这篇工作偏数据集或基准构建，适合判断是否能作为病原组学训练或评测资源。
abstract_zh: 随着预测蛋白质-配体相互作用及结合亲和力的 AI 基础模型不断涌现，本研究针对这一前沿领域展开了深入评估。研究者构建了一个极具挑战性的基准数据集，该数据集包含十个药理学相关靶点的超大规模虚拟筛选命中列表，并结合了体外结合实验（in vitro binding assays）数据进行验证。通过在该数据集上对 Boltz-2 模型进行压力测试，结果表明 Boltz-2 是目前性能最优异的分类器，其预测成功率达到了其他现有重评分（rescoring）策略的两倍。Boltz-2 在配体分类任务中表现出直观、准确、高效且稳健的特性。该研究证明，利用 Boltz-2 可以在普通商用计算资源上实现对百万级化合物的精确排序，这为药物研发中的大规模筛选提供了高效的技术路径。
abstract: AI foundational models for predicting protein-ligand interactions and binding affinities have started to emerge. We challenged Boltz-2 on a difficult dataset constructed on ten ultra-large virtual screening hit lists of pharmacologically relevant targets with in vitro binding assays. We show that Boltz-2 is the best classifier, with a success rate twice that of any other rescoring strategy. Ligand classifications by Boltz-2 are straightforward, accurate, efficient and robust, opening to million-compound accurate rankings on commodity resources.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究评估了新兴的 AI 基础模型 Boltz-2 在药物虚拟筛选任务中的表现。研究通过构建包含 10 个药理学靶点及对应体外结合实验数据的超大规模数据集，对比了 Boltz-2 与传统重评分策略在预测蛋白质-配体结合亲和力方面的差异。

## 为什么相关
在病原生物学和临床微生物学领域，针对特定病原体蛋白（如病毒蛋白酶、细菌细胞壁合成酶）开发小分子抑制剂是核心任务。该工作涉及的蛋白质-配体相互作用预测技术，直接关系到抗感染药物的筛选效率，特别是 Boltz-2 展示的百万级化合物处理能力，对快速响应新兴传染病的药物开发具有重要意义。

## 新颖度判断
新颖度评分为 5.75（中等偏高）。其创新点在于：1. 针对“超大规模（ultra-large）”虚拟筛选列表构建了具有体外实验验证的挑战性基准数据集；2. 首次证明了 Boltz-2 模型在处理此类大规模数据时，其成功率可达到传统方法的两倍。

## 方法与证据
- **模型**：Boltz-2（AI 基础模型）。
- **数据规模**：包含 10 个药理学相关靶点的超大规模虚拟筛选命中列表（hit lists）。
- **验证手段**：使用了体外结合实验（in vitro binding assays）作为金标准。
- **关键指标**：Boltz-2 的分类成功率是其他重评分策略的两倍，且支持在普通计算资源（commodity resources）上进行百万级化合物排序。

## 应用价值
该研究证明了 AI 基础模型在虚拟筛选中的落地可行性。其应用价值在于降低了高精度筛选的硬件门槛，使得研究机构能够利用普通商用服务器对百万级别的候选药物分子进行快速、准确的优先级排序，显著缩短从靶点发现到先导化合物确定的周期。

## 局限与风险
摘要未说明 Boltz-2 在处理不同家族蛋白质（如高度柔性的病毒蛋白或膜蛋白）时的泛化能力差异。此外，虽然提到在普通资源上高效，但未给出具体的推理耗时（ms/compound）或内存占用指标。对于病原组学研究者而言，需注意该模型在非人类蛋白靶点上的表现是否经过充分验证。

papers.title: GeomMotif: A Benchmark for Arbitrary Geometric Preservation in Protein Generation
papers.text:
title: GeomMotif: A Benchmark for Arbitrary Geometric Preservation in Protein Generation
source: bioRxiv
topics: 
category: dataset
why: 这篇工作偏数据集或基准构建，适合判断是否能作为病原组学训练或评测资源。
abstract_zh: 蛋白质设计中的基序支架（Motif scaffolding）任务旨在生成完整的蛋白质结构，同时保留指定结构片段的3D几何形状，类似于计算机视觉中的图像外扩填充。现有的基准测试主要集中在功能基序上，使得通用的几何保留能力在很大程度上未得到测试。本研究推出了 GeomMotif，这是一个系统性的基准测试，用于评估不要求功能特异性的任意结构片段保留能力。我们从蛋白质数据库（PDB）中采样构建了 57 个基准任务，每个任务包含 1 到 2 个基序（最多由 7 个连续片段组成），确保每个问题都有真实的、可解的构象。这些任务具有全面的结构和理化特性描述：包括尺寸、几何环境、二级结构、疏水性、电荷和埋藏程度。通过 scRMSD 和 pLDDT 评估几何忠实度，并利用聚类分析结构多样性和新颖性。结果表明，基于序列和基于结构的方法在不同任务中面临的挑战各异，且几何保留能力随结构和理化背景显著变化。GeomMotif 为蛋白质生成模型的改进奠定了基础。
abstract: Motif scaffolding in protein design involves generating complete protein structures while preserving the 3D geometry of designated structural fragments, analogous to image outpainting in computer vision. Current benchmarks focus on functional motifs, leaving general geometric preservation capabilities largely untested. We introduce GeomMotif, a systematic benchmark that evaluates arbitrary structural fragment preservation without requiring functional specificity. We construct 57 benchmark tasks, each containing one or two motifs with up to 7 continuous fragments, by sampling from the Protein Data Bank (PDB) to ensure a ground-truth, solvable conformation for every problem. The tasks are characterized by comprehensive structural and physicochemical properties: size, geometric context, secondary structure, hydrophobicity, charge, and degree of burial. These features enable detailed performance analysis beyond simple success rates, revealing model-specific strengths and limitations. We evaluate models using scRMSD and pLDDT for geometric fidelity and clustering for structural diversity and novelty. Our results show that sequence-based and structure-based approaches find different tasks challenging, and that geometric preservation varies significantly with structural and physicochemical context. GeomMotif provides insights complementary to function-focused benchmarks and establishes a foundation for improving protein generative models.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究提出了名为 **GeomMotif** 的基准测试集，专门用于评估蛋白质生成模型在执行“基序支架（Motif scaffolding）”任务时，对任意几何结构片段的保留能力。与以往关注功能性基序的测试不同，GeomMotif 侧重于通用的几何保真度，通过 57 个源自 PDB 的任务，多维度分析模型在不同理化环境下的表现。

## 为什么相关
在病原生物学和蛋白质组学研究中，设计能够稳定展示特定抗原表位（Motif）的支架蛋白是疫苗研发和抗体设计的关键。该基准测试能够帮助研究者判断当前的 AI 生成模型（如 ProteinMPNN、RFdiffusion 等类似工具）在处理复杂病原蛋白片段时的几何准确性，是评估蛋白质设计工具可靠性的重要资源。

## 新颖度判断
**新颖度：5.75（中等偏高）**。其创新点在于打破了“功能基序”的限制，提出了“任意几何保留”的概念。它不再仅关注基序是否具有生物学功能，而是系统性地考察模型在处理不同二级结构、电荷分布和疏水环境下的几何还原能力，填补了蛋白质生成模型评估体系的空白。

## 方法与证据
- **数据规模与来源**：从 PDB 数据库中采样，构建了 **57 个** 具有真实构象（ground-truth）的任务。
- **任务复杂度**：每个任务包含 **1-2 个基序**，且基序最多可由 **7 个不连续片段** 组成。
- **评估指标**：使用 **scRMSD** 衡量几何忠实度，**pLDDT** 衡量结构置信度，并结合**聚类算法**评估生成结构的多样性与新颖性。
- **分析维度**：详细对比了蛋白质的尺寸、二级结构、疏水性、电荷及埋藏程度对生成效果的影响。实验发现基于序列（sequence-based）和基于结构（structure-based）的模型在应对这些理化特性时表现出截然不同的局限性。

## 应用价值
GeomMotif 为蛋白质生成算法的开发者提供了精细化的诊断工具。通过该基准，研究者可以明确模型在哪些特定理化条件下（如高电荷区域或深埋片段）容易失效，从而针对性地优化模型架构，提升病原体相关蛋白设计的成功率。

## 局限与风险
- **样本量限制**：摘要中提到的 57 个任务虽然覆盖面广，但对于深度学习模型的全面泛化性评估而言，规模仍显不足。
- **模型覆盖**：摘要未明确列出具体测试了哪些主流模型（仅以分类代称），无法直接获知当前最先进模型（SOTA）的具体表现。
- **静态局限**：该基准主要关注静态几何结构的保留，摘要未说明是否考虑了蛋白质在生理环境下的动态构象变化。

papers.title: Generative machine learning unlocks the first proteome-wide image of human cells
papers.text:
title: Generative machine learning unlocks the first proteome-wide image of human cells
source: bioRxiv
topics: 
category: methods
why: 这篇工作更像方法创新，可能直接关联 metagenomics、long-read 或 pathogen identification 流程优化。
abstract_zh: 蛋白质在细胞内的空间组织决定了其功能，但现有成像技术仅能同时观察数十种蛋白质，远低于人类细胞中数千种蛋白质的规模。本研究开发了深度生成模型 ProtiCelli，仅需三种细胞地标染色即可模拟 12,800 种人类蛋白质的显微图像。该模型基于人类蛋白质图谱（HPA）的 123 万张图像训练，在重建准确度和纹理保真度上优于现有方法，并能推广至未见过的细胞类型和药物扰动。ProtiCelli 生成的图像保留了层级化亚细胞组织，重现了已知的蛋白质相互作用图谱，并在单细胞水平解析了兼职蛋白质（moonlighting proteins）的区室特异性功能。此外，该模型能仅凭细胞形态推断药物诱导的表达与定位变化，预测细胞周期阶段，并实现亚细胞区室的无监督分割。利用 ProtiCelli，研究者构建了包含 3070 万张模拟图像的 Proteome2Cell 数据集，涵盖 12 种人类细胞系的 2400 个虚拟细胞。该工作为空间虚拟细胞建模奠定了基础，推动了空间蛋白质组学从蛋白质编目向完整细胞系统模拟的转变。
abstract: The spatial organization of proteins within cells governs virtually all cellular functions. Yet, current imaging technologies can simultaneously visualize only tens of proteins, orders of magnitude below the thousands that populate a single human cell. Here, we present ProtiCelli, a deep generative model that simulates microscopy images for 12,800 human proteins from just three cellular landmark stains. Trained on 1.23 million images from the Human Protein Atlas, ProtiCelli outperforms existing methods in reconstruction accuracy and textural fidelity, and generalizes to unseen cell types and drug perturbations absent from training. We demonstrate that ProtiCelli-generated images preserve hierarchical subcellular organization, recapitulate known protein protein interaction landscapes, and resolve compartment-specific functions of moonlighting proteins at the single-cell level. Remarkably, the model infers drug-induced changes in protein expression and localization from cell morphology alone, predicts cell cycle stage without dedicated cell cycle markers, and enables unsupervised segmentation of subcellular compartments as well as spatial decomposition of gene sets into functional regions. Ultimately, we leverage ProtiCelli to generate Proteome2Cell, an unprecedented dataset of 30.7 million simulated images creating 2,400 virtual cells across 12 human cell lines. These proteome-scale images enable the construction of hierarchical single-cell models that distinguish conserved from dynamic protein architectures. Integration of Proteome2Cell into the Human Protein Atlas democratizes the exploration of these "virtual cells". By computationally bridging the experimental scalability gap, ProtiCelli establishes a foundation for spatial virtual cell modeling and paves an avenue for transforming spatial proteomics from cataloging proteins to simulating complete cellular systems.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究推出了名为 ProtiCelli 的深度生成模型，旨在解决空间蛋白质组学中成像通量的瓶颈。通过学习 123 万张人类蛋白质图谱（HPA）图像，该模型实现了仅凭 3 种地标染色（Landmark stains）即可预测 12,800 种蛋白质在细胞内空间分布的能力。研究进一步构建了包含 3070 万张图像的 Proteome2Cell 数据集，实现了全蛋白质组维度的“虚拟细胞”成像。

## 为什么相关
本研究属于蛋白质组学与 AI 的深度交叉。对于病原生物学研究而言，虽然该模型目前针对人类细胞，但其展示的“从细胞形态推断蛋白质定位变化”的能力，可被借鉴用于研究病原体感染引起的宿主细胞空间蛋白质组重构。此外，其对药物扰动的敏感性预测，为临床微生物学中的药物机理研究提供了高通量的计算模拟手段。

## 新颖度判断
高。其新颖性体现在：1. 规模突破：将可同时观察的蛋白质数量从数十种提升至 12,800 种（蛋白质组量级）；2. 泛化能力：模型能够处理训练集中未出现的细胞类型和药物扰动；3. 功能推断：不仅是图像生成，还能重现蛋白质相互作用（PPI）和解析兼职蛋白质的复杂功能。

## 方法与证据
方法上采用了深度生成学习架构（ProtiCelli）。证据包括：1. 使用 1.23M 张 HPA 图像进行大规模训练；2. 在重建准确度和纹理保真度指标上超越现有基准模型；3. 通过 30.7M 张模拟图像验证了模型在 12 种人类细胞系中的适用性；4. 实验证明模型能无监督分割亚细胞区室，并准确预测细胞周期阶段。

## 应用价值
1. **虚拟筛选**：通过模拟药物对 1.28 万种蛋白定位的影响，加速药物靶点发现；2. **低成本成像**：仅需 3 种染色即可获得全蛋白组空间信息，极大降低实验成本；3. **系统生物学**：为构建层级化单细胞模型和理解细胞全局动态架构提供了数据基础。

## 局限与风险
摘要未说明模型在处理极低丰度蛋白时的预测精度。此外，模型高度依赖 HPA 训练数据的质量，对于 HPA 未涵盖的特殊病理状态或非人类物种细胞的迁移能力尚不明确。作为生成式模型，是否存在“幻觉”导致错误的蛋白定位分布仍需在实际生物学实验中进一步验证。

papers.title: AgentCo-op: Retrieval-Based Synthesis of Interoperable Multi-Agent Workflows
papers.text:
title: AgentCo-op: Retrieval-Based Synthesis of Interoperable Multi-Agent Workflows
source: arXiv
topics: 
category: methods
why: 这篇工作更像方法创新，可能直接关联 metagenomics、long-read 或 pathogen identification 流程优化。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: Designing multi-agent workflows is especially difficult in open-ended scientific settings where tasks lack curated training sets, reliable scalar evaluation metrics, and standardized interfaces between existing tools and agents. We propose AgentCo-op, a retrieval-based synthesis framework that composes reusable skills, tools, and external agents into executable workflows through typed artifact handoffs, then applies bounded self-guided local repair to implicated components when execution evidence indicates failure. In two open-world genomics case studies, AgentCo-op composes independently developed scientific agents and external tool repositories into auditable workflows without redesigning them or running global topology search. It coordinates specialized agents for spatial transcriptomics and gene-set interpretation to enable collaborative discovery from spatial transcriptomics data, and builds a parallel workflow for cross-modality marker analysis on single-cell multiome data. AgentCo-op can also import a searched workflow as a structural prior and improve it by grounding nodes with retrieved components and applying local repair, showing that synthesis and search are complementary. On six coding, math, and question-answering benchmarks, AgentCo-op achieves the best result on four benchmarks and the best average score under a unified backbone setting, while consistently reducing per-task cost relative to multi-agent baselines. Together, these results suggest that retrieval-based synthesis can extend automated agentic workflow design beyond benchmark-optimized agent graphs to open-world workflows built from existing agents, tools, and typed artifacts.

papers.title: SMDD-Bench: Can LLMs Solve Real-World Small Molecule Drug Design Tasks?
papers.text:
title: SMDD-Bench: Can LLMs Solve Real-World Small Molecule Drug Design Tasks?
source: arXiv
topics: 
category: foundation_model
why: 这篇工作偏基础模型/Agent方向，可能影响病原检测任务的建模上限，值得关注其任务定义与评测设计。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: LLM agents have incredible potential for scientific discovery applications. However, the performance of LLM agents on real-world, small molecule drug design (SMDD) tasks across diverse chemistries and targets is unclear. Current evaluation methods are either ad hoc, too simple for real-world discovery, limited in scale, or restricted to single-turn question answering. In effort to standardize the evaluation of LLM agents on small molecule design, we introduce SMDD-Bench, a challenging, multi-turn, long-horizon agentic benchmark consisting of 502 guaranteed-solvable task instances spanning 5 task types: 2D Pharmacophore Identification, Interaction Point Discovery, Scaffold Hopping, Lead Optimization, and Fragment Assembly. SMDD-Bench tasks span a wide region of chemical space and involve 102 unique protein targets. Completely solving the benchmark would require having strong chemical and biological reasoning and 3D intuition, understanding specialized tool use, and displaying planning expertise over a limited number of oracle calls. We benchmark 7 frontier open and closed source LLMs and find even the most performant LLM, GPT5.4, solves only 40.2\% of tasks. We hope SMDD-Bench provides a standardized testbed to invigorate the field towards training and evaluating LLM agents for fully autonomous computational drug design. We host a public leaderboard at smddbench.com .

papers.title: dbGIST: An LLM-Assisted Multi-Omics Resource for Target Exploration and Cross-Dataset Validation in Gastrointestinal Stromal Tumors
papers.text:
title: dbGIST: An LLM-Assisted Multi-Omics Resource for Target Exploration and Cross-Dataset Validation in Gastrointestinal Stromal Tumors
source: bioRxiv
topics: 
category: methods
why: 这篇工作更像方法创新，可能直接关联 metagenomics、long-read 或 pathogen identification 流程优化。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: Gastrointestinal stromal tumors (GISTs) are the most common mesenchymal neoplasms of the gastrointestinal tract, yet GIST-specific omics evidence remains scattered across small cohorts and is not represented as a dedicated disease project in major cancer genomics resources, limiting reproducible target exploration. Here, we present dbGIST (https://www.dbgist.com), a dedicated GIST-focused multi-omics resource built to make dispersed GIST evidence searchable, analyzable, and reusable. dbGIST harmonizes data from 37 centers and 1,991 samples, including pathologically verified in-house cohorts, across genomics, bulk transcriptomics, proteomics, phosphoproteomics, and single-cell transcriptomics, and couples these data with curated clinical annotations covering survival, mutation status, risk stratification, metastasis or recurrence, mitotic index, tumor site and size, and imatinib response. The platform supports cohort-level molecular-clinical association, survival, enrichment, immune-infiltration, drug-sensitivity, and single-cell analyses through interactive visualizations, downloadable source data, and public APIs for programmatic access to reusable analysis outputs and visualization-ready data. An optional LLM-assisted interface helps users navigate analyses and interpret outputs. Using MCM7 as a case study, dbGIST linked a resource-derived candidate to survival, risk features, metastatic or recurrent disease, imatinib-response phenotypes, proliferative cell states, and in vitro GIST-cell behavior. dbGIST therefore provides a traceable and interoperable resource for target exploration and precision oncology research in GIST.
