papers.title: Escalating burden and mortality of carbapenem-resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae species complex infections in Bangladeshi infants
papers.text:
title: Escalating burden and mortality of carbapenem-resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae species complex infections in Bangladeshi infants
source: medRxiv
topics: pathogenomics foundation_model_agent
category: clinical_application
why: 这篇工作更接近临床/监测落地，适合评估其对快速识别、预警或治疗辅助的实际价值。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: Klebsiella pneumoniae infections in young infants are an escalating threat in low- and middle-income countries, yet robust longitudinal data integrating hospital burden, clinical outcomes, antimicrobial, and genomics remains scarce. We performed an 18-year (2004-2021) prospective, multicenter genomic epidemiology study across four hospitals in Bangladesh. Among 122,353 enrolled children from whom blood or cerebrospinal fluid cultures were performed, 1,600 (1.3%) yielded culture-confirmed Klebsiella pneumoniae species complex (KpSC) isolates. Positivity increased from 16 per 1,000 cases tested in 2004 to 37 per 1,000 in 2021. Hospital case-fatality rate (CFR) rose from 21.4% to 51.4% during the study, paralleling the emergence and expansion of carbapenem resistance, first detected in 2008 and reaching 81% of isolates by 2021. Neonates accounted for 80.5% of infections and experienced a CFR of 40.8%. Whole-genome sequencing of 599 representative isolates revealed four KpSC species, 145 sequence types and 92 capsular alleles. Global high-risk clones ST11, ST16 and ST147 harbouring NDM-type carbapenemases dominated recent cases. These findings document the increasing resistance and mortality associated with KpSC infections amongst neonates in Bangladesh, underscoring the urgent need for strengthened infection prevention & control, equitable access to effective combination therapies, and vaccine-based preventative strategies.

papers.title: OK-AIR study protocol: a longitudinal cluster-randomised 2x2 factorial trial of portable air purification and upper-room UVGI on sick-related absences, indoor air quality, environmental pathogens and social-emotional development in early care and education classrooms (birth-5 years)
papers.text:
title: OK-AIR study protocol: a longitudinal cluster-randomised 2x2 factorial trial of portable air purification and upper-room UVGI on sick-related absences, indoor air quality, environmental pathogens and social-emotional development in early care and education classrooms (birth-5 years)
source: medRxiv
topics: pathogenomics foundation_model_agent
category: clinical_application
why: 这篇工作更接近临床/监测落地，适合评估其对快速识别、预警或治疗辅助的实际价值。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: Abstract This protocol is reported in accordance with the SPIRIT 2025 guidelines for clinical trial protocols. Introduction: Young children, from birth to age 5 y are particularly vulnerable to indoor air pollutants and respiratory pathogens. Portable air purifiers (or filtration) and upper-room ultraviolet germicidal irradiation (UVGI) are two widely used interventions with the potential to improve indoor air quality (IAQ) and reduce sick-related absences. However, a review of the literature revealed no real-world randomized studies evaluating their effectiveness in reducing young children's sick-related absences in early care and education (ECE) classrooms. Methods and Analysis: The OK-AIR study is a longitudinal, cluster-randomized 2x2 factorial trial conducted in Head Start centers using two implementation cohorts: Cohort 1 (five Head Start centers and 20 classrooms from 2023 to 2024) and Cohort 2 (11 centers and 59 classrooms from 2025 to 2026), with expanded inclusion of rural areas. Cohort 1 enrolled 204 children, 48 teachers and 5 site directors, and Cohort 2 enrolled 462 children, 97 teachers and 11 site directors. Within each center, four classrooms are randomized to: (1) control; (2) portable filtration; (3) upper-room ultraviolet germicidal irradiation (UVGI); or (4) both interventions. Cohort 2 was initially planned as a second factorial trial but was amended to a purifier-only design due to funding changes; details are provided in the protocol amendments section. We collect continuous IAQ data, including particulate matter (PM) with aerodynamic diameters [≤]1 m (PM1), [≤]2.5 m (PM2.5), [≤]4 m (PM4), and [≤]10 m (PM10); total volatile organic compounds (TVOCs) index; nitrogen oxides (NOx) index; carbon monoxide (CO), noise; temperature; and relative humidity, alongside daily child absences. Seasonal environmental surface swabs (dining tables and toilet flooring) are tested by Reverse-Transcriptase quantitative Polymerase Chain Reaction (RT-qPCR) for Influenza A/B, Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV), Human Parainfluenza Virus Type 3 (HPIV3), Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome Coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2), and Norovirus. IAQ monitoring is structured across Winter, Spring, Summer, and Fall, including designated baseline/off-period weeks to characterize temporal and seasonal variability in environmental measures across classrooms and centers. Multi-informant surveys (Director, Teacher, Parent) capture contextual factors, and children's social-emotional development is assessed using teacher ratings on the Devereux Early Childhood Assessment (DECA). The primary outcome is the sick-related absence rate, analyzed as cumulative absences over the attendance year while accounting for clustering by school and classroom using generalized mixed-effects models. Secondary outcomes include children's social-emotional ratings, IAQ metrics and pathogen detection rates; analyses of IAQ incorporate time/seasonal structure, and season-stratified absenteeism analyses will be treated as secondary/exploratory refinements. An economic evaluation will estimate incremental intervention costs and cost-effectiveness/cost-benefit (such as cost per sick-related absence day averted). Ethics and Dissemination: This study was approved by the Institutional Review Board (IRB) at the University of Oklahoma. Findings will be shared through peer-reviewed publications; presentations at local, state, and national conferences; research briefs developed for lay and policy audiences; and community briefings prioritizing the participating early childhood programs and communities. ISRCTN Trial Registration: ISRCTN78764448 Disclaimer: The views expressed are those of the authors and do not reflect the official views of the Uniformed Services University or the United States Department of War. Strengths and Limitations of This Study: {middle dot} Real-world longitudinal cluster RCT: The study uses a rigorous longitudinal cluster-randomized 2x2 factorial design in real-world ECE settings. {middle dot} Combined interventions: Interventions target both air filtration and disinfection, allowing for combined and comparative evaluation. {middle dot} Objective air quality monitoring: Continuous monitoring of IAQ metrics provides objective and reliable data on environmental change. {middle dot} Environmental pathogen surveillance: qPCR on surface swabs yields an objective biological outcome to triangulate with IAQ and absences. {middle dot} Comprehensive context and child measures: Multi-method and multi-reporter data collection includes Head Start attendance records, continuous air monitoring, pathogen detection, contextual surveys completed by center directors, teachers, and parents, and standardized social-emotional assessments (DECA) completed by classroom teachers. Head Start program records providing children's longer-term health data available through Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) authorization. {middle dot} Clustered/temporal complexity: Seasonal design accounts for variation over time but may introduce complexity in modeling temporal effects. {middle dot} Practical Implications: Study findings will have practical implications for Head Start and other ECE programs striving to maximize child attendance with cost effective strategies. Keywords: Early childhood; Head Start; indoor air quality (IAQ); air purifiers; filtration; ultraviolet germicidal irradiation; cluster randomized trial; absenteeism; environmental pathogens; DECA; cost-benefit analysis

papers.title: The Receptor Kinase MEE39/ATHE Mediates Cell Wall Integrity Surveillance During Root Vascular Pathogen Infection
papers.text:
title: The Receptor Kinase MEE39/ATHE Mediates Cell Wall Integrity Surveillance During Root Vascular Pathogen Infection
source: bioRxiv
topics: pathogenomics foundation_model_agent
category: clinical_application
why: 这篇工作更接近临床/监测落地，适合评估其对快速识别、预警或治疗辅助的实际价值。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: Plant cell wall (CW) integrity signaling enables early detection of microbial invasion, yet the receptors involved and their spatial and temporal dynamics during infection remain largely unknown. We identify ATHENA (ATHE)/MEE39, a previously uncharacterized malectin-like leucin-rich repeat receptor kinase (Mal-LRR-RK) that contributes to defense against the root vascular pathogen Fusarium oxysporum (Fo), particularly in outer root layers where colonization begins. ATHE abundance, localization, and endocytic trafficking are rapidly remodeled during infection, and loss of ATHE compromises basal immunity and early pathogen-induced transcriptional reprogramming. ATHE responds to altered cellulose synthesis, cellulose-derived oligosaccharides, mechanically induced CW perturbations, and the fungal secreted peptide Fo-RALF. In most of these contexts, ATHE acts together with the LRR-RK MIK2, forming a pathogen-strengthened RK complex that fine-tunes root responses to Fo. This represents the first example of a receptor complex visualized subcellularly in vivo during a plant-microbe interaction. Although Brassicaceae-specific, heterologous expression of ATHE enhanced tomato resistance to Fo, highlighting its functional relevance across plant lineages and its potential use for crop engineering. Our work reveals a previously unrecognized strategy by which plants decode microbial threats through dynamic CW-integrity surveillance.

papers.title: LongMINT: Evaluating Memory under Multi-Target Interference in Long-Horizon Agent Systems
papers.text:
title: LongMINT: Evaluating Memory under Multi-Target Interference in Long-Horizon Agent Systems
source: arXiv
topics: 
category: foundation_model
why: 这篇工作偏基础模型/Agent方向，可能影响病原检测任务的建模上限，值得关注其任务定义与评测设计。
abstract_zh: 现实世界的智能体在长周期且不断演进的环境中运行，信息频繁更新且存在记忆干扰，需要准确召回并对多条信息进行聚合推理。现有基准测试多关注静态、独立的召回，无法捕捉动态演进记忆间的交互。本文提出了 LongMINT 基准，旨在评估记忆增强型智能体在现实、高干扰、长周期设置下的表现。该基准具有以下特征：(1) 包含频繁更新信息且相互关联的长上下文；(2) 涵盖状态追踪、多轮对话、维基百科修订和 GitHub 提交等多样化领域；(3) 设计了单目标召回和多目标聚合推理两类题型，以评估系统对干扰的鲁棒性。LongMINT 包含 1.56 万个问答对，平均上下文长度为 13.88 万 token，最高可达 180 万 token。对 7 种代表性系统（包括长文本 LLM、RAG 和记忆增强框架）的评估显示，系统平均准确率仅为 27.9%，在多证据聚合推理上表现尤为薄弱。分析表明，性能主要受限于检索和记忆构建，且系统难以处理被后续信息修订或干扰的早期事实。
abstract: Real-world agents operate over long and evolving horizons, where information is repeatedly updated and may interfere across memories, requiring accurate recall and aggregated reasoning over multiple pieces of information. However, existing benchmarks focus on static, independent recall and fail to capture these dynamic interactions between evolving memories. In this paper, we study how current memory-augmented agents perform in realistic, interference-heavy, long-horizon settings across diverse domains and question types. We introduce LongMINT (Long-Horizon Memory under INTerference), a benchmark featuring (1) long, highly interconnected contexts with frequently updated information that induces substantial interference, (2) diverse domains (state tracking, multi-turn dialogue, Wikipedia revisions, and GitHub commits), enabling evaluation of domain generalization, and (3) diverse question types that assess robustness to interference, including (i) single-target recall tasks requiring retrieval of a specific target from long contexts, and (ii) multi-target aggregation tasks requiring reasoning over multiple relevant pieces of information. Overall, LongMINT has 15.6k question-answering pairs over long-horizon contexts averaging 138.8k tokens and extending up to 1.8M tokens per instance. We evaluate 7 representative systems, including vanilla long-context LLMs, RAG, and memory-augmented agent frameworks. Across all systems, we observe consistently low performance (avg. 27.9% accuracy), especially on questions requiring aggregated reasoning over multiple pieces of evidence. Our analysis shows that performance is primarily limited by retrieval and memory construction. Furthermore, current memory systems struggle to recall and reason over earlier facts that are later revised or interfered with by subsequent context, with performance degrading as the number of intervening updates increases.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究推出了 LongMINT 基准测试，专门用于评估 AI 智能体在长达 180 万 token 的超长上下文中，处理频繁更新和相互干扰信息的能力。研究重点考察了智能体在面对信息修订（如 Wikipedia 编辑、GitHub 提交）时的记忆召回与多目标聚合推理能力。

## 为什么相关
虽然该论文属于基础模型与 Agent 领域，但其核心挑战与病原生物学及临床微生物学高度相似：临床病例记录、病原体进化追踪以及基因组数据库均具有“长周期”和“动态更新”的特点。例如，患者的耐药性特征可能随治疗进程不断更新，AI 需要在海量历史记录中准确识别最新的有效信息并排除早期过时信息的干扰。LongMINT 提出的干扰下记忆评估模型，为构建可靠的临床决策支持智能体提供了评测框架。

## 新颖度判断
新颖度较高（7.51）。相比于传统的“大海捞针”（Needle In A Haystack）测试，LongMINT 引入了“多目标干扰”和“动态更新”维度。它不再仅仅测试模型能否找到一个静态事实，而是测试模型在信息被多次修订（如 GitHub 提交历史）后，能否依然准确提取正确版本并进行跨片段推理。

## 方法与证据
研究构建了包含 15,600 个问答对的数据集，覆盖状态追踪、对话、维基百科和 GitHub 四个领域。实验对比了 7 种系统（包括原生长文本 LLM 和 RAG 框架）。结果显示，所有系统的平均准确率仅为 27.9%。证据表明，随着干扰更新次数的增加，模型性能显著下降，尤其是在需要整合多个证据点的“多目标聚合任务”中表现最差，揭示了当前模型在长程记忆构建上的严重缺陷。

## 应用价值
对于病原生信领域，该研究的价值在于：(1) 提供了评估复杂文献综述工具的基准，特别是处理相互矛盾或随时间更迭的研究结论时；(2) 指出了 RAG 和长文本模型在处理动态演进数据（如病毒变异追踪）时的瓶颈，即检索和记忆构建环节的失效。

## 局限与风险
本研究属于弱 AI 交叉，其测试集主要基于通用领域（维基百科、代码），并未包含生物医学或基因组学专用数据。摘要未说明该基准是否考虑了生物信息学中常见的非结构化数据（如序列比对结果）。此外，27.9% 的极低准确率预示着目前的 Agent 系统在处理高精度临床微生物任务时存在极高的误导风险。

papers.title: Aerobic pathogen profiles and antibiotic resistance in diabetic foot ulcers: Data from a Specialized Diabetes Center in Jordan.
papers.text:
title: Aerobic pathogen profiles and antibiotic resistance in diabetic foot ulcers: Data from a Specialized Diabetes Center in Jordan.
source: PubMed
topics: pathogenomics
category: clinical_application
why: 这篇工作更接近临床/监测落地，适合评估其对快速识别、预警或治疗辅助的实际价值。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: This study aimed to identify the aerobic bacterial profile and antibiotic susceptibility patterns in patients with infected and uninfected diabetic foot ulcers (DFUs) at the National Center for Diabetes, Endocrinology, and Genetics (NCDEG), Amman, Jordan. A single-center, cross-sectional study was conducted from November 9, 2022 to January 2, 2023, involving 171 patients with DFUs. Superficial swabs and tissue specimens were collected, and antibiotic susceptibility testing was performed following Clinical and Laboratory Standards Institute (CLSI) guidelines. A total of 260 bacterial isolates were obtained, with an average of 1.6 pathogens per participant. Gram-positive bacteria (GPB) accounted for 65.1% of isolates, while Gram-negative bacteria represented 28.4%. The prevalence of monomicrobial and polymicrobial infections was nearly equal (50%). Among the 181 GPB isolates, Staphylococcus aureus was the most predominant pathogen, representing 39.8% of all GPB isolates. Notably, 68.1% of S aureus isolates were identified as methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus. The GPB isolates exhibited complete susceptibility to vancomycin, linezolid, tigecycline, and teicoplanin. For Gram-negative bacteria, ertapenem, meropenem, amikacin, and imipenem were the most effective antibiotics. This study highlights the predominance of GPB, particularly S aureus, in DFUs, with a significant proportion of methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus isolates. The findings underscore the importance of continued surveillance of bacterial profiles and antibiotic susceptibility patterns in DFUs. Future research is needed to guide the judicious use of antibiotics in empirical therapy for diabetic foot infections.

papers.title: Development and optimization of self-collected, field stable, saliva-based immunoassays for scalable epidemiological surveillance of pathogen-specific immunity
papers.text:
title: Development and optimization of self-collected, field stable, saliva-based immunoassays for scalable epidemiological surveillance of pathogen-specific immunity
source: medRxiv
topics: pathogenomics
category: methods
why: 这篇工作更像方法创新，可能直接关联 metagenomics、long-read 或 pathogen identification 流程优化。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: Serological surveillance is fundamental to infectious disease research and informed public-health decision making. Immunoassays used in the study of pathogen-specific immunity have historically relied on the collection of venous blood. While critical for many public-health applications, this sample collection method is invasive and resource intensive. The costs and logistical barriers associated with venous blood collection are exacerbated in resource-limited regions, and the shift to less invasive sampling methods would increase sample availability for pathogen surveillance and study of pathogen-specific immunity. To this end, we have developed and optimized a self-collected, saliva-based immunoassay capable of quantifying pathogen-specific antibody binding in saliva samples. Using samples collected from geographically and epidemiologically diverse regions of the world, we compared antigen-specific IgG levels in paired plasma and saliva samples. We observed that levels of IgG against multiple pathogens of public health concern - including SARS-CoV-2 and dengue virus (DENV) - were highly correlated in plasma and swab-collected saliva. In addition, the decay of maternally derived antibodies in saliva samples collected from infants was readily observed using this immunoassay, demonstrating the assay's sensitivity and potential for use in measuring antibody kinetics. We posit that this assay represents a climate stable, non-invasive tool that can aid in the surveillance and study of pathogen-specific immunity across a broad range of public-health indications.

title: Fitness effects of antimicrobial resistance genes in changing environments
source: bioRxiv
topics: pathogenomics
category: methods

abstract_zh: 
abstract: The evolutionary success of antimicrobial resistance (AMR) genes is generally seen as a trade-off between their function in the presence and their cost in the absence of antibiotics. Mobile integrons are genetic elements that recruit and disseminate dozens of AMR genes among Gram-negative pathogens. Here, we have measured the fitness effects of 136 integron genes conferring resistance against several antibiotic families. We have found a significant proportion having neutral and positive effects in the absence of antibiotics. We confirmed this using a mouse model, where we also observed cases of changes in the sign of fitness effects. This led us to unveil that oxygen availability modulates the cost of AMR genes. Using a stochastic model, we show that fluctuating aerobic/anaerobic conditions can rescue AMR genes in the absence of selective pressure. Here we provide a comprehensive analysis of the cost of AMR at the gene level challenging the traditional fitness-resistance trade-off hypothesis.

papers.text:
title: Proteomic Adaptations of Escherichia coli in Urinary Tract Infection Patients.
source: PubMed
topics: pathogenomics
category: methods
why: 这篇工作更像方法创新，可能直接关联 metagenomics、long-read 或 pathogen identification 流程优化。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: Urinary tract infections (UTIs) are among the most prevalent bacterial infections worldwide, with Escherichia coli responsible for the majority of cases. While much of what is known about E. coli physiology comes from laboratory culture, this paradigm overlooks the critical influence of the unique host environment on bacterial adaptation and pathogenesis. Here, we analyzed the E. coli proteome directly from the urine of five UTI-positive patients and compared it to their respective isolates after a single in vitro passage. The comparison revealed profound proteomic changes; notably, 37 proteins consistently expressed across all patient-derived samples were uniformly absent postculture. Functional analysis of the host-adapted E. coli proteome versus after a single laboratory passage (i.e., culture) points to key roles in nutrient acquisition, virulence, stress tolerance, and host interaction, highlighting adaptive features that are lost during culture. Among these were outer membrane transporters such as FepA, CirA, and YfiB, surface-exposed proteins with diagnostic and vaccine potential, and metabolic or stress-response enzymes such as SodA, NirB, MetE, and IlvA, which represent attractive drug targets due to their essential in vivo roles and absence in humans. Our findings demonstrate the value of profiling pathogens taken directly from the host environment, revealing proteins that may serve as novel biomarkers or therapeutic targets for UTIs.

papers.text:
title: Arabidopsis acclimation to daily environmental fluctuations converts a defense response regulator into a susceptibility factor toward Sclerotinia.
source: PubMed
topics: pathogenomics
category: methods
why: 这篇工作更像方法创新，可能直接关联 metagenomics、long-read 或 pathogen identification 流程优化。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: Acclimation enables plants to adjust to immediate environmental fluctuations and is therefore key to the resilience of plant disease resistance in a time of climate change. Here, we report on the acclimation of Arabidopsis thaliana quantitative immune responses against the fungal pathogen Sclerotinia sclerotiorum to daily environmental fluctuations. We analyzed disease resistance phenotypes and global gene expression in plants grown in three acclimation regimes, revealing the rewiring of regulatory networks during this process. We identified pathogen-induced genes weakly sensitive to acclimation as promising bases for acclimation-proof immunity. Fluctuations in Mediterranean-like acclimation resulted in an increased disease susceptibility and the misregulation of many pathogen-responsive genes. We identified A. thaliana mutants in novel immune components contributing positively to quantitative disease resistance following temperate but not Mediterranean acclimation. Quantitative disease resistance was maintained under Mediterranean acclimation in NAC42-like mutants and associated with a switch in the repertoire of pathogen-responsive targets of this transcription factor. Our work reveals the role of immune gene networks' plasticity in acclimation and suggests new strategies to maintain plant immune function in a warming climate.

papers.text:
title: In vitro modulatory effects of lichen secondary metabolite vulpinic acid on pyoverdine production and quorum sensing-regulated traits in Pseudomonas aeruginosa.
source: PubMed
topics: pathogenomics
category: methods
why: 这篇工作更像方法创新，可能直接关联 metagenomics、long-read 或 pathogen identification 流程优化。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: Pseudomonas aeruginosa is a major opportunistic pathogen, especially involved with nosocomial infections. Siderophores such as pyoverdine are crucial for iron acquisition in bacteria and play an important role in virulence regulation. Therefore, targeting siderophore pathways has been suggested as a potential antivirulence approach. Lichens produce secondary metabolites with various effects, including the ability to influence quorum sensing (QS). In this study, lichen secondary metabolite vulpinic acid was investigated for its in vitro effects on pyoverdine production and specific QS-regulated traits of P. aeruginosa . Pyoverdine production, fluorescence quenching, QS-related virulence traits, and biofilm formation were evaluated using wild-type and GFP-expressing biosensor strains. In addition, quantitative qRT-PCR was performed to analyse QS and pyoverdine gene expressions. Results show that vulpinic acid application decreased pyoverdine production by 53.65% ± 5.45 and quenched the produced pyoverdine by 67.55% ± 2.98. The QS regulated genes lasB and rhlA were significantly downregulated. No biofilm inhibition at any applied concentration was observed, suggesting a selective influence on the bacteria rather than a global attenuation of virulence. These findings suggest that vulpinic acid can modulate specific virulence factors of P. aeruginosa in vitro , and provides a basis for further investigation of lichen secondary metabolites as antivirulence agents.

papers.text:
title: OSM+: Billion-Level OpenStreetMap Dataset for City-wide Experiments
source: arXiv
topics: foundation_model_agent
category: foundation_model
why: 这篇工作偏基础模型/Agent方向，可能影响病原检测任务的建模上限，值得关注其任务定义与评测设计。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: Road network data provides rich information about cities, but processing worldwide OpenStreetMap (OSM) data is computationally intensive, and the resulting graphs are often difficult to unify for benchmarking downstream tasks. Existing graph learning benchmarks fail to capture the billion-scale and unique topological properties of real-world road networks, leaving model scalability underexplored. To close this gap, we process OSM data with distributed cloud computing using 5,000 cores and release \textbf{OSM+}, a structured worldwide 1-billion-vertex road network graph dataset designed for high accessibility and usability. OSM+ is open source and globally downloadable, providing an open-box graph structure and an easy spatial query interface; the evaluated release is a fixed snapshot for reproducibility, with a versioned update plan for future releases. We demonstrate the utility of OSM+ through three illustrative use cases: city boundary detection, traffic prediction, and traffic policy control. For traffic prediction, we construct a new 31-city benchmark by processing traffic data and combining it with OSM+, enabling broader spatial coverage and more comprehensive evaluation than commonly used datasets, while scaling from hundreds of road network intersections to thousands. For traffic policy control, we release a new six-city dataset at a much larger scale, introducing challenges for thousand-scale multi-agent coordination. We also provide data processing tools for integrating multimodal spatial-temporal data with OSM+ for geospatial foundation model training, thereby expediting the discovery of compelling scientific insights.

papers.text:
title: Microbial Community Multi-omic Analysis of Marsh Sediment post Crustacean Shell Compost Enrichment: pathogen emergence and community response
source: bioRxiv
topics: pathogenomics sequencing_bioinformatics
category: methods
why: 这篇工作更像方法创新，可能直接关联 metagenomics、long-read 或 pathogen identification 流程优化。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: Changes in nutrient availability can rapidly alter microbial processes in natural environments, with implications in biogeochemical cycling and pathogen emergence. Short-term, functional responses of microbial communities to nutrient amendment in coastal communities remain poorly understood, particularly in temperate environments. A 48-hour microcosm pulse experiment was completed in which paired metagenomic and metatranscriptomic sequencing were employed to examine how the decomposition of chitin rich substrates, namely crab and lobster shell compost, alters salt marsh microbiome structure and function. Within 48 hours of amendment, pronounced shifts in community metabolism were observed, including increased chitin degradation and utilization, stress-response, and sporulation. These responses coincided with marked decreases in genes associated with key biogeochemical processes, including carbon fixation, sulfur oxidation and reduction, and other metabolic pathways. Shell compost addition also enriched putative pathogens and virulence-associated genes, accompanied by modest transcriptional activation, notably aerolysin A (aerA), which encodes the pore-forming exotoxin aerolysin. These results demonstrate temperate salt marsh sediment microbiomes can undergo shifts in community composition and function that is associated with chitin-rich nutrient perturbation. The sensitivity of temperate coastal systems to organic matter input and the potential for ecological and public-health relevant outcomes are underscored, notably given that chitin is among the most abundant and readily available bionutrients in aquatic ecosystems globally.

papers.title: Certifiably Robust RAG against Retrieval Corruption
papers.text:
title: Certifiably Robust RAG against Retrieval Corruption
source: arXiv
topics: 
category: foundation_model
why: 这篇工作偏基础模型/Agent方向，可能影响病原检测任务的建模上限，值得关注其任务定义与评测设计。
abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）易受检索污染攻击的影响，即在检索结果中注入恶意段落会导致模型生成错误的响应。本文提出了 RobustRAG，这是首个针对检索污染攻击具有可证明鲁棒性（Certifiable Robustness）的防御框架。RobustRAG 的核心思想是“隔离后聚合”策略：首先将检索到的段落隔离到不相交的组中，基于每组连接的段落分别生成大语言模型（LLM）响应，随后通过安全聚合算法处理这些响应以获得鲁棒输出。为实现该框架，作者设计了基于关键词和基于解码的算法，用于安全聚合非结构化文本。实验表明，RobustRAG 实现了可证明的鲁棒性：即使面对了解防御机制并能注入有限数量恶意段落的自适应攻击者，该框架也能为特定查询的响应质量提供正式的下限保证。在开放域问答和长文本生成任务中，通过 3 个数据集和 3 个 LLM 验证了其有效性。
abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is susceptible to retrieval corruption attacks, where malicious passages injected into retrieval results can lead to inaccurate model responses. We propose RobustRAG, the first defense framework with certifiable robustness against retrieval corruption attacks. The key insight of RobustRAG is an isolate-then-aggregate strategy: we isolate passages into disjoint groups, generate LLM responses based on the concatenated passages from each isolated group, and then securely aggregate these responses for a robust output. To instantiate RobustRAG, we design keyword-based and decoding-based algorithms for securely aggregating unstructured text responses. Notably, RobustRAG achieves certifiable robustness: for certain queries in our evaluation datasets, we can formally certify non-trivial lower bounds on response quality -- even against an adaptive attacker with full knowledge of the defense and the ability to arbitrarily inject a bounded number of malicious passages. We evaluate RobustRAG on the tasks of open-domain question-answering and free-form long text generation and demonstrate its effectiveness across three datasets and three LLMs.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究针对 RAG 系统中的“检索污染”问题，提出了 RobustRAG 防御框架。其核心是“隔离-聚合”机制，通过将检索到的文本切分为独立组并分别生成响应，最后利用安全聚合算法（基于关键词或解码）剔除潜在恶意信息，从而确保最终输出的可靠性。

## 为什么相关
在病原检测、临床微生物学或基因组学领域，研究人员常利用 RAG 架构构建知识库问答系统（如查询耐药基因数据库或临床指南）。若数据库中混入错误标注的序列信息或虚假的临床建议（检索污染），可能导致错误的诊断结论。RobustRAG 提供的可证明鲁棒性，为构建高可信度的临床决策支持 Agent 提供了理论基础和技术方案。

## 新颖度判断
新颖度较高（6.0）。这是首个针对 RAG 检索污染提出“可证明鲁棒性”的工作。不同于以往仅靠启发式防御的研究，它通过数学证明给出了响应质量的下限，在安全性要求极高的生物医学 AI 领域具有重要意义。

## 方法与证据
- **方法**：采用“隔离后聚合”（isolate-then-aggregate）策略。具体包括将段落分配至不相交组、基于各组生成独立响应，以及使用关键词聚合和解码聚合算法。
- **证据**：在开放域问答和自由形式长文本生成两类任务上进行了评估。实验覆盖了 3 个数据集和 3 个主流 LLM（摘要未说明具体模型名称）。
- **指标**：成功证明了在存在自适应攻击者（拥有防御全知且能注入受限数量恶意段落）的情况下，响应质量仍存在非平凡的下限。

## 应用价值
对于临床微生物学 Agent，该技术可用于过滤知识库中的噪声或恶意篡改数据。在处理多源异构的病原基因组注释时，即使部分来源数据不可靠，RobustRAG 也能通过聚合一致性响应，确保 AI 助手输出的致病性分析或用药建议具有较高的安全性。

## 局限与风险
- **计算开销**：由于需要对多个隔离组分别调用 LLM 生成响应，会显著增加推理成本和延迟，这在实时临床诊断场景中可能受限。
- **覆盖范围**：摘要提到仅对“某些查询”（certain queries）实现了正式证明，暗示该防御在复杂或极度稀疏的知识检索任务中可能效果有限。
- **聚合难度**：非结构化文本的“安全聚合”比数值聚合更复杂，摘要未详细说明如何处理语义冲突但非恶意的生物学证据。

papers.title: Why These Documents? Explainable Generative Retrieval with Hierarchical Category Paths
papers.text:
title: Why These Documents? Explainable Generative Retrieval with Hierarchical Category Paths
source: arXiv
topics: 
category: foundation_model
why: 这篇工作偏基础模型/Agent方向，可能影响病原检测任务的建模上限，值得关注其任务定义与评测设计。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: Generative retrieval directly decode a document identifier (i.e., docid) in response to a query, making it impossible to provide users with explanations as an answer for ``why is this document retrieved?''. To address this limitation, we propose Hierarchical Category Path-Enhanced Generative Retrieval (HyPE), which enhances explainability by first generating hierarchical category paths step-by-step then decoding docid. By leveraging hierarchical category paths which progress from broader to more specific semantic categories, HyPE can provide detailed explanation for its retrieval decision. For training, HyPE constructs category paths with external high-quality semantic hierarchy, leverages LLM to select appropriate candidate paths for each document, and optimizes the generative retrieval model with path-augmented dataset. During inference, HyPE utilizes path-aware ranking strategy to aggregate diverse topic information, allowing the most relevant documents to be prioritized in the final ranked list of docids. Our extensive experiments demonstrate that HyPE not only offers a high level of explainability but also improves the retrieval performance.

papers.title: Evaluating Legal Reasoning Traces with Legal Issue Tree Rubrics
papers.text:
title: Evaluating Legal Reasoning Traces with Legal Issue Tree Rubrics
source: arXiv
topics: 
category: foundation_model
why: 这篇工作偏基础模型/Agent方向，可能影响病原检测任务的建模上限，值得关注其任务定义与评测设计。
abstract_zh: 评估大语言模型（LLM）在法律等专家领域生成的推理路径（reasoning traces）对于确保其可信度和可解释性至关重要，但由于推理任务的复杂性，这仍具挑战。本研究引入了 LEGIT（法律问题树），这是一个包含 2.4 万个实例的大规模专家级法律推理数据集，重点在于推理路径的评估。研究者将法院判决转化为由对立各方论点和法院结论组成的层次树，作为评估推理路径中问题覆盖范围和正确性的准则（rubrics）。通过人类专家标注以及与粗粒度准则的对比，验证了该准则的可靠性。基于 LEGIT 数据集的研究表明：(1) LLM 的法律推理能力受法律问题覆盖率和正确性的严重影响；(2) 检索增强生成（RAG）和基于准则的强化学习（RL）对法律推理能力具有互补作用，其中 RAG 提升了整体推理能力，而 RL 提高了正确性，但会导致覆盖范围缩小。
abstract: Evaluating the quality of LLM-generated reasoning traces in expert domains (e.g., law) is essential for ensuring credibility and explainability, yet remains challenging due to the inherent complexity of such reasoning tasks. We introduce LEGIT (LEGal Issue Trees), a novel large-scale (24K instances) expert-level legal reasoning dataset with an emphasis on reasoning trace evaluation. We convert court judgments into hierarchical trees of opposing parties' arguments and the court's conclusions, which serve as rubrics for evaluating the issue coverage and correctness of the reasoning traces. We verify the reliability of these rubrics via human expert annotations and comparison with coarse, less informative rubrics. Using the LEGIT dataset, we show that (1) LLMs' legal reasoning ability is seriously affected by both legal issue coverage and correctness, and that (2) retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and RL with rubrics bring complementary benefits for legal reasoning abilities, where RAG improves overall reasoning capability, whereas RL improves correctness albeit with reduced coverage.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究针对专家领域（法律）中 LLM 推理路径难以评估的问题，提出了 LEGIT 数据集（24,000 个实例）。其核心是通过将法院判决转化为层次化的“法律问题树”（Legal Issue Trees），构建了一套细粒度的评估准则，用于衡量模型推理的“覆盖范围”和“正确性”。

## 为什么相关
虽然本研究的应用场景是法律，但其核心方法论——**复杂推理路径的结构化评估**——与临床微生物学和病原基因组学的诊断推理高度相关。在临床场景中，从测序数据到致病性判断的推理过程（如排除污染、识别耐药基因、结合临床表型）同样需要类似“问题树”的逻辑框架来确保 AI Agent 的诊断建议具有可解释性和严谨性。

## 新颖度判断
**新颖度：6.0（较高）**。该研究的新颖之处在于将非结构化的法律文本转化为结构化的层次树作为评估 Rubrics，并系统对比了 RAG 和 RL 在提升推理质量上的差异。这种从“结果评估”转向“过程（路径）评估”的思路在专家领域 AI 研究中具有前瞻性。

## 方法与证据
- **数据集规模**：构建了包含 2.4 万个实例的 LEGIT 数据集。
- **评估方法**：利用层次树（包含对立论点和法院结论）作为 Rubrics，并通过专家标注验证了其可靠性。
- **实验结论**：研究发现 RAG 能提升整体推理能力，而基于 Rubrics 的强化学习（RL）虽然能显著提高推理的正确性，但会以牺牲“覆盖范围”为代价（即模型变得更保守，只关注容易答对的点）。

## 应用价值
对于病原生信和临床诊断 Agent 的开发，该研究提供了两点借鉴：
1. **评估框架设计**：可以借鉴“问题树”模式，为病原鉴定建立“证据链树”评估准则。
2. **策略选择**：明确了 RAG 和 RL 的优劣，提示在构建临床辅助决策系统时，若追求全面性应优先优化 RAG，若追求极高准确性则应考虑 RL 调优。

## 局限与风险
- **领域局限性**：研究完全基于法律文本，法律逻辑与生物医学逻辑（基于实验证据和统计概率）存在本质差异。
- **RL 负面效应**：摘要明确指出 RL 会导致“覆盖范围缩小”（reduced coverage），这在临床诊断中可能导致漏诊风险，需谨慎对待。

papers.title: TempPerturb-Eval: On the Joint Effects of Internal Temperature and External Perturbations in RAG Robustness
papers.text:
title: TempPerturb-Eval: On the Joint Effects of Internal Temperature and External Perturbations in RAG Robustness
source: arXiv
topics: 
category: foundation_model
why: 这篇工作偏基础模型/Agent方向，可能影响病原检测任务的建模上限，值得关注其任务定义与评测设计。
abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）系统的评估通常独立考察检索质量和生成参数（如温度），忽略了二者的相互作用。本研究系统调查了文本扰动（模拟噪声检索）与不同大语言模型（LLM）运行温度设置之间的交互影响。我们提出了一个全面的 RAG 扰动-温度分析框架，在不同温度设置下对检索到的文档进行三种不同类型的扰动。通过在 HotpotQA 数据集上对开源和闭源 LLM 进行的大量实验，研究证明性能下降遵循特定模式：高温度设置会持续放大模型对扰动的脆弱性，而某些扰动类型在温度范围内表现出非线性敏感性。本工作的主要贡献包括：(1) 用于评估 RAG 鲁棒性的诊断基准；(2) 量化扰动-温度交互作用的分析框架；(3) 在噪声检索条件下进行模型选择和参数调整的实用指南。
abstract: The evaluation of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems typically examines retrieval quality and generation parameters like temperature in isolation, overlooking their interaction. This work presents a systematic investigation of how text perturbations (simulating noisy retrieval) interact with temperature settings across multiple LLM runs. We propose a comprehensive RAG Perturbation-Temperature Analysis Framework that subjects retrieved documents to three distinct perturbation types across varying temperature settings. Through extensive experiments on HotpotQA with both open-source and proprietary LLMs, we demonstrate that performance degradation follows distinct patterns: high-temperature settings consistently amplify vulnerability to perturbations, while certain perturbation types exhibit non-linear sensitivity across the temperature range. Our work yields three key contributions: (1) a diagnostic benchmark for assessing RAG robustness, (2) an analytical framework for quantifying perturbation-temperature interactions, and (3) practical guidelines for model selection and parameter tuning under noisy retrieval conditions.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究聚焦于 RAG 系统中内部参数（生成温度）与外部因素（检索文档扰动）的联合效应。研究提出了 **TempPerturb-Eval** 框架，旨在量化噪声检索环境下，温度调节如何影响 LLM 的输出稳定性与准确性。

## 为什么相关
在病原检测、临床微生物学或基因组学领域，利用 RAG 构建的 AI Agent 常需处理存在噪声的文献或临床报告。本文研究的“噪声检索”与“生成温度”交互作用，直接关系到临床决策支持系统在面对不确定数据时的可靠性。若温度设置不当，可能会放大错误检索信息对诊断建议的干扰。

## 新颖度判断
**新颖度：6.0（中等偏高）**。该研究打破了以往将检索质量评估与生成参数优化孤立看待的局限，首次系统性地提出了针对 RAG 鲁棒性的“扰动-温度”联合分析框架，并发现了高温度会放大扰动脆弱性这一关键规律。

## 方法与证据
- **实验对象**：涵盖了开源和闭源的大语言模型（摘要未说明具体型号）。
- **数据规模与任务**：基于 **HotpotQA** 数据集进行多跳问答实验。
- **实验设计**：设置了 **3 种不同类型的文本扰动**，并在变化的温度梯度下观察模型表现。
- **主要结论**：高温度设置会显著降低模型对噪声的容忍度；特定扰动类型在不同温度下表现出非线性敏感性，而非简单的线性下降。

## 应用价值
- **参数调优**：为临床微生物 AI 助手提供参数设置指南，建议在检索数据质量不可控时降低温度以增强鲁棒性。
- **模型选型**：提供了一套诊断基准，可用于评估不同 LLM 在处理模糊基因组注释或复杂病原体文献时的抗干扰能力。

## 局限与风险
- **领域局限性**：实验仅在通用问答数据集 HotpotQA 上完成，未在生物医学或病原基因组等专业领域数据上验证。
- **细节缺失**：摘要未明确说明三种扰动的具体形式（如拼写错误、语义冲突或无关插入）以及所测试的具体模型列表。
- **AI 交叉属性**：属于基础模型/Agent 架构的鲁棒性研究，与病原生信属于弱交叉，主要影响下游应用层的稳定性设计。

papers.title: His2Trans: A Skeleton-First Framework for Self-Evolving C-to-Rust Translation with Historical Retrieval
papers.text:
title: His2Trans: A Skeleton-First Framework for Self-Evolving C-to-Rust Translation with Historical Retrieval
source: arXiv
topics: 
category: foundation_model
why: 这篇工作偏基础模型/Agent方向，可能影响病原检测任务的建模上限，值得关注其任务定义与评测设计。
abstract_zh: 自动化 C 到 Rust 的代码迁移在工业级项目中面临构建上下文缺失（“依赖地狱”）和领域演化知识匮乏的挑战，导致现有基于大语言模型（LLM）的方法常因无法重建精确类型定义或推断惯用 API 对应关系，产生幻觉依赖和低效修复循环。为此，我们提出 His2Trans 框架，结合确定性的构建感知骨架与自进化知识提取。在结构层面，His2Trans 通过构建追踪生成可编译的项目级骨架图（Project-Level Skeleton Graph），提供严格类型环境以分离全局验证与局部逻辑生成。在认知层面，它从历史迁移轨迹中提取细粒度 API 和代码片段规则，利用检索增强生成（RAG）引导 LLM 实现惯用接口重用。在 OpenHarmony 工业模块实验中，His2Trans 实现了 97.51% 的增量编译通过率。在通用基准测试中，相比 C2Rust，其 unsafe 代码比例降低了 25.23 个百分点。知识积累研究表明，该框架通过集成验证模式，使新任务的修复开销降低了约 60%。
abstract: Automated C-to-Rust migration encounters systemic obstacles when scaling from code snippets to industrial projects, mainly because build context is often unavailable ("dependency hell") and domain-specific evolutionary knowledge is missing. As a result, current LLM-based methods frequently cannot reconstruct precise type definitions under complex build systems or infer idiomatic API correspondences, which in turn leads to hallucinated dependencies and unproductive repair loops.To tackle these issues, we introduce His2Trans, a framework that combines a deterministic, build-aware skeleton with self-evolving knowledge extraction to support stable, incremental migration. On the structural side, His2Trans performs build tracing to create a compilable Project-Level Skeleton Graph, providing a strictly typed environment that separates global verification from local logic generation. On the cognitive side, it derives fine-grained API and code-fragment rules from historical migration traces and uses a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system to steer the LLM toward idiomatic interface reuse.Experiments on industrial OpenHarmony modules show that His2Trans reaches a 97.51% incremental compilation pass rate, effectively fixing build failures where baselines struggle. On general-purpose benchmarks, it reduces the unsafe code ratio by 25.23 percentage points compared with C2Rust while also lowering warning counts, although cross-domain functional correctness remains challenging. Finally, knowledge accumulation studies demonstrate the framework's evolutionary behavior: by continuously integrating verified patterns, His2Trans cuts repair overhead on unseen tasks by about 60%.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究提出了 His2Trans 框架，旨在解决工业级 C 语言项目向 Rust 语言迁移中的构建上下文缺失和 API 转换不规范问题。核心组件包括用于结构约束的“项目级骨架图”和用于逻辑生成的“自进化 RAG 系统”。

## 为什么相关
本研究属于计算机科学中的软件工程与 AI 交叉领域。虽然其直接对象是代码迁移，但与病原检测、基因组学等领域的**弱相关性**体现在：生物信息学中大量底层高性能工具（如序列比对、组装算法）由 C/C++ 编写，利用此类 AI 框架将其安全地迁移至 Rust，可显著提升生物数据处理工具的内存安全性和并发稳定性，降低病原分析软件的崩溃风险。

## 新颖度判断
新颖度较高（6.0）。不同于传统的端到端 LLM 翻译，His2Trans 引入了“骨架优先”策略，通过构建追踪（Build Tracing）解决工业级项目的依赖问题，并利用历史迁移轨迹实现知识的自进化，这种将确定性结构与概率性生成结合的思路在代码转换领域具有前瞻性。

## 方法与证据
1. **项目级骨架图**：通过构建追踪技术生成，确保全局类型环境的严格性，实验显示在 OpenHarmony 模块上达到了 97.51% 的增量编译通过率。
2. **自进化 RAG**：从历史迁移中提取 API 规则。证据显示，这种知识积累使新任务的修复开销（Repair Overhead）降低了约 60%。
3. **对比实验**：在通用基准上，相比基准工具 C2Rust，His2Trans 将 unsafe 代码比例降低了 25.23 个百分点，并有效减少了编译器警告。

## 应用价值
对于临床微生物学或基因组学研究者，该框架的价值在于提供了一种可靠的工具链，用于重构和优化陈旧的生物信息学 C 语言库。它不仅能提高代码的安全性（减少内存漏洞），还能通过 RAG 学习特定领域的 API 调用习惯，降低维护成本。

## 局限与风险
摘要明确指出“跨领域功能正确性（Cross-domain functional correctness）”仍然具有挑战性，这意味着在处理高度专业化的生物计算逻辑时，可能仍需人工干预。此外，摘要未说明该框架对不同规模 LLM（如 GPT-4 vs. 较小模型）的依赖程度及推理成本。

papers.title: MDER-DR: Multi-Hop Question Answering with Entity-Centric Summaries
papers.text:
title: MDER-DR: Multi-Hop Question Answering with Entity-Centric Summaries
source: arXiv
topics: 
category: methods
why: 这篇工作更像方法创新，可能直接关联 metagenomics、long-read 或 pathogen identification 流程优化。
abstract_zh: 针对知识图谱（KG）的检索增强生成（RAG）在将文本简化为三元组时，往往会丢失重要的上下文细微差别，导致多跳问答（QA）性能下降。为此，我们提出了一种领域无关的 KG 问答框架 MDER-DR，涵盖索引与检索推理阶段。在索引阶段，MDER（映射-消歧-丰富-归约）方法生成源自上下文的三元组描述，并将其与实体级摘要整合，从而在检索阶段无需显式遍历图边缘。在检索阶段，DR（分解-解决）机制将用户查询分解为可解析的三元组，并通过迭代推理将其定位到 KG 中。MDER-DR 构成了一个由大语言模型（LLM）驱动的问答流水线，对稀疏、不完整和复杂的关联数据具有鲁棒性。实验表明，在标准和特定领域基准测试中，MDER-DR 较标准 RAG 基线提升高达 66%，并表现出跨语言鲁棒性。
abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) over Knowledge Graphs (KGs) suffers from the fact that indexing approaches may lose important contextual nuance when text is reduced to triples, thereby degrading performance in downstream Question-Answering (QA) tasks, particularly for multi-hop QA, which requires composing answers from multiple entities, facts, or relations. We propose a domain-agnostic, KG-based QA framework that covers both the indexing and retrieval/inference phases. A new indexing approach called Map-Disambiguate-Enrich-Reduce (MDER) generates context-derived triple descriptions and subsequently integrates them with entity-level summaries, thus avoiding the need for explicit traversal of edges in the graph during the QA retrieval phase. Complementing this, we introduce Decompose-Resolve (DR), a retrieval mechanism that decomposes user queries into resolvable triples and grounds them in the KG via iterative reasoning. Together, MDER and DR form an LLM-driven QA pipeline that is robust to sparse, incomplete, and complex relational data. Experiments show that on standard and domain specific benchmarks, MDER-DR achieves substantial improvements over standard RAG baselines (up to 66%), while maintaining cross-lingual robustness. Our code is available at https://github.com/DataSciencePolimi/MDER-DR_RAG.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究提出了 MDER-DR 框架，旨在解决知识图谱 RAG 中因三元组简化导致的上下文缺失问题。核心组件包括：1) MDER 索引法，通过生成包含上下文的三元组描述和实体摘要来保留信息；2) DR 检索机制，通过查询分解和迭代推理实现多跳问答。该框架由 LLM 驱动，强调在不遍历图边缘的情况下完成复杂推理。

## 为什么相关
在病原生物学和临床微生物学中，知识通常以复杂的生物网络（如宿主-病原体相互作用、耐药基因调控网络）形式存在。这类数据具有高度的“多跳”属性（例如：查询“某种耐药基因通过哪些代谢途径影响特定抗生素的敏感性”）。MDER-DR 处理稀疏、不完整数据的能力，直接契合临床微生物领域中知识库更新不及时或实验数据碎片化的现状。

## 新颖度判断
新颖度较高（6.0）。其创新点在于打破了传统 GraphRAG 依赖显式图遍历（Edge Traversal）的局限，转而采用“实体中心化摘要”与“上下文增强三元组”相结合的索引策略。这种方法在保留图结构关联性的同时，利用 LLM 的语义理解能力弥补了结构化数据的硬性缺失。

## 方法与证据
- **方法**：采用 MDER（Map-Disambiguate-Enrich-Reduce）流程进行数据预处理，并利用 DR（Decompose-Resolve）进行迭代式查询解析。
- **数据与实验**：在标准基准和特定领域基准（摘要未具体说明领域名称）上进行了测试。
- **指标**：相比标准 RAG 基线，性能提升最高达 66%，并验证了跨语言鲁棒性。

## 应用价值
该方法可用于构建更智能的临床微生物决策支持系统。例如，在基因组学研究中，可利用该框架整合异构的文献数据和基因组注释，辅助研究人员在海量稀疏数据中发现病原体致病机制的潜在关联。其跨语言特性有助于整合全球不同语言的病原体监测报告。

## 局限与风险
- **计算开销**：摘要提到该流程由 LLM 驱动且涉及迭代推理，这可能导致在处理大规模生物医学知识图谱时推理延迟较高或 API 调用成本昂贵。
- **领域适配性**：虽然声称“领域无关”，但生物医学术语具有高度专业性，MDER 阶段的“消歧”和“丰富”在处理同名异义的基因或菌株时，其准确性仍需在真实临床数据中验证。
- **数据依赖**：摘要未说明对超大规模图谱（亿级节点）的扩展性表现。

papers.title: Toward Robust GraphRAG: Mitigating Retrieval Drift and Hallucination from Imperfect Knowledge Graphs
papers.text:
title: Toward Robust GraphRAG: Mitigating Retrieval Drift and Hallucination from Imperfect Knowledge Graphs
source: arXiv
topics: 
category: methods
why: 这篇工作更像方法创新，可能直接关联 metagenomics、long-read 或 pathogen identification 流程优化。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GraphRAG) has become a common approach for multi-hop reasoning by using knowledge graphs (KGs) as structured retrieval indexes. However, most existing GraphRAG methods implicitly assume that LLM-constructed KGs provide structural support for evidence chaining. In this paper, we show that this assumption does not always hold in practice through an empirical analysis, and identify two recurring KG issue modes often overlooked by current retrievers: spurious noise and incomplete information. Spurious noise induces retrieval drift toward plausible but unsupported triples, whereas incomplete information leads to retrieval hallucination by forcing continuation through under-supported graph structure. To address these challenges, we propose CS-RAG, a robust GraphRAG framework that mitigates the impact of imperfect KGs during retrieval rather than relying on KG repair. CS-RAG first plans each query as an ordered sequence of executable atomic constraints and performs fine-grained anchor- and relation-aware retrieval to constrain evidence acquisition around the intended hop semantics. It then applies a sufficiency check to decide whether the retrieved evidence can safely induce variable bindings for subsequent propagation and activates textual recovery when structural support is insufficient, thereby reducing hallucinated structural continuation. Experiments on three multi-hop QA benchmarks show that CS-RAG is less sensitive to builder choice and remains stable under controlled KG issue injection. Code is available at: https://github.com/myz12138/CS-RAG/
analysis_zh:

papers.title: CoverageBench: Evaluating Information Coverage across Tasks and Domains
papers.text:
title: CoverageBench: Evaluating Information Coverage across Tasks and Domains
source: arXiv
topics: 
category: methods
why: 这篇工作更像方法创新，可能直接关联 metagenomics、long-read 或 pathogen identification 流程优化。
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在衡量即时检索算法的“信息覆盖率”，即搜索结果涵盖可用相关信息的程度。信息覆盖率是检索系统的核心指标，尤其是在检索增强生成（RAG）系统中。传统的即时检索指标（如精确率、召回率、RBP、nDCG 和 MAP）通常根据检索到的相关文档数量来奖励系统。然而，由于这些测试集中的相关性是针对单个文档定义的，未考虑文档间可能包含重复信息的情况，因此高召回率虽能保证覆盖率，但并非必要条件。虽然 Web 搜索中的多样性排序集合包含部分覆盖率概念，但缺乏跨领域的统一标准。为此，我们构建了 CoverageBench，这是一个利用现有集合构建的、专门用于评估信息覆盖率的测试套件。该套件为研究人员提供了一个跨多个流派和任务的统一测试平台。目前，所有主题、信息点（nuggets）、相关性标签和基准排名均已在 Hugging Face Datasets 上发布，并附带了访问公开文档集的说明。
abstract: We wish to measure the information coverage of an ad hoc retrieval algorithm, that is, how much of the range of available relevant information is covered by the search results. Information coverage is a central aspect for retrieval, especially when the retrieval system is integrated with generative models in a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) system. The classic metrics for ad hoc retrieval, precision and recall, reward a system as more and more relevant documents are retrieved. However, since relevance in ad hoc test collections is defined for a document without any relation to other documents that might contain the same information, high recall is sufficient but not necessary to ensure coverage. The same is true for other metrics such as rank-biased precision (RBP), normalized discounted cumulative gain (nDCG), and mean average precision (MAP). Test collections developed around the notion of diversity ranking in web search incorporate multiple aspects that support a concept of coverage in the web domain. In this work, we construct a suite of collections for evaluating information coverage from existing collections. This suite offers researchers a unified testbed spanning multiple genres and tasks. All topics, nuggets, relevance labels, and baseline rankings are released on Hugging Face Datasets, along with instructions for accessing the publicly available document collections.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究提出了 **CoverageBench**，一个专门用于评估检索系统“信息覆盖率”（Information Coverage）的基准测试套件。其核心目标是量化检索结果在多大程度上覆盖了所有已知相关的“信息点”（nuggets），而非仅仅计算相关文档的数量。该工具旨在解决 RAG 系统中传统指标（如 Precision/Recall）无法有效衡量信息冗余与完整性的问题。

## 为什么相关
在病原体生物信息学和临床微生物学领域，研究人员经常需要从海量文献或基因组数据库中检索特定病原体的特征（如耐药基因、毒力因子）。传统的检索系统可能返回 10 篇高度相关的文档，但如果这些文档内容高度重复，RAG 系统生成的综述就会缺失关键信息。CoverageBench 提供的覆盖率评估方法，可以直接优化病原体鉴定流程中知识检索的完整性，确保 AI 助手能捕捉到不同来源的异质化生物学证据。

## 新颖度判断
**中等偏高（6.0）**。该研究的新颖性在于从方法论层面挑战了传统的即时检索评价体系。它不再将文档视为独立的相关性单元，而是引入了“信息点（nuggets）”的概念，并构建了一个跨任务、跨领域的统一测试床。这对于当前依赖 RAG 架构的生物医学大模型应用具有重要的基准指导意义。

## 方法与证据
研究者通过整合现有的多个检索数据集，构建了 CoverageBench。其核心评价逻辑是基于“信息点（nuggets）”的覆盖情况。摘要提到，该套件包含了**主题（topics）、信息点（nuggets）、相关性标签（relevance labels）和基准排名（baseline rankings）**。实验数据规模和具体的原始集合来源在摘要中未明确说明，但指出所有资源已发布在 **Hugging Face Datasets** 上供社区调用。

## 应用价值
1. **RAG 流程优化**：可用于评估临床微生物学 AI 助手在处理复杂查询（如“某种罕见菌的临床表现”）时，检索到的上下文是否涵盖了所有关键诊断指标。
2. **长读段/宏基因组分析**：在处理长序列或复杂样本时，评估检索算法是否能覆盖所有潜在的病原体候选者，而非仅集中在丰度最高的几种。
3. **模型对比**：为生物医学领域定制的检索模型提供了一个衡量“信息广度”的标准化工具。

## 局限与风险
1. **弱 AI 交叉**：该工作属于通用信息检索（IR）领域的算法创新，并非专门针对生物信息学设计。其在处理高度专业化的生物术语（如复杂的基因命名法）时的表现尚未在摘要中提及。
2. **数据依赖**：CoverageBench 是基于“现有集合”构建的，其评估效力高度依赖于预先定义的“信息点（nuggets）”的质量和标注的完备性。如果生物医学领域的“信息点”定义不准确，该基准可能失效。

papers.title: CanViT: Toward Active-Vision Foundation Models
papers.text:
title: CanViT: Toward Active-Vision Foundation Models
source: arXiv
topics: 
category: foundation_model
why: 这篇工作偏基础模型/Agent方向，可能影响病原检测任务的建模上限，值得关注其任务定义与评测设计。
abstract_zh: 主动计算机视觉通过序列化、局部观察实现高效感知，但长期缺乏可扩展的通用架构。本文提出 CanViT，这是首个任务与策略无关的主动视觉基础模型（AVFM）。CanViT 采用视网膜拓扑结构的 Vision Transformer 骨干网络，并通过场景相对旋转位置编码（RoPE）将其与场景范围的潜空间工作记忆（称为“画布”）绑定。利用新型非对称交叉注意力机制（Canvas Attention），模型实现了与高容量工作记忆的高效交互。通过解耦计算（骨干层）与存储（画布层），消除了画布端的自注意力和全连接层，确保了快速序列推理和高分辨率扩展性。预训练采用无标签的“被动到主动密集潜空间蒸馏”方案，从随机位置、缩放和长度的低分辨率观察序列中重建 DINOv3 嵌入。实验在 1320 万张 ImageNet-21k 场景（10 亿次随机观察）上进行。结果显示，在 ADE20K 分割任务中，CanViT-B 单次观察即达到 38.5% mIoU，多次观察后提升至 45.9%，显著优于现有主动视觉模型。在 ImageNet-1k 分类中，其微调准确率达到 84.5%，证明了该模型在处理大型场景和新策略时的泛化潜力。
abstract: Active computer vision promises efficient, biologically plausible perception through sequential, localized glimpses, but lacks scalable general-purpose architectures and pretraining pipelines, leaving Active-Vision Foundation Models (AVFMs) underexplored. We introduce CanViT, the first task- and policy-agnostic AVFM. CanViT uses scene-relative RoPE to bind a retinotopic Vision Transformer backbone and a spatiotopic scene-wide latent workspace, the canvas. Efficient interaction with this high-capacity working memory is supported by Canvas Attention, a novel asymmetric cross-attention mechanism. We decouple thinking (backbone-level) and memory (canvas-level), eliminating canvas-side self-attention and fully-connected layers to achieve fast sequential inference and scalability to high output resolutions. We propose a label-free active vision pretraining scheme, policy-agnostic passive-to-active dense latent distillation: reconstructing scene-wide DINOv3 embeddings from sequences of low-resolution glimpses with randomized locations, zoom levels, and lengths. We pretrain CanViT-B from a random initialization on 13.2 million ImageNet-21k scenes--an order of magnitude more than previous active models--and 1 billion random glimpses, in 166 hours on a single H100. On ADE20K segmentation, a frozen CanViT-B achieves 38.5% mIoU in a single low-resolution glimpse, outperforming the best active model's 27.6% with 20x fewer inference FLOPs as well as its FLOP- or input-matched DINOv3 teacher. Given additional glimpses, CanViT-B reaches 45.9% ADE20K mIoU. On ImageNet-1k classification, CanViT-B also sets a new active-vision state of the art, with 84.5% top-1 accuracy after fine-tuning. CanViT generalizes to longer rollouts, larger scenes, and new policies. Our work narrows the wide gap between passive and active computer vision, demonstrating the potential of task- and policy-agnostic AVFM pretraining.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究提出了 CanViT，一种主动视觉基础模型（AVFM），旨在通过局部、序列化的“观察（glimpses）”来构建对全局场景的理解。核心组件包括一个处理局部信息的 ViT 骨干网络和一个存储全局信息的“画布（Canvas）”潜空间。通过 Canvas Attention 机制和被动到主动的知识蒸馏（利用 DINOv3 作为教师模型），CanViT 实现了在极低计算开销下对高分辨率场景的逐步解析。

## 为什么相关
本研究与病原生物学或临床微生物学的相关性属于**弱 AI 交叉**。其技术逻辑可类比于临床微生物学中的**全扫描切片成像（WSI）分析**或**自动化显微镜寻靶**。在处理超高分辨率的病理切片或环境样本扫描时，传统模型难以一次性处理全局像素，CanViT 这种“局部观察、全局汇总”的主动视觉策略，为开发能够自动识别病原体聚集区、优化扫描路径的智能显微镜 Agent 提供了底层架构参考。

## 新颖度判断
**新颖度高（6.0）**。该工作首次实现了任务与策略无关的主动视觉基础模型预训练。其创新点在于：1. 引入了解耦“思考”与“记忆”的非对称架构；2. 提出了 label-free 的主动视觉蒸馏预训练方案，将被动视觉大模型的知识迁移到主动感知任务中；3. 训练规模达到 13.2M 场景和 10 亿次观察，远超此前同类研究。

## 方法与证据
- **模型架构**：CanViT-B 结合了 RoPE 位置编码和 Canvas Attention，去除了画布端的复杂计算以提升推理速度。
- **数据规模**：在 ImageNet-21k 上进行了 13.2M 场景的预训练，使用单张 H100 耗时 166 小时。
- **实验指标**：在 ADE20K 语义分割中，单次低分辨率观察的 mIoU 为 38.5%，多次观察后升至 45.9%，而此前最佳主动模型仅为 27.6%。
- **分类性能**：ImageNet-1k Top-1 准确率达到 84.5%，证明了其作为通用骨干网络的有效性。

## 应用价值
在临床微生物领域，该模型可用于：1. **智能病理诊断**：模拟病理医生在低倍镜下寻找可疑区域、高倍镜下确认病原体的过程；2. **高通量筛选**：在自动化实验室中，指导机械臂或相机序列化地捕捉培养皿中的菌落特征，减少无效数据采集；3. **资源受限设备**：在算力有限的便携式检测设备上，通过少量局部采样实现高精度的全局推断。

## 局限与风险
- **领域迁移风险**：模型目前在 ImageNet 等自然图像上预训练，对于特征高度重复、纹理细微的微生物显微图像，其“画布”记忆机制的有效性尚未验证。
- **依赖教师模型**：预训练高度依赖 DINOv3 的特征质量，若教师模型在医学/生物领域表现不佳，CanViT 的性能上限将受限。
- **策略泛化性**：摘要提到模型对新策略有泛化性，但在复杂的临床决策场景下，如何定义最优的“观察路径”仍是挑战。

papers.title: AI-Supervisor: Autonomous AI Research Supervision via a Persistent Research World Model
papers.text:
title: AI-Supervisor: Autonomous AI Research Supervision via a Persistent Research World Model
source: arXiv
topics: 
category: methods
why: 这篇工作更像方法创新，可能直接关联 metagenomics、long-read 或 pathogen identification 流程优化。
abstract_zh: 现有的自动化研究系统多为无状态的线性流水线，缺乏对研究领域的持久性理解。本文提出了 AI-Supervisor，这是一个由人类兴趣驱动的多智能体编排框架，旨在提供从文献综述、缺口发现、方法开发、评估到论文撰写的端到端 AI 研究监督。与传统线性系统不同，AI-Supervisor 维护一个以知识图谱实现的持续演化“研究世界模型”，记录方法、基准、局限性及未探索的缺口，作为智能体间的共享内存。该框架包含三大核心贡献：一是结构化缺口发现，通过分解方法模块并验证其在基准上的表现来定位研究空白；二是自我修正发现循环，探究模块成败原因及基准偏差；三是自我改进开发循环，通过跨领域机制搜索迭代优化失效模块。所有智能体在共识机制下运行，确保研究发现在存入世界模型前经过独立验证。
abstract: Existing automated research systems operate as stateless, linear pipelines -- generating outputs without maintaining any persistent understanding of the research landscape they navigate. They process papers sequentially, propose ideas without structured gap analysis, and lack mechanisms for agents to verify, challenge, or refine each other's findings. We present \textbf{AI-Supervisor}, a multi-agent orchestration framework where specialized agents provide end-to-end AI research supervision driven by human interests -- from literature review through gap discovery, method development, evaluation, and paper writing -- through autonomous exploration and self-correcting updates of research knowledge. Unlike sequential pipelines, AI-Supervisor maintains a continuously evolving \emph{Research World Model}, implemented as a Knowledge Graph, that captures methods, benchmarks, known limitations, and unexplored gaps, serving as shared memory across all agents and enabling agents to explore and build upon a structured understanding of the research landscape. The framework introduces three architectural contributions: (1) \emph{structured gap discovery} that decomposes methods into core modules, validates their performance across benchmarks, and maps the specific gaps each module creates; (2) \emph{self-correcting discovery loops} that probe why modules succeed on certain problems and fail on others, whether benchmarks carry hidden biases, and whether evaluation protocols remain adequate for emerging challenges; and (3) \emph{self-improving development loops} governed by cross-domain mechanism search that iteratively targets failing modules by finding solutions from other scientific fields. All agents operate under a \emph{consensus mechanism} where independent findings are corroborated before being committed to the Research World Model.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究提出了名为 **AI-Supervisor** 的多智能体框架，核心是构建了一个基于**知识图谱（Knowledge Graph）**的“研究世界模型”。该模型不仅是数据的堆叠，而是作为智能体的共享内存，支持从文献调研到论文撰写的全流程自动化，重点解决了现有 AI 科研助手缺乏长期记忆和逻辑一致性的问题。

## 为什么相关
虽然摘要未直接提及病原学或基因组学，但其提出的“结构化缺口发现”和“跨领域机制搜索”对生物信息学具有高度潜在价值。例如，在宏基因组组装或长读长测序算法开发中，该框架可自动识别现有工具在特定病原体基因组上的性能瓶颈，并尝试从其他计算领域引入算法机制进行优化。

## 新颖度判断
**新颖度高（6.0）**。该工作跳出了“Prompt-Pipeline”的简单模式，引入了**持久化世界模型**和**共识机制**。这种从“线性执行”到“闭环演化”的转变，是 AI 驱动科学发现（AI4Science）领域的重要架构创新。

## 方法与证据
框架通过三个关键循环实现：
1. **结构化缺口发现**：将研究方法分解为核心模块，并在基准测试中验证，从而精确映射技术缺口。
2. **自我修正循环**：主动探测模块失败的深层原因（如基准偏差或评估协议失效）。
3. **自我改进循环**：利用跨领域机制搜索（Cross-domain mechanism search）寻找解决方案。
**证据说明**：摘要提到了框架的架构组成和运行逻辑，但**摘要未说明**具体的实验数据集规模、具体的 LLM 底座型号以及对比基准的具体量化提升指标。

## 应用价值
在临床微生物学与基因组学领域，该框架可用于：
- 自动追踪耐药性研究的最新进展并识别尚未解决的分子机制缺口。
- 跨学科借鉴深度学习在图像处理中的注意力机制，优化病原体序列的特征提取算法。
- 通过共识机制减少 AI 生成科研假设时的“幻觉”问题。

## 局限与风险
1. **领域知识深度**：摘要未说明该框架在处理高度专业化的生物医学本体（Ontology）时的准确性。
2. **计算成本**：多智能体频繁的共识验证和跨领域搜索可能带来巨大的 Token 消耗和计算开销。
3. **实验验证缺失**：目前框架侧重于“研究监督”和“论文撰写”，对于湿实验验证的集成能力**摘要未说明**。

papers.title: Training the Knowledge Base through Evidence Distillation and Write-Back Enrichment
papers.text:
title: Training the Knowledge Base through Evidence Distillation and Write-Back Enrichment
source: arXiv
topics: 
category: methods
why: 这篇工作更像方法创新，可能直接关联 metagenomics、long-read 或 pathogen identification 流程优化。
abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）系统的知识库通常在构建后便不再修订，但查询所需的事实往往分散在多个文档中并被无关内容掩盖。本研究提出将知识库视为“可训练组件”的观点，并开发了 WriteBack-RAG 框架。该框架利用标注示例识别检索成功的路径，隔离相关文档，并将其提炼为紧凑的知识单元，随后将其与原始语料库共同索引。由于该方法仅修改语料库，可作为离线预处理步骤应用于任何 RAG 流程。在 4 种 RAG 方法、6 个基准测试和 2 种大模型底座上的实验表明，WriteBack-RAG 在所有设置下均实现了性能提升，平均增幅为 +2.14%。跨方法迁移实验进一步证实，提炼后的知识能使非生成该知识的 RAG 流程受益，证明了改进源于语料库本身的优化。
abstract: The knowledge base in a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) system is typically assembled once and never revised, even though the facts a query requires are often fragmented across documents and buried in irrelevant content. We argue that the knowledge base should be treated as a trainable component and propose WriteBack-RAG, a framework that uses labeled examples to identify where retrieval succeeds, isolate the relevant documents, and distill them into compact knowledge units that are indexed alongside the original corpus. Because the method modifies only the corpus, it can be applied once as an offline preprocessing step and combined with any RAG pipeline. Across four RAG methods, six benchmarks, and two LLM backbones, WriteBack-RAG improves every evaluated setting, with gains averaging +2.14%. Cross-method transfer experiments further show that the distilled knowledge benefits RAG pipelines other than the one used to produce it, confirming that the improvement resides in the corpus itself.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究提出了 **WriteBack-RAG** 框架，核心思想是将 RAG 系统中的静态知识库转变为动态可优化的“可训练组件”。通过证据蒸馏（Evidence Distillation）技术，将原本碎片化、分散在不同文档中的事实提炼为紧凑的知识单元，并将其“回写”（Write-Back）到索引库中，从而增强检索效率和生成质量。

## 为什么相关
在病原微生物学和宏基因组学领域，关键证据（如耐药基因片段、毒力因子描述或临床表型）往往散落在海量的文献、测序报告或临床记录中。WriteBack-RAG 提供了一种优化此类“碎片化知识库”的通用方法。对于病原体鉴定流程，该方法可能通过预先整合零散的基因组特征描述，提高 LLM 在处理复杂临床咨询时的证据提取准确性。

## 新颖度判断
新颖度较高（6.0）。不同于大多数 RAG 研究侧重于改进检索算法（Retriever）或生成模型（Generator），本项目另辟蹊径，通过离线预处理的方式优化语料库（Corpus）本身。这种“回写增强”机制使得知识库具备了类似模型参数的“可训练性”，且具有极强的模型无关性。

## 方法与证据
- **方法**：WriteBack-RAG 框架，包含识别相关文档、蒸馏紧凑知识单元、回写索引三个步骤。
- **实验规模**：涵盖了 4 种不同的 RAG 方法、6 个标准基准测试（Benchmarks）以及 2 种主流大语言模型（LLM）底座。
- **核心指标**：在所有评估设置中均有提升，平均性能增幅达 **+2.14%**。
- **迁移性证据**：跨方法迁移实验显示，由一种 RAG 流程生成的蒸馏知识可以被其他 RAG 流程直接利用并产生增益。

## 应用价值
1. **流程优化**：可作为病原体鉴定或长读段（Long-read）分析流程中的离线预处理步骤，不增加在线推理延迟。
2. **知识整合**：在临床微生物学中，可用于整合分散在不同病历或实验记录中的病原体证据，形成高密度的知识索引。
3. **通用性**：由于其仅修改语料库，可无缝集成到现有的生物信息学 AI Agent 框架中。

## 局限与风险
- **数据依赖**：摘要提到该方法需要“标注示例”（labeled examples）来识别检索成功的情况，在缺乏高质量标注数据的临床微生态领域，其冷启动可能存在困难。
- **蒸馏质量**：摘要未详细说明蒸馏过程中是否会引入幻觉或丢失关键的生物学细节（如具体的碱基突变位置）。
- **计算开销**：对于超大规模的基因组数据库，离线蒸馏和回写的计算成本摘要未予说明。

papers.title: Resolving the Robustness-Precision Trade-off in Financial RAG through Hybrid Document-Routed Retrieval
papers.text:
title: Resolving the Robustness-Precision Trade-off in Financial RAG through Hybrid Document-Routed Retrieval
source: arXiv
topics: 
category: foundation_model
why: 这篇工作偏基础模型/Agent方向，可能影响病原检测任务的建模上限，值得关注其任务定义与评测设计。
abstract_zh: 针对金融文档问答的检索增强生成（RAG）系统通常采用基于分块（CBR）的范式，即将文档切分为片段、嵌入向量空间并通过相似度搜索进行检索。但在监管文件等结构高度同质化的语料库中，该方法常因跨文档分块混淆而导致失效。语义文件路由（SFR）利用大模型结构化输出将查询路由至完整文档，虽减少了灾难性失败，但牺牲了精准分块检索的精度。本研究通过 FinDER 基准测试（涵盖 5 个组别、1500 个查询）识别了这种“鲁棒性-精准度”权衡：SFR 平均得分较高（6.45 vs 6.02）且失败率较低（10.3% vs 22.5%），而 CBR 的完美回答率更高（13.8% vs 8.5%）。为此，我们提出混合文档路由检索（HDRR），这是一种两阶段架构，先利用 SFR 过滤文档，再在选定文档范围内进行分块检索。实验表明，HDRR 在所有指标上均表现最佳：平均得分 7.54，失败率仅 6.4%，正确率达 67.7%，完美回答率达 20.1%。HDRR 通过同时实现最低失败率和最高精准度，成功解决了上述权衡。
abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems for financial document question answering typically follow a chunk-based paradigm: documents are split into fragments, embedded into vector space, and retrieved via similarity search. While effective in general settings, this approach suffers from cross-document chunk confusion in structurally homogeneous corpora such as regulatory filings. Semantic File Routing (SFR), which uses LLM structured output to route queries to whole documents, reduces catastrophic failures but sacrifices the precision of targeted chunk retrieval. We identify this robustness-precision trade-off through controlled evaluation on the FinDER benchmark (1,500 queries across five groups): SFR achieves higher average scores (6.45 vs. 6.02) and fewer failures (10.3% vs. 22.5%), while chunk-based retrieval (CBR) yields more perfect answers (13.8% vs. 8.5%). To resolve this trade-off, we propose Hybrid Document-Routed Retrieval (HDRR), a two-stage architecture that uses SFR as a document filter followed by chunk-based retrieval scoped to the identified document(s). HDRR eliminates cross-document confusion while preserving targeted chunk precision. Experimental results demonstrate that HDRR achieves the best performance on every metric: an average score of 7.54 (25.2% above CBR, 16.9% above SFR), a failure rate of only 6.4%, a correctness rate of 67.7% (+18.7 pp over CBR), and a perfect-answer rate of 20.1% (+6.3 pp over CBR, +11.6 pp over SFR). HDRR resolves the trade-off by simultaneously achieving the lowest failure rate and the highest precision across all five experimental groups.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究针对金融领域 RAG 系统在处理结构相似文档（如监管报告）时存在的“鲁棒性-精准度”权衡问题，提出了一种名为 HDRR（Hybrid Document-Routed Retrieval）的两阶段检索架构。该架构结合了语义文件路由（SFR）的全局导航能力和基于分块检索（CBR）的局部定位能力，旨在消除跨文档的检索混淆。

## 为什么相关
虽然本研究的应用场景是金融（FinDER 基准），但其核心挑战与**临床微生物学及基因组学**高度相似。在病原体检测或临床报告分析中，研究者常面临大量结构高度一致的文档（如不同患者的检测报告、不同菌株的注释文件）。传统的 CBR 容易在相似的表格或描述中“迷失”，导致检索到错误样本的信息。HDRR 提供的“先定位文档、后精细检索”思路，对构建高可靠性的临床决策支持 Agent 具有直接的借鉴意义。

## 新颖度判断
**中等偏高**。该研究敏锐地捕捉到了 RAG 在同质化语料库中的特定失效模式，并量化了 SFR（侧重鲁棒性）与 CBR（侧重精准度）之间的对立关系。其提出的 HDRR 并非简单的模型堆叠，而是针对特定检索痛点的架构优化，并在 1500 个查询的大规模测试中证明了其优越性。

## 方法与证据
- **实验对象与数据**：使用 FinDER 基准测试，包含 5 个实验组别，共计 1,500 个查询。
- **对比模型**：对比了传统的基于分块检索（CBR）和基于大模型结构化输出的语义文件路由（SFR）。
- **关键指标**：HDRR 的平均得分为 7.54，显著高于 CBR（6.02）和 SFR（6.45）。
- **可靠性证据**：HDRR 将失败率降低至 6.4%（CBR 为 22.5%），同时将完美回答率提升至 20.1%，证明了其在减少错误的同时提升了答案质量。

## 应用价值
在病原体生信领域，该方法可用于构建更精准的知识库检索工具。例如，在处理数千份流感病毒序列分析报告时，HDRR 可以先准确锁定特定年份或地区的报告（SFR 阶段），再从中提取具体的突变位点信息（CBR 阶段），有效避免因报告格式雷同导致的跨样本数据混淆。

## 局限与风险
- **计算开销**：摘要未说明两阶段检索（尤其是第一阶段涉及 LLM 路由）带来的推理延迟和 API 成本增加。
- **文档规模限制**：摘要未提及当候选文档数量极多（如数万份报告）时，SFR 阶段的路由效率是否会成为瓶颈。
- **弱 AI 交叉**：本研究属于通用 AI 架构改进，并非专门针对生物医学数据设计，迁移至病原体领域时需重新评估其在非结构化生物文本上的路由准确性。

papers.title: From PDF to RAG-Ready: Evaluating Document Conversion Frameworks for Domain-Specific Question Answering
papers.text:
title: From PDF to RAG-Ready: Evaluating Document Conversion Frameworks for Domain-Specific Question Answering
source: arXiv
topics: 
category: dataset
why: 这篇工作偏数据集或基准构建，适合判断是否能作为病原组学训练或评测资源。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems depend critically on the quality of document preprocessing, yet no prior study has evaluated PDF processing frameworks by their impact on downstream question-answering accuracy. We address this gap through a systematic comparison of four open-source PDF-to-Markdown conversion frameworks, Docling, MinerU, Marker, and DeepSeek OCR, across 21 pipeline configurations, varying the conversion tool, cleaning transformations, splitting strategy, and metadata enrichment. Evaluation was performed using a 50-question benchmark over a corpus of 36 Portuguese administrative documents (1706 pages, ~492K words), with LLM-as-judge scoring over 50 independent runs per configuration. Statistical significance was assessed via Wilcoxon signed-rank tests with Cohen's d effect sizes. Two baselines bounded the results: naïve PDFLoader (86.2%) and manually curated Markdown (91.3%). Docling with hierarchical splitting and image descriptions achieved the highest automated accuracy (94.1 +/- 1.6%), surpassing even manual curation. A per-question-type analysis revealed that table-dependent questions drive the largest accuracy differences, with a 33-percentage-point gap between basic and hierarchical splitting. Metadata enrichment and hierarchy-aware chunking contributed more to accuracy than the conversion framework alone. An exploratory GraphRAG implementation underperformed basic RAG (82% vs. 94.1%). These findings demonstrate that data preparation quality is the dominant factor in RAG system performance.

papers.title: MolClaw: An Autonomous Agent with Hierarchical Skills for Drug Molecule Evaluation, Screening, and Optimization
papers.text:
title: MolClaw: An Autonomous Agent with Hierarchical Skills for Drug Molecule Evaluation, Screening, and Optimization
source: arXiv
topics: 
category: foundation_model
why: 这篇工作偏基础模型/Agent方向，可能影响病原检测任务的建模上限，值得关注其任务定义与评测设计。
abstract_zh: 计算药物研发，特别是复杂的药物分子筛选和优化流程，需要协调数十种专业工具。目前的 AI 智能体在处理此类高复杂度场景时表现不佳，难以维持鲁棒性能。本文提出 MolClaw，一个用于药物分子评估、筛选和优化的自主智能体。它通过三层分级技能架构（共 70 个技能）统一了 30 多个专业领域资源：工具级技能标准化原子操作；工作流级技能将其组合为带有质量检查和反思的验证流程；学科级技能则提供指导全场景规划与验证的科学原则。此外，研究者推出了 MolBench 基准测试，涵盖分子筛选、优化及端到端发现挑战，涉及 8 到 50 多个连续工具调用。MolClaw 在所有指标上均达到 SOTA 水平。消融实验证实，其优势集中在需要结构化工作流的任务中，而在简单脚本可解决的任务中优势不明显，证明了工作流编排能力是 AI 驱动药物研发的主要瓶颈。
abstract: Computational drug discovery, particularly the complex workflows of drug molecule screening and optimization, requires orchestrating dozens of specialized tools in multi-step workflows, yet current AI agents struggle to maintain robust performance and consistently underperform in these high-complexity scenarios. Here we present MolClaw, an autonomous agent that leads drug molecule evaluation, screening, and optimization. It unifies over 30 specialized domain resources through a three-tier hierarchical skill architecture (70 skills in total) that facilitates agent long-term interaction at runtime: tool-level skills standardize atomic operations, workflow-level skills compose them into validated pipelines with quality check and reflection, and a discipline-level skill supplies scientific principles governing planning and verification across all scenarios in the field. Additionally, we introduce MolBench, a benchmark comprising molecular screening, optimization, and end-to-end discovery challenges spanning 8 to 50+ sequential tool calls. MolClaw achieves state-of-the-art performance across all metrics, and ablation studies confirm that gains concentrate on tasks that demand structured workflows while vanishing on those solvable with ad hoc scripting, establishing workflow orchestration competence as the primary capability bottleneck for AI-driven drug discovery.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究开发了名为 **MolClaw** 的自主 AI 智能体，专门用于药物分子的评估、筛选与优化。其核心是通过一个包含 **70 个技能** 的三层分级架构，整合了 **30 多个专业领域工具**。研究同时发布了 **MolBench** 基准测试，用于评估智能体在处理长达 **8 至 50 步以上** 连续工具调用任务时的表现。

## 为什么相关
虽然该工作侧重于药物研发，但其提出的“多工具编排”和“分级技能架构”与病原生物信息学高度相关。在病原体鉴定、耐药性分析或多组学整合中，研究者同样面临需要调用比对、组装、注释等数十个异构工具的复杂流程。MolClaw 的架构为构建病原检测自动化流水线提供了直接的 Agent 建模参考。

## 新颖度判断
**新颖度高（6.0）**。不同于以往仅简单调用 API 的 Agent，MolClaw 引入了“学科级技能（discipline-level skill）”来提供科学原则指导，并设计了包含质量检查和反思的“工作流级技能”。其针对长程任务（50+ 步骤）的评测设计在当前生物医药 AI 领域具有领先性。

## 方法与证据
- **方法**：采用三层架构（工具级、工作流级、学科级）。工具级负责标准化原子操作，工作流级负责构建带反馈的 Pipeline，学科级负责高层规划。
- **证据**：在 MolBench 基准上取得 SOTA 性能。消融实验显示，MolClaw 的性能提升主要源于对“结构化工作流”的编排能力，而在可以通过简单脚本（ad hoc scripting）解决的简单任务中，其优势会消失。

## 应用价值
- **药物研发**：显著提升分子筛选和端到端发现的自动化程度。
- **生物信息学**：该 Agent 框架可迁移至病原基因组分析，实现从原始测序数据到临床报告生成的全流程自动化编排。

## 局限与风险
- **摘要未说明**：未提及该 Agent 在处理大规模并发任务时的计算资源消耗和推理延迟。
- **工具依赖性**：Agent 的表现受限于其整合的 30 多个底层工具的准确性，摘要未讨论如何处理底层工具输出错误导致的连锁反应。
- **泛化能力**：摘要未明确说明该 Agent 在未见过的全新实验协议下的适应能力。

papers.title: BridgeRAG: Training-Free Bridge-Conditioned Retrieval for Multi-Hop Question Answering
papers.text:
title: BridgeRAG: Training-Free Bridge-Conditioned Retrieval for Multi-Hop Question Answering
source: arXiv
topics: 
category: foundation_model
why: 这篇工作偏基础模型/Agent方向，可能影响病原检测任务的建模上限，值得关注其任务定义与评测设计。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: Multi-hop retrieval is not a single-step relevance problem: later-hop evidence should be ranked by its utility conditioned on retrieved bridge evidence, not by similarity to the original query alone. We present BridgeRAG, a training-free, graph-free retrieval method for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over multi-hop questions that operationalizes this view with a tripartite scorer s(q,b,c) over (question, bridge, candidate). BridgeRAG separates coverage from scoring: dual-entity ANN expansion broadens the second-hop candidate pool, while a bridge-conditioned LLM judge identifies the active reasoning chain among competing candidates without any offline graph or proposition index. Across four controlled experiments we show that this conditioning signal is (i) selective: +2.55pp on parallel-chain queries (p<0.001) vs. ~0 on single-chain subtypes; (ii) irreplaceable: substituting the retrieved passage with generated SVO query text reduces R@5 by 2.1pp, performing worse than even the lowest-SVO-similarity pool passage; (iii) predictable: cos(b,g2) correlates with per-query gain (Spearman rho=0.104, p<0.001); and (iv) mechanistically precise: bridge conditioning causes productive re-rankings (18.7% flip-win rate on parallel-chain vs. 0.6% on single-chain), not merely more churn. Combined with lightweight coverage expansion and percentile-rank score fusion, BridgeRAG achieves the best published training-free R@5 under matched benchmark evaluation on all three standard MHQA benchmarks without a graph database or any training: 0.8146 on MuSiQue (+3.1pp vs. PropRAG, +6.8pp vs. HippoRAG2), 0.9527 on 2WikiMultiHopQA (+1.2pp vs. PropRAG), and 0.9875 on HotpotQA (+1.35pp vs. PropRAG).

papers.title: PaperOrchestra: A Multi-Agent Framework for Automated AI Research Paper Writing
papers.text:
title: PaperOrchestra: A Multi-Agent Framework for Automated AI Research Paper Writing
source: arXiv
topics: 
category: foundation_model
why: 这篇工作偏基础模型/Agent方向，可能影响病原检测任务的建模上限，值得关注其任务定义与评测设计。
abstract_zh: 将非结构化的研究材料合成论文是 AI 驱动科学发现（AI4S）中一个重要但尚未得到充分探索的挑战。现有的自动写作系统通常与特定的实验流水线紧密耦合，且生成的文献综述质量较低。本文提出了 PaperOrchestra，这是一个用于自动编写 AI 研究论文的多智能体框架。该框架能够灵活地将不受限制的写作前材料转化为可直接提交的 LaTeX 手稿，涵盖了全面的文献综合以及自动生成的图表（如数据绘图和概念图）。为了评估其性能，研究者推出了 PaperWritingBench，这是首个通过对 200 篇顶级 AI 会议论文进行逆向工程提取原始材料而构建的标准基准测试，并配备了全套自动评估工具。在人类侧对侧评估中，PaperOrchestra 显著优于现有的自动化基准，在文献综述质量上取得了 50%-68% 的绝对胜率优势，在手稿整体质量上取得了 14%-38% 的优势。
abstract: Synthesizing unstructured research materials into manuscripts is an essential yet under-explored challenge in AI-driven scientific discovery. Existing autonomous writers are rigidly coupled to specific experimental pipelines, and produce superficial literature reviews. We introduce PaperOrchestra, a multi-agent framework for automated AI research paper writing. It flexibly transforms unconstrained pre-writing materials into submission-ready LaTeX manuscripts, including comprehensive literature synthesis and generated visuals, such as plots and conceptual diagrams. To evaluate performance, we present PaperWritingBench, the first standardized benchmark of reverse-engineered raw materials from 200 top-tier AI conference papers, alongside a comprehensive suite of automated evaluators. In side-by-side human evaluations, PaperOrchestra significantly outperforms autonomous baselines, achieving an absolute win rate margin of 50%-68% in literature review quality, and 14%-38% in overall manuscript quality.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究推出了名为 **PaperOrchestra** 的多智能体框架，旨在解决从非结构化实验材料到高质量 LaTeX 论文手稿的自动化转化问题。其核心功能包括文献综合、文本撰写以及视觉图表（Plots 和 Diagrams）的生成。同时，研究发布了包含 200 篇顶会论文数据的基准测试集 **PaperWritingBench**。

## 为什么相关
在病原生物学和临床微生物学领域，研究人员常面临海量测序数据、蛋白质组学图谱与零散临床记录的整合难题。PaperOrchestra 处理“非约束性预写作材料”的能力，可直接应用于病原体基因组分析报告或临床微生物发现的自动化撰写，提升从实验发现到成果发表的转化效率。这属于 AI Agent 赋能科研全流程的典型交叉应用。

## 新颖度判断
新颖度较高（6.0）。相比于以往硬编码在特定实验流程中的写作工具，PaperOrchestra 实现了写作逻辑与实验流程的解耦。其新颖性体现在：1. 多智能体协同处理复杂的 LaTeX 结构；2. 能够生成视觉图表而非仅限于文本；3. 建立了首个基于逆向工程真实顶会论文的基准测试 PaperWritingBench。

## 方法与证据
- **方法**：采用多智能体框架（Multi-agent framework），输入为非结构化材料，输出为 LaTeX 手稿。
- **数据规模**：基准测试 PaperWritingBench 包含 200 篇顶级 AI 会议论文的逆向工程数据。
- **实验证据**：通过人类侧对侧评估（Side-by-side human evaluations），PaperOrchestra 在文献综述质量上比基线模型高出 50%-68% 的胜率，整体质量高出 14%-38%。

## 应用价值
对于临床微生物学研究者，该工具可用于快速生成复杂多组学研究的初稿。它不仅能处理文字，还能生成“概念图和绘图”，这对于展示病原体进化树或蛋白质相互作用网络具有潜在价值。此外，其强大的文献综合能力有助于在快速更迭的病原学领域快速构建背景综述。

## 局限与风险
- **事实准确性**：摘要未说明该框架如何防止 AI 幻觉，特别是在处理严谨的临床数据和实验指标时，错误引用或数据误读可能导致严重的科研诚信问题。
- **领域适配性**：该模型主要在 AI 领域论文（PaperWritingBench）上训练和评估，对于生物医学、蛋白质组学等具有特定术语规范和图表格式要求的领域，其迁移能力摘要未予说明。
- **弱 AI 交叉**：目前该工作属于通用的科研辅助工具，并非专门针对生物医学建模，属于方法论层面的强相关，但领域知识深度可能不足。

papers.title: HyperMem: Hypergraph Memory for Long-Term Conversations
papers.text:
title: HyperMem: Hypergraph Memory for Long-Term Conversations
source: arXiv
topics: 
category: foundation_model
why: 这篇工作偏基础模型/Agent方向，可能影响病原检测任务的建模上限，值得关注其任务定义与评测设计。
abstract_zh: 长期记忆对于对话智能体在长对话中保持连贯性、追踪持续任务和提供个性化交互至关重要。然而，现有的检索增强生成（RAG）和基于图的存储方法主要依赖成对关系，难以捕捉多个元素之间的联合依赖等高阶关联，导致检索内容碎片化。为此，我们提出了 HyperMem，一种基于超图的分层存储架构，利用超边显式建模此类关联。HyperMem 将存储结构化为主题（topics）、情节（episodes）和事实（facts）三个层面，并通过超边将相关情节及其事实分组，将分散内容统一为连贯单元。基于此结构，我们设计了混合词法-语义索引和由粗到精的检索策略，支持对高阶关联的准确高效检索。在 LoCoMo 基准测试上的实验表明，HyperMem 实现了 92.73% 的 LLM-as-a-judge 准确率，达到了当前先进水平（SOTA），证明了其在长程对话处理中的有效性。
abstract: Long-term memory is essential for conversational agents to maintain coherence, track persistent tasks, and provide personalized interactions across extended dialogues. However, existing approaches as Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and graph-based memory mostly rely on pairwise relations, which can hardly capture high-order associations, i.e., joint dependencies among multiple elements, causing fragmented retrieval. To this end, we propose HyperMem, a hypergraph-based hierarchical memory architecture that explicitly models such associations using hyperedges. Particularly, HyperMem structures memory into three levels: topics, episodes, and facts, and groups related episodes and their facts via hyperedges, unifying scattered content into coherent units. Leveraging this structure, we design a hybrid lexical-semantic index and a coarse-to-fine retrieval strategy, supporting accurate and efficient retrieval of high-order associations. Experiments on the LoCoMo benchmark show that HyperMem achieves state-of-the-art performance with 92.73% LLM-as-a-judge accuracy, demonstrating the effectiveness of HyperMem for long-term conversations.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究针对长程对话中信息检索碎片化的问题，提出了名为 HyperMem 的超图分层存储架构。其核心是通过“超边（hyperedges）”显式建模多个元素之间的高阶关联，而非传统的简单成对关系。系统将记忆划分为主题、情节、事实三个层级，并结合混合词法-语义索引与由粗到精的检索策略，提升了长对话背景下的信息召回准确性。

## 为什么相关
本研究属于 AI/LLM/Agent 交叉领域的基础架构创新。在临床微生物学或病原基因组学研究中，科研 Agent 需要处理跨越数周甚至数月的实验记录、多批次的测序分析报告以及复杂的临床病例演变。HyperMem 提供的高阶关联建模能力，可能用于整合“病原体-宿主-环境-药物”之间复杂的多维关系，避免传统 RAG 在处理此类长程、多因素关联任务时的信息丢失。

## 新颖度判断
新颖度较高（6.0）。相比于目前主流的基于向量数据库的 RAG 或基于普通知识图谱（GraphRAG）的存储方案，HyperMem 引入了超图（Hypergraph）理论。其创新点在于利用超边将“情节”与“事实”进行非线性的高阶聚合，解决了传统图结构在表达多对多复杂依赖关系时的局限性。

## 方法与证据
- **架构设计**：构建了包含主题（topics）、情节（episodes）和事实（facts）的三层分层结构。
- **技术手段**：采用超边（hyperedges）进行关联建模，并开发了混合词法-语义索引（hybrid lexical-semantic index）以及由粗到精（coarse-to-fine）的检索策略。
- **实验数据**：在 LoCoMo 基准测试集上进行了验证。
- **性能指标**：实验结果显示，HyperMem 在 LLM-as-a-judge 评估中达到了 92.73% 的准确率，优于现有的基准模型。

## 应用价值
在生物信息学 Agent 开发中，该技术可用于构建“科研助理级”长效记忆系统。例如，在追踪某种耐药菌株的演化轨迹时，Agent 可以利用超图结构将不同时间点的测序结果（事实）、实验操作步骤（情节）与爆发流行趋势（主题）进行高阶关联，实现比传统检索更具逻辑连贯性的深度推断。

## 局限与风险
摘要未说明超图构建过程中的计算开销（如超边的动态生成算法复杂度）。此外，在处理高度专业化的临床微生物术语时，其“混合词法-语义索引”的泛化能力是否优于针对生物医学微调的模型尚不明确。对于病原检测等高可靠性任务，92.73% 的准确率虽为 SOTA，但在临床决策支持中仍需关注剩余 7% 错误可能带来的误导风险。

papers.title: Memory as Metabolism: A Design for Companion Knowledge Systems
papers.text:
title: Memory as Metabolism: A Design for Companion Knowledge Systems
source: arXiv
topics: 
category: foundation_model
why: 这篇工作偏基础模型/Agent方向，可能影响病原检测任务的建模上限，值得关注其任务定义与评测设计。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation remains the dominant pattern for giving LLMs persistent memory, but a visible cluster of personal wiki-style memory architectures emerged in April 2026 -- design proposals from Karpathy, MemPalace, and LLM Wiki v2 that compile knowledge into an interlinked artifact for long-term use by a single user. They sit alongside production memory systems that the major labs have shipped for over a year, and an active academic lineage including MemGPT, Generative Agents, Mem0, Zep, A-Mem, MemMachine, SleepGate, and Second Me. Within a 2026 landscape of emerging governance frameworks for agent context and memory -- including Context Cartography and MemOS -- this paper proposes a companion-specific governance profile: a set of normative obligations, a time-structured procedural rule, and testable conformance invariants for the specific failure mode of entrenchment under user-coupled drift in single-user knowledge wikis built on the LLM wiki pattern. The design principle is that personal LLM memory is a companion system: its job is to mirror the user on operational dimensions (working vocabulary, load-bearing structure, continuity of context) and compensate on epistemic failure modes (entrenchment, suppression of contradicting evidence, Kuhnian ossification). Five operations implement this split -- TRIAGE, DECAY, CONTEXTUALIZE, CONSOLIDATE, AUDIT -- supported by memory gravity and minority-hypothesis retention. The sharpest prediction: accumulated contradictory evidence should have a structural path to updating a centrality-protected dominant interpretation through multi-cycle buffer pressure accumulation, a failure mode no existing benchmark captures. The safety story at the single-agent level is partial, and the paper is explicit about what it does and does not solve.
