papers.title: Query-Adaptive Semantic Chunking for Retrieval-Augmented Generation: A Dynamic Strategy with Contextual Window Expansion
papers.text:
title: Query-Adaptive Semantic Chunking for Retrieval-Augmented Generation: A Dynamic Strategy with Contextual Window Expansion
source: arXiv
topics: 
category: general
why: Query-Adaptive Semantic Chunking for Ret 与你的主题有弱匹配，暂时保留作低优先级跟踪。
abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）系统的性能高度依赖于文档分块质量。传统的固定分块方法忽略了语义逻辑和用户意图，导致精确率与召回率之间存在难以通过调整块大小来解决的权衡问题。虽然语义分块和代理分块方法部分缓解了这些限制，但未能将用户查询整合到分块阶段。本文提出查询自适应语义分块（QASC）方法，通过三种机制动态构建分块：利用句子与查询嵌入之间的余弦相似度识别种子句、围绕种子句进行上下文窗口扩展以保持连贯性、以及块级评分聚合以确保整体相关性。在包含 100 份技术文档和 200 个查询（涵盖四种类型）的评估中，QASC 实现了 0.85 的 F1 分数，比固定分块提升了 18-27%，比语义和代理分块提升了 8-12%。消融实验证实了各组件的贡献，三名标注者的人工评估（Cohen kappa = 0.82）进一步证实了 QASC 生成的分块比现有方法更具相关性和连贯性。
abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems depend critically on document chunking quality for retrieving relevant context. Fixed chunking segments documents into uniform units irrespective of semantics or user intent, producing a precision-recall trade-off unresolvable by tuning chunk size alone. Semantic and agentic methods partially address these limitations but do not integrate user queries at the chunking stage. We present Query-Adaptive Semantic Chunking (QASC), which dynamically constructs chunks by integrating queries into segmentation through three mechanisms: cosine similarity scoring between sentence and query embeddings to identify seed sentences, contextual window expansion around seeds to preserve coherence, and chunk-level score aggregation to ensure holistic relevance. We evaluate QASC on 100 technical documents across 200 queries spanning four types, comparing against fixed chunking at five granularities, recursive splitting, semantic chunking, and agentic chunking. QASC achieves an F1-score of 0.85, a relative improvement of 18-27% over fixed chunking and 8-12% over semantic and agentic alternatives. Ablation studies confirm each component contributes meaningfully. Human evaluation by three annotators (Cohen kappa = 0.82) corroborates that QASC produces more relevant and coherent chunks than existing methods.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究提出了一种名为 QASC（Query-Adaptive Semantic Chunking）的动态文档分块策略，旨在优化 RAG 系统的检索质量。其核心逻辑是将用户查询（Query）直接引入分块过程，通过计算句子与查询的余弦相似度来确定核心语义种子，并结合上下文窗口扩展技术，动态生成与查询高度相关的非固定长度分块。

## 为什么相关
本研究与病原生信、临床微生物学等领域属于**弱 AI 交叉**。在处理复杂的临床指南、病原体基因组研究报告或耐药性分析文档时，传统的固定长度分块往往会切断关键的生物学上下文（如基因序列描述或临床诊断标准）。QASC 提供的查询自适应能力，可以帮助研究人员在针对特定病原体或基因突变进行提问时，更精准地从海量技术文献中提取完整的语义片段。

## 新颖度判断
**中等偏高（5.25）**。其新颖性在于打破了“先分块、后检索”的传统 RAG 范式，将检索意图（Query）提前到了分块阶段。相比于现有的语义分块（Semantic Chunking）和代理分块（Agentic Chunking），QASC 引入了“种子句识别”与“动态窗口扩展”的组合机制，解决了分块阶段对用户意图感知不足的问题。

## 方法与证据
- **实验对象与规模**：使用了 100 份技术文档，针对 4 种类型的 200 个查询进行了测试。
- **技术机制**：包含三个关键步骤：1. 句子与查询嵌入的余弦相似度评分；2. 围绕种子句的上下文窗口扩展；3. 块级评分聚合。
- **性能指标**：QASC 达到了 **0.85 的 F1 分数**。对比实验显示，其表现优于固定分块（提升 18-27%）、递归切分、语义分块及代理分块（提升 8-12%）。
- **人工验证**：通过三名标注者进行评估，Cohen kappa 系数为 0.82，显示出极高的一致性和分块连贯性。

## 应用价值
在临床微生物学和基因组学知识库构建中，该方法可显著提升专业问答系统的准确性。例如，在检索特定耐药基因的调控机制时，QASC 能够根据查询动态调整分块边界，确保返回的上下文包含完整的实验条件和结论，而非断章取义的文本片段。

## 局限与风险
- **计算开销**：摘要未详细说明在推理阶段进行动态分块的计算延迟。由于分块依赖于实时查询，可能比预先计算好的静态分块索引更耗费计算资源。
- **冷启动问题**：对于极短或语义模糊的查询，种子句的识别准确率可能会下降。
- **领域适配性**：实验仅在 100 份“技术文档”上进行，尚未在包含大量专业术语（如拉丁学名、基因编号）的生物医学专用语料库上验证其嵌入模型的泛化能力。

papers.title: Intern-Atlas: A Methodological Evolution Graph as Research Infrastructure for AI Scientists
papers.text:
title: Intern-Atlas: A Methodological Evolution Graph as Research Infrastructure for AI Scientists
source: arXiv
topics: 
category: methods
why: 这篇工作更像方法创新，可能直接关联 metagenomics、long-read 或 pathogen identification 流程优化。
abstract_zh: 现有的科研基础设施主要以文献为中心，仅提供论文间的引用链接，缺乏对方法论演进的显式表达，难以揭示研究方法产生、适配及迭代的结构化逻辑。随着 AI 科研智能体（AI Agents）成为科学知识的新型消费者，这种局限性愈发显著，因为智能体难以从非结构化文本中可靠地重构方法演进拓扑。本文推出 Intern-Atlas，这是一个方法论演进图谱，旨在自动识别方法级实体、推断方法间的谱系关系，并捕捉驱动技术创新的瓶颈。该图谱基于 1,030,314 篇 AI 领域的会议、期刊及 arXiv 预印本论文构建，包含 9,410,201 条具有语义类型的边，每条边均由原始证据支撑，形成了可查询的方法论发展因果网络。此外，我们提出了一种自引导时间树搜索算法，用于构建追踪方法随时间演进的链条。经专家评估，该图谱与真实演进链高度一致。Intern-Atlas 可支持想法评估和自动想法生成，是自动化科学发现的基础数据层。
abstract: Existing research infrastructure is fundamentally document-centric, providing citation links between papers but lacking explicit representations of methodological evolution. In particular, it does not capture the structured relationships that explain how and why research methods emerge, adapt, and build upon one another. With the rise of AI-driven research agents as a new class of consumers of scientific knowledge, this limitation becomes increasingly consequential, as such agents cannot reliably reconstruct method evolution topologies from unstructured text. We introduce Intern-Atlas, a methodological evolution graph that automatically identifies method-level entities, infers lineage relationships among methodologies, and captures the bottlenecks that drive transitions between successive innovations. Built from 1,030,314 papers spanning AI conferences, journals, and arXiv preprints, the resulting graph comprises 9,410,201 semantically typed edges, each grounded in verbatim source evidence, forming a queryable causal network of methodological development. To operationalize this structure, we further propose a self-guided temporal tree search algorithm for constructing evolution chains that trace the progression of methods over time. We evaluate the quality of the resulting graph against expert-curated ground-truth evolution chains and observe strong alignment. In addition, we demonstrate that Intern-Atlas enables downstream applications in idea evaluation and automated idea generation. We position methodological evolution graphs as a foundational data layer for the emerging automated scientific discovery.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究开发了名为 **Intern-Atlas** 的方法论演进图谱，旨在解决现有科研文献体系中“方法演进逻辑缺失”的问题。它通过从超过 103 万篇 AI 论文中提取 941 万条语义边，构建了一个结构化的因果网络，能够显式表达研究方法如何通过解决特定“瓶颈”而实现迭代。

## 为什么相关
在病原生物学、基因组学等领域，生物信息学工具（如组装算法、变异检测流程）的更迭极快。Intern-Atlas 提出的这种从“文献引用”转向“方法逻辑演进”的思路，对于构建能理解复杂生物信息学流程演变的 **AI Scientist** 至关重要。它能帮助研究者或智能体快速理解为何某个新算法（如针对 Long-read 的新组装器）优于旧算法，并识别当前技术路径的瓶颈。

## 新颖度判断
**新颖度高（5.25）**。不同于传统的引文网络（Citation Graph），Intern-Atlas 引入了“语义类型边”和“瓶颈捕捉”机制。它不仅记录 A 引用了 B，还解释了 A 是如何改进 B 的。其提出的“自引导时间树搜索算法”为自动化追踪技术谱系提供了新的技术路径。

## 方法与证据
- **数据规模**：使用了 1,030,314 篇 AI 相关论文，涵盖会议、期刊和 arXiv。
- **图谱规模**：生成了 9,410,201 条语义类型边，且每条边都关联了原文证据（verbatim source evidence）。
- **核心算法**：提出了 **Self-guided temporal tree search**（自引导时间树搜索），用于生成演进链。
- **验证方式**：通过与专家人工标注的“真实演进链”（expert-curated ground-truth）进行对比，验证了图谱的准确性。

## 应用价值
- **科研决策**：支持“想法评估”，帮助研究者判断某个新思路在方法论演进链中的位置。
- **自动化发现**：支持“自动想法生成”，AI 智能体可以基于图谱中的瓶颈信息，针对性地提出改进方案。
- **基础设施**：为病原分析、蛋白质组学等高度依赖算法迭代的领域提供了构建“领域知识图谱”的范式。

## 局限与风险
- **领域局限**：摘要明确指出该图谱目前是基于 **AI 领域** 的论文构建的，其在生物医学、临床微生物学等跨学科术语更复杂的领域，实体识别和关系推断的准确性尚未验证。
- **证据依赖**：图谱依赖于论文中的“原文证据”，如果论文本身对方法改进的描述模糊，图谱可能无法准确捕捉演进逻辑。
- **动态更新**：摘要未说明该图谱如何实时处理每日新增的大量预印本数据。

papers.title: Experiment-as-Code Labs: A Declarative Stack for AI-Driven Scientific Discovery
papers.text:
title: Experiment-as-Code Labs: A Declarative Stack for AI-Driven Scientific Discovery
source: arXiv
topics: 
category: foundation_model
why: 这篇工作偏基础模型/Agent方向，可能影响病原检测任务的建模上限，值得关注其任务定义与评测设计。
abstract_zh: 为了释放 AI for Science 的全部潜力，必须将智能体从纯数字环境扩展到物理实验室。智能体在现实实验室中的控制与探索能力至关重要，因为物理实验仍是科学发现的基石。尽管自动化实验室正通过可编程 API 实现软件控制，但在强大的 AI 智能体与自动化设备之间仍存在鸿沟。本文提出“实验即代码（EaC）实验室”范式，其核心是将实验编码为声明式配置，并可编译为设备级 API。在该架构中，AI 智能体负责提出假设并编写声明式实验配置；系统层执行程序分析、安全检查、资源分配和作业编排；最后通过驱动设备 API 完成程序化实验。该技术栈具有科学领域、实验室及仪器无关性，通过物理层、系统层与智能层的综合集成，旨在为 AI 驱动的科学发现提供通用基础设施。
abstract: To unleash the full potential of AI for Science, we must untether the agents from a purely digital environment. The agent's ability to control and explore in real-world labs is essential because the physical lab remains foundational to scientific discovery. While some tasks can be performed on a computer (e.g., data analysis, running simulated experiments), Eureka moments could occur at any time while operating lab instruments (e.g., when a scientist notices unexpected clues, intuition may prompt a real-time course change). Although autonomous labs are on the rise, which expose programmable APIs to control scientific instruments via software, bridging the gap between increasingly powerful AI agents and automated lab equipment requires innovation that draws insights from computer systems. We propose a new paradigm called ``Experiment-as-Code (EaC) Labs,'' where a core concept is to encode experiments as declarative configurations that can be compiled down to device-level APIs. AI agents come up with hypotheses and experiments, written as an ensemble of declarative configurations. The systems layer performs program analysis, safety checks, resource assignment, and job orchestration. Finally, programmatic experimentation occurs via actuating the device APIs. This is a general stack that is science-, lab-, and instrument-independent, representing a novel synthesis across the physical, systems, and intelligence layers to unleash the next breakthrough in AI for Science.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究提出了名为“Experiment-as-Code (EaC) Labs”的新范式，旨在构建一个连接 AI 智能体与物理实验室仪器的通用技术栈。其核心逻辑是将复杂的科学实验抽象为“声明式配置（declarative configurations）”，通过系统层的编译与编排，实现 AI 对物理实验设备的自动化控制。

## 为什么相关
在病原微生物学、蛋白质组学及基因组学领域，湿实验验证（如菌株培养、测序文库构建、蛋白质纯化）是核心环节。该工作定义的“实验即代码”模式，可能改变临床微生物自动化实验室的运行方式，使 AI Agent 能够直接介入病原检测的物理操作流程，提升实验的通量与响应速度。

## 新颖度判断
新颖度较高（5.25）。该工作借鉴了信息技术中的“基础设施即代码（IaC）”理念，将其引入科学实验领域。相比于传统的硬编码自动化脚本，其提出的“声明式配置”允许 AI 在更高层级定义实验目标，而无需关心底层硬件的具体 API 实现，实现了智能层与物理层的解耦。

## 方法与证据
方法上，该框架分为三个层次：1. **智能层**：AI 智能体生成假设并输出声明式配置；2. **系统层**：负责程序分析、安全性检查（Safety checks）、资源分配和作业编排；3. **物理层**：通过设备 API 执行具体动作。摘要中未提供具体的实验数据、对比指标或具体的应用案例（如具体的病原检测实验），主要侧重于架构设计与范式定义。

## 应用价值
该架构具有“仪器无关性”，意味着它可以推广至各种临床微生物实验室。其应用价值在于：1. **安全性**：通过系统层的安全检查防止 AI 产生危险操作；2. **可扩展性**：支持跨实验室的实验迁移；3. **自动化上限**：使 AI 能够根据实时观测（如实验中的意外线索）动态调整实验路径，而不仅仅是执行预设脚本。

## 局限与风险
摘要未说明该系统在处理生物样本复杂性（如样本降解、污染）时的容错机制。此外，从“声明式配置”到复杂生物实验步骤（如微量移液的物理精度控制）的编译过程可能存在语义丢失。目前缺乏在真实病原检测或基因组学任务中的性能基准测试，其实际落地效果尚待验证。

title: Experiment-as-Code Labs: A Declarative Stack for AI-Driven Scientific Discovery
source: arXiv
topics: 
category: foundation_model
why: 这篇工作偏基础模型/Agent方向，可能影响病原检测任务的建模上限，值得关注其任务定义与评测设计。
abstract_zh: 为了充分释放 AI for Science 的潜力，必须将智能体从纯数字环境扩展到物理实验室。智能体在真实实验室中的控制与探索能力至关重要，因为物理实验仍是科学发现的基石。虽然数据分析和模拟实验可在计算机上完成，但科学突破往往源于操作仪器时的实时洞察与调整。尽管自动化实验室正通过可编程 API 实现设备控制，但在强大 AI 智能体与自动化设备之间仍存在鸿沟。我们提出“实验即代码（EaC）实验室”范式，核心是将实验编码为声明式配置，并可编译为设备级 API。在此架构下，AI 智能体提出假设并编写声明式实验配置，系统层负责程序分析、安全性检查、资源分配和任务编排，最终通过驱动设备 API 执行实验。这是一个独立于学科、实验室和仪器的通用技术栈，通过物理、系统与智能层的融合，旨在推动 AI 驱动科学发现的下一次突破。

The agent's ability to control and explore in real-world labs is essential because the physical lab remains foundational to scientific discovery. While some tasks can be performed on a computer (e.g., data analysis, running simulated experiments), Eureka moments could occur at any time while operating lab instruments (e.g., when a scientist notices unexpected clues, intuition may prompt a real-time course change). Although autonomous labs are on the rise, which expose programmable APIs to control scientific instruments via software, bridging the gap between increasingly powerful AI agents and automated lab equipment requires innovation that draws insights from computer systems. analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究提出了一种名为“实验即代码（Experiment-as-Code, EaC）实验室”的新范式。其核心逻辑是将复杂的科学实验抽象为“声明式配置（declarative configurations）”。AI 智能体负责生成这些配置（包含假设和实验设计），而底层的系统架构负责将这些高层指令编译、校验并下发至具体的实验室设备 API 执行，从而实现 AI 对物理实验过程的闭环控制。

## 为什么相关
在病原基因组学与蛋白质组学领域，湿实验（如核酸提取、文库构建、质谱分析）的标准化和自动化一直是瓶颈。EaC 提出的“独立于学科和仪器（science-, lab-, and instrument-independent）”的通用架构，为临床微生物实验室实现从“样本进”到“报告出”的全流程 AI 自动化提供了系统级框架，特别是其处理“实时调整（real-time course change）”的能力，对处理复杂生物样本具有参考价值。

## 新颖度判断
新颖度较高（5.25）。该工作并非简单的实验室自动化升级，而是借鉴了软件工程中“基础设施即代码（IaC）”的思想，引入了“系统层（systems layer）”进行程序分析和安全检查。这种将实验逻辑与硬件执行解耦的声明式堆栈，在 AI 驱动的科学发现领域具有前瞻性。

## 方法与证据
摘要描述了一个三层架构：
1. **智能层**：AI 智能体生成基于声明式配置的实验方案。
2. **系统层**：执行程序分析（program analysis）、安全性检查（safety checks）、资源分配（resource assignment）和作业编排（job orchestration）。
3. **物理层**：通过驱动设备 API 进行程序化实验。 
摘要未说明具体的模型名称、实验对象（如具体的化学或生物实验）以及量化的性能指标。

## 应用价值
该架构的价值在于其通用性。在临床微生物学中，它可以用于构建自动化的病原筛查流水线，允许 AI 根据初步实验结果（如摘要提到的“意外线索”）自动修正后续实验方案。同时，系统层的“安全检查”功能对于处理高致病性微生物的自动化实验室至关重要，可防止 AI 误操作导致的生物安全风险。

## 局限与风险
摘要未说明该系统在处理高度非标准化的生物实验（如复杂的细胞培养或组织处理）时的鲁棒性。此外，将“声明式配置”准确编译为物理动作的精度要求极高，摘要未提供具体的编译成功率或实验重复性数据。对于临床应用而言，系统层如何满足医疗器械级别的合规性要求也是潜在挑战。

papers.title: CuSearch: Curriculum Rollout Sampling via Search Depth for Agentic RAG
papers.text:
title: CuSearch: Curriculum Rollout Sampling via Search Depth for Agentic RAG
source: arXiv
topics: 
category: dataset
why: 这篇工作偏数据集或基准构建，适合判断是否能作为病原组学训练或评测资源。
abstract_zh: 强化学习与可验证奖励（RLVR）已成为从仅有结果监督中训练代理检索增强生成（RAG）系统的有效范式。然而，现有方法通常对采样轨迹进行均匀优化，忽略了不同轨迹在搜索深度上的差异。深层搜索轨迹包含更多检索决策点，能为检索子策略提供更密集的直接监督。随着训练进行，批次内的深度分布会向高值偏移，而均匀采样无法捕捉这一动态变化。为此，本文提出 CuSearch 框架，其核心是搜索深度贪婪分配（SDGA）算子，旨在将固定的更新预算重新分配给深层搜索轨迹。SDGA-Auto 自动针对当前批次中最深的轨迹，形成隐式课程学习；SDGA-Phase 则在深层轨迹充足时显式推进课程阈值。在不同模型和检索框架下的实验表明，CuSearch 显著提升了性能，在 ZeroSearch 任务上比标准 GRPO 算法提高了 11.8 个精确匹配（Exact-Match）点。研究证明，轨迹搜索深度是 RLVR 训练中检索监督密度的可靠且无需标注的代理指标。
abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has emerged as a promising paradigm for training agentic retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems from outcome-only supervision. Most existing methods optimize policies from uniformly sampled rollouts, implicitly treating all trajectories as equally informative. However, trajectories differ substantially in search depth and are therefore not equally informative: deeper-search trajectories contain more retrieval decision points and provide denser direct supervision for the retrieval sub-policy. Moreover, this heterogeneity grows over training as the within-batch depth distribution shifts toward higher values, yet uniform rollout sampling remains blind to this shift. To address this, we propose CuSearch, a curriculum rollout sampling framework built on Search-Depth Greedy Allocation (SDGA), a batch-level operator that reallocates a fixed update budget toward deeper-search trajectories. SDGA-Auto always targets the deepest available trajectories in the current batch, yielding an implicit training-aligned curriculum as the depth distribution shifts upward. SDGA-Phase explicitly advances the curriculum threshold as deeper trajectories become sufficiently abundant. Experiments across model types and retrieval frameworks show that CuSearch consistently improves performance, achieving up to 11.8 exact-match points over standard GRPO on ZeroSearch. These results establish per-trajectory search depth as a reliable, annotation-free proxy for retrieval supervision density in RLVR-based agentic RAG training.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究针对代理检索增强生成（Agentic RAG）系统的训练效率问题，提出了名为 CuSearch 的课程学习框架。其核心逻辑是利用“搜索深度”作为监督密度的代理指标，通过搜索深度贪婪分配（SDGA）算子，将训练资源集中在包含更多检索决策点的深层轨迹上，从而优化检索子策略的性能。

## 为什么相关
本研究属于 AI/LLM/Agent 交叉领域的技术优化。在病原组学或临床微生物学中，研究人员常需面对复杂的检索任务（如跨基因组数据库、临床指南和耐药性报告的多步查询）。Agentic RAG 是解决此类复杂生物信息检索的关键工具。CuSearch 提供的训练方法能提升 Agent 在处理需要多步搜索（深层轨迹）的生物医学问答时的准确性。但需注意，该论文属于通用 AI 算法研究，与病原学领域的交叉属于“弱 AI 交叉”，主要作为底层工具链的优化参考。

## 新颖度判断
新颖度较高（5.25）。该工作首次指出在 RLVR 训练中，均匀采样轨迹会导致监督信号的浪费，并创新性地提出将“搜索深度”这一无需人工标注的指标作为课程学习的依据，打破了传统 RL 训练中对所有采样结果一视同仁的局限。

## 方法与证据
- **方法**：提出了 CuSearch 框架，包含两种 SDGA 策略：SDGA-Auto（动态针对批次内最深轨迹）和 SDGA-Phase（基于深层轨迹丰度显式推进阈值）。
- **实验对象**：多种模型类型和检索框架。
- **数据与指标**：在 ZeroSearch 基准测试中进行评估，主要指标为精确匹配（Exact-Match, EM）。
- **结论**：CuSearch 在 ZeroSearch 上比标准 GRPO 算法提升了 11.8 个 EM 点，证明了深层轨迹在提升检索子策略方面的核心作用。

## 应用价值
对于构建临床微生物学决策支持系统的开发者而言，CuSearch 提供了一种更高效的 Agent 训练方案。在处理如“根据特定基因突变检索多种病原体的耐药机制”等复杂任务时，该框架能帮助模型更好地学习如何进行多轮、深度的数据库检索，提高最终诊断或分析建议的可靠性。

## 局限与风险
- **奖励依赖**：摘要提到该方法基于“可验证奖励（Verifiable Rewards）”，这意味着在缺乏明确对错判定标准（如某些前沿病原学推断）的领域，该方法可能难以应用。
- **计算预算**：虽然 SDGA 重新分配了预算，但深层轨迹本身的采样和计算开销通常高于浅层轨迹，摘要未详细说明整体计算成本的增幅。
- **领域泛化**：在 ZeroSearch 上的成功是否能直接转化为生物医学专业领域的性能提升，仍需在特定病原组学数据集上验证。

papers.title: AOP-Wiki EMOD 3.0: Data Model Expansions and Content Evaluation Framework for Using Agentic AI to Improve Integration between AOPs and New Approach Methodologies (NAMs)
papers.text:
title: AOP-Wiki EMOD 3.0: Data Model Expansions and Content Evaluation Framework for Using Agentic AI to Improve Integration between AOPs and New Approach Methodologies (NAMs)
source: arXiv
topics: 
category: methods
why: 这篇工作更像方法创新，可能直接关联 metagenomics、long-read 或 pathogen identification 流程优化。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: Adverse Outcome Pathways (AOP) are logic models that causally link biological mechanisms that can be measured in a lab to adverse outcomes, relevant to chemical regulatory endpoints. AOPs contextualize new approach methodologies (NAMs), in vitro and in silico methods used as alternatives to animal testing and the sequential events in an AOP serve as multi-scale models spanning biological scales. The AOP-Wiki serves as the global repository for AOPs. While the AOP-Wiki has played a central role in AOP expansion over the past decade, constraints within the current data model and application infrastructure limit the AOP-Wiki from supporting continued AOP growth and evolution. Yet, the transformative power of agentic AI has re-invigorated AOP-Wiki data modernization efforts at a time when core AOP principles can be harnessed to inform use of AI for aggregating and structuring AOP-relevant information. Seizing upon this momentum, we present AOP-Wiki EMOD 3.0, the third in a series of evidence model prototypes, which concretely demonstrates data model expansions and our vision for how the AOP-Wiki might be transformed to better serve regulatory science and emergent use of AOPs in biomedical and One Health contexts. We aim to lay a foundation to support computationally-generated AOPs and quantitative AOPs (qAOPs) by focussing on solutions for AOP-Wiki internal quality improvement, evidence structuring to enhance AOP FAIRness and AI-readiness, and improved integration between the AOP framework and NAMs to better serve next generation risk assessment.

papers.title: Claim-Selective Certification for High-Risk Medical Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.text:
title: Claim-Selective Certification for High-Risk Medical Retrieval-Augmented Generation
source: arXiv
topics: 
category: general
why: Claim-Selective Certification for High-R 与你的主题有弱匹配，暂时保留作低优先级跟踪。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: Medical RAG systems in high-risk QA settings are often evaluated through a single answer-or-abstain decision, but mixed evidence may support one claim, require conditions for another, and contradict a third. We study claim-selective certification: each response is decomposed into verifiable claims, scored against retrieved evidence, and mapped by an intent-aware selector to {full, partial, conflict, abstain}. On the primary weak-label certificate protocol, whose real-source-only dev/test rows cover the naturally occurring non-abstain actions, the full system records UCCR=0.0000, PAU=1.0000, PAU Precision=0.9901, and action accuracy=0.9204 on dev (n=314), and UCCR=0.0000, PAU=0.9967, PAU Precision=0.9739, and action accuracy=0.8997 on test (n=319). UCCR measures unsupported-claim risk within the certificate definition, and a source-missing counterfactual slice evaluates abstain under empty evidence. Shortcut controls quantify the action-label prior explained by source and intent metadata, while source/evidence-novel slices characterize transfer boundaries. The resulting interface separates action-label prediction from evidence-linked claim selection under mixed evidence.

papers.title: Credit-assigned Policy Gradient for Early Stage Retrieval in Two-stage Ranking
papers.text:
title: Credit-assigned Policy Gradient for Early Stage Retrieval in Two-stage Ranking
source: arXiv
topics: 
category: general
why: Credit-assigned Policy Gradient for Earl 与你的主题有弱匹配，暂时保留作低优先级跟踪。
abstract_zh: 大规模搜索、推荐及检索增强生成（RAG）系统通常采用两阶段架构：初级排序器（ESR）生成候选集，随后由高级排序器（LSR）进行重排。虽然强化学习（RL）在训练 LSR 方面应用广泛，但 ESR 的端到端训练仍具挑战。特别是传统的“原生”策略梯度（V-PG）在处理大规模候选集时，由于梯度传播至候选集的联合概率，忽略了单个项目对奖励的具体贡献，导致方差爆炸，难以扩展。为解决此问题，本文提出一种新型的“信用分配”策略梯度（CA-PG）。该方法通过对包含目标项目的所有候选集进行边缘化处理，计算目标项目被选中的概率梯度。理论分析表明，CA-PG 在保持学习正确项目排序能力的同时，显著降低了 V-PG 的方差。在合成数据和真实世界数据上的实验证明，CA-PG 提升了基于 Plackett-Luce 模型的 ESR 的收敛速度和训练稳定性，尤其在大规模候选集场景下表现优异。
abstract: Large-scale search, recommendation, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems typically employ a two-stage architecture: an early-stage ranker (ESR) generates a candidate set, which is subsequently re-ranked by a late-stage ranker (LSR). While there are many reinforcement learning (RL) methods for training the LSR, end-to-end training of the ESR has proven challenging. In particular, naive application of "vanilla" policy gradient (V-PG) is not scalable for candidate-set sizes relevant for practical use due to exploding variance. This issue arises because V-PG propagates the gradient to the joint probability of the candidate sets, ignoring the contribution of each specific item in the candidate set to the reward. To mitigate this issue, we propose a novel "credit-assigned" policy gradient (CA-PG), which computes gradients with respect to the probability that the target item is chosen in any candidate set, i.e. marginalizing over all candidate sets that contain it. Our theoretical analysis reveals that CA-PG significantly reduces the variance of V-PG by marginalizing over the specific composition of the candidate set, while preserving the ability to learn the correct ranking of items under a reasonably aligned LSR policy. Experiments on both synthetic and real-world data demonstrate that CA-PG improves the convergence speed and training stability for ESRs utilizing the canonical Plackett-Luce model, especially when the candidate-set size is large.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究针对两阶段排名系统（如 RAG 或大规模搜索）中的初级检索器（ESR）训练难题，提出了一种名为 CA-PG（Credit-assigned Policy Gradient）的新型强化学习算法。其核心是解决原生策略梯度在处理大规模候选集时因方差过大而无法收敛的问题，通过将奖励信用分配到单个项目而非整个候选集，实现了 ESR 的高效端到端训练。

## 为什么相关
**弱相关。** 本文属于信息检索（IR）与强化学习的通用算法研究。其与病原生信或临床微生物学的关联在于：在构建大规模病原体基因组数据库检索系统或临床决策支持的 RAG 系统时，如何从海量序列/文献中精准、快速地召回候选子集是关键技术瓶颈。CA-PG 提供了一种优化此类检索系统第一阶段性能的数学框架。

## 新颖度判断
**5.25（中等偏上）。** 创新点在于打破了传统 V-PG 将候选集视为整体的思路，引入了边缘化（Marginalizing）技术来处理 Plackett-Luce 模型下的梯度计算。这种针对两阶段架构中“信用分配”问题的数学建模，为解决检索系统中的梯度方差爆炸提供了新视角。

## 方法与证据
- **模型框架**：采用经典的 Plackett-Luce 模型作为 ESR 的概率建模基础。
- **核心方法**：CA-PG 算法，通过计算目标项目在任意包含它的候选集中被选中的边缘概率梯度，替代了 V-PG 的联合概率梯度。
- **实验数据**：在合成数据集（Synthetic data）和真实世界数据集（Real-world data）上进行了验证。
- **实验结论**：摘要指出，在候选集规模较大时，CA-PG 相比 V-PG 具有显著的收敛速度优势和训练稳定性，且理论分析证实其在 LSR 策略合理对齐的情况下能保持排序的准确性。

## 应用价值
在生物信息学领域，该算法可应用于：
1. **基因组/蛋白质序列检索**：优化从亿级序列库中初步筛选相似序列的召回模型。
2. **临床 RAG 系统**：提升医学知识库检索的效率，使初级检索器能更好地配合复杂的重排模型（如大型语言模型）。

## 局限与风险
- **依赖性**：CA-PG 的有效性前提是 LSR（高级排序器）策略需要“合理对齐”（reasonably aligned），若 LSR 奖励信号质量极差，ESR 的学习效果可能受限。
- **计算复杂度**：摘要未详细说明边缘化计算在大规模类别空间下的具体计算开销。
- **领域适配**：尚未在生物医学特定的非结构化数据（如蛋白质结构或基因表达谱）上进行直接验证。

papers.title: Surfacing Isolated Learners with Outcome-Independent Mediation of Feedback between Teachers and Students Using AI
papers.text:
title: Surfacing Isolated Learners with Outcome-Independent Mediation of Feedback between Teachers and Students Using AI
source: arXiv
topics: 
category: methods
why: 这篇工作更像方法创新，可能直接关联 metagenomics、long-read 或 pathogen identification 流程优化。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: AI-augmented classrooms generate rich teacher and student feedback before graded outcomes become available, yet these signals can be difficult to translate into timely instructional decisions. We propose an interpretable decision layer: a transparent mechanism that ranks course topics requiring attention without using grades or post-hoc outcome labels. The approach combines three signals: student learning difficulty prevalence, disagreement between learner self-reports and observed difficulties, and unresolved teacher concerns. The output is a ranked set of topic priorities with per-topic decision records explaining each ranking. In one graduate CS course offering ($n=5$ instructor interviews; $n=279$ survey responses), prioritized topics aligned with instructor concerns (top-5 overlap 3/5; Spearman $ρ=0.80$) and student-reported topic difficulty ($ρ=0.46$, $p=.048$). Multi-signal integration also surfaced learners not identified through individual signal sources alone (AUC $=0.96$ vs. $0.91$ for gap prevalence alone). Reflective thinking, help-seeking, and self-efficacy provided additional evidence that student behavioral signals align with learning-related constructs. While preliminary, these findings suggest that transparent coordination mechanisms may help support human-AI co-agency when feedback is incomplete.

papers.title: Persona Conditioning of Brand Recommendations in Retrieval-Augmented Commercial Chat: A Prominence-Stratified Cross-Provider Audit
papers.text:
title: Persona Conditioning of Brand Recommendations in Retrieval-Augmented Commercial Chat: A Prominence-Stratified Cross-Provider Audit
source: arXiv
topics: 
category: general
why: Persona Conditioning of Brand Recommenda 与你的主题有弱匹配，暂时保留作低优先级跟踪。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: The same prompt -- "best CRM software" -- reaches AI assistants from buyers in widely different contexts: a solo founder, an enterprise VP, a UK SMB owner. We audit how strongly that contextual variation reshapes which brands the model recommends. The audit samples 2,000 runs over a design space of 10 personas x 8 prompts x 3 model configurations x N=10 reps, with the two OpenAI cells at full 8-prompt coverage and the Anthropic sonnet-4.6 / low cell at 4-prompt coverage. Prefixing the user message with a persona drops the recommendation-set similarity (Jaccard) by Delta = -0.12 to -0.20 relative to a same-persona baseline (clustered 95% CIs exclude zero on all three measured cells; the sonnet cell's CI rests on only 4 prompt clusters and is correspondingly wider). The effect is sharply prominence-stratified: category leaders are persona-resistant (~80% same-brand consistency across personas), but mid-market brands swap up to 75% of the recommendation set as the persona changes. The Anthropic model shows a larger point-estimate effect than the OpenAI configurations, though clustered CIs overlap for the closer contrast (sonnet vs. OpenAI/high); the asymmetry is consistent with Anthropic's more retrieval-unattributed generation route (43-52% recommendations without observed retrieval-layer evidence, vs OpenAI's 8-29%, documented in Jack 2026). Any measurement of AI brand perception must condition on the buyer persona supplying the query: the same prompt produces materially different recommendation sets depending on who the model thinks is asking, and a measurement protocol that aggregates across personas systematically obscures that variation. The effect concentrates at mid-market and is largest on the most priors-reliant generation route in our audit, consistent with persona responsiveness growing as models lean more on training-data priors and richer context integration.

papers.title: Guideline-grounded retrieval-augmented generation for ophthalmic clinical decision support
papers.text:
title: Guideline-grounded retrieval-augmented generation for ophthalmic clinical decision support
source: arXiv
topics: 
category: methods
why: 这篇工作更像方法创新，可能直接关联 metagenomics、long-read 或 pathogen identification 流程优化。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: In this work, we propose Oph-Guid-RAG, a multimodal visual RAG system for ophthalmology clinical question answering and decision support. We treat each guideline page as an independent evidence unit and directly retrieve page images, preserving tables, flowcharts, and layout information. We further design a controllable retrieval framework with routing and filtering, which selectively introduces external evidence and reduces noise. The system integrates query decomposition, query rewriting, retrieval, reranking, and multimodal reasoning, and provides traceable outputs with guideline page references. We evaluate our method on HealthBench using a doctor-based scoring protocol. On the hard subset, our approach improves the overall score from 0.2969 to 0.3861 (+0.0892, +30.0%) compared to GPT-5.2, and achieves higher accuracy, improving from 0.5956 to 0.6576 (+0.0620, +10.4%). Compared to GPT-5.4, our method achieves a larger accuracy gain of +0.1289 (+24.4%). These results show that our method is more effective on challenging cases that require precise, evidence-based reasoning. Ablation studies further show that reranking, routing, and retrieval design are critical for stable performance, especially under difficult settings. Overall, we show how combining visionbased retrieval with controllable reasoning can improve evidence grounding and robustness in clinical AI applications,while pointing out that further work is needed to be more complete.

papers.title: UBio-MolFM: A Universal Molecular Foundation Model for Bio-Systems
papers.text:
title: UBio-MolFM: A Universal Molecular Foundation Model for Bio-Systems
source: arXiv
topics: 
category: foundation_model
why: 这篇工作偏基础模型/Agent方向，可能影响病原检测任务的建模上限，值得关注其任务定义与评测设计。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: All-atom molecular simulation serves as a quintessential ``computational microscope'' for understanding the machinery of life, yet it remains fundamentally limited by the trade-off between quantum-mechanical (QM) accuracy and biological scale. We present UBio-MolFM, a universal foundation model framework specifically engineered to bridge this gap. UBio-MolFM introduces three synergistic innovations: (1) UBio-Mol26, a large bio-specific dataset constructed via a multi-fidelity ``Two-Pronged Strategy'' that combines systematic bottom-up enumeration with top-down sampling of native protein environments (up to 1,200 atoms); (2) E2Former-V2, a linear-scaling equivariant transformer that integrates Equivariant Axis-Aligned Sparsification (EAAS) and Long-Short Range (LSR) modeling to capture non-local physics with up to ~4x higher inference throughput in our large-system benchmarks; and (3) a Three-Stage Curriculum Learning protocol that transitions from energy initialization to energy-force consistency, with force-focused supervision to mitigate energy offsets. Rigorous benchmarking across microscopic forces and macroscopic observables -- including liquid water structure, ionic solvation, and peptide folding -- demonstrates that UBio-MolFM achieves ab initio-level fidelity on large, out-of-distribution biomolecular systems (up to ~1,500 atoms) and realistic MD observables. By reconciling scalability with quantum precision, UBio-MolFM provides a robust, ready-to-use tool for the next generation of computational biology.

papers.title: Trustworthy Clinical Decision Support Using Meta-Predicates and Domain-Specific Languages
papers.text:
title: Trustworthy Clinical Decision Support Using Meta-Predicates and Domain-Specific Languages
source: arXiv
topics: foundation_model_agent
category: methods
why: 这篇工作更像方法创新，可能直接关联 metagenomics、long-read 或 pathogen identification 流程优化。
abstract_zh: 医疗 AI 监管框架要求临床决策支持系统不仅要准确，还必须具备可审计性。现有临床逻辑的形式语言仅能验证语法和结构正确性，无法判断决策规则是否使用了认识论上合理的证据。本研究借鉴契约式设计原则，引入了“元谓词”（meta-predicates），即关于谓词的谓词，用于对领域特定语言（DSL）表达的临床决策规则施加认识论约束。该框架建立了一个四维认识论类型系统（目的、知识领域、规模、获取方法），用于断言规则中允许使用的证据类型。我们在开源遗传变异分析平台 AnFiSA 中实现了该框架，并利用 Brigham 基因组医学协议对 Genome in a Bottle 基准中的 560 万个变异进行了验证。结果表明，变异解读决策树可重构为单调级联，实现单变异级别的审计追踪。元谓词验证能在部署前捕获人工或 AI 生成规则中的认识论错误。该方法补充了 LIME 和 SHAP 等事后解释方法，通过事前约束确保证据使用的合规性，为实现可独立审计的临床决策奠定了基础。
abstract: \textbf{Background:} Regulatory frameworks for AI in healthcare, including the EU AI Act and FDA guidance on AI/ML-based medical devices, require clinical decision support to demonstrate not only accuracy but auditability. Existing formal languages for clinical logic validate syntactic and structural correctness but not whether decision rules use epistemologically appropriate evidence. \textbf{Methods:} Drawing on design-by-contract principles, we introduce meta-predicates -- predicates about predicates -- for asserting epistemological constraints on clinical decision rules expressed in a DSL. An epistemological type system classifies annotations along four dimensions: purpose, knowledge domain, scale, and method of acquisition. Meta-predicates assert which evidence types are permissible in any given rule. The framework is instantiated in AnFiSA, an open-source platform for genetic variant curation, and demonstrated using the Brigham Genomics Medicine protocol on 5.6 million variants from the Genome in a Bottle benchmark. \textbf{Results:} Decision trees used in variant interpretation can be reformulated as unate cascades, enabling per-variant audit trails that identify which rule classified each variant and why. Meta-predicate validation catches epistemological errors before deployment, whether rules are human-written or AI-generated. The approach complements post-hoc methods such as LIME and SHAP: where explanation reveals what evidence was used after the fact, meta-predicates constrain what evidence may be used before deployment, while preserving human readability. \textbf{Conclusions:} Meta-predicate validation is a step toward demonstrating not only that decisions are accurate but that they rest on appropriate evidence in ways that can be independently audited. While demonstrated in genomics, the approach generalises to any domain requiring auditable decision logic.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究提出了一种基于“元谓词”（Meta-Predicates）和领域特定语言（DSL）的框架，旨在解决临床决策支持系统（特别是基因组变异解读）中的可审计性问题。通过在决策规则中引入认识论约束，确保 AI 或人工生成的规则基于科学合理的证据。研究在 AnFiSA 平台上实现，并处理了 560 万个基因变异数据。

## 为什么相关
在病原基因组学和临床微生物学领域，变异鉴定（Variant Identification）和耐药性预测的决策逻辑必须符合生物学常识。该工作直接关联到“基础模型/智能体（foundation_model_agent）”在临床场景的落地，特别是如何约束大模型生成的诊断逻辑，防止其引用不相关的实验指标或产生认识论错误。

## 新颖度判断
新颖度较高（0.75）。不同于传统的 LIME 或 SHAP 等事后（post-hoc）解释技术，该方法提出了事前（ex-ante）约束机制。通过“元谓词”对证据类型进行分类（如区分实验证据与统计推断），在规则部署前就进行逻辑合规性检查，这在基因组临床决策领域具有显著的工程创新。

## 方法与证据
- **方法**：引入元谓词和四维认识论类型系统（目的、领域、规模、获取方式）；将决策树重构为单调级联（unate cascades）以支持单样本审计。
- **数据与工具**：使用开源平台 AnFiSA；应用 Brigham 基因组医学协议；测试数据集为 Genome in a Bottle (GIAB) 基准中的 5.6 million 个变异位点。
- **结论**：该框架能有效识别不符合认识论要求的规则错误，并提供清晰的审计追踪（audit trails）。

## 应用价值
1. **监管合规**：直接响应 EU AI Act 和 FDA 对医疗 AI 可审计性的要求。
2. **自动化策展**：在病原体变异解读中，可用于自动校验 AI 智能体生成的筛选规则，确保其符合临床微生物学规范。
3. **透明度提升**：为复杂的基因组分析流程提供每一步的逻辑依据，方便临床医生复核。

## 局限与风险
- **摘要未说明**：未提及定义元谓词和认识论类型系统的专家知识成本。
- **摘要未说明**：未讨论该框架在处理实时高通量测序流数据时的计算开销。
- **风险**：如果元谓词本身的定义存在偏差，可能会误杀正确的创新性规则（即过度约束风险）。

papers.title: MedResearchBench: A Multi-Domain Benchmark for Evaluating AI Research Agents on Clinical Medical Research
papers.text:
title: MedResearchBench: A Multi-Domain Benchmark for Evaluating AI Research Agents on Clinical Medical Research
source: medRxiv
topics: pathogenomics
category: clinical_application
why: 这篇工作更接近临床/监测落地，适合评估其对快速识别、预警或治疗辅助的实际价值。
abstract_zh: 随着AI Scientist等自动化研究系统的发展，自主科学发现展现出巨大潜力，但现有基准多集中于基础科学，忽视了临床医学研究中复杂的调查设计、混杂控制及报告规范（如STROBE）。为此，本研究推出了MedResearchBench，这是首个专门评估AI系统在临床医学研究任务中表现的基准。该基准包含涵盖心血管、肿瘤、传染病等7个领域的16项任务，基于NHANES和SEER公开数据集构建，并以16篇高质量已发表论文（影响因子2.3-51.0）作为金标准。评估涵盖统计方法、结果准确性、临床解释及报告合规性等6个维度。初步测试显示，一个Agentic data2paper流水线在三项试点任务中平均得分为72/100（B级），虽能正确执行调查加权方法，但在协变量完整性和参考组指定方面存在局限。该基准为评估AI能否进行临床可靠的研究提供了标准化平台。
abstract: The rapid advancement of AI research automation systems--including AI Scientist, data-to-paper, and Agent Laboratory--has demonstrated the potential for autonomous scientific discovery. However, existing benchmarks for evaluating these systems focus pre-dominantly on fundamental sciences (machine learning, physics, chemistry), overlooking the unique challenges of medical clinical research: complex survey designs, inferential statistics with confounding control, adherence to reporting standards (STROBE, CONSORT), and the requirement for clinically actionable interpretation. We present MedResearchBench, the first benchmark specifically designed to evaluate AI systems on medical clinical research tasks. MedResearchBench comprises 16 tasks spanning 7 clinical domains (cardiovascular, oncology, mental health, metabolic, respiratory, neurology, infectious disease), built on publicly available datasets (the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey [NHANES] and the Surveillance, Epidemiology, and End Results [SEER] program) with ground truth from 16 high-quality published papers (IF range: 2.3-51.0). Each task is evaluated along 6 medical-specific dimensions: statistical methodology, results accuracy, visualization quality, clinical interpretation, confounding sensitivity, and reporting compliance. We describe the benchmark design rationale, task construction methodology, paper selection criteria with anti-paper-mill filtering, and a detailed analysis of task characteristics including methodological diversity, evaluation dimension coverage, and difficulty stratification. To demonstrate benchmark executability, we evaluate an agentic data2paper pipeline on 3 pilot tasks spanning all three difficulty tiers, achieving scores of 72/100 (Tier 1, Cardio 000), 69/100 (Tier 2, Mental 000), and 75/100 (Tier 3, Metabolic 002), with a mean score of 72/100 (B-level). Survey-weighted methodology was correctly implemented across all tasks; primary limitations included covariate incompleteness and reference group misspecification. MedResearchBench addresses a critical gap in AI research evaluation and provides a standardized, community-extensible platform for assessing whether AI systems can conduct clinically sound, publication-quality medical research. All task materials are publicly available at https://github.com/TerryFYL/MedResearchBench.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究开发了名为 **MedResearchBench** 的基准测试框架，旨在评估 AI 研究智能体（AI Research Agents）在临床医学研究中的表现。该基准包含 16 个任务，覆盖传染病、肿瘤等 7 个临床领域，利用 NHANES 和 SEER 数据集，并以 16 篇高影响因子（最高 51.0）的论文作为评价标准，从统计、准确性、解释力等 6 个维度进行量化评分。

## 为什么相关
该工作与病原基因组学及临床微生物学具有**中度相关性**。虽然摘要未直接提及病原体测序，但其涵盖了“传染病（infectious disease）”领域，且重点解决的“临床可操作性解释”和“混杂因素控制”是临床微生物研究从数据走向辅助决策的关键环节。对于开发能够自动分析病原体流行病学数据的 AI Agent 具有直接的评测参考价值。

## 新颖度判断
**新颖度较高**。现有的 AI 科学发现基准（如 AI Scientist）多侧重于机器学习或基础理化，而 MedResearchBench 首次针对临床医学的特殊性（如 STROBE/CONSORT 报告规范、复杂的调查加权统计）建立了评价体系，填补了临床 AI 研究自动化评估的空白。

## 方法与证据
- **数据来源**：使用 NHANES（国家健康和营养检查调查）和 SEER（监测、流行病学和最终结果程序）公开数据集。
- **任务构建**：16 项任务，匹配 16 篇已发表论文作为 Ground Truth。
- **评估维度**：包括统计方法学、结果准确性、可视化质量、临床解释、混杂敏感性及报告合规性。
- **实验证据**：对一个 data2paper 智能体进行了试点评估，在心血管（72分）、精神健康（69分）和代谢（75分）任务中平均得分为 72/100，达到 B 级水平。

## 应用价值
为临床研究自动化提供了“度量衡”。它不仅能识别 AI 在撰写医学论文时的统计正确性，还能评估其是否符合临床逻辑。对于需要快速生成疫情预警报告或临床微生物流行病学分析的科研团队，该基准可用于筛选和优化其 AI 智能体工具。

## 局限与风险
- **技术局限**：试点评估显示 AI 在“协变量完整性（covariate incompleteness）”和“参考组指定错误（reference group misspecification）”方面存在明显短板，说明 AI 尚不能完全替代人类进行严谨的临床推断。
- **覆盖范围**：目前仅基于 NHANES 和 SEER 数据，对于更复杂的病原体多组学数据或实时临床监测数据的适配性摘要未予说明。

papers.title: Benchmarking LLM-based agents for single-cell omics analysis
papers.text:
title: Benchmarking LLM-based agents for single-cell omics analysis
source: arXiv
topics: 
category: foundation_model
why: 这篇工作偏基础模型/Agent方向，可能影响病原检测任务的建模上限，值得关注其任务定义与评测设计。
abstract_zh: 单细胞组学数据的激增暴露了传统手动分析工作流的局限性。AI 智能体（Agents）通过自适应规划、可执行代码生成、可追溯决策和实时知识融合，为该领域带来了范式转变，但缺乏全面的基准测试阻碍了其发展。本研究引入了一种新型基准评估系统，旨在严格评估智能体在单细胞组学分析中的能力。该系统包含：一个兼容多种智能体框架和 LLM 的统一平台；涵盖认知程序合成、协作、执行效率、生物信息学知识整合和任务完成质量的多维指标；以及 50 个涵盖多组学、物种和测序技术的真实世界单细胞组学分析任务。评估结果显示，Grok3-beta 在测试的智能体框架中达到了当前最先进水平（SOTA）。多智能体框架通过专业化分工，在协作和执行效率上显著优于单智能体。能力归因分析表明，高质量代码生成是任务成功的关键，而自我反思对整体表现的影响最为显著，其次是检索增强生成（RAG）和规划。本研究指出了代码生成、长上下文处理和知识检索方面的挑战，为计算生物学 AI 智能体的开发提供了实证基础。
abstract: Background: The surge in single-cell omics data exposes limitations in traditional, manually defined analysis workflows. AI agents offer a paradigm shift, enabling adaptive planning, executable code generation, traceable decisions, and real-time knowledge fusion. However, the lack of a comprehensive benchmark critically hinders progress. Results: We introduce a novel benchmarking evaluation system to rigorously assess agent capabilities in single-cell omics analysis. This system comprises: a unified platform compatible with diverse agent frameworks and LLMs; multidimensional metrics assessing cognitive program synthesis, collaboration, execution efficiency, bioinformatics knowledge integration, and task completion quality; and 50 diverse real-world single-cell omics analysis tasks spanning multi-omics, species, and sequencing technologies. Our evaluation reveals that Grok3-beta achieves state-of-the-art performance among tested agent frameworks. Multi-agent frameworks significantly enhance collaboration and execution efficiency over single-agent approaches through specialized role division. Attribution analyses of agent capabilities identify that high-quality code generation is crucial for task success, and self-reflection has the most significant overall impact, followed by retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and planning. Conclusions: This work highlights persistent challenges in code generation, long-context handling, and context-aware knowledge retrieval, providing a critical empirical foundation and best practices for developing robust AI agents in computational biology.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究构建了首个针对单细胞组学分析的 AI 智能体基准测试系统。通过 50 个涵盖不同物种和测序技术的真实世界任务，对比了不同 LLM（如 Grok3-beta）和智能体架构（单智能体 vs 多智能体）在生物信息学分析中的表现，并定量分析了代码生成、RAG、规划和自我反思等核心能力对任务成功率的贡献度。

## 为什么相关
在病原体研究和临床微生物学中，单细胞测序（如宿主免疫反应分析、病原-宿主互作）已成为核心技术。该基准测试评估了 AI 智能体处理复杂生物信息学工作流的能力，这直接关系到未来能否利用 AI 自动化分析病原体感染后的单细胞转录组或多组学数据，提高临床诊断和科研效率。

## 新颖度判断
新颖度较高（6.5）。该工作填补了单细胞领域缺乏标准化 AI 智能体评估体系的空白。特别是对 Grok3-beta 在生物信息学任务中的 SOTA 表现进行了首次实证，并明确了“自我反思”机制在复杂组学分析任务中比 RAG 和规划更具影响力的结论。

## 方法与证据
研究采用了包含 50 个多样化任务的测试集，涵盖多组学和多物种数据。评估指标不仅看任务完成度，还包括认知程序合成和执行效率。实验证据显示：1. Grok3-beta 表现优于其他模型；2. 多智能体框架通过角色分工提升了效率；3. 归因分析证明自我反思（Self-reflection）是提升性能的最关键因素，而代码生成质量是任务成功的基石。

## 应用价值
为生物信息学工具开发者提供了选型参考，证明了在构建组学分析 Agent 时应优先强化“自我反思”逻辑和“代码生成”精度。该基准平台可作为未来病原学专用 Agent 开发的测试底座，加速从原始测序数据到生物学发现的自动化进程。

## 局限与风险
摘要指出智能体在处理长上下文（Long-context）和上下文感知知识检索方面仍存在持续挑战。在临床微生物应用中，如果代码生成出现细微错误或知识检索不准确，可能导致错误的病原体鉴定或耐药性分析结论。此外，50 个任务的规模对于全面覆盖复杂的生物学场景可能仍显不足。

papers.title: Very Efficient Listwise Multimodal Reranking for Long Documents
papers.text:
title: Very Efficient Listwise Multimodal Reranking for Long Documents
source: arXiv
topics: 
category: foundation_model
why: 这篇工作偏基础模型/Agent方向，可能影响病原检测任务的建模上限，值得关注其任务定义与评测设计。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: Listwise reranking is a key yet computationally expensive component in vision-centric retrieval and multimodal retrieval-augmented generation (M-RAG) over long documents. While recent VLM-based rerankers achieve strong accuracy, their practicality is often limited by long visual-token sequences and multi-step autoregressive decoding. We propose ZipRerank, a highly efficient listwise multimodal reranker that directly addresses both bottlenecks. It reduces input length via a lightweight query-image early interaction mechanism and eliminates autoregressive decoding by scoring all candidates in a single forward pass. To enable effective learning, ZipRerank adopts a two-stage training strategy: (i) listwise pretraining on large-scale text data rendered as images, and (ii) multimodal finetuning with VLM-teacher-distilled soft-ranking supervision. Extensive experiments on the MMDocIR benchmark show that ZipRerank matches or surpasses state-of-the-art multimodal rerankers while reducing LLM inference latency by up to an order of magnitude, making it well-suited for latency-sensitive real-world systems. The code is available at https://github.com/dukesun99/ZipRerank.

papers.title: Do Multimodal RAG Systems Leak Data? A Comprehensive Evaluation of Membership Inference and Image Caption Retrieval Attacks

title: Do Multimodal RAG Systems Leak Data? A Comprehensive Evaluation of Membership Inference and Image Caption Retrieval Attacks
source: arXiv
topics: foundation_model_agent
category: foundation_model

abstract_zh: 
abstract: The growing adoption of multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (mRAG) pipelines for vision-centric tasks (e.g., visual QA) introduces important privacy challenges. In particular, while mRAG provides a practical capability to connect private datasets and improve model performance, it risks the leakage of private information from these datasets. In this paper, we perform an empirical study to analyze the privacy risks inherent in the mRAG pipeline observed through standard model prompting. Specifically, we implement a case study that attempts to determine whether a visual asset (e.g., image) is included in the mRAG, and, if present, to leak the metadata (e.g., caption) related to it. Our findings highlight the need for privacy-preserving mechanisms and motivate future research on mRAG privacy. Our code is published online: https://github.com/aliwister/mrag-attack-eval.

papers.title: MAB-DQA: Addressing Query Aspect Importance in Document Question Answering with Multi-Armed Bandits
papers.text:
title: MAB-DQA: Addressing Query Aspect Importance in Document Question Answering with Multi-Armed Bandits
source: arXiv
topics: foundation_model_agent
category: methods
why: 这篇工作更像方法创新，可能直接关联 metagenomics、long-read 或 pathogen identification 流程优化。
abstract_zh: 文档问答（DQA）是文档理解的关键任务，涉及根据用户查询从文档中生成答案。由于需要解释视觉布局，近期研究多采用多模态检索增强生成（RAG）处理页面图像。然而，多模态 RAG 在处理大量图像时存在局限，检索阶段通常仅保留少数候选页（如 Top-4），导致信息丰富但视觉显著性较低的内容被忽略。为解决此问题，本文提出基于多臂老虎机（MAB）的 DQA 框架（MAB-DQA），显式建模查询中多个隐含维度的重要性。MAB-DQA 将查询分解为维度感知的子查询，并为每个子查询检索候选集。该框架将每个子查询视为一个“臂”，利用少数代表性页面的初步推理结果作为奖励信号来估计维度效用。在探索-利用策略指导下，MAB-DQA 动态地向高价值维度重新分配检索预算。通过整合最具信息量的页面及其关联，生成最终结果。在四个基准测试中，MAB-DQA 比现有最先进方法平均提高 5%-18%，显著增强了文档理解能力。
abstract: Document Question Answering (DQA) involves generating answers from a document based on a user's query, representing a key task in document understanding. This task requires interpreting visual layouts, which has prompted recent studies to adopt multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) that processes page images for answer generation. However, in multimodal RAG, visual DQA struggles to utilize a large number of images effectively, as the retrieval stage often retains only a few candidate pages (e.g., Top-4), causing informative but less visually salient content to be overlooked in favor of common yet low-information pages. To address this issue, we propose a Multi-Armed Bandit-based DQA framework (MAB-DQA) to explicitly model the varying importance of multiple implicit aspects in a query. Specifically, MAB-DQA decomposes a query into aspect-aware subqueries and retrieves an aspect-specific candidate set for each. It treats each subquery as an arm and uses preliminary reasoning results from a small number of representative pages as reward signals to estimate aspect utility. Guided by an exploration-exploitation policy, MAB-DQA dynamically reallocates retrieval budgets toward high-value aspects. With the most informative pages and their correlations, MAB-DQA generates the expected results. On four benchmarks, MAB-DQA shows an average improvement of 5%-18% over the state-of-the-art method, consistently enhancing document understanding. Codes are available at https://github.com/ElephantOH/MAB-DQA.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究提出了 MAB-DQA 框架，旨在解决多模态检索增强生成（RAG）在处理复杂文档问答时，因检索窗口过窄（如仅保留 Top-4 页面）而丢失关键信息的问题。其核心是通过多臂老虎机（Multi-Armed Bandit）算法动态优化查询维度的权重，从而更精准地分配检索资源。

## 为什么相关
该工作与病原体研究及临床微生物学属于**弱相关（方法论交叉）**。在处理宏基因组长报告、病原体鉴定手册或复杂的临床诊疗指南时，研究人员往往需要从多维度（如病原体分类、耐药基因、临床关联）提取信息。MAB-DQA 提供的多维度查询分解与动态预算分配机制，可直接用于优化此类长文档或多模态实验数据的自动化分析流程。

## 新颖度判断
**中等偏低**。该研究的新颖性在于将经典的强化学习模型（MAB）引入 RAG 的查询处理阶段，通过“探索-利用”策略解决检索预算分配问题，而非开发全新的基础大模型。这种针对特定检索瓶颈的方法改进在通用 AI 领域较为常见。

## 方法与证据
- **方法**：1. 将原始查询分解为“维度感知子查询”（aspect-aware subqueries）；2. 将每个子查询建模为 MAB 的一个“臂”；3. 利用少量页面的初步推理结果作为“奖励信号”（reward signals）；4. 采用探索-利用策略（exploration-exploitation policy）动态调整检索预算。
- **证据**：在 4 个标准基准测试集上进行了验证，实验结果显示 MAB-DQA 相比当前最先进（SOTA）方法，性能平均提升了 5% 至 18%。

## 应用价值
在生物信息学和临床微生物学领域，该方法可应用于：
1. **长篇文献挖掘**：从数千页的病原体研究综述中，根据复杂的组合查询（如“特定菌株+特定抗生素+耐药机制”）精准定位关键图表或段落。
2. **自动化报告解读**：优化 AI Agent 对包含复杂视觉布局（如系统发育树、耐药谱表格）的临床检测报告的理解精度。

## 局限与风险
- **计算开销**：摘要未说明 MAB 迭代过程产生的额外推理延迟和计算成本。
- **奖励依赖**：该方法依赖于初步推理结果作为奖励信号，若初始检索的页面质量极差，可能导致奖励信号失效。
- **适用范围**：摘要未明确该方法在纯文本（非视觉布局）文档上的表现是否同样优越。

papers.title: Knowledge Poisoning Attacks on Medical Multi-Modal Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.text:
title: Knowledge Poisoning Attacks on Medical Multi-Modal Retrieval-Augmented Generation
source: arXiv
topics: foundation_model_agent
category: foundation_model
why: 这篇工作偏基础模型/Agent方向，可能影响病原检测任务的建模上限，值得关注其任务定义与评测设计。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is a widely adopted paradigm for enhancing LLMs in medical applications by incorporating expert multimodal knowledge during generation. However, the underlying retrieval databases may naturally contain, or be intentionally injected with, adversarial knowledge, which can perturb model outputs and undermine system reliability. To investigate this risk, prior studies have explored knowledge poisoning attacks in medical RAG systems. Nevertheless, most of them rely on the strong assumption that adversaries possess prior knowledge of user queries, which is unrealistic in deployments and substantially limits their practical applicability. In this paper, we propose M\textsuperscript{3}Att, a knowledge-poisoning framework designed for medical multimodal RAG systems, assuming only limited distribution knowledge of the underlying database. Our core idea is to inject covert misinformation into textual data while using paired visual data as a query-agnostic trigger to promote retrieval. We first propose a unified framework that introduces imperceptible perturbations to visual inputs to manipulate retrieval probabilities. Besides, due to the prior medical knowledge in LLMs, naively poisoned medical content with explicit factual errors can be corrected during generation. Thus, we leverage the inherent ambiguity of medical diagnosis and design a covert misinformation injection strategy that degrades diagnostic accuracy while evading model self-correction. Experiments on five LLMs and datasets demonstrate that M\textsuperscript{3}Att consistently produces clinically plausible yet incorrect generations. Codes: https://github.com/ypr17/M3Att.

papers.title: MoLF: Mixture-of-Latent-Flow for Pan-Cancer Spatial Gene Expression Prediction from Histology
papers.text:
title: MoLF: Mixture-of-Latent-Flow for Pan-Cancer Spatial Gene Expression Prediction from Histology
source: arXiv
topics: 
category: methods
why: 这篇工作更像方法创新，可能直接关联 metagenomics、long-read 或 pathogen identification 流程优化。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: Inferring spatial transcriptomics (ST) from histology enables scalable histogenomic profiling, yet current methods are largely restricted to single-tissue models. This fragmentation fails to leverage biological principles shared across cancer types and hinders application to data-scarce scenarios. While pan-cancer training offers a solution, the resulting heterogeneity challenges monolithic architectures. To bridge this gap, we introduce MoLF (Mixture-of-Latent-Flow), a generative model for pan-cancer histogenomic prediction. MoLF leverages a conditional Flow Matching objective to map noise to the gene latent manifold, parameterized by a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) velocity field. By dynamically routing inputs to specialized sub-networks, this architecture effectively decouples the optimization of diverse tissue patterns. Our experiments demonstrate that MoLF establishes a new state-of-the-art, consistently outperforming both specialized and foundation model baselines on pan-cancer benchmarks. Furthermore, MoLF exhibits zero-shot generalization to cross-species data, suggesting it captures fundamental, conserved histo-molecular mechanisms.

title: scpFormer: A Foundation Model for Unified Representation and Integration of the Single-Cell Proteomics
source: arXiv
topics: 
category: methods
why: 这篇工作更像方法创新，可能直接关联 metagenomics、long-read 或 pathogen identification 流程优化。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: The integration of single-cell proteomic data is often hindered by the fragmented nature of targeted antibody panels. To address this limitation, we introduce scpFormer, a transformer-based foundation model designed for single-cell proteomics. Pre-trained on over 390 million cells, scpFormer replaces standard index-based tokenization with a continuous, sequence-anchored approach. By combining Evolutionary Scale Modeling (ESM) with value-aware expression embeddings, it dynamically maps variable panels into a shared semantic space without artificial discretization. We demonstrate that scpFormer generates global cell representations that perform competitively in large-scale batch integration and unsupervised clustering. Moreover, its open-vocabulary architecture facilitates in silico panel expansion, assisting in the reconstruction of biological manifolds in sparse clinical datasets. Finally, this learned protein co-expression logic is transferable to bulk-omics tasks, supporting applications like cancer drug response prediction. scpFormer provides a versatile, panel-agnostic framework to facilitate scalable biomarker discovery and precision oncology.

papers.title: GGBound: A Genome-Grounded Agent for Microbial Life-Boundary Prediction
papers.text:
title: GGBound: A Genome-Grounded Agent for Microbial Life-Boundary Prediction
source: arXiv
topics: 
category: foundation_model
why: 这篇工作偏基础模型/Agent方向，可能影响病原检测任务的建模上限，值得关注其任务定义与评测设计。
abstract_zh: 预测微生物菌株的生理生命边界（如温度、pH、盐度、底物利用和形态）对生物技术和生态学至关重要，但传统方法依赖耗时的体外筛选。现有计算方法多将生理特征视为孤立的监督目标，或仅将生物基础模型作为静态编码器，未能有效弥合基因型与表型间的鸿沟。本研究将微生物生命边界预测定义为统一的“基因组到生理”任务，并开发了受基因组约束且具备工具增强能力的LLM智能体GGBound。研究团队从IJSEM、NCBI和BacDive整理了一个包含1,525个菌株、6,448个实例的基准数据集，涵盖生存区间、环境最适条件、底物利用及形态特征。在架构上，该智能体通过轻量化Token融合将冻结的LucaOne基因组嵌入注入Qwen骨干网络，并利用基于相似性的RAG模块和全基因组代谢模型（GEM）扰动工具进行推理。通过基因-文本对齐、蒸馏轨迹的智能体SFT以及引入反事实基因接地奖励的GRPO算法进行三阶段优化。结果显示，这个4B参数的智能体性能达到或超过了更大规模的前沿LLM，消融实验证实了基因组Token融合、动态工具调用和反事实奖励的有效性。
abstract: Characterizing the physiological life boundaries of microbial strains, including viable temperature, pH, salinity, substrate utilization, and morphology, is central to biotechnology and ecology, yet traditionally requires exhaustive in vitro screening. Existing computational approaches either treat physiological traits as isolated supervised targets or repurpose biological foundation models as static encoders, leaving the genotype-to-physiology gap largely unbridged. We formulate microbial life-boundary prediction as a unified genome-to-physiology task and address it with a genome-conditioned, tool-augmented LLM agent. To support this task, we curate a strain-centric benchmark from IJSEM, NCBI, and BacDive covering 1,525 strains and 6,448 instances across viability intervals, environmental optima, substrate utilization, categorical traits, and morphology. Architecturally, the agent injects frozen LucaOne genome embeddings into a Qwen backbone via lightweight token fusion, and reasons over a similarity-based RAG module and a Genome-scale Metabolic Model (GEM) perturbation tool. We optimize the agent through a three-stage pipeline of gene-text alignment, agentic SFT on distilled trajectories, and GRPO with a novel counterfactual gene-grounding reward that reinforces the policy only when the authentic genome embedding causally improves correct-token generation relative to a zero-gene ablation. The resulting 4B-parameter agent matches or surpasses substantially larger frontier LLMs, with ablations confirming that genome-token fusion, dynamic tool use, and the counterfactual reward each yield distinct, significant gains.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究提出了GGBound，一个专门用于预测微生物生理边界（如耐受温度、pH、底物利用等）的基因组驱动型AI智能体。它通过将蛋白质/基因组基础模型（LucaOne）的嵌入向量与大语言模型（Qwen）融合，并结合检索增强生成（RAG）和全基因组代谢模型（GEM）工具，实现了从基因型到表型的端到端预测。

## 为什么相关
在病原检测和临床微生物学中，了解未知菌株的生长边界（如在何种温度或pH下存活）对于病原鉴定、环境适应性评估及培养基优化至关重要。该工作将基因组信息直接转化为生理特征描述，为临床微生物的自动化表型鉴定提供了新思路。

## 新颖度判断
**新颖度：中等偏上（1.5）**。其创新点不在于单纯的LLM微调，而在于：1. **架构融合**：将冻结的基因组基础模型嵌入通过Token融合注入LLM；2. **工具增强**：引入了GEM代谢模型扰动工具；3. **强化学习创新**：设计了一种“反事实基因接地奖励（Counterfactual Gene-grounding Reward）”，强制模型必须依赖基因组信息而非仅靠文本记忆来生成答案。

## 方法与证据
- **数据规模**：整合了来自IJSEM、NCBI和BacDive的1,525个菌株，共6,448个实验实例。
- **模型架构**：以Qwen为骨干（4B参数），融合LucaOne基因组嵌入。
- **训练策略**：采用三阶段管线，包括基因-文本对齐、基于蒸馏轨迹的SFT，以及使用GRPO算法进行强化学习。
- **实验结论**：4B规模的GGBound在生理特征预测任务上匹配或超越了参数量更大的前沿LLM，消融实验证明了基因组Token融合和GEM工具调用对提升预测准确性有显著贡献。

## 应用价值
该模型可用于快速筛选新发现病原体的生理特性，减少实验室体外筛选的工作量。特别是在生物技术领域，可辅助设计特定底物利用能力的工程菌株，或预测环境微生物在极端条件下的生存能力。

## 局限与风险
- **数据局限**：1,525个菌株的数据量对于覆盖极其多样化的微生物界仍显不足，可能存在分类学偏差。
- **工具依赖**：GEM工具的有效性依赖于高质量的代谢网络重建，对于缺乏高质量注释的非模式物种，该工具的辅助效果可能受限。
- **泛化性**：摘要未明确说明模型在完全未见的科/属水平上的外推表现。

abstract_zh: 
abstract: AlphaFold3 introduces a diffusion-based architecture that elevates protein structure prediction to all-atom resolution with improved accuracy. This state-of-the-art performance has established AlphaFold3 as a foundation model for diverse generation and design tasks. However, its iterative design substantially increases inference time, limiting practical deployment in downstream settings such as virtual screening and protein design. We propose DCFold, a single-step generative model that attains AlphaFold3-level accuracy. Our Dual Consistency training framework, which incorporates a novel Temporal Geodesic Matching (TGM) scheduler, enables DCFold to achieve a 15x acceleration in inference while maintaining predictive fidelity. We validate its effectiveness across both structure prediction and binder design benchmarks.

papers.title: Applications of temporal graph learning for predicting the dynamics of biological systems
papers.text:
title: Applications of temporal graph learning for predicting the dynamics of biological systems
source: arXiv
topics: 
category: foundation_model
why: 这篇工作偏基础模型/Agent方向，可能影响病原检测任务的建模上限，值得关注其任务定义与评测设计。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: Biological foundation models have shown strong performance in single-cell representation learning by applying transformer architectures directly to gene-expression matrices. However, these approaches predominantly operate in static settings and do not explicitly model the temporal evolution of developmental programs in the cell. Modeling such dynamics is important for understanding how cellular states progressively emerge, differentiate, and reorganize during development or disease progression. In this work-in-progress paper, we investigate an alternative temporal graph-based perspective in which cellular states are represented through pseudotime-resolved gene regulatory networks and modeled as evolving graph structures over persistent gene identities. Starting from single-cell transcriptomic data, we infer pseudotime trajectories, discretize cells into developmental snapshots, reconstruct one gene regulatory network per snapshot, and apply temporal graph neural networks to forecast biological states. We evaluate this framework on two publicly available mouse developmental datasets, erythroid gastrulation and pancreatic endocrinogenesis, considering three complementary tasks: gene-expression forecasting, link prediction, and out-degree centrality prediction. Our results show that graph-based models outperform well-known foundation-model such as scGPT and scFoundation, suggesting that explicitly modeling evolving regulatory structure provides useful information beyond static pretrained representations. For link prediction and centrality forecasting, temporal graph learning captures non-trivial regulatory dynamics and enables the identification of temporally important gene hubs. Overall, our findings support temporal graph learning as a promising direction for modeling dynamic biological systems and as a complementary paradigm to current foundation model approaches in single-cell biology.

abstract_zh: 
abstract: Lateral flow immunoassay (LFIA), as one of the core technologies of point-of-care testing (POCT), holds significant value in pathogen diagnosis and biomarker analysis. Notably, spherical nanomaterials exhibit high clinical translatability and commercial advantages. Therefore, this review first employs bibliometric analysis of relevant literature from 2015 to 2025 to outline research trends, and summarizes the preparation and optimization strategies for various spherical nano labels, such as noble metal nanoparticles, fluorescent nanoparticles, nanozyme-active nanoparticles, surface-enhanced Raman scattering active nanoparticles, and magnetic nanoparticles. In addition, this review discusses the synergistic enhancement effects of multimodal signal strategies such as colorimetric, fluorescent, SERS, magnetic, and photothermal signals in clinical diagnostics, and elaborates on the role of surface functionalization mechanisms in improving detection sensitivity and specificity. Currently, systematic reviews focusing on spherical nano label-assisted lateral flow immunoassay for clinical sample detection remain scarce. This review not only provides a theoretical basis and technical support for precision medical diagnostics but also lays a critical foundation for advancing the development of personalized and intelligent home-based health monitoring systems.
