papers.title: Peripheral Treg-monocyte immune signatures relate to neurodegeneration and prognosis in patients with primary tauopathies
papers.text:
title: Peripheral Treg-monocyte immune signatures relate to neurodegeneration and prognosis in patients with primary tauopathies
source: medRxiv
topics: foundation_model_agent
category: foundation_model
why: 这篇工作偏基础模型/Agent方向，可能影响病原检测任务的建模上限，值得关注其任务定义与评测设计。
abstract_zh: 神经炎症是原发性 tau 蛋白病（如 PSP 和 CBS）的共同特征，且与临床预后恶化相关。本研究旨在表征进行性核上性麻痹（PSP）和皮质基底节综合征（CBS）患者的血源性免疫细胞谱。研究利用高维质谱流式技术（29 个标记物）分析了 60 名患者及 21 名匹配对照者的外周血。通过层次聚类、主成分分析及基于扩散的网络传播技术，整合细胞计数与血浆炎症标志物。结果发现，患者外周免疫网络协调性增强。单核细胞驱动的集群（Cluster 1）在患者中显著升高，反映了单核细胞从经典型向非经典型转变的障碍，并与高水平神经丝轻链（NfL）、认知功能下降及预后不良相关。相反，Treg 驱动的集群（Cluster 2）在患者中评分较低，且与较好的认知和生存期相关。研究揭示了 Treg-单核细胞轴的失调，为该病的液体生物标志物和免疫治疗提供了新靶点。
abstract: Background: Neuroinflammation is a common hallmark of primary tauopathies, and is associated with worse clinical outcomes over time. However, accurate prognosis in these disorders remains challenging, and current fluid biomarkers provide limited insight into the contribution of peripheral immune cells to PSP/CBS pathogenesis. Our study aims to characterise blood based immune cell profiles in patients with progressive supranuclear palsy (PSP) and corticobasal syndrome (CBS), and test their associations with neurodegeneration and clinical outcomes. Methods: Peripheral blood immune cells from fresh whole blood were characterized with high dimensional mass cytometry (29 markers) in n=60 people with PSP/CBS and n=21 age and sex matched controls. Cell type abundance was defined as the ratio of counts for each gated population divided by total live cells. Hierarchical clustering of cell types and principal component analysis were used to derive data-driven immune clusters. Correlation network analysis and diffusion based network propagation integrated cell counts with plasma inflammation markers to prioritise mediators of intercellular signalling. Associations between immunological markers, plasma concentrations of neurofilament light chain (NfL), cognition, and survival were assessed using regression and Cox proportional hazards models. Results: Patients with PSP/CBS showed a global increase in covariance among immune cell populations, indicating heightened coordination within the peripheral immune network. A monocyte driven cluster (Cluster 1) showed higher scores in PSP/CBS, reflecting impaired phenotypic transition from classical to nonclassical monocytes, which was associated with higher NfL levels, poorer cognitive performance, and worse prognosis. In contrast, a Treg driven cluster (Cluster 2) showed lower scores in PSP/CBS and was associated with better cognition and longer survival. Integrated multimodal networks identified a small set of immune regulatory molecules and cytokines mediating crosstalk between Treg/Th17-like cells and monocytic populations, supporting a dysregulated Treg and monocyte axis in PSP/CBS. Conclusions: We identified peripheral blood based immunophenotypic profiles of individuals with PSP/CBS that are associated with neurodegeneration, cognitive decline, and survival. Dysregulated monocyte maturation and reduced Treg related immune configurations are enriched in patients with worse outcomes, suggesting that specific peripheral immune cell subsets may serve as fluid biomarkers and potential immunotherapy targets in primary tauopathies.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究通过高维质谱流式细胞术（CyTOF）对原发性 tau 蛋白病（PSP/CBS）患者的外周免疫系统进行了深度表征。核心发现是患者体内存在失调的“Treg-单核细胞轴”：单核细胞成熟受阻（Cluster 1）与神经损伤标志物 NfL 升高及生存期缩短相关，而调节性 T 细胞（Treg）驱动的免疫配置（Cluster 2）则具有神经保护倾向。研究通过网络传播算法识别了介导这些细胞间通讯的关键细胞因子。

## 为什么相关
尽管分类标签标注为“foundation_model”，但从摘要来看，本研究属于**弱 AI 交叉**。其相关性主要体现在**多模态数据整合与网络分析方法**上。研究采用了基于扩散的网络传播（diffusion-based network propagation）来整合细胞丰度与蛋白质组学数据，这种图论方法是构建生物医学知识图谱或生物基础模型（Foundation Models）中处理异构数据的常用技术。对于病原或临床微生物领域，这种分析免疫应答网络的方法可借鉴用于宿主-病原体相互作用的建模。

## 新颖度判断
新颖度评分为 0.25（较低）。主要原因在于：1. 质谱流式分析外周免疫谱在神经退行性疾病（如 AD、PD）中已有较多研究；2. 样本量（n=81）相对有限；3. 采用的聚类和回归模型属于常规生物统计范畴。其贡献更多在于填补了 PSP/CBS 这一特定罕见 tau 蛋白病的外周免疫图谱空白，而非算法创新。

## 方法与证据
- **数据规模**：60 名 PSP/CBS 患者，21 名对照组，共 81 例样本。
- **技术手段**：29 个标记物的高维质谱流式技术（Mass Cytometry）；血浆 NfL 浓度测定。
- **计算方法**：层次聚类、主成分分析（PCA）、相关网络分析及基于扩散的网络传播。
- **关键指标**：Cluster 1（单核细胞驱动）与 NfL 正相关（p 值未注明，但摘要明确提到显著性）；Cluster 2（Treg 驱动）与 Cox 比例风险模型中的生存期延长相关。

## 应用价值
研究识别出的外周免疫特征（如单核细胞成熟障碍）可作为 PSP/CBS 的**液体生物标志物**，辅助临床预后评估。此外，识别出的 Treg-单核细胞轴通讯分子为开发针对原发性 tau 蛋白病的**免疫调节疗法**提供了潜在靶点。

## 局限与风险
- **AI 深度不足**：摘要未提及使用任何大语言模型或生成式 AI 技术，仅涉及传统机器学习和统计推断。
- **样本局限性**：作为 medRxiv 预印本，其结论尚需更大规模的独立队列验证。
- **因果关系不明**：外周免疫改变是神经退行性变的“因”还是“果”，仅凭横断面数据和 Cox 模型难以完全厘清。

papers.title: Machine learning predicts hepatocellular carcinoma risk from routine clinical data: a large population-based multicentric study.
papers.text:
title: Machine learning predicts hepatocellular carcinoma risk from routine clinical data: a large population-based multicentric study.
source: PubMed
topics: foundation_model_agent
category: foundation_model
why: 这篇工作偏基础模型/Agent方向，可能影响病原检测任务的建模上限，值得关注其任务定义与评测设计。
abstract_zh: 肝细胞癌（HCC）是一种高致死性肿瘤，其风险分层对预后至关重要但仍具挑战。本研究开发了一个基于常规临床数据的可解释机器学习框架 PRE-Screen-HCC。研究利用了来自两个大规模队列（UK Biobank 用于模型开发，All of Us 研究计划用于外部测试）的 900,000 多名受试者和 983 例 HCC 病例的前瞻性多模态数据。研究评估了人口统计学、生活方式、健康记录、血液指标、基因组学和代谢组学等数据模态的个体与累积贡献。结果显示，基于随机森林（Random Forest）的最终模型在内部和外部测试集上均显著优于现有的所有最先进风险评分系统。该模型在不同种族亚群中表现出鲁棒性，提供了全面的可解释性，并公开发布了代码、模型权重和网页计算器，以支持外部验证和智能体（Agent）集成。
abstract: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is a highly fatal tumor, for which risk stratification is crucial, yet remains challenging. Here, we develop an interpretable machine-learning framework for HCC risk stratification based on routinely collected clinical data. We utilize prospectively collected multimodal data from over 900,000 individuals and 983 cases of HCC across two population-scale cohorts: the "UK Biobank study" (development) and the "All of Us Research Program" (external testing). We assess individual and cumulative contributions of data modalities including demographics, lifestyle, health records, blood, genomics, and metabolomics. Our final, random-forest-based models significantly outperform all publicly available state-of-the-art risk-scores on both internal and external test sets. We demonstrate robustness across ethnic subgroups, provide comprehensive interpretability and release all code, model weights and a web-calculator for external validation and agentic integration. Our study presents PRE-Screen-HCC, a robust and interpretable machine-learning framework for HCC risk stratification and early detection.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究构建并验证了名为 **PRE-Screen-HCC** 的机器学习框架，旨在利用常规临床多模态数据进行肝细胞癌（HCC）的风险分层和早期检测。研究核心在于利用超大规模人群队列（>900,000人）证明了整合血液、基因组、代谢组等多维度数据能显著提升风险预测精度。

## 为什么相关
虽然该研究的核心算法是随机森林，属于传统机器学习，但其与 AI/LLM/Agent 领域的交叉点在于：
1. **多模态融合**：涉及基因组学与代谢组学数据，这是病原生信与基因组学研究的高频领域。
2. **智能体集成（Agentic Integration）**：摘要明确提到发布模型权重以支持 Agent 集成，暗示该模型可作为医疗 AI Agent 的一个下游任务工具或插件（Tool Use）。
3. **临床微生物关联**：HCC 风险通常与肝炎病毒（HBV/HCV）感染密切相关，该模型对临床微生物学背景下的癌症预防有参考价值。

## 新颖度判断
**新颖度较低（0.25）**。主要原因在于算法层面使用了相对成熟的随机森林（Random Forest），而非当前 AI 领域前沿的 Transformer 或扩散模型。其贡献主要体现在**数据规模（900,000+ 样本）**和**多中心外部验证**，而非架构创新。所谓的“基础模型”分类可能更多是指其在 HCC 风险预测领域的基准作用，而非模型架构本身。

## 方法与证据
- **数据规模**：使用了 UK Biobank（开发集）和 All of Us Research Program（外部测试集），包含 983 例 HCC 确诊病例。
- **输入模态**：涵盖人口统计学、生活方式、电子健康记录（EHR）、血液检测、基因组学和代谢组学。
- **模型架构**：基于随机森林（Random Forest）。
- **结论证据**：在内部和外部测试中，PRE-Screen-HCC 的表现均优于现有的 SOTA 风险评分系统，且在不同种族亚群中具有鲁棒性。

## 应用价值
- **临床决策**：通过网页计算器提供直接的风险评估工具，辅助早期筛查。
- **科研集成**：开源代码和权重允许研究者将其整合进更复杂的医疗 AI 系统或自动化 Agent 工作流中，作为风险评估的专家模块。

## 局限与风险
- **弱 AI 交叉**：该研究本质上是临床流行病学与传统 ML 的结合，并非强 AI（如大语言模型或生成式 AI）驱动的研究。
- **样本不平衡**：在 900,000 名受试者中仅有 983 例病例（约 0.1%），摘要未说明如何处理极度不平衡的数据对模型特异性的影响。
- **解释性局限**：虽然提到“全面可解释性”，但随机森林的特征重要性分析与临床因果推断之间仍存在鸿沟。

papers.title: Graph Vector Field: A Unified Framework for Multimodal Health Risk Assessment from Heterogeneous Wearable and Environmental Data Streams
papers.text:
title: Graph Vector Field: A Unified Framework for Multimodal Health Risk Assessment from Heterogeneous Wearable and Environmental Data Streams
source: arXiv
topics: foundation_model_agent
category: foundation_model
why: 这篇工作偏基础模型/Agent方向，可能影响病原检测任务的建模上限，值得关注其任务定义与评测设计。
abstract_zh: 数字健康研究在动态图疾病模型、单纯复形拓扑学习和多模态专家混合架构（MoE）方面取得了进展，但这些领域仍处于割裂状态。本文提出图向量场（GVF）框架，将健康风险建模为随时间变化的单纯复形上的向量值场，结合了离散微分几何算子与模态结构化的专家混合模型。风险被表示为向量值上链（cochain），其演化由 Hodge 拉普拉斯算子和离散外演算算子参数化，通过 Helmholtz-Hodge 分解为势驱动（恰当）、循环类（余恰当）和拓扑约束（调和）分量，分别对应可解释的传播、循环和持续风险机制。来自可穿戴传感器、行为/环境背景及临床/基因组数据的多模态输入通过丛结构（bundle-structured）MoE 整合，其中特定模态的潜空间作为纤维附着在基复形上。该方法分离了模态特有的贡献与共享贡献，为模态级可辨识性提供了原则性路径。GVF 将几何动力系统、高阶拓扑与结构化多模态融合集成到统一框架中，用于可解释的风险建模。本文重点阐述数学基础与架构设计，实证验证正在进行中。
abstract: Digital health research has advanced dynamic graph-based disease models, topological learning on simplicial complexes, and multimodal mixture-of-experts architectures, but these strands remain largely disconnected. We propose Graph Vector Field (GVF), a framework that models health risk as a vector-valued field on time-varying simplicial complexes, coupling discrete differential-geometric operators with modality-structured mixture-of-experts. Risk is represented as a vector-valued cochain whose evolution is parameterised with Hodge Laplacians and discrete exterior calculus operators, yielding a Helmholtz-Hodge decomposition into potential-driven (exact), circulation-like (coexact), and topologically constrained (harmonic) components linked to interpretable propagation, cyclic, and persistent risk mechanisms. Multimodal inputs from wearable sensors, behavioural/environmental context, and clinical/genomic data are incorporated through a bundle-structured mixture-of-experts in which modality-specific latent spaces are attached as fibres to the base complex. This separates modality-specific from shared contributions and offers a principled route toward modality-level identifiability. GVF integrates geometric dynamical systems, higher-order topology (enforced indirectly via geometric regularisation and Hodge decomposition), and structured multimodal fusion into a single framework for interpretable, modality-resolved risk modelling. This paper develops the mathematical foundations, architectural design, and formal guarantees; empirical validation is the subject of ongoing work.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究提出了名为 **Graph Vector Field (GVF)** 的统一框架，旨在整合异构健康数据流进行风险评估。其核心是将健康风险视为在**随时间变化的单纯复形（time-varying simplicial complexes）**上演化的向量场。通过引入**Hodge 拉普拉斯算子**和**离散外演算（Discrete Exterior Calculus）**，该框架能够将复杂的风险动态分解为可解释的几何分量，并利用**丛结构专家混合模型（bundle-structured MoE）**融合临床、基因组及传感器数据。

## 为什么相关
在病原检测与临床微生物学领域，该工作具有潜在的交叉价值。虽然摘要主要讨论“健康风险”，但其提到的**“传播机制（propagation mechanisms）”**和**“基因组数据（genomic data）”**的整合方式，可直接外推至传染病时空传播建模或宿主对病原体反应的多组学分析。这种基于几何动力系统的建模方式，为处理高维、非平稳的生物医学数据提供了新的数学工具。

## 新颖度判断
**新颖度高（5.8/10）**。其创新点在于：1. 突破了传统图神经网络（GNN）的局限，采用**单纯复形**捕捉高阶交互；2. 首次将 **Helmholtz-Hodge 分解**应用于健康风险建模，将风险演化拆解为势驱动、循环和调和分量；3. 提出了**丛结构 MoE**，在数学上严格区分了不同模态（如基因组与环境数据）对整体风险的贡献。

## 方法与证据
- **数学方法**：利用**向量值上链（vector-valued cochain）**表示风险，通过 **Hodge Laplacians** 参数化演化过程。
- **架构设计**：采用 **Helmholtz-Hodge 分解**实现可解释性，将风险分为“恰当（exact）”、“余恰当（coexact）”和“调和（harmonic）”分量。
- **数据整合**：设计了**丛结构 MoE**，将特定模态的潜空间作为“纤维（fibres）”附着在基复形上。
- **证据强度**：摘要明确指出“本文开发了数学基础、架构设计和正式保证”，但**“实证验证是正在进行的工作”**，因此目前缺乏实验指标（如 AUC、准确率）的支持。

## 应用价值
该框架对于构建**临床决策支持 Agent**具有重要意义。它能够处理来自可穿戴设备、环境和临床基因组的异构流数据，并提供**模态级可辨识性（modality-level identifiability）**，帮助医生理解风险是源于环境暴露（循环机制）还是生物学基础（持续机制）。在病原学研究中，可用于模拟病原体在复杂社会-生物网络中的演化路径。

## 局限与风险
- **缺乏实证数据**：摘要明确说明实证验证尚未完成，目前仅停留在数学框架和架构设计阶段，其实际预测效能未知。
- **计算复杂度**：涉及单纯复形上的高阶拓扑计算和 Hodge 分解，在大规模临床数据集上的实时性可能面临挑战。
- **弱 AI 交叉**：目前属于**基础模型架构（Foundation Model Architecture）**与数学物理方法的交叉，尚未直接展示在特定病原检测任务上的优越性。

papers.title: Big data in multiple sclerosis.
papers.text:
title: Big data in multiple sclerosis.
source: PubMed
topics: foundation_model_agent
category: methods
why: 这篇工作更像方法创新，可能直接关联 metagenomics、long-read 或 pathogen identification 流程优化。
abstract_zh: 本综述总结了利用多源大数据和先进分析技术在多发性硬化症（MS）领域取得的关键进展。源自MS大数据的真实世界证据（RWE）显著优化了治疗策略，重新定义了疾病进展概念，并完善了预后模型。RWE强调了早期强化治疗相较于阶梯治疗的长期获益，揭示了减量治疗的风险及妊娠期管理的重要性。此外，研究明确了特定高效疗法的有效性与安全性差异，以及换药的关键预测因子。RWE还强调了“独立于复发活动的进展”（PIRA）是导致成人和儿童MS残疾及长期不良预后的核心因素。利用人工智能和大数据驱动的方法建立了理解疾病演变的全方位框架。整合临床、影像（MRI）、基因组学、生物标志物和APP监测指标的多模态大数据框架，显著提升了MS的诊断性能和风险分层能力，为精准医疗提供了强有力的证据支持。
abstract: This review summarizes recent key advancements in multiple sclerosis (MS) achieved through the utilization of big data from diverse sources and advanced analytical techniques. Real-world evidence (RWE) derived from MS big data has significantly enhanced treatment strategies, redefined the concept of disease progression, refined prognostic models, and facilitated personalized medicine. RWE has highlighted the long-term benefits of early intensive treatment compared to escalation strategies, the unfavorable risk profile associated with treatment de-escalation and the importance of managing treatments during pregnancy. Additionally, it has revealed similarities and differences in the effectiveness and safety of specific high-efficacy therapies, as well as key predictors for switching treatments. RWE has also emphasized the central role of progression independent of relapse activity as a significant driver of disability and predictor of unfavorable long-term outcomes in both adult and pediatric onset MS. A data-driven approach utilizing artificial intelligence and big data has established a comprehensive framework for understanding the disease's evolution. Multimodal big data frameworks - encompassing clinical data, MRI, genomics, biomarkers, and app-based metrics - have demonstrated their ability to enhance diagnostic performance and risk stratification in MS. Big data approaches are transforming MS research and clinical practice by providing stronger RWE to guide therapeutic decision-making, refining models of disease progression, and developing more precise prognostic tools.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该综述系统阐述了大数据和人工智能在多发性硬化症（MS）中的应用。核心结论包括：1. 真实世界证据（RWE）证明早期强化治疗优于传统的阶梯治疗策略；2. 明确了“独立于复发活动的进展”（PIRA）是残疾加重的主要驱动力；3. 构建了整合临床、MRI、基因组学及生物标志物的多模态框架，用于优化诊断和风险分层。

## 为什么相关
本研究涉及**基因组学**与**AI交叉领域**。虽然其核心关注点是临床神经病学，但其提到的“多模态大数据框架”整合了基因组学数据和生物标志物，这与病原生信及精准医学中的多组学整合分析方法高度相关。对于开发针对复杂疾病的AI预后模型具有参考意义。

## 新颖度判断
**新颖度：中等偏高（5.25）**。其创新点在于将传统的临床RWE与现代AI驱动的多模态数据（特别是APP监测指标和基因组学）相结合，打破了单一临床指标的局限，提出了更全面的疾病演变理解框架，尤其是对PIRA在成人和儿童患者中作用的统一认识。

## 方法与证据
- **方法**：采用数据驱动的方法，利用人工智能技术对来自多源的真实世界大数据进行分析。
- **数据规模与对象**：摘要未说明具体样本量，但明确涵盖了成人及儿童发病的MS患者。
- **证据指标**：通过对比“早期强化治疗”与“阶梯治疗”的长期获益、评估“减量治疗”的风险概况、以及分析MRI和基因组学等指标在诊断性能上的提升来提供证据。

## 应用价值
1. **临床决策支持**：为医生提供关于换药时机、妊娠期用药管理及治疗强度选择的RWE指导。
2. **精准预后**：利用多模态框架开发更精确的预后工具，实现风险分层。
3. **疾病定义更新**：推动临床对MS进展机制（如PIRA）的重新认知，影响未来药物研发终点设定。

## 局限与风险
- **AI交叉深度**：属于**中等强度AI交叉**。摘要中提到的AI主要用于“建立框架”和“风险分层”，更偏向于传统机器学习或统计建模，未明确提及是否应用了LLM或Agent等前沿架构。
- **数据局限**：摘要未说明不同来源大数据（如APP指标与临床数据）之间的异质性处理方法及数据隐私保护风险。
- **模型透明度**：摘要未说明AI模型的解释性，这在临床决策中至关重要。

papers.title: Comparative evaluation of multimodal point-of-care tests to differentiate gram-negative from gram-positive infections in critically ill adults: a diagnostic accuracy study.
papers.text:
title: Comparative evaluation of multimodal point-of-care tests to differentiate gram-negative from gram-positive infections in critically ill adults: a diagnostic accuracy study.
source: PubMed
topics: foundation_model_agent
category: clinical_application
why: 这篇工作更接近临床/监测落地，适合评估其对快速识别、预警或治疗辅助的实际价值。
abstract_zh: 针对脓毒症患者在培养结果前过度使用广谱抗生素的问题，本研究系统评估了区分革兰氏阴性（GN）与革兰氏阳性（GP）感染的即时检测（POCT）方法。研究检索了 2005 年至 2025 年间 86 项相关研究，对 72 项研究进行了定量合成，涵盖宿主反应生物标志物、病原体定向检测、组学测试及临床参数。结果显示，病原体定向快速检测（如 PCR、MALDI-TOF MS）表现出最高的准确性，合并灵敏度和特异性均 >0.90，AUC 达 0.97-0.99。在生物标志物中，降钙素原（PCT）具有明显的阈值依赖性，3-5 ng/mL 范围的区分效果最平衡（灵敏度 0.84，特异性 0.83，AUC 0.90）。组学方法准确性波动较大，而单纯临床参数的灵敏度和特异性均低于 0.70。研究表明，病原体定向检测是区分 GN/GP 最可靠的手段，PCT 3-5 ng/mL 可作为调整经验性抗生素治疗的实用阈值。
abstract: Patients with suspected sepsis often receive broad-spectrum antibiotics before culture results are available. A rapid point-of-care test (POCT) that indicates Gram-negative (GN) versus Gram-positive (GP) infection could help tailor empiric therapy. We systematically compared available POCT for GN/GP differentiation and, for biomarkers, examined clinically usable thresholds. PubMed, Embase, Web of Science and the Cochrane Library (January 2005 to August 2025) were searched for studies in adults with sepsis that evaluated rapid tests to distinguish GN from GP infection. We pooled host-response biomarkers, pathogen-directed assays, omics-based tests, and clinical-parameter approaches using a bivariate random-effects model to obtain pooled sensitivity, specificity, area under the curve (AUC) and Youden's index. For biomarkers reported at multiple cut-offs, clinically relevant strata were prespecified and compared. Of 86 included studies, 72 were eligible for quantitative synthesis. Pathogen-directed rapid assays (PCR, MALDI-TOF MS) showed the highest and most consistent accuracy (pooled sensitivity and specificity > 0.90; AUC 0.97-0.99; Youden 0.85-0.92). Among the biomarker studies, procalcitonin (PCT) showed clear threshold dependence: the 3-5 ng/mL stratum provided the most balanced discrimination (sensitivity 0.84; specificity 0.83; AUC 0.90; Youden 0.67), whereas higher cut-offs did not yield further gains. Omics-based approaches showed variable accuracy, and clinical-parameter approaches alone achieved sensitivity and specificity < 0.70. In adults with sepsis, pathogen-directed rapid assays are the most reliable POCT for early GN/GP differentiation. When biomarker testing is available, a PCT range of 3-5 ng/mL is a pragmatic working threshold that can support earlier tailoring of empiric antimicrobial therapy.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究是一项系统综述和荟萃分析，旨在评估多种即时检测（POCT）手段在重症患者中区分革兰氏阴性（GN）与革兰氏阳性（GP）感染的诊断准确性。研究对比了病原体直接检测、宿主生物标志物、组学技术及临床参数四类方法。

## 为什么相关
该研究直接关联临床微生物学与精准用药。在病原学诊断的“窗口期”，快速区分 GN/GP 感染对于抗生素降阶梯治疗至关重要。虽然匹配主题标注为 `foundation_model_agent`，但从摘要看，该研究属于**弱 AI 交叉**，主要利用二元随机效应模型进行统计学荟萃分析，而非直接应用大模型或智能体技术。

## 新颖度判断
新颖度较低（0.25）。其贡献在于对 2005-2025 年长达 20 年的数据进行了系统性梳理，并针对 PCT 提出了具体的临床可用阈值（3-5 ng/mL），而非开发了全新的诊断技术或 AI 算法。

## 方法与证据
- **数据规模**：纳入 86 项研究，其中 72 项进入定量合成。
- **检测手段对比**：
    - **病原体定向检测（PCR、MALDI-TOF MS）**：表现最优，AUC 0.97-0.99，Youden 指数 0.85-0.92。
    - **生物标志物（PCT）**：在 3-5 ng/mL 阈值下，AUC 为 0.90，灵敏度 0.84，特异性 0.83。
    - **组学与临床参数**：组学表现不稳定（摘要未给出具体指标）；临床参数表现最差，灵敏度与特异性均 <0.70。

## 应用价值
为临床医生提供了明确的决策支持：
1. 确认了 PCR 和 MALDI-TOF MS 在快速诊断中的核心地位。
2. 为 PCT 的临床应用提供了务实的“操作阈值”（3-5 ng/mL），有助于在缺乏高级检测手段时辅助经验性抗生素调整。

## 局限与风险
- **组学技术不成熟**：摘要指出组学方法（Omics-based）准确性差异较大，暗示其目前尚不具备临床普适性。
- **临床参数局限**：单纯依赖临床表现（Clinical-parameter）无法有效区分感染类型。
- **数据滞后性**：虽然涵盖至 2025 年，但荟萃分析依赖于已发表研究，可能存在发表偏倚，且对于最新开发的 AI 辅助诊断工具覆盖不足。

papers.title: Multi-omics biomarkers in psychiatric disorders diagnosis and stratification.
papers.text:
title: Multi-omics biomarkers in psychiatric disorders diagnosis and stratification.
source: PubMed
topics: foundation_model_agent
category: clinical_application
why: 这篇工作更接近临床/监测落地，适合评估其对快速识别、预警或治疗辅助的实际价值。
abstract_zh: 精神疾病的精准诊断与分层因缺乏客观生物标志物且依赖主观临床标准而面临挑战。基因组学、转录组学、蛋白质组学、代谢组学和表观基因组学等多组学技术的进展，深化了对精神分裂症、双相情感障碍、重度抑郁症和自闭症谱系障碍等复杂神经精神疾病的理解。本综述评估了精神医学领域多组学研究的现状，重点关注方法学创新、整合策略以及在标志物发现和临床实施中的转化潜力。通过合成不同分子层面的数据，多组学方法能够从系统水平将精神疾病视为受分子、细胞、环境和神经回路相互作用影响的多因素实体。尽管在提高诊断准确性和个性化治疗方面取得了进展，但仍存在数据异质性、分析复杂性以及分子特征与临床表型之间的转化鸿沟等障碍。本文系统探讨了各组学领域的贡献、多模态数据整合的新兴框架、系统生物学与网络模型的作用，以及大型联盟在推动临床转化中的影响。
abstract: The precise diagnosis and stratification of psychiatric disorders remain formidable challenges in modern medicine, hindered by the absence of objective biomarkers and reliance on subjective clinical criteria. Recent advances in multi-omics technologies, including genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, metabolomics, and epigenomics, have revolutionized our understanding of complex neuropsychiatric conditions such as schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, major depressive disorder, and autism spectrum disorder. This review critically evaluates the current landscape of multi-omics research in psychiatry, highlighting methodological innovations, integrative strategies, and translational potential for biomarker discovery and clinical implementation. By synthesizing data across diverse molecular layers, multi-omics approaches enable a systems-level view of psychiatric disorders as multifactorial entities shaped by molecular, cellular, environmental, and neurocircuitry interactions. Despite promising advances in diagnostic accuracy and personalized treatment, significant barriers persist, including data heterogeneity, analytical complexity, and the translational gap between molecular signatures and clinical phenotypes. This review systematically explores the contributions of individual omics domains, emerging frameworks for multimodal data integration, the role of systems biology and network-based models, and the impact of large-scale consortia in driving clinical translation.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该综述系统性地探讨了利用多组学技术（包括基因组、转录组、蛋白质组、代谢组和表观组）来解决精神分裂症、双相障碍、重度抑郁症和自闭症谱系障碍的诊断与分层难题。核心结论是多组学整合能提供系统水平的视角，但临床转化仍受限于数据异质性和分析复杂性。

## 为什么相关
本研究与“foundation_model_agent”主题的相关度主要体现在“多模态数据整合（multimodal data integration）”上。在构建临床智能体（Agent）或辅助诊断大模型时，如何处理和融合来自不同分子层面的异构数据是核心技术挑战。该综述提供的整合框架和网络模型（network-based models）为AI模型的数据预处理和特征工程提供了理论支撑。

## 新颖度判断
新颖度较低（0.25）。这是一篇综述性文章，而非提出原创性算法或发现新生物标志物的实验研究。其价值在于对现有“多模态整合框架”和“系统生物学模型”的总结，而非技术突破。

## 方法与证据
摘要提到的方法包括：1. **多组学合成分析**：涵盖基因、转录、蛋白、代谢等多个分子层面；2. **整合策略**：提及了“新兴的多模态数据整合框架”和“基于网络的模型（network-based models）”；3. **研究对象**：明确针对精神分裂症、双相障碍、抑郁症和自闭症。摘要未说明具体的样本量规模、具体的机器学习算法名称或诊断准确率（AUC）等量化指标。

## 应用价值
该研究对临床微生物学与精神医学的交叉落地有参考价值，特别是通过客观的分子特征（生物标志物）取代主观的临床量表评分。这为开发能够自动识别精神疾病预警信号的临床决策支持系统（CDSS）提供了多组学数据基础。

## 局限与风险
属于**弱 AI 交叉**。虽然提及了“分析复杂性”和“整合框架”，但并未深入讨论深度学习、大语言模型或智能体在其中的具体应用。摘要明确指出存在“转化鸿沟（translational gap）”，即分子特征与临床表型之间难以一一对应，且数据异质性（data heterogeneity）可能导致AI模型在不同人群中的泛化性较差。

papers.title: CRISPR/Cas12a: A Comprehensive Review from Structural Foundations to Applications in Nucleic Acid Precision Detection.
papers.text:
title: CRISPR/Cas12a: A Comprehensive Review from Structural Foundations to Applications in Nucleic Acid Precision Detection.
source: PubMed
topics: foundation_model_agent
category: clinical_application
why: 这篇工作更接近临床/监测落地，适合评估其对快速识别、预警或治疗辅助的实际价值。
abstract_zh: CRISPR/Cas12a 技术凭借其独特的反向切割（trans-cleavage）活性，已从基因编辑工具演变为强大的分子检测工具。本文系统阐述了 Cas12a 的结构基础与分子机制，重点探讨了该技术如何将特定核酸识别转化为级联信号放大。其应用涵盖病原体诊断、物种鉴定、食品安全及中药材鉴别。通过与等温扩增及多模态检测平台集成，Cas12a 推动了分子诊断向便携化、可视化和定量化方向发展。文章进一步讨论了在灵敏度、定量准确性、crRNA 设计及标准化方面的挑战，并展望了其与微流控和人工智能（AI）等前沿技术融合的未来方向，为开发下一代精准生物传感平台提供了前瞻性视角。
abstract: CRISPR/Cas12a technology, characterized by its distinctive trans-cleavage activity, has evolved beyond its gene-editing function to emerge as a powerful tool for molecular detection. This review systematically delineates its structural foundation and molecular mechanism, with a focus on how the technology converts specific nucleic acid recognition into cascade signal amplification. Its applications span pathogen diagnosis, species identification, food safety, and authentication of traditional Chinese medicines. Through integration with isothermal amplification and multimodal detection platforms, Cas12a has driven molecular diagnostics toward portability, visualization, and quantification. The review further discusses challenges related to sensitivity, quantitative accuracy, crRNA design, and standardization, while outlining future directions through convergence with cutting-edge technologies such as microfluidics and artificial intelligence, offering a forward-looking perspective for the development of next-generation precision biosensing platforms.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该综述系统性地梳理了 CRISPR/Cas12a 系统从蛋白质结构、分子水平的反向切割机制到核酸精准检测的应用全景，重点分析了其作为信号放大器在分子诊断中的技术演进。

## 为什么相关
该研究直接关联临床微生物学中的病原体快速诊断任务。对于 AI/LLM 领域，其提到的“crRNA 设计”和“与 AI 融合”是当前生成式模型在生物序列优化中的热点方向，有助于实现检测探针的自动化设计。

## 新颖度判断
新颖度较低（0.25）。作为一篇综述，其价值在于对现有 Cas12a 检测技术的整合（如等温扩增、多模态平台），而非提出原创性的生物学发现或 AI 算法。其 AI 相关性属于“弱交叉”，仅作为未来展望提及。

## 方法与证据
摘要提到了 Cas12a 的结构基础分析及其特有的反向切割活性。证据链涵盖了该技术在病原体诊断、物种鉴定、食品安全和中药鉴别中的实际应用案例。技术集成方面，重点提及了与等温扩增（isothermal amplification）和多模态检测平台的结合，以实现可视化和定量化产出。

## 应用价值
在临床和现场检测（POCT）中具有极高价值，特别是推动了检测设备的便携化。通过与微流控和 AI 结合，有望解决复杂样本中的高通量自动化分析问题，提升预警和辅助诊断的效率。

## 局限与风险
摘要明确指出该技术目前面临四大挑战：一是灵敏度（sensitivity）尚需优化；二是定量准确性（quantitative accuracy）不足；三是 crRNA 设计缺乏标准化流程；四是整体检测体系的标准化（standardization）有待完善。

papers.title: Title: Multimodal profiling reveals Mycobacterium tuberculosis restricts lung mitochondrial immunometabolism to promote pathogenesis
papers.text:
title: Title: Multimodal profiling reveals Mycobacterium tuberculosis restricts lung mitochondrial immunometabolism to promote pathogenesis
source: bioRxiv
topics: foundation_model_agent
category: foundation_model
why: 这篇工作偏基础模型/Agent方向，可能影响病原检测任务的建模上限，值得关注其任务定义与评测设计。
abstract_zh: 结核分枝杆菌（Mtb）感染早期肺部免疫反应的塑造机制尚不明确。本研究利用高维流式细胞术、单细胞转录组学和非靶向代谢组学，定义了小鼠气溶胶感染 Mtb 后产生保护性与致病性结果前的早期肺部免疫环境。研究发现，Mtb 诱导肺部持续糖酵解，同时限制氧化磷酸化（OXPHOS）并损害线粒体，该过程部分通过 Mtb 丝氨酸蛋白酶 Hip1 实现，导致能量输出降低及巨噬细胞与 T 细胞相互作用受损，从而促进致病性免疫。相反，早期肺部线粒体 OXPHOS、氨基酸代谢和脂肪酸氧化的强力诱导可产生高 ATP 输出，增强先天免疫-T 细胞信号网络，激发保护性免疫。此外，研究还鉴定出一种与动物模型和人类 Mtb 感染保护性结果相关的线粒体免疫代谢特征。本研究揭示了 Mtb 通过诱导线粒体功能障碍操纵肺部免疫代谢的机制，强调了维持肺部线粒体代谢完整性对产生保护性免疫的关键作用。
abstract: Early events in the lung that shape protective immune responses to M. tuberculosis (Mtb) infection are not well understood but are critical for developing better vaccines and immunomodulatory therapies for tuberculosis. Here, we used high-dimensional flow cytometry, single-cell transcriptomics, and untargeted metabolomics to define the early lung immune environment that precedes the development of protective versus pathogenic outcomes following aerosolized Mtb infection of mice. We show that Mtb induced sustained glycolysis in the lung while restricting oxidative phosphorylation (OXPHOS) and impairing mitochondria, in part through the Mtb serine protease Hip1, leading to low energy output and suboptimal macrophage-T cell interactions that promoted pathogenic immunity. However, robust induction of mitochondrial OXPHOS, amino acid metabolism, and fatty acid oxidation in the early lung resulted in high ATP output and enhanced innate-T cell signaling networks that stimulated protective immune responses. Moreover, we identified a novel mitochondrial immunometabolic lung signature associated with protective outcomes to Mtb infection in animal models and humans. Our studies identify induction of mitochondrial dysfunction as a mechanism employed by Mtb to manipulate lung immunometabolism to its benefit and reveal that maintenance of intact mitochondrial metabolism in the early lung is pivotal for generating protective outcomes to Mtb infection.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究通过多组学技术揭示了结核分枝杆菌（Mtb）通过破坏宿主肺部线粒体代谢来逃避免疫的机制。核心结论是 Mtb 利用其丝氨酸蛋白酶 Hip1 抑制氧化磷酸化（OXPHOS），迫使免疫环境转向低能量输出的糖酵解模式，从而削弱巨噬细胞与 T 细胞的协同作用；而维持高水平的线粒体代谢（如脂肪酸氧化和氨基酸代谢）则是产生保护性免疫的关键。

## 为什么相关
虽然该论文被分类在基础模型（foundation_model）路径下，但从摘要看，其属于**弱 AI 交叉**。它并未直接构建或使用大语言模型或 Agent 架构，而是提供了高质量的多模态数据集（单细胞转录组+非靶向代谢组+高维流式）。这类研究对于构建病原-宿主相互作用的“生物学基础模型”具有重要的数据支撑价值，其定义的“免疫代谢特征”可作为 AI 预测模型的关键特征输入。

## 新颖度判断
新颖度中等偏高。研究首次明确了 Mtb 丝氨酸蛋白酶 Hip1 在调控宿主线粒体免疫代谢中的具体作用，并跨物种（小鼠与人类）鉴定出了一套通用的线粒体免疫代谢保护性签名（Signature），这为结核病的免疫干预提供了新靶点。

## 方法与证据
研究采用了以下方法和证据：
1. **多模态分析**：结合了高维流式细胞术、单细胞转录组学（scRNA-seq）和非靶向代谢组学。
2. **实验模型**：使用小鼠气溶胶感染模型，并验证了人类数据。
3. **关键因子**：确定了 Mtb 蛋白酶 Hip1 是导致线粒体受损和 OXPHOS 受限的诱因。
4. **代谢指标**：通过 ATP 输出量、氨基酸代谢和脂肪酸氧化水平来区分保护性与致病性免疫反应。

## 应用价值
1. **药物研发**：Hip1 蛋白酶可作为新型抗结核药物的潜在靶点。
2. **疫苗评价**：研究发现的线粒体免疫代谢特征可用于评估新型结核疫苗的保护效力。
3. **免疫治疗**：通过调节肺部线粒体代谢（如增强 OXPHOS）来辅助治疗结核病。

## 局限与风险
摘要未说明 Hip1 导致线粒体损伤的具体分子通路（即 Hip1 的直接底物是什么）；此外，虽然提到了人类数据关联，但摘要未说明人类样本的规模及该代谢特征在不同临床表型（如潜伏感染与活动性结核）中的差异显著性。该研究主要基于小鼠模型，其代谢特征向临床转化的稳健性仍需验证。

papers.title: Contrastive multimodal deep learning for survival prediction in grade 2/3 gliomas.
papers.text:
title: Contrastive multimodal deep learning for survival prediction in grade 2/3 gliomas.
source: PubMed
topics: foundation_model_agent
category: methods
why: 这篇工作更像方法创新，可能直接关联 metagenomics、long-read 或 pathogen identification 流程优化。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: Accurate survival prediction for grade 2/3 glioma patients remains challenging due to tumor biological heterogeneity and limitations of current prognostic methods that rely on single-modality data. We developed a multimodal deep learning framework integrating histopathology whole-slide images, somatic mutations, and clinical-demographic data. A three-stage training pipeline combined contrastive learning with survival-specific optimization to align cross-modal representations. The framework was trained on 498 grade 2/3 glioma patients from TCGA and evaluated using 5-fold cross-validation and an independent Dartmouth-Hitchcock Medical Center (DHMC) cohort (n = 61). The contrastive multimodal model achieved a c-index of 0.91 (95% CI: 0.84 to 0.96), significantly outperforming the unimodal models (image-only = 0.76; non-image-only = 0.87) and showing an improvement over the non-contrastive multimodal model (c-index = 0.89), although this difference was not statistically significant. Kaplan-Meier analysis demonstrated clear survival separation across risk strata (log-rank P = 4.4 × 10-5). Contrastive learning improved representation clustering quality, with silhouette scores increasing from 0.20 to 0.24 (P = 0.05). External evaluation on the DHMC cohort achieved a c-index of 0.87 (95% CI: 0.77 to 0.95) after domain adaptation. Contrastive multimodal learning significantly enhances survival prediction in grade 2/3 gliomas by effectively integrating histopathology, genomics, and clinical data. This annotation-free approach enables early risk stratification using routinely collected data and shows promise for informing personalized treatment decisions and clinical trial stratification.

papers.title: Multimodal predictions of end stage chronic kidney disease from asymptomatic individuals for discovery of genomic biomarkers.
papers.text:
title: Multimodal predictions of end stage chronic kidney disease from asymptomatic individuals for discovery of genomic biomarkers.
source: PubMed
topics: foundation_model_agent
category: foundation_model
why: 这篇工作偏基础模型/Agent方向，可能影响病原检测任务的建模上限，值得关注其任务定义与评测设计。
abstract_zh: 慢性肾脏病（CKD）影响全球约10%的人口，且在早期往往难以察觉。本研究利用英国生物样本库（UKBB）构建了一个包含46,986名具有基因组、临床和人口统计学数据患者的CKD队列，其中2,151名子集成员拥有全身磁共振成像（MRI）扫描数据。研究利用该多模态队列，成功对最初健康的个体进行了5年内终末期肾病（ESRD）风险预测（n=210，5折交叉验证AUC为0.804±0.03），并在大队列中验证了发病时间预测及全基因组关联分析（GWAS）。通过提取临床、表型和遗传特征，研究识别出一组与线粒体/细胞死亡、肾脏发育及功能相关的未报道显著SNP。特别是，研究证明了SNP rs1383063的风险等位基因（在人群中占比30%，推测调节足细胞裂孔隔膜表达的MAGI-1基因）是ESRD的强预测因子，能有效分层高龄男性群体。
abstract: Chronic kidney disease (CKD) is a complex condition where the kidneys are damaged and progressively lose their ability to filter blood, 10% of the world population have the disease that often goes undetected until it is too late for intervention. Using the UK Biobank (UKBB) we constructed a CKD cohort of patients (n = 46,986) with genomic, clinical and demographic data available, a subset (n = 2,151) having also whole body Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) scans. We used this multimodal cohort to successfully predict, from initially healthy patients, their 5-year outcomes for End-Stage Renal Disease (ESRD, n = 210, AUC = 0.804 ± 0.03 with 5 fold cross-validation) and the larger cohort for validation to predict time-to ESRD and perform Genome-wide association studies (GWAS). Extracting important clinical, phenotypic and genetic features from the models, we were able to stratify the cohorts based on a novel set of significant previously unreported SNPs related to mitochondria/cell death, kidney development and function. In particular, we show that the risk allele of SNP rs1383063 present in 30% of the population irrespective of ancestry and putatively regulating MAGI-1, a gene expressed in the podocyte slit diaphragm, is a strong predictor of ESRD and stratifies male populations of older age.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究利用UK Biobank的大规模多模态数据（基因组、临床指标及全身MRI），构建了针对无症状人群的终末期肾病（ESRD）预测模型，并结合GWAS发现了新的遗传生物标志物（如rs1383063）。

## 为什么相关
虽然该研究主要针对慢性病（CKD），但其“多模态数据融合”与“从无症状到疾病进展的预测建模”思路，对于病原感染后的重症转化预测、宿主基因组对病原易感性分析具有方法论上的借鉴意义。需注意，此研究属于典型的临床基因组学AI应用，而非直接的病原微生物研究。

## 新颖度判断
**中等偏高**。其新颖性在于将全身MRI影像特征与大规模基因组数据（n=46,986）结合进行ESRD的超前预测（5年窗口期），并识别出此前未报道的与线粒体和足细胞功能相关的SNP（rs1383063）。

## 方法与证据
- **数据规模**：使用UKBB队列，总样本46,986人，MRI子集2,151人。
- **模型性能**：在210例ESRD阳性样本的预测中，5折交叉验证的AUC达到0.804±0.03。
- **生物学证据**：通过GWAS识别出rs1383063，该SNP在30%的人群中存在，被认为调节MAGI-1基因，该基因在肾脏足细胞裂孔隔膜中表达，实验证据支持其作为高龄男性ESRD风险分层的关键指标。

## 应用价值
该模型可用于体检人群的早期筛查，识别出具有高ESRD风险的无症状个体。其发现的MAGI-1相关SNP为肾脏病的精准医疗和药物靶点开发提供了遗传学依据。

## 局限与风险
- **AI交叉强度**：属于**弱AI交叉**（传统机器学习/深度学习预测模型），摘要未提及使用了大语言模型（LLM）或智能体（Agent）技术。
- **样本局限**：ESRD阳性事件数较少（n=210），可能存在过拟合风险。
- **泛化性**：虽然摘要称SNP影响不受祖先背景影响，但主要数据源于UKBB（欧洲裔为主），在其他族裔中的预测效力需进一步验证。

papers.title: Using image classifiers to predict CMT2A disease-relevant mitochondrial motility phenotypes in iPSC motor neurons
papers.text:
title: Using image classifiers to predict CMT2A disease-relevant mitochondrial motility phenotypes in iPSC motor neurons
source: bioRxiv
topics: sequencing_bioinformatics
category: methods
why: 这篇工作更像方法创新，可能直接关联 metagenomics、long-read 或 pathogen identification 流程优化。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 2A (CMT2A) is a genetic disease characterized by autosomal dominant MFN2 mutations and dysregulated mitochondrial trafficking. While there is currently no FDA-approved CMT2A therapy, the recent development of iPSC motor neuron model systems, high-throughput imaging platforms, and CRISPR-based gene editing technologies holds promise for screening new therapies at scale in vitro. A critical roadblock for therapeutic screening is the development of scalable and robust computational methods to assess the mitochondrial trafficking phenotypes, healthy or diseased, of each iPSC motor neuron sample. To address this gap, we developed a vision transformer (ViT) based classification framework that predicts disease phenotypes using kymographs, an image transformation that captures particle movement along a prespecified path, such as mitochondrial movement along axons. We show that our classification approach more accurately discriminates healthy MFN2 wild-type (WT) from diseased MFN2 R364W-mutant (R364W) iPSCs than alternative summary statistics, such as mitochondrial speed and fraction of stationary mitochondria that are directly extracted from kymographs. Furthermore, we show that our model maintains high accuracy when deployed on a biological replicate holdout dataset. An analysis of ViT patch embeddings of the kymographs shows that mitochondria with highly variable sizes and many intersection events most strongly associate with R364W diseased kymographs. The computational approach demonstrated in this paper has broad applicability for future high-throughput screens where organelle trafficking along axons plays a key role in disease pathogenesis.

papers.title: PluriHopRAG: Exhaustive, Recall-Sensitive QA Through Corpus-Specific Document Structure Learning
papers.text:
title: PluriHopRAG: Exhaustive, Recall-Sensitive QA Through Corpus-Specific Document Structure Learning
source: arXiv
topics: 
category: foundation_model
why: 这篇工作偏基础模型/Agent方向，可能影响病原检测任务的建模上限，值得关注其任务定义与评测设计。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has been used in question answering (QA) systems to improve performance when relevant information is in one (single-hop) or multiple (multi-hop) passages. However, many real life scenarios (e.g. dealing with financial, legal, medical reports) require checking all documents for relevant information without a clear stopping condition. We term these pluri-hop questions, and formalize them by 3 conditions - recall sensitivity, exhaustiveness, and exactness. To study this setting, we introduce PluriHopWIND, a multilingual diagnostic benchmark of 48 pluri-hop questions over 191 real wind-industry reports, with high repetitiveness to reflect the challenge of distractors in real-world datasets. Naive, graph-based, and multimodal RAG methods only reach up to 40% statement-wise F1 on PluriHopWIND. Motivated by this, we propose PluriHopRAG, which learns from synthetic examples to decompose queries according to corpus-specific document structure, and employs a cross-encoder filter at the document level to minimize costly LLM reasoning. We test PluriHopRAG on PluriHopWIND and the Loong benchmark built on financial, legal and scientific reports. On PluriHopWIND, our method shows 18-52% F1 score improvement across base LLMs, while on Loong, we show 33% improvement over long-context reasoning and 52% improvement over naive RAG.

papers.title: ARK: Answer-Centric Retriever Tuning via KG-augmented Curriculum Learning
papers.text:
title: ARK: Answer-Centric Retriever Tuning via KG-augmented Curriculum Learning
source: arXiv
topics: 
category: foundation_model
why: 这篇工作偏基础模型/Agent方向，可能影响病原检测任务的建模上限，值得关注其任务定义与评测设计。
abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）在知识密集型任务中表现出色，但在长文本场景下，检索器往往因无法识别稀疏但关键的证据而面临瓶颈。传统的检索器多基于查询-文档相似度进行优化，难以对齐生成准确答案的下游目标。为此，我们提出了 ARK 框架，通过“答案对齐”优化检索器。该方法首先通过评估文本块对于生成正确答案的充分性来识别高质量正样本；随后采用基于课程学习的对比学习方案进行微调。该方案利用大语言模型（LLM）构建的知识图谱（KG）生成增强查询，从而挖掘难度递增的硬负样本，训练检索器从细微干扰项中区分出答案充分的文本块。在 Ultradomain 和 LongBench 基准测试的 10 个数据集上的实验表明，ARK 在不改变架构的情况下，较基础模型性能提升了 14.5%，达到了 SOTA 水平，并保持了长文本 RAG 的高效性。
abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has emerged as a powerful framework for knowledge-intensive tasks, yet its effectiveness in long-context scenarios is often bottlenecked by the retriever's inability to distinguish sparse yet crucial evidence. Standard retrievers, optimized for query-document similarity, frequently fail to align with the downstream goal of generating a precise answer. To bridge this gap, we propose a novel fine-tuning framework that optimizes the retriever for Answer Alignment. Specifically, we first identify high-quality positive chunks by evaluating their sufficiency to generate the correct answer. We then employ a curriculum-based contrastive learning scheme to fine-tune the retriever. This curriculum leverages LLM-constructed Knowledge Graphs (KGs) to generate augmented queries, which in turn mine progressively challenging hard negatives. This process trains the retriever to distinguish the answer-sufficient positive chunks from these nuanced distractors, enhancing its generalization. Extensive experiments on 10 datasets from the Ultradomain and LongBench benchmarks demonstrate that our fine-tuned retriever achieves state-of-the-art performance, improving 14.5\% over the base model without substantial architectural modifications and maintaining strong efficiency for long-context RAG. Our work presents a robust and effective methodology for building truly answer-centric retrievers. Source Code is available on https://github.com/valleysprings/ARK/.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究提出了名为 ARK 的检索器微调框架，旨在解决长文本 RAG 中检索结果与答案生成目标不一致的问题。其核心是通过 LLM 构建的知识图谱（KG）驱动课程学习，使检索器能够精准识别对回答问题具有“充分性”的文本块，而非仅仅计算语义相似度。

## 为什么相关
在病原生物学和临床微生物学领域，研究人员常需从海量文献或长篇基因组注释报告中提取特定证据（如耐药基因位点、罕见病原体特征）。ARK 提升了在长文本中定位稀疏关键证据的能力，对于构建更精准的临床决策支持 Agent 或病原学知识库检索系统具有潜在的底层技术支撑作用。

## 新颖度判断
新颖度较高。该工作跳出了传统的“查询-文档”匹配范式，引入了“答案对齐（Answer Alignment）”概念，并创新性地结合了 LLM 生成的知识图谱来自动化构建难度递增的负样本（Curriculum Learning），这在检索器微调领域具有较强的启发性。

## 方法与证据
研究采用了两阶段方法：1. **正样本识别**：评估文本块对生成正确答案的充分性；2. **课程对比学习**：利用 LLM 辅助构建的 KG 生成增强查询，挖掘硬负样本。实验在 Ultradomain 和 LongBench 的 10 个数据集上进行，结果显示 ARK 在不改变模型架构的前提下，比基础模型性能提升了 14.5%，证明了其在处理复杂长文本任务时的优越性。

## 应用价值
对于临床微生物学领域，该技术可用于优化针对复杂病例的文献检索工具，帮助 AI Agent 从长篇累牍的临床指南或研究论文中准确锁定支持诊断的特定证据。其高效性（无需大幅改动架构）也便于集成到现有的生物信息学工作流中。

## 局限与风险
1. **领域知识局限**：摘要未说明该框架在生物医学等专业垂直领域的 KG 构建效果，通用 LLM 构建的 KG 可能在病原学专业术语上存在偏差。2. **计算开销**：虽然检索高效，但微调阶段依赖 LLM 构建 KG 和多轮课程学习，初期训练成本可能较高。3. **数据依赖**：性能提升高度依赖于“答案充分”的正样本标注质量。

papers.title: SciResearcher: Scaling Deep Research Agents for Frontier Scientific Reasoning
papers.text:
title: SciResearcher: Scaling Deep Research Agents for Frontier Scientific Reasoning
source: arXiv
topics: 
category: foundation_model
why: 这篇工作偏基础模型/Agent方向，可能影响病原检测任务的建模上限，值得关注其任务定义与评测设计。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: Frontier scientific reasoning is rapidly emerging as a key foundation for advancing AI agents in automated scientific discovery. Deep research agents offer a promising approach to this challenge. These models develop robust problem-solving capabilities through post-training on information-seeking tasks, which are typically curated via knowledge graph construction or iterative web browsing. However, these strategies face inherent limitations in frontier science, where domain-specific knowledge is scattered across sparse and heterogeneous academic sources, and problem solving requires sophisticated computation and reasoning far beyond factual recall. To bridge this gap, we introduce SciResearcher, a fully automated agentic framework for frontier-science data construction. SciResearcher synthesizes diverse conceptual and computational tasks grounded in academic evidence, while eliciting information acquisition, tool-integrated reasoning, and long-horizon capabilities. Leveraging the curated data for supervised fine-tuning and agentic reinforcement learning, we develop SciResearcher-8B, an agent foundation model that achieves 19.46% on the HLE-Bio/Chem-Gold benchmark, establishing a new state of the art at its parameter scale and surpassing several larger proprietary agents. It further achieves 13-15% absolute gains on SuperGPQA-Hard-Biology and TRQA-Literature benchmarks. Overall, SciResearcher introduces a new paradigm for automated data construction for frontier scientific reasoning and offers a scalable path toward future scientific agents.

papers.title: Latent-Y: A Lab-Validated Autonomous Agent for De Novo Drug Design
papers.text:
title: Latent-Y: A Lab-Validated Autonomous Agent for De Novo Drug Design
source: arXiv
topics: 
category: foundation_model
why: 这篇工作偏基础模型/Agent方向，可能影响病原检测任务的建模上限，值得关注其任务定义与评测设计。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: Drug discovery relies on iterative expert workflows that are slow to parallelize and difficult to scale. Here we introduce Latent-Y, an AI agent that autonomously executes complete antibody design campaigns from text prompts, covering literature review, target analysis, epitope identification, candidate design, computational validation, and selection of lab-ready sequences. Latent-Y is integrated into the Latent Labs Platform, where it operates in the same environment as drug-discovery experts with access to bioinformatics tools, biological databases, and scientific literature. The agent can run fully autonomously end-to-end, or collaboratively, where researchers review progress, provide feedback, and direct subsequent steps. Candidate antibodies are generated using Latent-X2, our frontier generative model for drug-like antibody design. We demonstrate the agent's capability across three distinct campaign types: epitope discovery guided by therapeutic specifications, cross-species binder design, and autonomous design from a scientific publication targeting human transferrin receptor for blood-brain barrier crossing. Across nine targets, Latent-Y produced lab-confirmed nanobody binders against six, achieving a 67% target-level success rate with binding affinities reaching the single-digit nanomolar range, without human filtering or intervention. In user studies, experts working with Latent-Y completed design campaigns 56 times faster than independent expert time estimates, compressing weeks of work into hours. Because Latent-X2 is a general-purpose atomic-level model for biologics design, the same agent architecture naturally extends to macrocyclic peptide and mini-binder design campaigns, broadening autonomous discovery across therapeutic modalities. Latent-Y is available to selected partners at https://platform.latentlabs.com.

papers.title: Why Gaussian Diffusion Models Fail on Discrete Data?
papers.text:
title: Why Gaussian Diffusion Models Fail on Discrete Data?
source: arXiv
topics: foundation_model_agent
category: foundation_model
why: 这篇工作偏基础模型/Agent方向，可能影响病原检测任务的建模上限，值得关注其任务定义与评测设计。
abstract_zh: 扩散模型已成为连续领域生成建模的标准方法，但在离散数据上的应用仍面临挑战。本研究探讨了采用 DDPM 求解器的高斯扩散模型在处理连续空间中以 delta 分布混合表示的离散分布时表现不佳的原因。通过随机层次模型（Random Hierarchy Model），研究识别出一个关键采样区间，在该区间内加噪数据的密度呈现多模态特征。在此机制下，DDPM 采样会偶尔进入众数之间的低密度区域，产生超出分布（OOD）的输入，导致样本质量下降。研究表明，自调节（self-conditioning）和一种称为 q-sampling 的求解器等启发式方法能缓解此问题。此外，在关键区间内结合自调节并将 DDPM 切换为 q-sampling，可显著提升真实数据的生成质量。该结论在文本、编程代码和蛋白质等多个领域的条件与非条件生成任务中得到了验证。
abstract: Diffusion models have become a standard approach for generative modeling in continuous domains, yet their application to discrete data remains challenging. We investigate why Gaussian diffusion models with the DDPM solver struggle to sample from discrete distributions that are represented as a mixture of delta-distributions in the continuous space. Using a toy Random Hierarchy Model, we identify a critical sampling interval in which the density of noisified data becomes multimodal. In this regime, DDPM occasionally enters low-density regions between modes producing out-of-distribution inputs for the model and degrading sample quality. We show that existing heuristics, including self-conditioning and a solver we term q-sampling, help alleviate this issue. Furthermore, we demonstrate that combining self-conditioning with switching from DDPM to q-sampling within the critical interval improves generation quality on real data. We validate these findings across conditional and unconditional tasks in multiple domains, including text, programming code, and proteins.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究深入分析了高斯扩散模型（特别是 DDPM 求解器）在处理离散数据（如蛋白质序列、代码、文本）时失效的底层机制。核心发现是存在一个“关键采样区间”，此时加噪数据分布会演变为多模态，导致模型生成偏离真实分布的无效输入，进而破坏采样质量。

## 为什么相关
本研究与病原生物学及蛋白质组学高度相关。蛋白质序列本质上是离散的氨基酸排列，目前主流的蛋白质生成模型（如用于抗体设计或酶改造的模型）常借用连续空间的扩散模型。摘要明确提到该方法在“蛋白质（proteins）”领域得到了验证，这对于优化病原体进化模拟或功能蛋白设计中的离散序列建模具有直接指导意义。

## 新颖度判断
新颖度中等（0.5）。其贡献不在于提出全新的架构，而在于通过“随机层次模型（Random Hierarchy Model）”这一理论工具，定性且定量地解释了高斯扩散在离散空间失效的物理过程，并提出了针对性的求解器切换策略（从 DDPM 切换至 q-sampling）。

## 方法与证据
1. **理论模型**：使用随机层次模型识别出导致采样失败的“关键采样区间”。
2. **改进手段**：引入“自调节（self-conditioning）”技术和“q-sampling”求解器。
3. **实验证据**：在文本、编程代码和蛋白质等多个领域的条件与非条件任务中进行验证。摘要未说明具体的实验规模（如参数量或数据集大小）及具体的性能提升百分比指标。

## 应用价值
对于开发基于 AI 的病原检测 Agent 或蛋白质设计工具，该研究提供了一种提升生成稳定性的技术路径。通过在关键采样区间切换求解器，可以减少生成序列中的“幻觉”或无效氨基酸组合，提高蛋白质结构预测或序列设计的成功率。

## 局限与风险
1. **计算开销**：摘要未说明结合自调节与 q-sampling 是否会显著增加采样的时间成本。
2. **普适性限制**：虽然在蛋白质上有效，但对于极度稀疏或超长序列的病原基因组数据，该方法的表现尚未明确。
3. **指标缺失**：摘要未提供具体的定量对比数据（如困惑度或结构一致性得分），难以评估其实际改进幅度。

papers.title: From Research Question to Scientific Workflow: Leveraging Agentic AI for Science Automation
papers.text:
title: From Research Question to Scientific Workflow: Leveraging Agentic AI for Science Automation
source: arXiv
topics: foundation_model_agent
category: foundation_model
why: 这篇工作偏基础模型/Agent方向，可能影响病原检测任务的建模上限，值得关注其任务定义与评测设计。
abstract_zh: 科学工作流系统虽能实现调度、容错和资源管理等自动化执行，但仍缺乏前期的语义转换能力。科学家目前必须手动将研究问题转化为工作流规范，这要求同时具备领域知识和基础设施专业经验。本文提出一种三层智能体架构来填补这一空白：语义层利用大语言模型（LLM）将自然语言解析为结构化意图；确定性层通过验证生成器产生可复现的工作流有向无环图（DAG）；知识层则由领域专家编写“技能（Skills）”文档，定义词汇映射、参数约束和优化策略。该架构将 LLM 的不确定性严格限制在语义提取环节，确保相同意图始终生成一致的工作流。研究在 1000 基因组计划群体遗传学工作流及 Kubernetes 上的 Hyperflow 系统中进行了验证。消减实验表明，“技能”层将意图匹配准确率从 44% 提升至 83%，使数据传输量减少 92%，且单次查询的 LLM 开销低于 15 秒，成本不足 0.001 美元。
abstract: Scientific workflow systems automate execution -- scheduling, fault tolerance, resource management -- but not the semantic translation that precedes it. Scientists still manually convert research questions into workflow specifications, a task requiring both domain knowledge and infrastructure expertise. We propose an agentic architecture that closes this gap through three layers: an LLM interprets natural language into structured intents (semantic layer); validated generators produce reproducible workflow DAGs (deterministic layer); and domain experts author ``Skills'': markdown documents encoding vocabulary mappings, parameter constraints, and optimization strategies (knowledge layer). This decomposition confines LLM non-determinism to intent extraction: identical intents always yield identical workflows. We implement and evaluate the architecture on the 1000 Genomes population genetics workflow and Hyperflow WMS running on Kubernetes. In an ablation study on 150 queries, Skills raise full-match intent accuracy from 44% to 83%; skill-driven deferred workflow generation reduces data transfer by 92\%; and the end-to-end pipeline completes queries on Kubernetes with LLM overhead below 15 seconds and cost under $0.001 per query.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究开发了一种基于智能体（Agent）的科学自动化架构，旨在将自然语言形式的研究问题自动转化为可执行的科学工作流。核心设计包括三层结构：LLM 负责意图提取（语义层）、验证生成器负责 DAG 构建（确定性层）、专家文档提供约束（知识层/Skills）。其核心逻辑是通过解耦语义理解与逻辑生成，解决 LLM 在复杂科学计算中的不可预测性问题。

## 为什么相关
在病原基因组学和临床微生物学领域，分析流程（如物种鉴定、耐药基因筛查、进化树构建）通常涉及复杂的生物信息学工具链。该研究提出的架构能够降低生物学家使用高性能计算资源的门槛，通过自然语言驱动复杂的生物信息学分析流（如摘要中提到的 1000 基因组计划工作流），实现从“科学设想”到“代码执行”的自动化衔接。

## 新颖度判断
新颖度中等（0.5）。其创新点不在于提出了新的 LLM 模型，而在于提出了一种“约束型 Agent 架构”。通过引入专家编写的 Markdown “技能”文档作为知识层，成功将 LLM 的随机性限制在语义解析阶段，解决了科学实验中至关重要的“可复现性”痛点，这比单纯的 Prompt Engineering 更具工程参考价值。

## 方法与证据
研究采用了消减实验（Ablation Study）进行验证，实验对象为 1000 基因组计划（1000 Genomes）群体遗传学工作流，运行环境为 Kubernetes 上的 Hyperflow WMS。证据显示：在引入“技能”层后，意图匹配准确率从 44% 大幅提升至 83%；通过技能驱动的延迟生成策略，数据传输量显著减少 92%；性能指标上，LLM 额外开销控制在 15 秒内，成本极低（<$0.001/query）。

## 应用价值
对于临床微生物实验室，该技术可用于构建“对话式生信分析平台”。临床医生或研究员只需输入“分析该样本中副溶血性弧菌的毒力基因分布”，系统即可依据预设的专家技能文档，自动调用相应的生物信息学工具和计算资源，生成标准化的分析报告，极大地提高了科研效率并减少了基础设施操作门槛。

## 局限与风险
摘要未说明该架构在处理极其复杂、跨学科或未定义“技能”的新型研究问题时的表现。此外，虽然 LLM 成本低，但系统对专家编写“技能”文档的依赖程度较高，如果领域专家定义的参数约束或词汇映射存在偏差，可能会导致生成的工作流虽然逻辑一致但科学性错误。摘要亦未提及对多模态数据（如电泳图、质谱图）的直接处理能力。

papers.title: Utility-Oriented Visual Evidence Selection for Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.text:
title: Utility-Oriented Visual Evidence Selection for Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation
source: arXiv
topics: foundation_model_agent
category: methods
why: 这篇工作更像方法创新，可能直接关联 metagenomics、long-read 或 pathogen identification 流程优化。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: Visual evidence selection is a critical component of multimodal retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), yet existing methods typically rely on semantic relevance or surface-level similarity, which are often misaligned with the actual utility of visual evidence for downstream reasoning. We reformulate multimodal evidence selection from an information-theoretic perspective by defining evidence utility as the information gain induced on a model's output distribution. To overcome the intractability of answer-space optimization, we introduce a latent notion of evidence helpfulness and theoretically show that, under mild assumptions, ranking evidence by information gain on this latent variable is equivalent to answer-space utility. We further propose a training-free, surrogate-accelerated framework that efficiently estimates evidence utility using lightweight multimodal models. Experiments on MRAG-Bench and Visual-RAG across multiple model families demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art RAG baselines while achieving substantial reductions in computational cost.

papers.title: GeneMamba: An Efficient and Effective Foundation Model on Single Cell Data
papers.text:
title: GeneMamba: An Efficient and Effective Foundation Model on Single Cell Data
source: arXiv
topics: 
category: foundation_model
why: 这篇工作偏基础模型/Agent方向，可能影响病原检测任务的建模上限，值得关注其任务定义与评测设计。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) enables high-resolution analysis of cellular heterogeneity, but its complexity, which is marked by high dimensionality, sparsity, and batch effects, which poses major computational challenges. Transformer-based models have made significant advances in this domain but are often limited by their quadratic complexity and suboptimal handling of long-range dependencies. In this work, we introduce GeneMamba, a scalable and efficient foundation model for single-cell transcriptomics built on state space modeling. Leveraging the Bi-Mamba architecture, GeneMamba captures bidirectional gene context with linear-time complexity, offering substantial computational gains over transformer baselines. The model is pretrained on nearly 30 million cells and incorporates biologically informed objectives, including pathway-aware contrastive loss and rank-based gene encoding. We evaluate GeneMamba across diverse tasks, including multi-batch integration, cell type annotation, and gene-gene correlation, demonstrating strong performance, interpretability, and robustness. These results position GeneMamba as a practical and powerful alternative to transformer-based methods, advancing the development of biologically grounded, scalable tools for large-scale single-cell data analysis.

papers.title: BIOGEN: Evidence-Grounded Multi-Agent Reasoning Framework for Transcriptomic Interpretation in Antimicrobial Resistance
papers.text:
title: BIOGEN: Evidence-Grounded Multi-Agent Reasoning Framework for Transcriptomic Interpretation in Antimicrobial Resistance
source: arXiv
topics: 
category: foundation_model
why: 这篇工作偏基础模型/Agent方向，可能影响病原检测任务的建模上限，值得关注其任务定义与评测设计。
abstract_zh: 从 RNA-seq 数据中解释基因簇仍具挑战，尤其是在需要机制背景来生成假设的抗生素耐药性（AMR）研究中。传统的富集方法（如 ORA）利用预定义类别总结共表达模块，但结果往往稀疏，且缺乏针对特定基因簇的文献关联解释。本研究提出 BIOGEN，这是一个基于证据的多智能体（Multi-agent）框架，用于 RNA-seq 转录模块的事后解释。该框架集成了生物医学检索、结构化推理和多评论员验证机制，将来自 PubMed 和 UniProt 的证据组织成具有明确支持和置信度分级的可追溯簇级解释。在鼠伤寒沙门氏菌数据集上，BIOGEN 实现了强大的证据落地性能，将幻觉率从无约束 LLM 设置下的 0.67 降至检索落地配置下的 0.00。与 KEGG/ORA 和 GO/ORA 相比，BIOGEN 恢复了更广泛的生物学覆盖范围。在另外四个细菌 RNA-seq 数据集上，BIOGEN 保持了零幻觉，且在主题覆盖率上持续优于 KEGG。该结果表明 BIOGEN 可通过提高透明度和覆盖率来补充转录组学分析工作流。
abstract: Interpreting gene clusters from RNA-seq remains challenging, especially in antimicrobial resistance studies where mechanistic context is essential for hypothesis generation. Conventional enrichment methods summarize co-expressed modules using predefined categories, but often return sparse results and lack cluster-specific, literature-linked explanations. We present BIOGEN, an evidence-grounded multi-agent framework for post hoc interpretation of RNA-seq transcriptional modules that integrates biomedical retrieval, structured reasoning, and multi-critic verification. BIOGEN organizes evidence from PubMed and UniProt into traceable cluster-level interpretations with explicit support and confidence tiering. On a primary Salmonella enterica dataset, BIOGEN achieved strong evidence-grounding performance while reducing hallucination from 0.67 in an unconstrained LLM setting to 0.00 under retrieval-grounded configurations. Compared with KEGG/ORA and GO/ORA, BIOGEN recovered broader biological coverage, identifying substantially more biological themes per cluster. Across four additional bacterial RNA-seq datasets, BIOGEN maintained zero hallucination and consistently outperformed KEGG/ORA in cluster-level thematic coverage. These results position BIOGEN as an interpretive support framework that complements transcriptomic workflows through improved traceability, evidential transparency, and biological coverage.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究开发了名为 BIOGEN 的多智能体推理框架，专门用于解决细菌转录组（特别是抗生素耐药性相关）基因簇的功能解释问题。BIOGEN 通过整合 PubMed 和 UniProt 数据库，利用“检索-推理-验证”的多智能体协作流程，将传统的、基于预设数据库（如 GO/KEGG）的富集分析提升为基于文献证据的结构化解释。

## 为什么相关
本研究属于病原基因组学与 AI Agent 的强交叉领域。在临床微生物学和 AMR 研究中，单纯的差异表达分析或通路富集往往无法提供具体的生物学机制假设。BIOGEN 直接针对这一痛点，利用大语言模型（LLM）处理非结构化生物医学文献的能力，为病原菌转录调控研究提供了更深层次的自动化分析工具。

## 新颖度判断
新颖度较高（6.0）。其创新点在于：1. 放弃了单一 LLM 的直接生成，采用了多智能体（Multi-agent）架构，引入了“多评论员验证（multi-critic verification）”；2. 建立了置信度分级系统（confidence tiering）；3. 专门针对细菌（如沙门氏菌）的 AMR 场景进行了优化，而非通用的生物信息学工具。

## 方法与证据
- **方法**：采用多智能体框架，包含生物医学检索、结构化推理和多评论员验证三个核心环节。
- **数据规模**：主要测试集为鼠伤寒沙门氏菌（Salmonella enterica）数据集，并额外在 4 个细菌 RNA-seq 数据集上进行了验证。
- **实验证据**：在无约束 LLM 设置下，幻觉率为 0.67，而 BIOGEN 框架将其降低至 0.00。在生物学主题覆盖率上，BIOGEN 识别出的生物学主题数量显著多于传统的 KEGG/ORA 和 GO/ORA 方法。

## 应用价值
BIOGEN 为转录组学研究提供了一种“可追溯”的解释方案。对于研究抗生素耐药机制的科研人员，它不仅能给出受影响的通路，还能直接关联 PubMed 文献和 UniProt 功能注释，显著加速了从数据到科学假设的转化过程，且通过零幻觉表现确保了结果的可靠性。

## 局限与风险
摘要未说明该框架对计算资源的需求以及处理大规模单细胞转录组数据的扩展性。此外，虽然在细菌数据集上表现优异，但其在真核生物或更复杂的宿主-病原体互作转录组中的适用性尚未提及。摘要亦未明确说明所使用的底层 LLM 模型版本（如 GPT-4 或开源模型）。

papers.title: Species-specific small models for cell type classification approach the performance of large single cell foundation models
papers.text:
title: Species-specific small models for cell type classification approach the performance of large single cell foundation models
source: bioRxiv
topics: 
category: methods
why: 这篇工作更像方法创新，可能直接关联 metagenomics、long-read 或 pathogen identification 流程优化。
abstract_zh: 跨物种细胞类型分类是单细胞转录组学的核心任务。尽管基于数百万单细胞图谱训练的大型基础模型表现强劲，但其庞大的参数量和计算成本限制了可访问性与可解释性。本文引入了 CytoType，一种利用预训练 ESM-2 蛋白质嵌入进行细胞分类的简单可解释模型。CytoType 通过学习转录本嵌入上的线性细胞类型特定权重，在不依赖基因计数信息的情况下，实现了与大型 Transformer 基础模型相当或更高的 F1 分数。研究者还开发了更简化的变体 ESM-Cell Embedding (ESM-CE)，仅通过对表达基因的 ESM-2 嵌入求均值，即可产生极具竞争力的表现。CytoType 在参数量比基础模型少约 10,000 倍的情况下，在人类组织等数据上与最佳模型的 F1 差距仅为 0.053。此外，该研究量化了 ESM-2 嵌入的贡献，并在 9 个物种中显著缩小了与大模型的性能差距，同时证明其学习到的基因权重具有生物学可解释性。
abstract: Accurate cross-species cell type classification remains a key evaluation task in single-cell transcriptomics. Recent foundation models trained on millions of single-cell profiles demonstrate strong in-distribution and out-of-distribution performance on this task, but their large parameter counts and substantial computational costs limit accessibility and interpretability. Here, we introduce CytoType, a simple and interpretable model for cell type classification that leverages pre-trained ESM-2 protein embeddings. By learning linear cell-type-specific weights over transcript embeddings, without relying on gene count information, CytoType achieves F1 scores comparable to or exceeding those of large-scale transformer-based models. We further developed ESM-Cell Embedding (ESM-CE), an even simpler variant that only averages ESM-2 embeddings across expressed genes, which also performs competitively against foundation models. Both CytoType and ESM-CE are trained on species-specific data, maintaining high accuracy when classifying cell types with orders of magnitude fewer parameters compared to larger foundation models. For example, for human tissues, the average performance gap between CytoType and the best foundation model was 0.053 F1 points while CytoType uses ~10,000x fewer trainable parameters. Additionally, we quantified the contribution of ESM-2 embeddings to cell type classification tasks and demonstrated a three fold reduction in the performance gap between CytoType and the best foundation model for nine species. Finally, we show that CytoType's learned gene weights are biologically interpretable.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究挑战了单细胞领域“模型越大越好”的范式，提出了 CytoType 和 ESM-CE 两种轻量化模型。其核心逻辑是利用预训练的蛋白质语言模型（ESM-2）获取的蛋白质嵌入（Embeddings）来表征转录本，通过简单的线性权重或均值计算实现高精度的细胞类型分类，证明了物种特异性的小模型在特定任务上可以媲美参数量大万倍的基础模型。

## 为什么相关
本研究处于蛋白质组学（ESM-2 嵌入）、基因组学（单细胞转录组）与 AI 交叉的前沿。对于临床微生物学和病原研究而言，这种利用蛋白质结构/序列信息来增强转录组分类的方法，为资源受限环境下的细胞鉴定和病原反应分析提供了高效工具，尤其是在缺乏大规模标注数据的非模式生物研究中具有参考价值。

## 新颖度判断
新颖度较高。不同于主流单细胞基础模型（如 Geneformer 或 scGPT）依赖于大规模基因表达计数的注意力机制，CytoType 创新性地将蛋白质序列的语义信息（ESM-2）引入转录组分类任务，并证明了“无计数（count-free）”分类的可行性，极大地降低了计算门槛。

## 方法与证据
- **模型架构**：CytoType 采用线性层学习 ESM-2 嵌入的权重；ESM-CE 则是对表达基因的 ESM-2 嵌入进行简单平均。
- **数据规模**：实验覆盖了人类组织及其他 8 个物种（共 9 个物种）。
- **关键指标**：在人类组织任务中，CytoType 的 F1 分数与最强基础模型的差距仅为 0.053，但可训练参数量减少了约 10,000 倍。
- **证据支持**：通过对 9 个物种的测试，证明使用 ESM-2 嵌入可将小模型与大模型之间的性能差距缩小三倍。

## 应用价值
- **计算效率**：极低的参数量意味着可以在普通工作站甚至笔记本电脑上运行，提升了单细胞分析工具的可及性。
- **生物学解释性**：摘要提到模型学习到的基因权重具有生物学意义，有助于识别决定细胞身份的关键功能蛋白。
- **跨物种研究**：为非模式物种提供了高效的分类框架，无需从头训练数亿参数的模型。

## 局限与风险
- **任务局限**：摘要仅展示了在“细胞类型分类”任务上的表现，未说明在基因扰动预测、轨迹发育推断等更复杂的单细胞任务中是否依然有效。
- **依赖性**：模型性能高度依赖于预训练 ESM-2 嵌入的质量，对于 ESM-2 未能很好表征的特殊蛋白质或非编码 RNA 驱动的细胞差异，可能存在识别瓶颈。
- **物种特异性**：虽然模型小，但仍需针对特定物种数据进行训练，摘要未明确说明其零样本（Zero-shot）跨物种迁移能力。

papers.title: A Massively Scalable Ligand-Protein Dissociation Dynamic Database Derived from Atomistic Molecular Modelling
papers.text:
title: A Massively Scalable Ligand-Protein Dissociation Dynamic Database Derived from Atomistic Molecular Modelling
source: arXiv
topics: 
category: methods
why: 这篇工作更像方法创新，可能直接关联 metagenomics、long-read 或 pathogen identification 流程优化。
abstract_zh: 药物-蛋白质相互作用的动力学对药物设计至关重要，但该领域目前缺乏大规模动态数据。本研究推出了 DD-03B，这是一个大规模可扩展数据库，提供广泛配体-蛋白质复合物的全原子解离动力学轨迹。利用并扩展了经过验证的计算流程，研究者为来自 PDBbind+v2020R1 的 19,037 个复合物生成了解离轨迹，包含约 3 亿个模拟帧，总数据量达 40 TB。针对这些具有实验结合亲和力（kd）但通常缺乏实测解离速率（koff）的系统，研究通过轨迹重加权计算并分配了解离速率常数。分析显示，复合物可分为路径主导型、开袋型和熵袋型三种机制类型，每种类型需要不同的动力学表征策略。DD-03B 与此前发布的 DD-13M 共同构成了可扩展解离动力学数据库（DDD）项目的核心，为训练和基准测试下一代预测及优化药物-蛋白解离动力学的生成式 AI 模型奠定了基础。
abstract: Understanding the kinetics of drug-protein interactions is paramount for drug design, yet the field lacks large-scale, dynamic data to move beyond static structural analysis. Here, we present DD-03B, a massively scalable database providing dynamic, all-atom dissociation trajectories for a broad set of ligand-protein complexes. Utilising and extending a validated computational pipeline, we generated dissociation trajectories for 19,037 ligand-protein complexes sourced from PDBbind+v2020R1, resulting in a repository of approximately 0.3 billion simulation frames totalling 40 TB in size. For these systems-which possess experimental binding affinities (kd) but typically lack measured koff rates-we computed and assigned dissociation rate constants through trajectory reweighting. Our analysis reveals that protein-ligand complexes can be categorised into three mechanistic types (pathway-dominant, open-pocket, and entropy-pocket systems), each requiring distinct strategies for accurate kinetic characterisation. Together with our previously released DD-13M, DD-03B forms the core of the expandable Dissociation Dynamic Database (DDD) project, which will be continuously augmented with new trajectories. This large-scale, publicly available resource establishes a critical foundation for training and benchmarking next-generation generative AI models to predict and optimise drug-protein dissociation kinetics.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究发布了名为 DD-03B 的大规模全原子配体-蛋白质解离动力学数据库。通过对 PDBbind+v2020R1 中的 19,037 个复合物进行分子动力学模拟，生成了 3 亿帧（40 TB）的动态轨迹数据，并利用轨迹重加权技术解决了实验中 koff 速率缺失的问题，旨在将药物设计从静态结构分析转向动态动力学预测。

## 为什么相关
在病原体研究和临床微生物学中，理解药物（如抗生素或抗病毒药物）与靶标蛋白的结合稳定性（解离速率）是克服耐药性的关键。该数据库提供的动力学轨迹为 AI 模型学习病原体蛋白与配体的相互作用提供了底层数据，直接关联到蛋白质组学中的功能注释及药物筛选流程优化。

## 新颖度判断
新颖度高。该工作填补了生物信息学领域中“大规模动态数据”的空白。相比于传统的静态 PDB 结构，它提供了时间维度的解离过程，并首次提出了基于路径主导、开袋和熵袋的三种机制分类，为动力学表征提供了新的理论框架。

## 方法与证据
研究采用全原子分子建模（Atomistic Molecular Modelling）和轨迹重加权（Trajectory Reweighting）方法。证据包括：成功处理了 19,037 个配体-蛋白系统；生成了 0.3 billion 帧模拟数据；并将系统分类为三种机制类型。通过计算分配了 koff 速率常数，弥补了 PDBbind 仅有 kd 值的不足。

## 应用价值
该数据库是训练生成式 AI 和深度学习模型（如蛋白质-配体结合预测模型）的优质基准数据集。在临床微生物学领域，可用于预测突变对药物解离动力学的影响，辅助设计具有更长驻留时间（Residence Time）的高效药物。

## 局限与风险
首先，koff 值是通过计算重加权获得的，而非直接实验测定，其准确性受限于模拟力场和重加权算法的精度；其次，40 TB 的数据规模对普通研究机构的存储和计算资源提出了极高要求；此外，摘要未说明该模型在处理高度柔性蛋白或多聚体蛋白时的表现。

papers.title: CoDaS: AI Co-Data-Scientist for Biomarker Discovery via Wearable Sensors
papers.text:
title: CoDaS: AI Co-Data-Scientist for Biomarker Discovery via Wearable Sensors
source: arXiv
topics: 
category: clinical_application
why: 这篇工作更接近临床/监测落地，适合评估其对快速识别、预警或治疗辅助的实际价值。
abstract_zh: 数字健康领域的科学发现需要将可穿戴设备的连续生理信号转化为临床可操作的生物标志物。本文介绍了 CoDaS（AI 协同数据科学家），这是一个多智能体系统，通过大规模可穿戴数据集，将生物标志物发现构建为包含假设生成、统计分析、对抗验证、基于文献的推理及人工监督的迭代过程。在总计 9,279 名受试者的三个队列中，CoDaS 识别出 41 个心理健康候选数字标志物和 25 个代谢结果标志物，并进行了包含复制性、稳定性、鲁棒性和判别力的内部验证。在两个独立的抑郁症队列中，CoDaS 均发现了与昼夜节律不稳定性相关的特征，表现为睡眠时长变异性（DWB 队列，ρ=0.252，p<0.001）和入睡时间变异性（GLOBEM 队列，ρ=0.126，p<0.001）。在代谢队列中，CoDaS 推导出心血管健康指数（步数/静息心率，ρ=-0.374）并恢复了已知的临床关联（如 AST/ALT 比率，ρ=-0.375）。加入 CoDaS 提取的特征后，抑郁症和胰岛素抵抗的预测性能分别提升了 0.040 和 0.021 的 ΔR²。研究表明，CoDaS 能够从大规模可穿戴数据中实现系统化、可追溯的假设生成与优先级排序。
abstract: Scientific discovery in digital health requires converting continuous physiological signals from wearable devices into clinically actionable biomarkers. We introduce CoDaS (AI Co-Data-Scientist), a multi-agent system that structures biomarker discovery as an iterative process combining hypothesis generation, statistical analysis, adversarial validation, and literature-grounded reasoning with human oversight using large-scale wearable datasets. Across three cohorts totaling 9,279 participant-observations, CoDaS identified 41 candidate digital biomarkers for mental health and 25 for metabolic outcomes, each subjected to an internal validation battery spanning replication, stability, robustness, and discriminative power. Across two independent depression cohorts, CoDaS surfaced circadian instability-related features in both datasets, reflected in sleep duration variability (DWB, ρ= 0.252, p < 0.001) and sleep onset variability (GLOBEM, ρ= 0.126, p < 0.001). In a metabolic cohort, CoDaS derived a cardiovascular fitness index (steps/resting heart rate; ρ= -0.374, p < 0.001), and recovered established clinical associations, including the hepatic function ratio (AST/ALT; ρ= -0.375, p < 0.001), a known correlate of insulin resistance. Incorporating CoDaS-derived features alongside demographic variables led to modest but consistent improvements in predictive performance, with cross-validated ΔR^2 increases of 0.040 for depression and 0.021 for insulin resistance. These findings suggest that CoDaS enables systematic and traceable hypothesis generation and prioritization for biomarker discovery from large-scale wearable data.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究开发了名为 **CoDaS** 的多智能体 AI 系统，旨在自动化从可穿戴设备（如智能手表）产生的连续生理信号中挖掘数字生物标志物。该系统通过模拟数据科学家的工作流，在 9,279 个样本的大规模数据集上，针对心理健康和代谢性疾病识别并验证了数十个候选标志物。

## 为什么相关
虽然该论文主要关注心理健康和代谢，但其核心逻辑——**从连续生理监测数据中提取临床指标**——与病原感染后的生理状态监测（如发热模式、心率变异性分析）高度相关。这种多智能体协同分析方法可被借鉴用于构建感染性疾病的早期预警系统或重症监护中的病原载量间接评估。

## 新颖度判断
**中等偏高**。其新颖性不在于基础算法，而在于**多智能体（Multi-agent）架构**的引入。它将生物标志物发现过程拆解为假设生成、对抗验证和文献推理等环节，并引入了“对抗验证”机制来确保标志物的稳健性，这比传统的单模型特征工程更具系统性和可解释性。

## 方法与证据
- **方法**：采用多智能体系统进行迭代式发现，包含统计分析与文献验证。验证维度涵盖复制性、稳定性、鲁棒性和判别力。
- **数据规模**：三个队列，共 9,279 个参与者观测值。
- **关键证据**：
    - **抑郁症相关**：在 DWB 和 GLOBEM 两个独立队列中一致发现了睡眠变异性特征（ρ 分别为 0.252 和 0.126）。
    - **代谢相关**：成功识别出心血管健康指数（步数/静息心率，ρ=-0.374）以及与胰岛素抵抗相关的 AST/ALT 比率（ρ=-0.375）。
    - **性能提升**：在人口统计学变量基础上，ΔR² 提升了 0.021 至 0.040。

## 应用价值
CoDaS 提供了一种**可追溯且系统化**的特征发现工具。对于临床研究者而言，它可以快速从海量传感器数据中筛选出具有生物学意义的特征，缩短从原始数据到临床假设的周期。其发现的“睡眠变异性”和“步数/心率比”具有直接的临床监测参考价值。

## 局限与风险
- **预测增益有限**：尽管具有统计学意义，但 ΔR² 的实际提升幅度（0.021-0.040）相对较小，说明数字标志物在独立预测复杂疾病时仍仅能作为辅助手段。
- **领域局限**：摘要未说明该系统在处理急性感染或病原体特异性生理变化时的表现。
- **人工依赖**：系统仍需“人工监督”，摘要未明确说明在完全自动化场景下的错误率或幻觉风险。

papers.title: AI-Driven Chemometrics for Multi-omics Data Integration: Advances, Challenges, and Future Directions.
papers.text:
title: AI-Driven Chemometrics for Multi-omics Data Integration: Advances, Challenges, and Future Directions.
source: PubMed
topics: 
category: foundation_model
why: 这篇工作偏基础模型/Agent方向，可能影响病原检测任务的建模上限，值得关注其任务定义与评测设计。
abstract_zh: 本综述探讨了人工智能（AI）与化学计量学在多组学数据整合领域的融合进展，旨在揭示复杂生物系统的深层机制。文章重点评述了2020年至2025年间基因组学、蛋白质组学、代谢组学等多层组学数据的集成方法。针对批次效应、高维特征及结构异质性等核心挑战，评估了传统化学计量学向卷积神经网络（CNN）、自动编码器（AE）、变分自动编码器（VAE）及图神经网络（GNN）等深度学习架构的演进。这些模型在非线性特征提取与数据融合中展现了卓越能力。此外，SHAP和LIME等可解释性AI框架解决了分析化学中的解释性难题。研究涵盖了基于Transformer注意力机制和生物网络信息的垂直与水平整合策略。在阿尔茨海默病、肥胖和癌症的临床应用中，AI驱动的方法较传统手段实现了20%-30%的性能提升。未来方向包括联邦学习、量子计算及亚细胞分辨率的单细胞空间多组学。
abstract: The convergence of artificial intelligence and chemometrics has revolutionized multi-omics data integration, enabling unprecedented insights into complex biological systems. This critical review examines AI-driven approaches for integrating genomics, proteomics, metabolomics, and other omics layers, emphasizing developments from 2020 to 2025. We explore fundamental multi-omics challenges including batch effects, high dimensionality, and structural heterogeneity, evaluating how classical chemometric methods have evolved into sophisticated deep learning architectures. Convolutional neural networks, autoencoders, variational autoencoders, and graph neural networks demonstrate remarkable capabilities for non-linear feature extraction and data fusion. Explainable AI frameworks including SHAP and LIME address interpretability concerns critical for analytical chemistry. We review vertical and horizontal integration strategies, highlighting transformer-based attention mechanisms and biological network-informed architectures. Clinical applications in Alzheimer's disease, obesity, and cancer demonstrate 20%-30% performance improvements over traditional approaches. Emerging hyphenated techniques coupling microfluidics with mass spectrometry enable miniaturized analyses. Persistent challenges include computational scalability, overfitting mitigation, regulatory validation gaps, and interdisciplinary collaboration barriers. Future directions encompass federated learning for privacy-preserving analyses, quantum computing applications, and single-cell spatial multi-omics at subcellular resolution. This assessment provides analytical chemists with critical evaluation of available tools, benchmarking strategies, and roadmaps for advancing precision medicine and analytical applications.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该综述系统性地回顾了2020-2025年间AI驱动的化学计量学在多组学（基因组、蛋白组、代谢组）整合中的应用。核心聚焦于利用深度学习架构（如CNN、VAE、GNN）替代传统统计方法，以解决多组学数据特有的高维、异质性及批次效应问题，并探讨了可解释性AI（XAI）在分析化学中的应用。

## 为什么相关
本研究与病原生信及蛋白质组学高度相关。多组学整合是理解病原体致病机制和宿主反应的关键。摘要中提到的“Transformer-based attention”和“biological network-informed architectures”是当前开发生物大模型（Foundation Models）和智能体（Agents）处理复杂生物序列与网络数据的核心技术路径。20%-30%的性能提升直接证明了AI在临床微生物诊断和精准医学中的潜力。

## 新颖度判断
新颖度评分为1.0（较低），主要因为这是一篇综述性文章（critical review），而非提出原创性模型或算法的研究。其价值在于对2020-2025年间AI在化学计量学领域的演进进行了全景式总结，并前瞻性地提出了量子计算与联邦学习在组学中的应用方向。

## 方法与证据
摘要提到了多种AI架构的应用：
1. **特征提取与融合**：利用CNN、AE、VAE和GNN进行非线性处理。
2. **整合策略**：涵盖了基于Transformer注意力机制的垂直与水平整合方法。
3. **可解释性**：引入SHAP和LIME框架以增强模型透明度。
4. **实验证据**：在阿尔茨海默病、肥胖和癌症的临床案例中，AI方法比传统化学计量学方法性能提高20%-30%。

## 应用价值
1. **临床诊断**：为精准医疗提供了更高精度的多指标整合工具。
2. **技术融合**：微流控与质谱联用（hyphenated techniques）结合AI，推动了分析设备的微型化。
3. **前沿探索**：为单细胞空间多组学提供了亚细胞分辨率的处理思路，有助于深入研究病原体在组织中的空间分布。

## 局限与风险
摘要明确指出了四个主要挑战：
1. **计算可扩展性**：大规模组学数据的处理压力。
2. **过拟合风险**：在高维小样本数据中尤为突出。
3. **监管验证缺口**：AI模型进入临床实践缺乏统一的法规标准。
4. **跨学科障碍**：化学计量学家与AI专家之间的协作壁垒。

papers.title: Generalizing intensive care AI across time scales in resource-limited settings
papers.text:
title: Generalizing intensive care AI across time scales in resource-limited settings
source: medRxiv
topics: 
category: clinical_application
why: 这篇工作更接近临床/监测落地，适合评估其对快速识别、预警或治疗辅助的实际价值。
abstract_zh: 重症监护中的生理监测时间分辨率在不同医疗系统中差异巨大，而现有AI模型通常假设采样频率固定，限制了其在资源受限地区的推广。本研究提出了一种针对生理时间序列的新型分辨率迁移任务，探讨在高分辨率数据上训练的模型能否在不重新训练的情况下推广到低数据密度环境。研究利用印度一家三级医院长达十年的新型儿科重症监护数据集SafeICU，包含984次住院的144,271个患者小时的高分辨率生理信号。研究采用自监督Transformer模型学习心率、呼吸频率、血氧饱和度和动脉血压的表征。结果显示，该模型在临床相关的低频区间表现稳健，优于直接在粗糙分辨率下训练的模型。此外，该表征可跨人群推广，在无需重新训练的情况下，于MIMIC-III和eICU成人队列中保持了性能。在早期休克预测任务中，模型在儿科队列中达到0.87的AUROC，且在10至60分钟的监测间隔内表现稳定。SafeICU数据集包含生命体征、微生物学等记录，为资源受限地区的临床AI部署奠定了基础。
abstract: Temporal resolution of physiological monitoring in intensive care varies widely across healthcare systems. Artificial intelligence models assume a uniform and fixed frequency of sampling, thus limiting the generalizability of models, especially to resource-limited settings. Here, we propose a novel resolution-transfer task for physiological time series and ask whether models trained on high-resolution data can generalize to a low data-density setting without the need to retrain them. SafeICU, a novel longitudinal pediatric intensive care dataset spanning ten years from a tertiary care hospital in India, was used to test this hypothesis. Self-supervised transformer models were trained on 144,271 patient-hours of high-resolution physiological signals from 984 pediatric ICU stays to learn representations of heart rate, respiratory rate, oxygen saturation, and arterial blood pressure. Transfer of this model to low-resolution data established robust performance in clinically relevant lower-frequency intervals, consistently outperforming models trained directly at coarser resolutions. Further, these representations generalized across patient populations, maintaining performance when evaluated on adult intensive care cohorts from the MIMIC-III and eICU databases without retraining. In a downstream task of early shock prediction, models achieved strong discrimination in the pediatric cohort (area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) 0.87; area under the precision-recall curve (AUPRC) 0.92) and retained stable performance across monitoring intervals from 10 to 60 minutes (AUROC 0.78-0.88). Together, these results demonstrate that physiological representations learned from high-resolution data enable time-scale-robust and transferable AI for intensive care. The publicly released SafeICU dataset, comprising longitudinal vital signs, laboratory measurements, treatment records, microbiology, and admission and discharge, provides a foundation for developing and deploying generalizable clinical AI in resource-limited settings.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究针对重症监护（ICU）中生理监测频率不一致的问题，提出了一种“分辨率迁移”任务。通过在印度SafeICU数据集（144,271患者小时）的高分辨率生理信号上训练自监督Transformer模型，证明了高频数据训练的模型可以有效泛化至低频采样环境，解决了AI模型在资源受限医疗机构中因数据稀疏而难以部署的痛点。

## 为什么相关
本研究属于临床微生物学与临床监测的交叉领域。摘要明确提到SafeICU数据集包含“微生物学（microbiology）”记录、实验室测量和治疗记录。在临床实践中，败血症或感染性休克的早期识别（如摘要中的休克预测任务）高度依赖于生理体征与微生物检测结果的整合，该模型为在资源有限环境下结合多模态数据进行感染监测提供了技术路径。

## 新颖度判断
中等偏高。其新颖性在于提出了“分辨率迁移”这一特定任务，打破了传统AI模型对固定采样频率的依赖。此外，研究利用了来自非西方国家（印度）的大规模儿科ICU数据集，并成功在MIMIC-III和eICU等成人数据集上实现了跨人群的零样本（without retraining）泛化，这在临床时间序列AI中较为少见。

## 方法与证据
1. **模型与任务**：使用自监督Transformer模型处理心率、呼吸率、血氧和血压信号。
2. **数据规模**：基于SafeICU数据集，涵盖984次儿科ICU住院记录，总计144,271患者小时。
3. **关键指标**：在早期休克预测中，儿科队列AUROC达0.87，AUPRC达0.92。在监测间隔从10分钟延长至60分钟时，AUROC仍保持在0.78-0.88之间，证明了对时间尺度的鲁棒性。
4. **泛化验证**：模型未经重新训练直接应用于MIMIC-III和eICU成人数据库，表现依然稳定。

## 应用价值
该研究具有极强的临床落地潜力，特别是在电力或设备受限、无法进行高频电子监测的基层医院。通过发布包含微生物学和生命体征的SafeICU数据集，为开发针对败血症、休克等重症的通用型预警工具提供了基础。其“高频训练、低频应用”的模式降低了AI在欠发达地区的使用门槛。

## 局限与风险
摘要未详细说明模型在处理极端缺失值或非周期性采样数据时的表现。虽然在休克预测中表现良好，但AUROC在监测间隔拉长时从0.88降至0.78，显示出性能仍受采样频率下降的影响。此外，SafeICU虽为十年纵向数据，但源自单一中心，其微生物学特征与生理体征的关联机制在摘要中未充分展开。

papers.title: A Versatile AI Agent for Rare Disease Diagnosis and Risk Gene Prioritization
papers.text:
title: A Versatile AI Agent for Rare Disease Diagnosis and Risk Gene Prioritization
source: arXiv
topics: 
category: clinical_application
why: 这篇工作更接近临床/监测落地，适合评估其对快速识别、预警或治疗辅助的实际价值。
abstract_zh: 准确及时的诊断对罕见病治疗至关重要，但现有诊断流程常面临评估周期长和准确率低的问题。为此，我们推出了 Hygieia，这是一种多模态 AI 智能体（Agent）系统，旨在通过整合表型特征、遗传谱图和临床记录等多元数据来支持精准诊断。Hygieia 采用基于路由（router-based）和知识增强的框架，有效缓解了模型幻觉，并能针对不同疾病类别定制诊断策略。该系统特别突出了对罕见病相关基因组风险因素的优先级排序功能，并提供置信度评分以辅助临床决策。通过与耶鲁大学医学院和杜克-新加坡国立大学医学院的专家合作验证，结果显示：Hygieia 在多个基准测试中达到顶尖水平，将医生的诊断表现提升了 12% 至 60%，并能有效辅助处理真实病例。研究表明，Hygieia 在提高诊断准确性与可解释性的同时，显著减轻了临床医生的工作负担。
abstract: Accurate and timely diagnosis is essential for effective treatment, particularly in the context of rare diseases. However, current diagnostic workflows often lead to prolonged assessment times and low accuracy. To address these limitations, we introduce Hygieia, a multi-modal AI agent system designed to support precision disease diagnosis by integrating diverse data sources, including phenotypic features, genetic profiles, and clinical records. Hygieia features a router-based and knowledge-enhanced framework that mitigates hallucination and tailors diagnostic strategies to different disease categories. Notably, it prioritizes risk-related genomic factors for rare diseases and provides confidence scores to assist clinical decision-making. We conducted a comprehensive evaluation demonstrating that Hygieia achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple diagnostic benchmarks. In collaboration with clinical experts from Yale School of Medicine and Duke-NUS Medical School, we further validated its practical utility by showing (1) Hygieia's superior diagnostic performance compared to physicians with an improvement from 12%-60% and (2) its effectiveness in assisting clinicians with medical records for handling real-world cases. Our findings indicate that Hygieia not only enhances diagnostic accuracy and interpretability but also significantly reduces clinician workload, highlighting its potential as a valuable tool in clinical decision support systems.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究开发了名为 Hygieia 的多模态 AI 智能体系统，专门用于罕见病的精准诊断与风险基因优先级排序。系统通过整合患者的表型、基因组及临床病历数据，利用知识增强框架解决 LLM 的幻觉问题，并为临床医生提供具有置信度评分的诊断建议。

## 为什么相关
该工作属于典型的“基因组学 + 临床医学 + AI Agent”交叉领域。对于病原生信和基因组学研究者而言，其核心价值在于如何将复杂的遗传谱图（Genetic profiles）与临床表型（Phenotypic features）自动化关联，并直接应用于临床决策支持（CDSS），这与快速识别罕见致病机制的需求高度契合。

## 新颖度判断
新颖度高。不同于传统的单模态诊断模型，Hygieia 引入了“AI Agent”架构和“基于路由（Router-based）”的策略，能够根据疾病类别动态调整诊断逻辑。其通过知识增强手段缓解 AI 幻觉，并给出可解释的置信度评分，在临床落地场景中具有较强的技术领先性。

## 方法与证据
- **方法**：构建多模态框架，整合表型、遗传和临床记录；采用路由机制分发任务；引入外部知识库增强推理。
- **证据**：在多个诊断基准上取得 SOTA 性能。通过与耶鲁和杜克-国大医学院专家合作，实验证明该系统将医生的诊断表现提升了 12%-60%。摘要未说明具体的基准数据集名称及样本量规模。

## 应用价值
1. **临床辅助**：显著提升医生对罕见病的诊断准确率，缩短“诊断漫漫路”。
2. **基因筛选**：自动对风险相关的基因组因素进行优先级排序，辅助分子诊断。
3. **减负增效**：通过自动化处理医疗记录，显著降低临床医生的文案与分析工作量。

## 局限与风险
- **数据透明度**：摘要未提及训练所使用的具体罕见病种类覆盖范围及遗传数据的深度（如 WGS 还是 WES）。
- **幻觉控制**：虽然提到缓解了幻觉，但在极端罕见病例（N-of-1）中的表现稳定性仍需验证。
- **落地挑战**：多模态数据的实时整合在不同医院的信息化系统间可能存在兼容性障碍。

papers.title: ChronoMedKG: A Temporally-Grounded Biomedical Knowledge Graph and Benchmark for Clinical Reasoning
papers.text:
title: ChronoMedKG: A Temporally-Grounded Biomedical Knowledge Graph and Benchmark for Clinical Reasoning
source: arXiv
topics: 
category: foundation_model
why: 这篇工作偏基础模型/Agent方向，可能影响病原检测任务的建模上限，值得关注其任务定义与评测设计。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: Biomedical knowledge graphs (KGs) treat disease associations as static facts, but temporal information is crucial for clinical reasoning, e.g., a symptom diagnostic of one disease at age 3 may imply a different disease at age 13. Existing KGs such as PrimeKG, Hetionet, and iKraph do not encode when a finding becomes clinically relevant over the course of a disease. This limits their usefulness for longitudinal clinical reasoning and retrieval augmentation. We introduce ChronoMedKG, a temporal biomedical knowledge graph that contains 460,497 evidence-linked triples (filtered from 13M raw extractions) covering 13,431 diseases. Each association is tied to temporal components like onset window or progression stage, which are backed by PMID-traceable evidence and a multi-signal credibility score. The graph is constructed through a disease-autonomous multi-agent pipeline in which multiple frontier LLMs independently extract knowledge from PubMed and PMC literature. Only those relations are kept that are supported by multi-model consensus, survive credibility filtering, as well as ontology alignment. ChronoMedKG scored 92.7% agreement against Orphadata and adds temporal grounding for 6,250 diseases absent from HPOA, Orphadata, and Phenopackets, including 1,657 Orphanet-coded rare diseases. We further introduce ChronoTQA, a benchmark of 3,341 questions across eight task types (six temporal plus two static controls), with a 12-question supplementary probe. Frontier LLMs lose roughly 30 points moving from static to temporal questions; ChronoMedKG retrieval rescues 47-65% of their long-tail failures, against 17-29% for HPOA-RAG. As such, ChronoMedKG provides a crucial temporal axis for retrieval-augmented clinical systems that was previously absent.
