category: foundation_model
why: 这篇工作偏基础模型/Agent方向，可能影响病原检测任务的建模上限，值得关注其任务定义与评测设计。
abstract_zh: 抑郁与晚发型阿尔茨海默病（LOAD）风险密切相关，但在高风险人群中的发病机制尚不明确。本研究对比了认知正常的LOAD患者中年子女（O-LOAD，n=28）与无家族史的对照组（HC，n=24），探讨抑郁症状的多模态影像学相关性。受试者平均年龄52岁，通过BDI-II量表评估抑郁症状，并进行结构MRI、静息态fMRI、FDG-PET和PiB-PET扫描。结果显示，O-LOAD组BDI得分升高与左侧中央后回皮层厚度减少相关。fMRI分析发现，O-LOAD组抑郁症状加重与扣带回在皮层边缘、前额叶、岛叶及小脑等区域的连接性降低显著相关（β值-0.10至-0.18）；而HC组则表现为右侧眶额网络连接降低。PiB-PET显示HC组岛叶淀粉样蛋白信号与BDI存在区域特异性关联。研究表明，具有LOAD家族风险的中年人抑郁症状涉及独特的结构与功能网络改变，提示了情感症状与神经退行性易感性之间的早期连接机制。
abstract: Background: Depression is associated with risk for late-onset Alzheimer&aposs disease (LOAD), but its underlying pathogenesis in at-risk individuals remains unclear. We examined multimodal imaging correlates of depressive symptoms in cognitively normal middle-aged offspring of patients with LOAD (O-LOAD) compared with control individuals without LOAD history up to a 4th degree of kinship (HC). Methods: Participants (n=58; 52{+/-}3 years; 74% female) underwent assessment with the Beck Depression Inventory II (BDI), structural MRI, resting-state fMRI, FDG-PET, and PiB-PET. Resting state fMRI data were available for 28 O-LOAD and 24 HC; PET data for 24 O-LOAD and 22 HC. General linear models tested associations between imaging measures and BDI, including group interactions. Results: In O-LOAD, higher BDI scores were associated with reduced cortical thickness in the left postcentral gyrus. Resting-state fMRI revealed significant group by BDI interactions involving cingulate and orbitofrontal networks. In O-LOAD, greater depressive symptom severity was associated with reduced cingulate connectivity across distributed corticolimbic, prefrontal, insular, occipital, and cerebellar regions ({beta} range - 0.10 to -0.18). In HC, depressive symptoms were associated with reduced right orbitofrontal and somatosensory-medial orbitofrontal connectivity ({beta}=-0.13), with divergent patterns of cingulate connectivity. FDG-PET showed no significant associations with depressive symptoms. PiB-PET demonstrated regionally specific associations between amyloid signal and BDI in HC, involving an inverse pattern in anterior and posterior insular cortices. Conclusions: Depressive symptoms in middle-aged individuals at familial risk for LOAD are associated with distinct structural and functional alterations, involving circuitry subserving salience and reward, and suggesting early network-level mechanisms linking affective symptoms with vulnerability to neurodegeneration.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究利用多模态成像技术（结构MRI、rs-fMRI、FDG-PET、PiB-PET）分析了具有阿尔茨海默病（LOAD）家族史的中年人群在认知正常阶段，其抑郁症状（BDI评分）与大脑结构及功能连接之间的关系。研究重点对比了有家族史（O-LOAD）与无家族史（HC）两组人群在神经影像学表现上的差异。

## 为什么相关
尽管分类标签标注为 `foundation_model_agent`，但从摘要内容看，该研究属于典型的**临床神经影像学**范畴。其与 AI/LLM 的相关性极弱，并未涉及基础模型或智能体架构。若要强行关联，其多模态数据的整合分析方法（如处理 MRI 和 PET 的融合数据）可为未来构建神经退行性疾病的预测大模型提供多维特征工程的参考。

## 新颖度判断
**新颖度：中等偏低（0.25）**。研究的新颖之处在于聚焦于“中年期”且“认知正常”的 LOAD 高危后代，试图寻找阿尔茨海默病临床前期的早期生物标志物。然而，所使用的统计方法（广义线性模型 GLM）和影像学指标（皮层厚度、功能连接、淀粉样蛋白沉积）属于该领域的常规手段，缺乏算法层面的突破。

## 方法与证据
- **实验对象**：58名中年受试者（平均52岁），其中 O-LOAD 组与 HC 组在 fMRI（n=52）和 PET（n=46）样本量上略有不同。
- **分析方法**：使用广义线性模型（GLM）测试影像学测量值与 BDI 评分的关联及组间交互作用。
- **关键证据**：在 O-LOAD 组中观察到扣带回连接性广泛下降（β 范围 -0.10 至 -0.18），涉及前额叶和岛叶等区域；而在 HC 组中，抑郁主要与右侧眶额和体感-内侧眶额连接降低相关。PiB-PET 仅在 HC 组中发现岛叶淀粉样蛋白与抑郁评分的相关性。

## 应用价值
该研究识别了 LOAD 高风险人群特有的神经回路改变（如扣带回和眶额网络），这有助于在临床前阶段识别抑郁症状背后的神经退行性风险。这些发现可作为早期干预的潜在靶点，或用于优化阿尔茨海默病风险预测模型的特征选择。

## 局限与风险
- **样本量限制**：总样本量仅 58 人，亚组分析（如 PET 仅 46 人）可能导致统计效能不足，结论的普适性有待验证。
- **AI 深度不足**：摘要未提及任何机器学习或深度学习模型的应用，仅使用了传统的统计推断，无法体现 AI 在复杂多模态数据挖掘中的优势。
- **因果关系不明**：作为横断面研究，无法确定抑郁症状是神经退行性改变的原因还是结果。

papers.title: Multiscale brain-wide mapping of α-synuclein-driven dopaminergic degeneration and white matter impairment in α-synucleinopathy mice
papers.text:
title: Multiscale brain-wide mapping of α-synuclein-driven dopaminergic degeneration and white matter impairment in α-synucleinopathy mice
source: bioRxiv
topics: foundation_model_agent
category: methods
why: 这篇工作更像方法创新，可能直接关联 metagenomics、long-read 或 pathogen identification 流程优化。
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在阐明α-突触核蛋白（α-syn）包涵体形成、多巴胺能变性与白质微结构变化之间的时空关系。研究者向野生型小鼠的黑质致密部（SNc）单侧注射预制纤维体（PFFs）或单体α-syn，并在注射后12周和20周进行9.4T离体磁共振成像（MRI）以评估微结构、体积及顺磁性变化。同时，利用光片显微镜（LSM）在全脑范围内以单细胞分辨率映射α-syn聚集体和多巴胺能神经元。研究开发了一个基于Python的自动化配准流程，实现了离体MRI与LSM之间小于40 μm的对齐误差，并可计算组织透明化诱导的畸变，支持多模态多尺度数据集成。结果显示，12周时同侧SNc出现密集磷酸化α-syn病理，20周时随酪氨酸羟化酶阳性神经元丢失而减少。病理性蛋白沿黑质纹状体通路扩散至同侧纹状体和对侧SNc。该开源框架为理解全脑病理传播提供了工具。
abstract: The spatiotemporal relationships among -synuclein inclusion formation, dopaminergic degeneration, and white matter microstructural changes remain poorly defined. To address this, we unilaterally injected preformed fibrils (PFFs) or monomeric -synuclein into the substantia nigra pars compacta (SNc) of wild-type mice. At 12 and 20 weeks post-injection (wpi), we performed ex vivo magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) at 9.4T to assess microstructural, volumetric and paramagnetic changes, along with light-sheet microscopy (LSM) to map -synuclein aggregates, and dopaminergic neuron at single-cell resolution across the whole brain. We developed a Python-based, automated registration pipeline that achieves <40 m alignment error between ex vivo MRI and LSM and computes clearing-induced distortion, enabling scalable deformation analysis and multimodal multiscale data integration. Unilateral SNc injection of -syn PFFs induced dense phospho--syn pathology in the ipsilateral SNc at 12 wpi, which decreased by 20 wpi in parallel with the loss of tyrosine hydroxylase-positive dopaminergic neuron. Pathogenic synuclein spreads along with dopaminergic denervation in the nigrostriatal pathway to the ipsilateral striatum and contralateral SNc. Our ex vivo MRI-LSM platform provides a scalable, open-source framework for understanding circuit-level and whole-brain propagation of pathology in an -synucleinopathy model and beyond.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究构建了一个整合离体高场磁共振成像（9.4T MRI）与光片显微镜（LSM）的多尺度全脑映射平台。核心产出是一个基于Python的自动化图像配准流水线，用于定量分析α-突触核蛋白（α-syn）在小鼠模型中的传播规律及其引起的多巴胺能神经元变性和白质损伤。

## 为什么相关
虽然该论文的主题是神经退行性疾病，但其核心技术贡献在于“多模态数据集成”与“自动化配准流程”。在病原生物学领域，这种高精度的空间映射技术可被借鉴用于追踪病原体（如病毒或细菌）在宿主器官内的时空定植与扩散规律。然而，摘要中提到的AI交叉点主要集中在传统的计算机视觉配准算法，而非大语言模型（LLM）或智能体（Agent），属于弱AI交叉。

## 新颖度判断
新颖度较低（0.25）。该研究的主要创新点在于将MRI的宏观结构信息与LSM的单细胞分辨率信息进行了高精度对齐（误差<40 μm），并解决了组织透明化过程中的形变计算问题。这种多模态融合在神经科学领域已有类似尝试，本工作更多是流程上的优化与开源贡献。

## 方法与证据
- **实验对象**：野生型小鼠，通过SNc单侧注射α-syn PFFs诱导病理。
- **技术手段**：9.4T离体MRI（微结构分析）+ LSM（单细胞映射）。
- **关键算法**：基于Python的自动化配准pipeline，实现了<40 μm的对齐误差。
- **观察指标**：磷酸化α-syn病理分布、酪氨酸羟化酶（TH）阳性神经元数量、黑质纹状体通路损毁情况。
- **结论证据**：12 wpi（注射后周数）观察到密集病理，20 wpi时病理减少但伴随明显的神经元丢失，证实了病理传播与变性的时空演进。

## 应用价值
该研究提供的开源Python框架可直接应用于其他需要跨尺度空间转录组或病理组数据对齐的研究。对于临床微生物学，该方法可用于建立病原体感染后的全脑损伤图谱，量化白质受损程度。

## 局限与风险
- **离体限制**：所有MRI数据均为离体（ex vivo）采集，无法完全模拟活体状态下的生理动态。
- **模型单一**：仅使用了PFFs诱导的小鼠模型，未验证其在其他蛋白病或感染模型中的普适性。
- **AI深度不足**：摘要未说明是否应用了深度学习进行自动分割或特征提取，配准过程可能仍依赖于传统的几何变换。

papers.title: Flow Matching Meets Biology and Life Science: A Survey
papers.text:
title: Flow Matching Meets Biology and Life Science: A Survey
source: arXiv
topics: 
category: methods
why: 这篇工作更像方法创新，可能直接关联 metagenomics、long-read 或 pathogen identification 流程优化。
abstract_zh: 过去十年，生成式建模（如生成对抗网络、掩码自编码器和扩散模型）显著改变了生物学研究，在分子设计、蛋白质生成、催化发现和药物研发等领域取得了突破性进展。近期，流匹配（Flow Matching）作为一种比扩散模型更强大且高效的替代方案脱颖而出，在生物与生命科学领域的应用兴趣日益增长。本文提供了关于流匹配及其在生物领域应用的首次全面综述。文章首先系统回顾了流匹配的基础理论及其变体，随后将其应用归纳为三大核心领域：生物序列建模、分子生成与设计，以及多肽与蛋白质生成。针对每个领域，本文深入评述了最新进展，并总结了常用的数据集和软件工具。最后，文章探讨了该领域的潜在未来方向。相关资源已在 GitHub 开源，旨在为生物信息学与生成式 AI 的交叉研究提供参考。
abstract: Over the past decade, advances in generative modeling, such as generative adversarial networks, masked autoencoders, and diffusion models, have significantly transformed biological research and discovery, enabling breakthroughs in molecule design, protein generation, catalysis discovery, drug discovery, and beyond. At the same time, biological applications have served as valuable testbeds for evaluating the capabilities of generative models. Recently, flow matching has emerged as a powerful and efficient alternative to diffusion-based generative modeling, with growing interest in its application to problems in biology and life sciences. This paper presents the first comprehensive survey of recent developments in flow matching and its applications in biological domains. We begin by systematically reviewing the foundations and variants of flow matching, and then categorize its applications into three major areas: biological sequence modeling, molecule generation and design, and peptide and protein generation. For each, we provide an in-depth review of recent progress. We also summarize commonly used datasets and software tools, and conclude with a discussion of potential future directions. The corresponding curated resources are available at https://github.com/Violet24K/Awesome-Flow-Matching-Meets-Biology.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该综述系统性地梳理了流匹配（Flow Matching, FM）技术在生命科学领域的应用现状。核心内容涵盖了流匹配的基础理论框架、算法变体，以及其在生物序列建模、小分子生成设计、多肽与蛋白质生成这三大关键生物学任务中的具体实践。此外，文章还汇总了配套的数据集和软件工具链。

## 为什么相关
流匹配作为继扩散模型（Diffusion Models）之后的下一代生成式 AI 技术，具有更高的采样效率和更优的建模性能。对于病原生物学、蛋白质组学和基因组学研究者而言，该技术直接关联到高通量序列分析、功能蛋白设计以及药物靶点发现等前沿流程的优化，是理解当前 AI+Science 趋势的重要文献。

## 新颖度判断
**高**。摘要明确指出这是“首个（first comprehensive survey）”针对流匹配在生物领域应用的全面综述。在生成式 AI 迅速从扩散模型转向流匹配的背景下，该综述填补了生物学应用层面的总结空白。

## 方法与证据
本文属于综述类研究，其证据链基于对既有文献的系统分类与评述。摘要提到将应用分为“生物序列建模（biological sequence modeling）”、“分子生成与设计（molecule generation and design）”以及“多肽与蛋白质生成（peptide and protein generation）”三个维度。文章通过回顾流匹配的“基础与变体（foundations and variants）”来提供理论支撑，并引用了 GitHub 上的开源资源库作为实践证据。

## 应用价值
1. **算法迁移**：为从事蛋白质组学和基因组学的研究者提供了从扩散模型迁移到更高效流匹配模型的路径参考。
2. **工具集成**：总结的“常用数据集和软件工具（commonly used datasets and software tools）”可直接辅助病原体序列分析或新药研发的基准测试。
3. **设计启发**：在多肽和蛋白质生成方面的综述有助于指导临床微生物学中的抗菌肽设计或疫苗抗原开发。

## 局限与风险
1. **综述局限**：作为综述文章，其本身不提供新的实验数据或新算法的性能验证，结论依赖于所引用原始文献的准确性。
2. **摘要未说明**：摘要未具体列出哪些特定的流匹配变体（如离散流匹配或流插值法）在生物学任务中表现最优，也未提及具体的实验指标（如 RMSD 或序列一致性）提升幅度。
3. **落地挑战**：流匹配虽然在理论上更高效，但在处理极大规模生物序列（如长读段宏基因组数据）时的计算开销和收敛性问题在摘要中未予详细讨论。

papers.title: Conversational Artificial Intelligence-Enabled Molecular Characterization of Sezary Syndrome Reveals Distinct Pathway-Level Alterations Compared with Non-Sezary Cutaneous T-Cell Lymphoma
papers.text:
title: Conversational Artificial Intelligence-Enabled Molecular Characterization of Sezary Syndrome Reveals Distinct Pathway-Level Alterations Compared with Non-Sezary Cutaneous T-Cell Lymphoma
source: medRxiv
topics: 
category: clinical_application
why: 这篇工作更接近临床/监测落地，适合评估其对快速识别、预警或治疗辅助的实际价值。
abstract_zh: 塞扎里综合征（SS）是皮肤T细胞淋巴瘤（CTCL）的一种侵袭性白血病变体。本研究利用面向精准肿瘤学的对话式人工智能（AI）平台，对哥伦比亚大学CTCL队列（SS组n=26，非SS组n=17）的体细胞突变和临床数据进行了二次分析。结果显示，SS与非SS CTCL的肿瘤突变负荷（TMB）无显著差异（p=0.83）。通路水平分析揭示了显著的定性差异：SS在表观遗传调节因子、肿瘤抑制和细胞周期控制基因、NFAT信号传导以及凋亡/免疫调节相关基因中表现出突变富集；相比之下，MAPK和JAK-STAT通路突变在非SS CTCL中更为频繁。共突变分析显示，SS的基因互作网络比非SS CTCL更集中。研究表明，SS的分子特征在于特定的通路改变而非突变总量，并验证了对话式AI代理在加速转化癌症基因组学解释和假设生成中的实用性。
abstract: ABSTRACT Background: Sezary syndrome (SS) represents an aggressive leukemic variant of cutaneous T-cell lymphoma (CTCL) with distinct clinical behavior compared with other CTCL subtypes. While prior studies have identified recurrent genomic alterations in CTCL, a systematic pathway-centric comparison between SS and non-SS CTCL remains limited. We applied our conversational artificial intelligence (AI) platform for precision oncology, to accelerate hypothesis generation and integrative interpretation of public genomic data. Methods: We performed a secondary analysis of somatic mutation and clinical data from the Columbia University CTCL cohort available via cBioPortal. Samples were stratified into SS (n=26) and non-SS CTCL (n=17). High-impact coding variants were retained and annotated to curated functional gene groups and signaling pathways relevant to CTCL biology. Pathway-level mutation frequencies were compared using Fishers exact test, with effect sizes summarized by odds ratios. Tumor mutation burden (TMB) was compared using Wilcoxon rank-sum testing. Subtype-specific gene-gene co-mutation patterns were assessed using pairwise association testing and visualized with heatmaps and oncoplots, with our conversational AI agents facilitating interactive exploration and prioritization of results. Results: Overall TMB did not differ between SS and non-SS CTCL (p=0.83), indicating comparable global mutational burden. Pathway-level analyses revealed enrichment of alterations affecting epigenetic regulators, tumor suppressor and cell-cycle control genes, NFAT signaling, and apoptosis/immune regulation in SS, whereas MAPK and JAK-STAT pathway alterations were relatively more frequent in non-SS CTCL. Co-mutation analysis demonstrated fewer but more focused gene-gene interactions in SS compared with broader co-mutation networks in non-SS CTCL, suggesting divergent evolutionary constraints. Several genes (including ERBB2, WWC1, POSTN) showed borderline subtype-specific enrichment, warranting further validation. Conclusions: Conversational AI-enhanced analysis reveals that SS is distinguished from other CTCL subtypes not by higher mutational load, but by qualitative differences in pathway involvement, particularly epigenetic dysregulation, immune escape, and transcriptional control. These findings generate testable hypotheses for downstream validation in patient-level datasets and demonstrate the utility of conversational AI agents as accelerators of translational cancer genomics.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究利用对话式AI平台对哥伦比亚大学CTCL队列（n=43）的基因组数据进行二次挖掘，对比了塞扎里综合征（SS）与非SS皮肤T细胞淋巴瘤的分子差异。核心发现是两者在总肿瘤突变负荷（TMB）上没有统计学差异（p=0.83），但在受累通路上有显著定性区别：SS侧重于表观遗传和免疫逃逸通路，而非SS侧重于MAPK和JAK-STAT通路。

## 为什么相关
本研究直接切入“基因组学+AI/LLM/Agent”的交叉点。它展示了如何利用对话式AI代理（Conversational AI agents）来辅助临床研究人员进行复杂的基因组数据解释、假设生成和结果优先级排序，属于AI赋能精准医疗的典型案例。

## 新颖度判断
中等偏高。虽然SS的基因组研究已有先例，但引入“对话式AI平台”作为交互式探索工具是其主要创新点。这种方法改变了传统的静态生物信息学分析流程，强调了AI在转化医学中作为“研究加速器”的角色。

## 方法与证据
研究采用了cBioPortal中的体细胞突变数据，样本量为26例SS和17例非SS。统计学方法包括费舍尔精确检验（Fisher's exact test）比较通路频率，以及威尔科克森秩和检验比较TMB。AI代理参与了结果的交互式探索。具体证据显示，ERBB2、WWC1和POSTN等基因表现出亚型特异性富集趋势，且SS的共突变网络比非SS更集中，暗示了不同的进化约束。

## 应用价值
临床上，这些发现有助于开发区分SS与非SS CTCL的分子诊断标志物。对于AI领域，该工作验证了对话式AI在处理复杂生物医学数据、辅助科研人员快速提取关键生物学见解方面的可行性，为开发临床肿瘤学决策支持系统提供了参考。

## 局限与风险
样本量相对较小（总计43例），部分基因（如ERBB2）的亚型特异性富集仅处于临界水平，尚需更大规模的独立队列验证。此外，摘要未详细说明对话式AI的具体模型架构（如是否基于GPT-4等）及其在分析中可能产生的幻觉风险控制机制。

papers.title: OpenScientist: evaluating an open agentic AI co-scientist to accelerate biomedical discovery
papers.text:
title: OpenScientist: evaluating an open agentic AI co-scientist to accelerate biomedical discovery
source: medRxiv
topics: 
category: clinical_application
why: 这篇工作更接近临床/监测落地，适合评估其对快速识别、预警或治疗辅助的实际价值。
abstract_zh: 背景：医学进步依赖于对大规模复杂数据的分析，但受限于研究人员的时间和专业知识。OpenScientist 是一款开源的智能体 AI（agentic AI）科研助手，旨在通过半自主调查科学问题并生成可验证的临床见解来加速生物医学发现。方法：领域专家在四个临床案例中评估了 OpenScientist：(1) 社区阿尔茨海默病生物标志物队列分析；(2) 血浆蛋白质组生存预测的无监督建模；(3) 神经原纤维缠结神经元的单细胞转录组数据假设调查；(4) 多发性骨髓瘤数据集的假设生成与验证（含随机阴性对照）。结果：OpenScientist 在几分钟内完成了通常需要数周或数月的人工分析。它确定 %ptau217 是淀粉样蛋白 PET 状态的最佳预测指标，生成的血浆蛋白质组生存模型性能与已发表模型相当，提出了 tau 病理与溶酶体酸化改变相关的机制，并生成了在外部队列中得到验证的多发性骨髓瘤假设。结论：OpenScientist 证明了开放、可审计的智能体 AI 能通过生成假设、执行分析和从复杂数据中发现见解来支持真实世界的临床研究。
abstract: Background: Advances in medicine depend on analyzing large and complex data sources, but discovery is partly constrained by the limited time and domain expertise of human researchers. Agentic artificial intelligence (agentic AI) can accelerate discovery by automating components of the scientific workflow, including information retrieval, data analysis, and knowledge synthesis. Aim: OpenScientist, an open-source agentic AI co-scientist, aims to accelerate biomedical discovery by semi-autonomously investigating scientist-defined queries and generating clinically relevant, verifiable scientific insights. Methods: Domain experts evaluated OpenScientist for novel discoveries in four clinical case studies: (1) a prespecified analysis in a community-based Alzheimer's disease biomarker cohort, (2) unsupervised modeling for plasma proteomic survival prediction, (3) hypothesis investigation in single-cell transcriptomic data from neurons with neurofibrillary tangles, and (4) hypothesis generation with validation in a multiple myeloma dataset with a randomized negative control. Results: OpenScientist completed analyses in minutes that otherwise would take weeks to months of human time and expertise. It identified %ptau217 as the best predictor of amyloid PET status, generated a plasma proteomic survival model with performance comparable to published models, proposed a mechanism linking tau pathology to altered lysosomal acidification, and generated multiple myeloma hypotheses that were validated in an external cohort while distinguishing true signal from randomized controls. Conclusion: OpenScientist demonstrates that open, auditable, agentic AI can support real-world clinical research by generating hypotheses, executing analyses, and discovering insights from complex datasets.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究评估了名为 **OpenScientist** 的开源智能体 AI（Agentic AI）在生物医学发现中的效能。该系统不仅限于文本生成，而是能够执行信息检索、数据分析和知识合成等科学工作流。研究通过阿尔茨海默病（AD）、血浆蛋白质组学、单细胞转录组学和多发性骨髓瘤四个具体临床案例，证明了该 AI 能够半自主地从复杂数据集中提取具有临床价值的见解。

## 为什么相关
本研究高度契合**蛋白质组学、基因组学与 AI/Agent 交叉领域**。它直接展示了 AI Agent 如何处理血浆蛋白质组数据进行生存预测，以及如何分析单细胞转录组数据（scRNA-seq）来探索神经退行性疾病的分子机制。对于临床微生物学或病原研究领域，这种自动化分析复杂组学数据并生成可验证假设的能力具有极强的迁移应用潜力。

## 新颖度判断
**新颖度高（0.75）**。不同于传统的预测模型或简单的 LLM 问答，OpenScientist 采用了“智能体（Agentic）”架构，强调**半自主性**和**全流程自动化**（从查询到分析再到验证）。其开源、可审计的特性解决了 AI 在临床研究中常见的“黑箱”问题，且在实验设计中引入了随机负对照来测试 AI 的鲁棒性，这在同类 AI 辅助科研工具中较为少见。

## 方法与证据
摘要提供了四个维度的证据：
1. **生物标志物识别**：在 AD 队列中准确识别出 **%ptau217** 为淀粉样蛋白 PET 状态的最佳预测指标。
2. **蛋白质组学建模**：在血浆蛋白质组生存预测任务中，AI 生成的模型性能达到了已发表学术模型的水平。
3. **机制探索**：通过分析单细胞转录组数据，提出了 **tau 病理与溶酶体酸化改变**之间的机械联系。
4. **严谨性验证**：在多发性骨髓瘤研究中，通过外部队列验证了 AI 生成的假设，并证明 AI 能区分真实生物信号与随机化的负对照信号。

## 应用价值
1. **极速分析**：将原本需要数周或数月的人工分析缩短至**分钟级**，极大提升了科研效率。
2. **辅助决策**：在临床生物标志物筛选和生存预测模型构建方面具有直接应用前景。
3. **假设生成**：能从海量组学数据中挖掘潜在的病理机制（如溶酶体酸化），为基础研究提供新方向。

## 局限与风险
1. **半自主性限制**：摘要提到是“半自主（semi-autonomously）”调查，意味着仍需人类科学家定义查询并进行最终把关，并非完全脱离人工。
2. **数据依赖性**：虽然在四个案例中表现良好，但 AI 的表现高度依赖于输入数据的质量和规模，摘要未详细说明其在数据稀疏或高噪声环境下的表现。
3. **可解释性深度**：尽管声称“可审计”，但 AI 提出的分子机制（如溶酶体酸化）是否具备深层生物学逻辑，仍需实验生物学家进行湿实验验证。

papers.title: Atomic Trajectory Modeling with State Space Models for Biomolecular Dynamics
papers.text:
title: Atomic Trajectory Modeling with State Space Models for Biomolecular Dynamics
source: arXiv
topics: 
category: methods
why: 这篇工作更像方法创新，可能直接关联 metagenomics、long-read 或 pathogen identification 流程优化。
abstract_zh: 理解生物分子的动态行为对于阐明生物功能和促进药物发现至关重要。虽然分子动力学（MD）模拟为研究这些动态提供了严谨的物理基础，但在长尺度上计算成本极高。现有的深度生成模型虽能加速构象生成，但往往无法建模时间关系，或仅限于单体蛋白质。为弥补这一缺陷，我们提出了 ATMOS，这是一种基于状态空间模型（SSM）的新型生成框架，旨在为生物分子系统生成原子级 MD 轨迹。ATMOS 集成了基于 Pairformer 的状态转换机制以捕捉长程时间依赖，并结合扩散模块以自回归方式解码轨迹帧。ATMOS 在 PDB 晶体结构以及 mdCATH 和 MISATO 等大规模 MD 模拟数据集上进行了训练。实验证明，ATMOS 在生成蛋白质单体和蛋白质-配体复合物系统的构象轨迹方面达到了 SOTA 性能。通过实现高效的原子运动轨迹推理，该工作为生物分子动力学建模奠定了基础。
abstract: Understanding the dynamic behavior of biomolecules is fundamental to elucidating biological function and facilitating drug discovery. While Molecular Dynamics (MD) simulations provide a rigorous physical basis for studying these dynamics, they remain computationally expensive for long timescales. Conversely, recent deep generative models accelerate conformation generation but are typically either failing to model temporal relationship or built only for monomeric proteins. To bridge this gap, we introduce ATMOS, a novel generative framework based on State Space Models (SSM) designed to generate atom-level MD trajectories for biomolecular systems. ATMOS integrates a Pairformer-based state transition mechanism to capture long-range temporal dependencies, with a diffusion-based module to decode trajectory frames in an autoregressive manner. ATMOS is trained across crystal structures from PDB and conformation trajectory from large-scale MD simulation datasets including mdCATH and MISATO. We demonstrate that ATMOS achieves state-of-the-art performance in generating conformation trajectories for both protein monomers and complex protein-ligand systems. By enabling efficient inference of atomic trajectory of motions, this work establishes a promising foundation for modeling biomolecular dynamics.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究提出了名为 **ATMOS** 的生成式框架，专门用于生成生物分子（包括蛋白质单体及蛋白质-配体复合物）的原子级分子动力学（MD）轨迹。其核心是利用**状态空间模型（SSM）**来解决传统 MD 模拟计算量大以及现有 AI 模型缺乏时间维度建模的问题。

## 为什么相关
在病原体研究和临床微生物学中，理解病毒或细菌关键蛋白（如蛋白酶、受体结合域）的动态构象变化对于药物设计至关重要。ATMOS 能够处理**蛋白质-配体系统**，这直接关联到抗生素或抗病毒药物的筛选与优化。此外，该方法对大规模 MD 数据集的利用，为从基因组序列到蛋白质功能动态演化的预测提供了技术支撑。

## 新颖度判断
**高**。该工作首次将 **State Space Models (SSM)** 引入原子级 MD 轨迹生成领域。相比于传统的 Transformer，SSM 在处理长序列（长程时间依赖）时具有更高的效率。同时，模型突破了以往模型仅限于单体蛋白的限制，支持复合物建模，并结合了**扩散模型（Diffusion）**进行自回归解码，在方法论上具有显著的交叉创新。

## 方法与证据
- **模型架构**：采用基于 **Pairformer** 的状态转换机制捕捉空间与时间的依赖关系，并结合**扩散模块**进行轨迹帧的自回归解码。
- **数据规模**：模型在 **PDB** 晶体结构数据集以及 **mdCATH** 和 **MISATO** 两个大规模 MD 模拟轨迹数据集上进行了联合训练。
- **实验对象**：涵盖了蛋白质单体（monomer）和复杂的蛋白质-配体（protein-ligand）系统。
- **结论证据**：摘要声称在轨迹生成任务中达到了 **SOTA（当前最佳）** 性能，但摘要未说明具体的 RMSD 或时间加速比等量化指标数值。

## 应用价值
- **药物研发**：通过高效推理蛋白质与配体结合的动态轨迹，加速先导化合物的动力学评估。
- **生物物理研究**：为研究病原体蛋白的功能机制提供低成本的轨迹模拟工具。
- **计算效率**：相比传统物理 MD 模拟，ATMOS 提供的生成式方法有望大幅缩短获取长尺度轨迹的时间。

## 局限与风险
- **物理一致性**：摘要未明确说明生成轨迹是否严格遵循物理守恒定律（如能量守恒）。
- **泛化能力**：虽然在 mdCATH 等数据集训练，但对于完全未见的、具有高度柔性的病原体新蛋白的预测精度尚待验证。
- **数据依赖**：模型性能高度依赖于高质量 MD 轨迹数据集（如 MISATO），对于缺乏模拟数据的复杂生物过程可能受限。

papers.title: Spatial multi-omics of multiple myeloma uncovers niche-dependent pro-myeloma and immunosuppressive signaling in the bone marrow and extramedullary lesions
papers.text:
title: Spatial multi-omics of multiple myeloma uncovers niche-dependent pro-myeloma and immunosuppressive signaling in the bone marrow and extramedullary lesions
source: bioRxiv
topics: 
category: methods
why: 这篇工作更像方法创新，可能直接关联 metagenomics、long-read 或 pathogen identification 流程优化。
abstract_zh: 多发性骨髓瘤（MM）是一种受浆细胞与免疫微环境动态相互作用影响的恶性肿瘤。为在空间维度剖析细胞背景对 MM 及免疫细胞表达的影响，本研究开发了一个整合 10x Genomics Visium HD、Xenium 及临床注释单细胞 RNA 测序（scRNA-seq）数据的多模态框架。Visium HD 实现了 16μm 分辨率下的无偏全转录组空间发现，Xenium 提供单细胞水平的正交验证，scRNA-seq 则通过映射空间标签和利用高测序深度扩展了研究发现。研究者开发了 Visium HD 空间仓位细胞注释的自定义框架，识别出富集非经典 Wnt 信号的浆细胞密集微环境（niche），该环境与细胞粘附介导的耐药、较差的无进展生存期（PFS）及髓外病变相关。此类环境中的免疫细胞表现出受抑状态，如 LAG3 等抑制性受体表达增加。基于此，研究者开发了包含 15 个基因的特征模型，可独立预测 PFS（HR = 2.00, p < 0.0001）。
abstract: Multiple myeloma (MM) is a plasma cell malignancy shaped by dynamic interactions between MM cells and non-malignant cells in the immune microenvironment. To spatially profile the influence of cellular context on MM and immune cell expression, we developed a multimodal framework integrating 10x Genomics Visium HD, 10x Genomics Xenium, and clinically annotated single-cell RNA (scRNA-seq) sequencing datasets. Visium HD enabled unbiased, whole transcriptome, spatial discovery at 16 m resolution, Xenium provided orthogonal validation at single-cell resolution, and scRNA-seq extended findings by mapping spatial labels and leveraging the greater sequencing depth. We developed a custom framework for cell type annotation within Visium HD spatial bins. Our approach enabled identification of plasma cell-dense niches enriched for non-canonical Wnt signaling, associated with gene expression supporting cell adhesion mediated drug resistance, inferior progression-free survival, and extramedullary lesions. Immune cells within these neighborhoods exhibited suppressed transcriptional states, including increased inhibitory receptor expression such as LAG3. Utilizing the niche-driven transcriptional states in MM and immune cells, we were able to develop a 15-gene signature independently predictive of progression free survival (HR = 2.00, p < 0.0001). Collectively, this study demonstrates the potential of integrated spatial and single-cell transcriptomics to define niche-specific programs supporting MM progression.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究构建了一个多模态空间组学分析框架，旨在揭示多发性骨髓瘤（MM）在骨髓和髓外病变中的空间异质性。核心发现是识别出一种特定的浆细胞密集型微环境（niche），该环境通过非经典 Wnt 信号传导驱动肿瘤进展、免疫抑制（如 LAG3 表达上调）及耐药性。此外，研究利用空间驱动的转录状态开发了具有显著预后价值的 15 基因签名。

## 为什么相关
本研究在基因组学与空间组学交叉领域具有高度相关性。虽然其核心对象是肿瘤，但其开发的多模态整合流程（Visium HD + Xenium + scRNA-seq）以及针对空间仓位（spatial bins）的自定义细胞注释算法，对于病原体-宿主相互作用的空间转录组研究、临床微生物浸润分析具有重要的技术迁移价值。

## 新颖度判断
新颖度较高（0.75）。其创新点在于：1. 首次应用了 16μm 超高分辨率的 Visium HD 技术于 MM 研究；2. 实现了从全转录组发现到单细胞原位验证的闭环；3. 并非简单的空间聚类，而是通过定义“微环境驱动的转录状态”来构建临床预后模型。

## 方法与证据
- **技术栈**：10x Genomics Visium HD（16μm 分辨率，全转录组）、Xenium（单细胞原位验证）、scRNA-seq（深度测序与标签映射）。
- **关键指标**：识别出非经典 Wnt 信号通路；发现免疫抑制标志物 LAG3 在特定微环境高表达。
- **模型效能**：15 基因预后签名在独立预测无进展生存期（PFS）时，风险比（HR）达到 2.00，统计学显著性 p < 0.0001。

## 应用价值
- **临床诊断**：15 基因签名可作为 MM 患者预后分层的新工具。
- **药物研发**：识别出的非经典 Wnt 信号和细胞粘附介导的耐药机制为克服 MM 耐药提供了潜在靶点。
- **方法学**：为高分辨率空间组学数据处理提供了可借鉴的自定义注释框架。

## 局限与风险
- **弱 AI 交叉**：研究主要侧重于生物信息学流程整合与统计建模，摘要中未提及是否使用了深度学习或大语言模型（LLM）进行自动化注释或预测。
- **数据局限**：摘要未说明样本量（N）的具体规模，亦未提及该 15 基因签名在不同种族或治疗背景下的外部验证情况。
- **技术细节**：自定义细胞注释框架的具体算法逻辑在摘要中未详细说明。

papers.title: Current understanding and future directions in severe asthma through artificial intelligence-integrated multi-omic approaches.
papers.text:
title: Current understanding and future directions in severe asthma through artificial intelligence-integrated multi-omic approaches.
source: PubMed
topics: 
category: methods
why: 这篇工作更像方法创新，可能直接关联 metagenomics、long-read 或 pathogen identification 流程优化。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: Severe asthma remains a challenging, heterogeneous condition, despite significant advances in therapeutic strategies. A subset of patients continues to experience poor control, frequent exacerbations and a high burden of disease. The advent of multi-omic technologies, including genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics and metabolomics, has opened new avenues for understanding the molecular underpinnings of asthma. When combined with artificial intelligence (AI), these approaches hold the potential to transform and augment the management of severe asthma by identifying key biomarkers, refining disease endotypes and enabling personalised treatment strategies. This review explores the role of AI-integrated multi-omic approaches in asthma research, highlighting how AI-driven models can analyse vast datasets to uncover patterns often missed by traditional methods. These insights can improve diagnostic precision, predict therapeutic responses and guide the development of novel, targeted therapies. Key areas of focus include genetic loci associated with asthma severity, single-cell RNA sequencing to uncover cellular heterogeneity, and proteomic profiles that differentiate asthma phenotypes. Through this review, we aim to provide readers with a clear understanding of the current landscape in severe asthma research, highlighting the breakthroughs achieved through AI-integrated multi-omic approaches. Additionally, we aspire to guide the future direction of the field by addressing the challenges that remain in translating these discoveries into clinical practice. By fostering a deeper understanding of the potential of these technologies, we hope to inspire further innovations that will pave the way for precision medicine to transform severe asthma management, ultimately leading to more personalised and effective treatment options for patients.

why: 这篇工作更接近临床/监测落地，适合评估其对快速识别、预警或治疗辅助的实际价值。
abstract_zh: 针对慢性淋巴细胞白血病（CLL）中固定疗程（FD）BTK抑制剂（BTKi）联合维奈克拉方案的患者选择，本研究旨在弥合临床试验与真实世界实践之间的差距。研究采用改进的德尔菲法，邀请意大利坎帕尼亚地区的9位血液学家，围绕合并症、基因组学（TP53/del(17p)、IGHV状态、复杂核型）及物流（照护支持、就医距离、给药能力）三大决策领域进行评估。基于2014-2025年的系统文献综述制定了12项声明，共识标准设定为≥75%一致性。结果显示，83.3%的声明达成共识。专家组建议对年轻、体健且基因风险中低水平的患者采用FD方案；对于心血管风险中低水平者，二代BTKi（如阿可替尼）联合维奈克拉优于伊布替尼方案。高危基因特征和物流挑战则倾向于选择持续二代BTKi单药治疗。此外，利用ChatGPT-4进行AI基准测试，显示其与专家共识的吻合度仅为58.3%（Cohen's κ = 0.32）。本研究为CLL一线治疗提供了务实的共识框架，并初步探讨了人机协作决策的潜力。
abstract: Optimal patient selection for the most effective BTK inhibitor (BTKi) partner of venetoclax in fixed-duration (FD) BTKi-venetoclax regimens for chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL) remains uncertain. This uncertainty largely reflects trial populations that are younger and fitter than many real-world patients, which may limit generalizability to older individuals or those with multiple comorbidities. The present study aims to provide harmonized, pragmatic guidance that bridges trial evidence and routine clinical practice for physicians caring for patients within a regional Italian area served by an established CLL network. An adapted Delphi process engaged nine hematologists from Campania, a Southern Italian region, to evaluate the impact of BTKi-venetoclax upfront decision making on three key CLL decision domains: (1) specific comorbidities, (2) genomics (TP53/del(17p), IGHV status, complex karyotype), and (3) logistics (caregiver support, distance to center, and venetoclax ramp-up capacity). A preregistered systematic literature review (2014-2025) informed 12 statements, with consensus defined as ≥ 75% agreement. The two-round Delphi included structured discussion and anonymous voting. Additionally, artificial intelligence (AI) benchmarking with ChatGPT-4 assessed concordance with evidence briefs. Consensus was achieved on 83.3% of statements. The panel recommended FD BTKi-venetoclax regimens for fit, younger patients with low- or intermediate-genomic risk. For patients with low-intermediate cardiovascular risk, continuous second-generation BTKi monotherapy or FD therapy combining a second-generation BTKi acalabrutinib with venetoclax is preferable to FD ibrutinib-venetoclax. Adverse genomic features and logistical challenges were key factors favoring continuous second-generation BTKi therapy. AI benchmarking indicated potential for hybrid human-AI decision support, although concordance was fair (58.3%; Cohen's κ = 0.32). This study provides a pragmatic, consensus-driven framework for FD BTKi-venetoclax therapy in CLL, emphasizing patient selection and logistical feasibility. The work lays the groundwork for more rigorous evaluation of human-AI collaboration in the still-complex landscape of first-line CLL therapy.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究通过德尔菲法（Delphi process）整合了血液学专家意见与系统文献综述，制定了针对CLL患者使用固定疗程（FD）BTKi-维奈克拉方案的临床指导建议，并引入ChatGPT-4作为AI基准，评估大语言模型在临床决策支持中的表现。

## 为什么相关
本研究涉及临床基因组学（TP53、IGHV状态、复杂核型）在治疗决策中的应用，并直接探讨了AI（LLM）在血液肿瘤临床路径中的一致性评价，属于临床医学与AI决策支持的交叉领域。

## 新颖度判断
新颖度中等偏上（0.75）。其创新点在于不仅完成了传统的专家共识，还同步使用了ChatGPT-4进行基准测试（AI benchmarking），将AI的决策逻辑与人类专家在特定区域（意大利坎帕尼亚）的临床实践进行定量对比。

## 方法与证据
- **数据与规模**：纳入9名血液学家，基于2014-2025年的文献综述制定12项声明。
- **共识结果**：83.3%的声明达成共识。明确指出对于年轻体健患者推荐FD方案，而对于存在心血管风险的患者，推荐二代BTKi（阿可替尼）联合方案。
- **AI实验**：使用ChatGPT-4对12项声明进行评估，结果显示与专家共识的吻合度仅为58.3%，Cohen's κ系数为0.32，属于“一般（fair）”一致性。

## 应用价值
为临床医生在面对非试验人群（高龄、多合并症）时提供了具体的用药决策参考，特别是细化了基因组学特征和物流因素（如维奈克拉剂量爬坡能力）对方案选择的影响。同时，量化了当前LLM在复杂血液病决策中的局限性。

## 局限与风险
- **AI表现欠佳**：ChatGPT-4的一致性得分（58.3%）较低，说明目前AI尚不能独立承担此类复杂的临床决策辅助。
- **样本局限性**：专家组成员仅限于意大利南部单一区域（坎帕尼亚），可能存在地域性的临床偏好。
- **弱AI交叉**：AI在此研究中仅作为对比参照（Benchmark），而非核心算法驱动或预测模型，属于AI在临床管理中的初步探索。

papers.title: GeneBench: Assessing AI Agents for Multi-Stage Inference Problems in Genomics and Quantitative Biology
papers.text:
title: GeneBench: Assessing AI Agents for Multi-Stage Inference Problems in Genomics and Quantitative Biology
source: bioRxiv
topics: 
category: dataset
why: 这篇工作偏数据集或基准构建，适合判断是否能作为病原组学训练或评测资源。
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了 GeneBench，这是一个针对遗传学和定量生物学中真实多阶段科学数据分析的 AI Agent 基准测试。现有基准多侧重于知识检索或单一分析步骤，而 GeneBench 填补了计算科学家在数据清洗、归一化、探索性数据分析、统计模型选择及诊断迭代等复杂工作流程中的评估空白。该基准包含 10 个领域的 103 项评估任务，以基因组学为核心，涵盖其他组学和定量生物学场景。每个问题均为封装的多步分析，提供分阶段数据和最简引导提示，并设有可验证的答案。解决这些问题需要识别并处理测量误差、选择偏倚、混杂因素和质控（QC）失败等现实障碍。评估结果显示，GPT-5.5 在高推理设置下的通过率为 25.0%，GPT-5.5 Pro 为 33.2%，而 Gemini 3.1 Pro 仅为 11.2%。研究发现，模型虽能识别局部诊断信号，但往往无法将其转化为正确的分析决策，导致错误在推理链中累积。GeneBench 衡量了一种目前尚不可靠的新兴能力。
abstract: We introduce GeneBench, a benchmark for AI agents on realistic multi-stage scientific data analysis in genetics and quantitative biology. Existing biology benchmarks mostly measure knowledge retrieval, execution of routine pipelines, or a single analysis step. Yet they do not capture the broader scope of work that occupies much of computational scientists' time: cleaning and normalizing assay, phenotype, or clinical data; exploratory data analysis; statistical model selection and diagnostic iteration; and producing a conclusion that informs a downstream scientific or translational decision. GeneBench addresses this gap with 103 evaluations targeting quantities of direct practical relevance across 10 domains, with a genomics-centered core and adjacent coverage in other 'omics and quantitative biology settings. Each problem comprises an encapsulated multi-step analysis with staged data, prompts that define a quantity of interest while otherwise providing minimal guidance, and verifiable answers. Solving each problem requires identifying and addressing realistic obstacles such as measurement error, selection bias, confounding, QC failures, and choosing among competing model classes. Through extensive ablation studies, we verify that each problem admits a single defensible answer. Each problem involves multiple dependent decision points; i.e., substantive inferential forks where a plausible wrong choice changes the downstream analysis, such that errors propagate through the inferential chain and into the final graded target. In initial evaluations, the mainline GPT family reaches an eval-level pass rate of 25.0% with GPT-5.5 at the xhigh reasoning setting. In separately reported GPT Pro runs, GPT-5.5 Pro reaches 33.2%, GPT-5.4 Pro reaches 25.6%, and GPT-5.2 Pro reaches 10.8%. Even for the two strongest reported Pro-harness settings, 60.2% and 62.1% of problems, respectively, remain below 20% pass rate over repeated runs. The strongest external baseline, Gemini 3.1 Pro, achieves 11.2%. Models often complete substantial portions of the workflow but exhibit a consistent gap between noticing and acting: they identify local diagnostic signals but fail to propagate the implication to the corresponding analysis decision, and as a result select wrong estimators or persist on initially plausible but incorrect analysis paths. GeneBench therefore measures an emerging capability that remains as yet unreliable.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究构建了名为 GeneBench 的基准测试集，专门用于评估 AI Agent 在遗传学和定量生物学领域处理复杂、多阶段推理问题的能力。该基准包含 103 个评估任务，覆盖 10 个生物学领域，重点考察模型在数据清洗、统计建模、诊断迭代及得出科学结论方面的表现，而非简单的知识问答。

## 为什么相关
在病原组学和临床微生物学研究中，数据分析往往涉及复杂的质控（QC）和多步推断。GeneBench 模拟了真实的计算生物学工作流，其涵盖的“测量误差”、“混杂因素”和“质控失败”等挑战，正是病原体基因组分析和临床多组学数据整合中常见的痛点。该基准可作为评估病原组学自动化分析 Agent 可靠性的核心资源。

## 新颖度判断
高。相比于现有的侧重知识检索（Knowledge Retrieval）或单一流水线执行的基准，GeneBench 首次系统性地提出了“推理分叉点（Inferential Forks）”概念，要求 AI 在没有详细指令的情况下，根据中间结果自主修正分析路径，这更接近真实的科研场景。

## 方法与证据
- **数据规模**：包含 103 个评估任务，跨越 10 个生物学子领域。
- **实验对象**：测试了 GPT-5.5、GPT-5.4、GPT-5.2 及其 Pro 版本，以及 Gemini 3.1 Pro。
- **关键指标**：GPT-5.5 Pro 达到最高通过率 33.2%，而 Gemini 3.1 Pro 仅为 11.2%。
- **核心发现**：模型存在“观察与行动脱节”现象，即能识别出局部异常信号（如 QC 失败），但无法据此调整后续分析策略，导致 60% 以上的问题在多次运行中通过率低于 20%。

## 应用价值
1. **模型评测**：为开发生物医学专用大模型提供了一个高难度的性能度量衡。
2. **Agent 开发**：揭示了当前 Agent 在处理“推理链错误传播”方面的弱点，指导未来在病原组学自动化工具中引入更强的诊断反馈机制。
3. **教学与实战**：任务设计中包含的“现实障碍”（如选择偏倚）可作为生物信息学自动化流程的典型案例库。

## 局限与风险
- **模型性能瓶颈**：摘要显示即使是最强的 GPT-5.5 Pro，通过率也仅为 33.2%，说明 AI Agent 在处理此类任务时仍极不可靠。
- **领域覆盖**：虽然以基因组学为核心，但对于临床微生物学中特有的病原鉴定、耐药基因挖掘等特定任务的覆盖程度，摘要未详细说明。
- **错误累积**：由于任务具有依赖性，初始阶段的微小决策错误会导致最终结果完全偏离，这在临床决策支持中具有较高风险。

papers.title: Learning the All-Atom Equilibrium Distribution of Biomolecular Interactions at Scale
papers.text:
title: Learning the All-Atom Equilibrium Distribution of Biomolecular Interactions at Scale
source: bioRxiv
topics: 
category: methods
why: 这篇工作更像方法创新，可能直接关联 metagenomics、long-read 或 pathogen identification 流程优化。
abstract_zh: 生物分子的功能由动态构象系综而非静态结构决定。尽管 AlphaFold 等模型革新了静态结构预测，但由于分子动力学（MD）计算成本高昂，准确捕捉全原子生物分子相互作用的平衡分布仍是重大挑战。本研究提出了 AnewSampling，这是一个可迁移的生成式基础框架，旨在实现全原子平衡分布的高保真采样，是首个在全原子水平上忠实再现 MD 的模型。该模型采用新型商空间（quotient-space）生成框架以确保数学一致性，并利用了包含超过 1500 万个构象的蛋白质-配体轨迹数据库。统计结果显示，AnewSampling 在 ATLAS 单体基准测试中优于所有先前的生成方法。其全原子能力使其在评估蛋白质-配体动力学中的原子级相互作用时，能与真实 MD 保持高度统计一致。此外，该模型成功恢复了 CDK2 系统中配体与侧链的耦合运动，克服了传统 MD 的采样障碍。AnewSampling 支持在密集模拟前快速探索构象景观，有助于阐明生物物理机制并加速功能分子设计。
abstract: Biomolecular functions are governed by dynamic conformational ensembles rather than static structures. While models like AlphaFold have revolutionized static structure prediction, accurately capturing the equilibrium distribution of all-atom biomolecular interactions remains a significant challenge due to the high computational cost of molecular dynamics (MD). We present AnewSampling, a transferable generative foundation framework designed for the high-fidelity sampling of all-atom equilibrium distributions, which is the first model to faithfully reproduce MD at the all-atom level. It uses a novel quotient-space generative framework to ensure mathematical consistency and leverages the largest self-curated database of protein-ligand trajectories to date, with over 15 million conformations. Statistically, AnewSampling consistently outperforms all prior generative methods on the ATLAS monomer benchmark, and the all-atom capabilities of AnewSampling enable close statistical alignment with ground-truth MD for evaluating atomic biomolecular interactions in protein-ligand dynamics. Furthermore, AnewSampling successfully recovers coupled ligand and side-chain motions in CDK2 systems, overcoming a major sampling hurdle inherent to conventional MD. AnewSampling enables rapid exploration of conformational landscapes prior to intensive simulations, elucidating fundamental biophysical mechanisms and accelerating the broader design of functional biomolecules.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究推出了名为 **AnewSampling** 的生成式基础框架，专门用于模拟生物分子的全原子平衡分布。其核心目标是解决传统分子动力学（MD）计算量过大的问题，通过生成式 AI 手段直接获取蛋白质与配体相互作用的动态构象系综，而非单一的静态结构。

## 为什么相关
在病原体研究和临床微生物学中，耐药性突变往往通过改变蛋白质的动态构象而非仅仅改变静态结合位点来起作用。AnewSampling 能够处理**蛋白质-配体动力学**，这对于理解病原体靶标蛋白与药物的相互作用、预测抗体-抗原结合的动态稳定性具有重要意义。它提供的动态视角比 AlphaFold 的静态预测更接近真实的生理过程。

## 新颖度判断
**高。** 该模型被描述为“首个在全原子水平上忠实再现 MD 的模型”。其新颖性体现在：1. 引入了**商空间（quotient-space）生成框架**来保证数学一致性；2. 构建并使用了规模达 **1500 万个构象**的蛋白质-配体轨迹数据库，这是目前已知最大的此类自研数据库。

## 方法与证据
- **方法**：采用商空间生成式基础框架进行高保真采样。
- **数据规模**：利用了超过 1500 万个构象的自研蛋白质-配体轨迹数据。
- **实验证据**：在 **ATLAS 单体基准测试**中，其统计性能超越了所有先前的生成方法。在 **CDK2 系统**的案例研究中，模型成功捕捉到了传统 MD 难以观察到的配体与侧链耦合运动。

## 应用价值
- **药物研发**：通过快速探索构象景观，加速针对病原体靶点的功能分子设计。
- **生物物理研究**：在进行昂贵的 MD 模拟前，利用该模型进行预筛选和机制阐明。
- **蛋白质组学**：深化对蛋白质功能机制的理解，特别是涉及复杂变构效应的场景。

## 局限与风险
- **泛化性疑问**：虽然摘要提到是“可迁移的”框架，但未明确说明其在完全未见的病原体特有蛋白家族上的表现。
- **计算开销**：摘要未具体说明 AnewSampling 自身的推理成本（Inference cost），仅强调比传统 MD 快。
- **实验验证**：目前证据主要集中在 ATLAS 基准和 CDK2 系统，缺乏更广泛的临床微生物相关样本（如病毒蛋白酶或细菌核糖体）的验证数据。

papers.title: AI-Enabled Imaging for Pathogen Detection Under Stress Conditions: A Systematic Review.
papers.text:
title: AI-Enabled Imaging for Pathogen Detection Under Stress Conditions: A Systematic Review.
source: PubMed
topics: 
category: methods
why: 这篇工作更像方法创新，可能直接关联 metagenomics、long-read 或 pathogen identification 流程优化。
abstract_zh: 本系统综述评估了人工智能（AI）赋能的成像技术在病原体检测中的应用、性能及方法学特征，重点探讨其在压力环境下的检测速度、准确性和建模表现。研究遵循 PRISMA 指南和 PICOS 框架，从五个电子数据库的 2736 篇文献中筛选出 28 项符合标准的研究。这些研究涵盖了 40 多种病原体，其中以沙门氏菌（Salmonella spp.）和大肠杆菌（Escherichia coli）最为常见。结果显示，仅有 3 项研究明确评估了压力或灭活状态下的微生物信号。此外，对比传统方法（如培养法或分子检测）的研究较少，且实验方案和计算流程的报告不一致，限制了基准测试和元分析的开展。综上，该综述总结了当前 AI 成像检测的技术现状，并强调亟需建立标准化的基准和报告规范，以支持可重复、可迁移的病原体检测。
abstract: Advances in pathogen detection that incorporate artificial intelligence (AI) may capture microbial signals under challenging environmental conditions that traditional methods miss. This systematic review evaluates the application, performance, and methodological characteristics of AI-enabled imaging for pathogen detection, including its impact on speed, accuracy, and modeling under stress conditions. Studies were systematically identified from five electronic databases using search terms related to AI, pathogen, detection, and imaging. Inclusion criteria, defined using the Population, Intervention, Comparators, Outcome, Study design (PICOS) framework, focused on microscopy-based pathogen detection enhanced by AI. Data extraction followed the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) guidelines and captured biological sample preparation, imaging modalities, AI-enabled data analyses, comparator methods, and performance metrics. Of 2736 citations retrieved, 120 were reviewed in full and 28 studies met the inclusion criteria. These represented more than 40 pathogens, most commonly Salmonella spp. and Escherichia coli. Only three studies explicitly evaluated signals from stress or inactivated states. Comparator methods (e.g., culture-based or molecular assays) were infrequently reported, limiting benchmarking against established workflows. Reporting inconsistencies in laboratory protocols and computational pipeline further complicated reproducibility and precluded meta-analysis. Overall, this review offers a comprehensive overview of current AI-enabled imaging approaches from both biological and computational perspectives and highlights the need for standardized benchmarks and reporting practices to support reproducible, transferable pathogen detection.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该综述系统性地分析了利用 AI 增强显微成像技术进行病原体检测的现有研究，特别关注在环境压力（Stress Conditions）下，AI 如何捕捉传统方法可能遗漏的微生物信号。研究重点考察了生物样本制备、成像模式、AI 数据分析流程及性能指标。

## 为什么相关
在临床微生物学和病原体鉴定中，微生物常处于非理想生长状态或受压环境，导致传统培养法失效。本文探讨的 AI 成像技术直接关联到快速诊断流程的优化，尤其是在需要超越传统分子检测（如 PCR）或培养法限制的场景下，为病原体识别提供了新维度。

## 新颖度判断
新颖度中等偏高（0.75）。虽然 AI 成像并非新技术，但该综述首次系统性地聚焦于“压力条件”下的检测表现，并指出当前领域内对灭活或受压状态病原体的 AI 识别研究极度匮乏（仅占纳入研究的 10.7%）。

## 方法与证据
研究采用 PRISMA 规范，从 2736 篇文献中精选 28 篇核心研究。证据显示，AI 已被应用于 40 多种病原体，主要集中在沙门氏菌和大肠杆菌。然而，摘要指出仅有 3 项研究涉及压力状态评估，且大多数研究缺乏与金标准（培养法或分子实验）的定量对比数据。

## 应用价值
该工作为开发能在复杂环境下工作的自动化检测工具提供了理论支撑。它指出了 AI 在提升检测速度和准确性方面的潜力，特别是在处理非典型形态的病原体时，有助于推动基于显微成像的快速筛查技术进入临床或环境监测应用。

## 局限与风险
属于弱 AI 交叉研究的综述，主要风险在于底层研究的质量参差不齐。摘要明确指出：1. 缺乏与传统方法的基准对比（Benchmarking）；2. 实验协议和计算管线（Computational Pipeline）报告不统一，导致研究不可重复；3. 样本量较小，无法进行统计学意义上的元分析。

papers.title: AI-powered insights in pediatric nephrology: current applications and future opportunities.
papers.text:
title: AI-powered insights in pediatric nephrology: current applications and future opportunities.
source: PubMed
topics: 
category: clinical_application
why: 这篇工作更接近临床/监测落地，适合评估其对快速识别、预警或治疗辅助的实际价值。
abstract_zh: 人工智能（AI）正成为儿科肾脏病领域的变革力量，显著提升了诊断准确性、治疗精准度和临床工作流效率。通过整合患者病史、基因组学、影像学及纵向临床记录等多维数据集，AI驱动的工具能够检测细微的肾脏异常、预测急性肾损伤（AKI）并预报疾病进展。深度学习模型在增强超声解读、精细化肾活检评估及简化病理评价方面展现出巨大潜力。结合决策支持系统，这些创新可优化药物剂量和透析方案，改善患者预后。此外，AI聊天机器人有助于提高患者参与度，而AI辅助文档方案则能减轻医护行政负担。尽管如此，该领域仍面临数据隐私、算法偏见及监管框架缺失等挑战。AI还能通过识别生物标志物和精准招募患者来加速儿科肾脏研究。跨学科合作与持续监管将是实现AI负责任集成的关键，旨在为肾病患儿提供个体化、主动且富有同理心的医疗护理。
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly emerging as a transformative force in pediatric nephrology, enabling improvements in diagnostic accuracy, therapeutic precision, and operational workflows. By integrating diverse datasets-including patient histories, genomics, imaging, and longitudinal clinical records-AI-driven tools can detect subtle kidney anomalies, predict acute kidney injury, and forecast disease progression. Deep learning models, for instance, have demonstrated the potential to enhance ultrasound interpretations, refine kidney biopsy assessments, and streamline pathology evaluations. Coupled with robust decision support systems, these innovations also optimize medication dosing and dialysis regimens, ultimately improving patient outcomes. AI-powered chatbots hold promise for improving patient engagement and adherence, while AI-assisted documentation solutions offer relief from administrative burdens, mitigating physician burnout. However, ethical and practical challenges remain. Healthcare professionals must receive adequate training to harness AI's capabilities, ensuring that such technologies bolster rather than erode the vital doctor-patient relationship. Safeguarding data privacy, minimizing algorithmic bias, and establishing standardized regulatory frameworks are critical for safe deployment. Beyond clinical care, AI can accelerate pediatric nephrology research by identifying biomarkers, enabling more precise patient recruitment, and uncovering novel therapeutic targets. As these tools evolve, interdisciplinary collaborations and ongoing oversight will be key to integrating AI responsibly. Harnessing AI's vast potential could revolutionize pediatric nephrology, championing a future of individualized, proactive, and empathetic care for children with kidney diseases. Through strategic collaboration and transparent development, these advanced technologies promise to minimize disparities, foster innovation, and sustain compassionate patient-centered care, shaping a new horizon in pediatric nephrology research and practice.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该综述系统介绍了 AI 在儿科肾脏病中的应用现状与前景，涵盖了从多模态数据整合（基因组学、影像学、临床记录）到具体临床任务（AKI 预测、疾病进展预报、超声与病理影像增强）的全过程，并探讨了 AI 在优化透析方案及减轻医生行政负担方面的潜力。

## 为什么相关
本文涉及“基因组学”与“临床微生物/病理”的交叉应用，特别是摘要提到的“整合基因组学数据”和“精细化肾活检/病理评估”，这与病原生信及蛋白质组学在临床诊断中的落地场景高度相关。对于关注临床监测落地的研究者，文中提到的 AKI 预警和治疗辅助具有实际参考价值。

## 新颖度判断
新颖度中等（0.75）。本文属于前瞻性综述，其价值在于将深度学习等通用 AI 技术具体化到“儿科肾脏病”这一特定细分领域。虽然未提出全新的算法架构，但对多维数据（Genomics + Imaging + Clinical records）的整合思路符合当前精准医疗的发展趋势。

## 方法与证据
摘要提到使用了“深度学习模型（Deep learning models）”用于超声和病理评估，以及“决策支持系统（Decision support systems）”用于剂量优化。关于实验规模、具体模型名称（如 CNN 或 Transformer）及定量指标（如 AUC、准确率等），摘要未说明。

## 应用价值
1. **临床决策**：通过 AI 预测 AKI 和疾病进展，实现早期干预；
2. **精准治疗**：优化药物剂量和透析方案，减少儿科用药风险；
3. **科研加速**：利用 AI 识别新型生物标志物并优化临床试验的患者招募过程；
4. **运营优化**：通过 AI 文档方案缓解医师职业倦怠。

## 局限与风险
摘要明确指出了三大挑战：一是**伦理与法律风险**，包括数据隐私保护和算法偏见（Algorithmic bias）；二是**监管障碍**，缺乏标准化的监管框架；三是**人为因素**，医护人员需要接受专门培训以防止 AI 应用侵蚀医患关系。此外，摘要未提及模型在不同中心间的泛化性验证情况。

papers.title: Biological multi-omics approaches to next-generation biomarkers in immune-related disorders and malignancies: An overview.
papers.text:
title: Biological multi-omics approaches to next-generation biomarkers in immune-related disorders and malignancies: An overview.
source: PubMed
topics: 
category: methods
why: 这篇工作更像方法创新，可能直接关联 metagenomics、long-read 或 pathogen identification 流程优化。
abstract_zh: 癌症和自身免疫性疾病具有显著的分子与临床异质性，传统单一分析物生物标志物在早期检测和个体化治疗中往往缺乏必要的灵敏度和特异性。本文综述了癌症及自身免疫病中下一代生物标志物（NGBs）的研究进展，重点探讨了多组学整合与人工智能（AI）驱动的方法在精准诊断和治疗中的应用。研究通过检索过去15年间PubMed、Scopus和Web of Science的文献，涵盖了基因组学、转录组学、空间转录组学、蛋白质组学、代谢组学及微生物组学，特别是结合多组学数据集与AI/机器学习的研究。结果表明，多组学与AI能够揭示循环肿瘤DNA、miRNA、lncRNA、蛋白质、代谢物及免疫谱等动态分子特征。单细胞和空间分析揭示了细胞异质性与组织背景，而蛋白质组学、代谢组学和微生物组学则提供了功能性见解，显著增强了疾病检测、患者分层和疗法监测的能力。尽管面临检测标准化、个体间差异和监管障碍等挑战，AI驱动的NGBs有望变革精准医疗。
abstract: Cancer and autoimmune diseases are major global health challenges characterized by molecular and clinical heterogeneity. Traditional single-analyte biomarkers often lack the sensitivity and specificity required for early detection and personalized therapy, highlighting the need for robust next-generation biomarkers (NGBs). This review provides a concise overview of NGBs in cancer and autoimmune diseases, emphasizing multi-omics integration and artificial intelligence (AI)-driven approaches shaping precision diagnostics and therapeutics. A literature search of PubMed, Scopus, and Web of Science over the last 15 years focused on genomics, transcriptomics, spatial transcriptomics, proteomics, metabolomics, and Microbiomics, particularly studies combining multi-omics datasets with AI/machine learning. Multi-omics and AI reveal dynamic molecular signatures-circulating tumor DNA, microRNAs, long non-coding RNAs, proteins, metabolites, and immune profiles. Single-cell and spatial analyses uncover cellular heterogeneity and tissue context, while proteomics, metabolomics, and microbiomics provide functional insights, enhancing disease detection, patient stratification, and therapy monitoring. Challenges include assay standardization, inter-patient variability, and regulatory hurdles. Multi-omics and AI-powered NGBs promise to transform precision diagnostics and personalized therapy, requiring continued research, standardization, and global collaboration.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该综述系统总结了利用多组学技术（基因组、转录组、蛋白质组、代谢组及微生物组）结合人工智能（AI）和机器学习（ML）开发下一代生物标志物（NGBs）的现状。重点关注癌症和自身免疫性疾病，强调了从单一生物标志物向多维度动态分子特征（如ctDNA、免疫谱、微生物功能见解）转变的必要性。

## 为什么相关
本研究与病原生信及临床微生物学高度相关。摘要明确提到了“微生物组学（Microbiomics）”作为NGBs的关键组成部分，并指出其能提供“功能性见解（functional insights）”。对于临床微生物学而言，AI驱动的微生物组分析是识别病原体关联标志物、优化诊断流程的核心手段。

## 新颖度判断
新颖度中等（0.75）。作为一篇综述，其创新点不在于提出新算法，而在于整合了“空间转录组学（spatial transcriptomics）”和“微生物组学”这两个前沿领域，并将其与AI驱动的精准医疗框架相结合。它反映了从单纯的序列分析向空间异质性和功能代谢分析跨越的趋势。

## 方法与证据
研究方法为文献综述，检索了过去15年内PubMed、Scopus和Web of Science三大数据库。证据基于对多组学数据集与AI/ML结合研究的归纳。摘要提到的具体分子证据包括：循环肿瘤DNA（ctDNA）、微小RNA（miRNAs）、长链非编码RNA（lncRNAs）、蛋白质、代谢物以及免疫谱。此外，提到了单细胞分析和空间分析在揭示细胞异质性方面的证据支持。

## 应用价值
1. **精准诊断**：通过AI整合多组学数据，提高早期疾病检测的灵敏度。
2. **患者分层**：利用动态分子特征对癌症和自身免疫病患者进行更细致的分类。
3. **疗法监测**：通过监测蛋白质组和代谢组的变化，实时评估治疗效果。
4. **流程优化**：为临床微生物学中病原体相关标志物的筛选提供方法论指导。

## 局限与风险
摘要明确指出了三个主要挑战：
1. **标准化问题**：实验分析（Assay）缺乏统一标准，影响结果的可重复性。
2. **个体差异**：患者间的生物学变异（inter-patient variability）可能掩盖真实的生物标志物信号。
3. **监管障碍**：AI驱动的诊断工具在进入临床应用前面临严格的法规审批挑战。

papers.title: Autoencoder/RandomForest-TabPFN for Cross-Cancer Metabolomics: Prostate and Breast Cancer Diagnosis Using Paper Spray and Ion Mobility-Mass Spectrometry Techniques.
papers.text:
title: Autoencoder/RandomForest-TabPFN for Cross-Cancer Metabolomics: Prostate and Breast Cancer Diagnosis Using Paper Spray and Ion Mobility-Mass Spectrometry Techniques.
source: PubMed
topics: 
category: methods
why: 这篇工作更像方法创新，可能直接关联 metagenomics、long-read 或 pathogen identification 流程优化。
abstract_zh: 准确快速地诊断前列腺癌（PC）和乳腺癌（BC）对改善患者预后至关重要。本研究提出了一种整合自动编码器（Autoencoder）、基于随机森林（Random Forest）的特征选择和表格先验数据拟合网络（TabPFN）的新型预测方法，用于分析癌症代谢组学数据。研究利用纸喷雾电离质谱（PSI-MS）和流动注射-行波离子迁移质谱（FI-TWIM-MS）获取了PC患者的尿液与血清样本数据，以及BC患者穿刺活检的代谢和脂质组特征。实验结果显示，该模型在区分PC患者与健康对照组时，准确率高达98.75%。通过自动编码器将高维质谱数据降维为潜在特征表示，并利用TabPFN捕捉肿瘤进展相关的特征交互，显著提升了分期诊断的精确度。本研究证明了将多源代谢组学数据与深度学习结合在癌症诊断中的潜力，为个性化医疗提供了具有扩展性的工具。
abstract: Accurate and rapid disease diagnosis, particularly in prostate cancer (PC) and breast cancer (BC), is critical for early intervention and improved patient outcomes. Metabolomic signatures represent a robust molecular framework for elucidating cancer-associated biochemical reprogramming. The use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in biology in recent years has become widespread and promising. This study introduces a novel predictive method that integrates an Autoencoder, random forest-based feature selection and Tabular Prior-data Fitted Network (TabPFN) to achieve high diagnostic accuracy from metabolomics data of prostate and breast cancer patients. The datasets were acquired using Paper Spray Ionization Mass Spectrometry (PSI-MS) and Flow Injection;Traveling-Wave Ion Mobility-Mass Spectrometry (FI-TWIM-MS) of individuals diagnosed with PC and BC. When leveraging metabolomic profiling data from two distinct sources, prostate cancer urine and serum samples, the proposed model achieved an accuracy up to 98.75% in distinguishing diseased from healthy conditions. Additionally, we employed a breast cancer dataset containing metabolic and lipidomic signatures acquired from core needle biopsies using a miniature MS platform coupled with PSI to assess the fidelity of our implementation across distinct cancer types. Our results on a well-characterized targeted dataset show that we can effectively reduce high-dimensional data into latent feature representations. At the same time, TabPFN captures tumor progression-related changes and feature interaction, thereby enhancing the possibility that the model will be a highly potent and effective tool for stage-specific diagnostic precision. Most existing machine learning approaches for disease diagnosis primarily rely on imaging, genomics, or clinical parameters, often overlooking the critical role of metabolites in identifying disease-specific biochemical signatures. By integrating metabolite-specific data with a robust deep-learning approach, this study demonstrates the transformative potential of AI in metabolomics-based diagnostics. The proposed model offers scalability and versatility, with applications extending beyond oncology to a much broader disease profiling aspect. These findings emphasise the value of combining multi-source metabolomic data with deep learning to advance personalised medicine and enhance diagnostic efficiency in clinical practice.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究开发了一种名为“Autoencoder/RandomForest-TabPFN”的机器学习工作流，专门用于处理通过纸喷雾电离质谱（PSI-MS）和离子迁移质谱（IM-MS）获取的高维代谢组学数据。研究重点在于利用该模型对前列腺癌（尿液和血清）及乳腺癌（活检组织）进行高精度诊断和分期分析。

## 为什么相关
虽然本研究对象为癌症，但其核心方法论——即利用自动编码器处理高维质谱数据并结合先进的表格数据模型（TabPFN）进行分类，与临床微生物学中的病原体质谱鉴定、耐药性代谢组学分析具有高度的技术迁移性。对于病原生信领域，这种处理复杂代谢特征的架构可直接用于优化基于质谱的微生物快速鉴定流程。

## 新颖度判断
中等偏上。其新颖性主要体现在将 TabPFN（一种基于 Transformer 架构、预训练于合成表格数据集的模型）引入代谢组学领域。相比传统的随机森林或支持向量机，TabPFN 在处理小样本、高维度表格数据时具有更强的特征交互捕捉能力，这在临床代谢组学 AI 应用中尚属前沿尝试。

## 方法与证据
1. **数据获取**：采用 PSI-MS 和 FI-TWIM-MS 技术获取前列腺癌（PC）和乳腺癌（BC）的代谢/脂质组特征。
2. **特征工程**：使用自动编码器（Autoencoder）进行非线性降维，提取潜在特征（Latent Representations），并结合随机森林进行特征筛选。
3. **模型性能**：在 PC 的尿液和血清多源数据整合测试中，模型分类准确率达到 98.75%。
4. **跨癌种验证**：在乳腺癌穿刺活检数据集上验证了模型的通用性和对肿瘤进展相关特征的捕捉能力。

## 应用价值
该模型展示了极高的诊断准确性（>98%），且具备处理多源异构数据（尿液、血清、组织）的能力。其“自动编码器+TabPFN”的架构为临床实验室提供了一种从复杂质谱信号中提取生物标志物并进行自动化诊断的高效方案，有助于实现癌症的早期精准分期。

## 局限与风险
1. **样本规模**：摘要未明确说明具体的样本量（N值），仅提到“良好表征的数据集”，可能存在过拟合风险。
2. **生物学解释性**：自动编码器生成的“潜在特征”往往缺乏直观的生物学意义，摘要未说明如何将这些特征回溯到具体的代谢通路。
3. **外部验证**：摘要未提及是否在独立中心或不同质谱平台的数据集上进行了外部验证，其跨设备的鲁棒性有待确认。

papers.title: Validation of an AI-Powered Automated Colony Analysis Platform Across Eight ISO Microbiological Methods: A Multi-Pathogen, Multi-Matrix Performance Study
papers.text:
title: Validation of an AI-Powered Automated Colony Analysis Platform Across Eight ISO Microbiological Methods: A Multi-Pathogen, Multi-Matrix Performance Study
source: bioRxiv
topics: 
category: methods
why: 这篇工作更像方法创新，可能直接关联 metagenomics、long-read 或 pathogen identification 流程优化。
abstract_zh: 手动菌落计数是食品微生物质控中依赖操作员且限制效率的关键环节。本研究对 Reshape Smart Incubator（一种基于自动成像和机器学习的菌落分析系统）进行了前瞻性多中心验证，涵盖 8 种 ISO 微生物标准方法。研究共分析了 887 张培养皿，涉及李斯特菌和沙门氏菌的定性检测，以及总菌落数（TVC）、蜡样芽孢杆菌、肠杆菌科、凝固酶阳性葡萄球菌、霉菌酵母及乳酸菌的定量计数。自动化结果以 3 名及以上资深技术人员的共识为基准。结果显示，该平台在定性检测中达到 100% 一致性，无假阴性或假阳性；在定量计数中，一致性范围为 92.97%（乳酸菌）至 98.46%（肠杆菌科）。在低计数平板上，变异系数为 5.88%，平均标准差为 0.44 CFU。该研究证明 AI 模型在多种微生物目标、琼脂类型和菌落形态上的表现达到或超过了人类技术人员，支持其作为食品微生物实验室手动读板的可验证替代方案。
abstract: Manual colony counting remains the rate-limiting, operator-dependent step in culture-based food microbiology quality control (QC). Automated colony analysis using machine learning (ML) offers the potential to standardise, accelerate, and improve the traceability of this process. However, systematic multi-method validation data for AI-based platforms against recognised international standards remain scarce. We conducted a prospective, multi-study validation of the Reshape Smart Incubator which is an automated imaging and ML-based colony analysis system, across eight ISO microbiological reference methods. In total, 887 plates were analysed, spanning qualitative (presence/absence) detection of Listeria spp. (ISO 11290-1) and Salmonella spp. (ISO 6579), and quantitative enumeration of total viable count (ISO 4833), Bacillus cereus (ISO 7932), Enterobacteriaceae (ISO 21528), coagulase-positive Staphylococci (ISO 6888), yeasts and moulds (ISO 21527), and lactic acid bacteria (ISO 15214). Automated results were benchmarked against the consensus of three or more trained technicians. The platform achieved 100% agreement with manual assessment for all both qualitative detection methods (ISO 11290-1, ISO 6579) with zero false positives and zero false negatives. For quantitative enumeration, agreement ranged from 92.97% (ISO 15214, n=122, using ISO-aligned {+/-}10%/>30 CFU thresholds) to 98.46% (ISO 21528, n=130). Where discrepancies occurred, they largely coincided with plates showing high inter-technician variability. Precision testing demonstrated a coefficient of variation of 5.88% and a mean standard deviation of 0.44 CFU for low-count plates. This study presents a comprehensive multi-ISO validation of an AI-based colony analysis system to date. The AI models demonstrated performance comparable to or exceeding that of trained human technicians across a broad range of microbiological targets, agar types, and colony morphologies, thereby supporting their use as a validated and traceable alternative to manual plate reading in accredited food microbiology quality control laboratories.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究验证了名为 Reshape Smart Incubator 的 AI 自动化成像与机器学习平台在食品微生物检测中的可靠性。研究严格遵循 8 项 ISO 国际标准，对包括沙门氏菌、李斯特菌在内的多种致病菌和指示菌进行了定性与定量分析，旨在解决传统人工计数效率低、主观性强的问题。

## 为什么相关
该工作属于临床微生物学与 AI 的交叉领域，特别是自动化鉴定流程的优化。虽然侧重食品安全，但其核心技术——基于计算机视觉的菌落形态学识别与计数，直接关联到临床微生物实验室的自动化升级。对于病原生信领域，这种自动化的表型数据采集是实现“基因型-表型”关联分析的重要基础。

## 新颖度判断
新颖度中等偏上（0.75）。其创新点不在于 AI 算法的底层突破，而在于**系统性的多方法验证**。摘要指出，目前针对 AI 平台进行跨 8 种 ISO 标准、多病原体、多基质的系统验证数据非常稀缺，该研究填补了 AI 技术进入标准化实验室所需的临床/准临床验证空白。

## 方法与证据
- **实验对象**：887 张培养皿，涵盖 8 种 ISO 标准方法（如 ISO 11290-1, ISO 6579 等）。
- **金标准**：3 名或更多受训技术人员的共识结果。
- **关键指标**：定性检测（李斯特菌、沙门氏菌）达成 100% 一致性（0 假阳性/假阴性）；定量计数一致性在 92.97% 至 98.46% 之间；精密性测试显示变异系数（CV）仅为 5.88%。
- **AI 模型**：摘要提到使用了机器学习（ML）模型，但未说明具体架构（如 CNN 或 Transformer）。

## 应用价值
该系统可直接应用于受认可的（Accredited）微生物质控实验室，提供具有溯源性的自动化读板方案。它能显著降低人工误差，提高通量，并为微生物检测提供标准化的数字记录，有助于后续的流行病学追踪和大数据分析。

## 局限与风险
- **基准依赖**：摘要提到差异主要发生在技术人员之间变异性较高的平板上，说明 AI 在处理极端模糊样本时仍受限于人类标注的质量。
- **模型透明度**：摘要未说明 AI 模型的具体算法细节及是否开源。
- **复杂样本挑战**：虽然涵盖了多种基质，但对于极高浓度的蔓延菌落或复杂背景干扰下的识别能力，摘要未给出极端情况下的失效分析。

papers.title: The landscape of structural variation in pediatric cancer.
papers.text:
title: The landscape of structural variation in pediatric cancer.
source: PubMed
topics: 
category: dataset
why: 这篇工作偏数据集或基准构建，适合判断是否能作为病原组学训练或评测资源。
abstract_zh: 结构变异（SVs）占儿童癌症驱动变异的60%以上。本研究通过对1,616例儿童和2,203例成人全基因组（WGS）的泛癌分析显示，儿童癌症的SV负荷在不同癌种间存在约100倍的差异。与成人脑肿瘤和实体瘤相比，儿童的SV负荷降低了6至16倍，但在血液恶性肿瘤中两者相当。研究发现，受SV破坏最严重的基因在儿童癌症中多为驱动基因，而在成人癌症中则多为脆性位点。在儿童急性淋巴细胞白血病中，RAG重组信号序列附近的复发性SV热点会同时破坏免疫位点和驱动基因，而成人淋巴系统癌症中仅破坏免疫位点。研究提取了10种SV特征，揭示了RAG介导的诱变是淋巴癌中COSMIC SV7特征的潜在病因。此外，对13名患者的时空样本聚类分析揭示了SV对肿瘤内异质性和驱动选择的持续进化贡献。该研究提供了精选的SV数据集，可指导未来的临床检测与基础研究。
abstract: Structural variants (SVs) account for over 60% of pediatric cancer driver variants. Pan-cancer analyses on 1,616 pediatric and 2,203 adult whole genomes show that pediatric SV burden varies ∼100-fold across cancer types, is reduced 6- to 16-fold compared to adult brain and solid tumors, but is comparable in hematological malignancies. The top-ranked SV-disrupted genes are drivers in pediatric cancers and fragile sites in adult cancers. Recurrent SV hotspots near RAG recombination signal sequences disrupt immune loci and driver genes in pediatric acute lymphoblastic leukemias, but immune loci exclusively in adult lymphoid cancers. Ten extracted SV signatures implicate RAG-mediated mutagenesis as a potential etiology for COSMIC SV7 in lymphoid cancers, while clustering of spatiotemporally distinct samples from 13 patients reveals the ongoing evolutionary contributions of SVs to intra-tumor heterogeneity and driver selection. Our study expands the known scope of RAG-mediated mutagenesis, while the curated SV dataset can guide future research and clinical testing.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究系统性地描绘了儿童癌症的结构变异（SV）图谱，通过对比1,616例儿童与2,203例成人全基因组数据，揭示了两者在SV负荷、受累基因类型及突变机制上的显著差异。核心发现包括：儿童实体瘤SV负荷远低于成人，RAG介导的诱变在儿童白血病驱动基因形成中起关键作用，并识别出10种特异性SV特征（Signatures）。

## 为什么相关
本研究属于**基因组学与数据集构建**领域。虽然论文本身未直接应用AI模型，但其提供的“精选SV数据集”和“10种SV特征”是病原生信和肿瘤基因组学AI模型（如SV调用算法优化、驱动变异预测Agent）极佳的训练与评测资源。对于开发临床微生物学中涉及的宿主反应或肿瘤相关病原检测工具，理解宿主基因组的不稳定性亦有参考价值。

## 新颖度判断
**高**。研究通过大规模跨年龄组（儿童vs成人）泛癌对比，首次量化了SV负荷的差异（6-16倍），并明确了RAG介导诱变在儿童与成人淋巴系统癌症中破坏位点的特异性（儿童包含驱动基因，成人仅限免疫位点），填补了儿童癌症SV进化动力学的空白。

## 方法与证据
- **数据规模**：分析了1,616例儿童和2,203例成人全基因组。
- **分析方法**：提取了10种SV特征（SV signatures），并对来自13名患者的时空多点采样样本进行聚类分析。
- **关键指标**：儿童癌症SV负荷跨癌种存在100倍差异；儿童实体瘤SV负荷比成人低6-16倍；RAG介导的诱变被关联至COSMIC SV7特征。

## 应用价值
- **临床检测**：精选的SV数据集可直接用于优化临床癌症基因组测序的变异过滤流程。
- **AI/算法开发**：10种SV特征可作为特征工程的输入，用于开发自动化的肿瘤演化分析Agent或变异致病性评分模型。
- **基础研究**：扩展了对RAG介导诱变机制的理解，为靶向治疗提供潜在位点。

## 局限与风险
- **AI交叉深度**：属于**弱AI交叉**，研究侧重于生物信息学统计分析，未涉及深度学习架构创新。
- **样本局限**：虽然泛癌规模大，但在探讨肿瘤内异质性（ITH）的演化分析中，仅涉及13名患者，样本量相对较小，结论的普适性需在更大队列中验证。
- **摘要未说明**：摘要未提及具体的SV检测算法名称及软件版本。

papers.title: Three Decades of FDA Authorizations of AI/ML Enabled Medical Devices: Persistent Specialty Concentration and the Care Delivery Gap (1995 to 2025)
papers.text:
title: Three Decades of FDA Authorizations of AI/ML Enabled Medical Devices: Persistent Specialty Concentration and the Care Delivery Gap (1995 to 2025)
source: medRxiv
topics: 
category: clinical_application
why: 这篇工作更接近临床/监测落地，适合评估其对快速识别、预警或治疗辅助的实际价值。
abstract_zh: 本研究对1995年9月至2025年12月期间获得美国FDA上市授权的所有1,430项人工智能/机器学习（AI/ML）赋能医疗器械进行了横断面分析，旨在表征其增长趋势、专业分布及制造商集中度。结果显示，年度授权量从1995-2014年间的年均1.8项激增至2023-2025年间的年均264项，仅2025年就记录了331项。在专业分布上，放射科专家组评审的器械达1,094项，占比76.5%；放射、心血管和神经科前三大专业合计占比90.6%。相比之下，病理学（9项）、微生物学（6项）和妇产科（4项）等临床专业的授权数量极少，精神病学领域则为零。在740家唯一公司中，67.8%仅拥有一项授权，而1.8%的头部公司贡献了15.2%的器械。研究表明，AI医疗器械虽增长迅速，但高度集中于图像密集型诊断领域，许多临床活跃专业存在显著缺口，这为优化监管和数据集投资方向提供了依据。
abstract: The US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) maintains a public list of artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML)-enabled medical devices that have received marketing authorization. Prior published analyses examined this list at earlier time points and reported a marked dominance of radiology applications. We performed a cross-sectional analysis of all 1,430 AI/ML-enabled medical device authorizations recorded by the FDA between September 1995 and December 2025 to characterize the cumulative growth, specialty distribution, and manufacturer concentration of authorized devices. The annual authorization volume increased from a mean of 1.8 per year between 1995 and 2014 to 264 per year between 2023 and 2025, with 331 authorizations recorded in 2025 alone. Devices reviewed by the FDA's Radiology panel accounted for 1,094 of 1,430 authorizations (76.5%), and the three most represented panels (Radiology, Cardiovascular, and Neurology) accounted for 90.6% of all authorizations. Several large clinical specialties were represented by very small numbers of authorized devices, including Pathology (n = 9), Microbiology (n = 6), and Obstetrics and Gynecology (n = 4). No authorizations were recorded under a psychiatry or behavioral health review panel. Of 740 unique companies, 502 (67.8%) had a single authorized device, while 13 companies (1.8%) accounted for 217 devices (15.2%). The cumulative regulatory record demonstrates rapid growth that has been concentrated in image-rich diagnostic specialties, with limited representation across many specialties that account for substantial clinical activity in the United States. These findings may inform policy discussions about where regulatory, infrastructure, and dataset investments are most needed to broaden the clinical scope of medical AI.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究系统梳理了FDA近30年（1995-2025年）授权的1,430项AI/ML医疗器械，揭示了授权数量从早期年均1.8项到2025年单年331项的爆发式增长趋势，并重点分析了医疗AI在不同临床专业间的分布极不均衡性。

## 为什么相关
对于病原微生物学和临床诊断领域，该研究揭示了一个关键现状：尽管AI在放射科（1,094项）应用极广，但在微生物学（仅6项）和病理学（仅9项）领域的渗透率极低。这表明在快速识别病原体、自动化药敏分析等临床微生物核心任务上，AI器械的转化落地仍处于起步阶段，存在巨大的未满足需求。

## 新颖度判断
中等偏高。虽然AI器械集中在放射科是已知现象，但本研究将时间跨度延伸至2025年底（包含最新预测或即时数据），提供了最新的量化证据，并首次详细对比了微生物学、病理学等特定细分专业的“缺口”程度，为评估AI在临床落地的广度提供了数据支撑。

## 方法与证据
研究采用横断面分析法，数据源自FDA公开的AI/ML医疗器械清单。证据包括：1. 规模：分析了1,430项授权和740家公司；2. 集中度指标：放射科占比76.5%，前三大专业合计占比90.6%；3. 缺口数据：微生物学仅6项授权，精神病学为0项；4. 市场结构：1.8%的公司（13家）占据了15.2%的授权量。

## 应用价值
该研究为政策制定者和科研机构提供了投资指南。它明确指出，为了缩小临床交付差距，监管机构和投资者应优先支持微生物学、病理学和精神病学等领域的AI基础设施和数据集建设，而非继续在已经饱和的图像诊断领域过度投入。

## 局限与风险
摘要未说明这些获批器械在临床实际应用中的有效性或性能差异。此外，研究仅基于FDA授权记录，无法反映未进入监管审批阶段的实验室自建检测（LDTs）或早期研究成果。由于包含2025年数据，需注意部分数据可能基于截至2025年底的最新统计或趋势推断。

papers.title: Cosine Similarity Conflates Clinically Distinct Cancer Variants: A Case for Typed-Graph Retrieval in Precision Oncology Decision Support
papers.text:
title: Cosine Similarity Conflates Clinically Distinct Cancer Variants: A Case for Typed-Graph Retrieval in Precision Oncology Decision Support
source: bioRxiv
topics: 
category: methods
why: 这篇工作更像方法创新，可能直接关联 metagenomics、long-read 或 pathogen identification 流程优化。
abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）正日益应用于肿瘤临床决策支持，其核心是将患者NGS报告中的体细胞变异匹配至证据分级的治疗方案。然而，RAG系统常用的基于向量余弦相似度的检索架构更侧重语言接近性而非实体身份。本研究评估了9对具有不同FDA批准疗法指示的癌症变异（如EGFR L858R与T790M，KRAS G12C与G12D），涵盖BRAF、EGFR、KRAS等关键基因。实验发现，在PubMedBERT和MedCPT等生物医学编码器下，100%的临床差异变异对在“基因+变异+肿瘤类型”格式下的余弦相似度均≥0.95，且生物医学预训练模型的表现甚至劣于通用模型。在52份文档的语料库检索中，错误变异出现在前5名的概率高达75%-100%。相比之下，通过引入精确变异ID护栏或采用端到端类型图（Typed-Graph）检索，可将错误检索率降至零。研究表明，在临床决策支持中，应优先采用类型图检索或带有严格ID护栏的向量检索，以确保变异层面的身份准确性。
abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is increasingly applied to clinical decision support in oncology, where treatment selection depends on identifying a patient's specific somatic variant from an NGS report and matching it to evidence-graded therapy options. The vector retrieval that underlies most RAG systems uses cosine similarity over text embeddings, an architecture optimized for linguistic proximity rather than entity-level identity. We hypothesize that cosine-similarity-based retrieval conflates clinically distinct cancer variants at clinically relevant rates, while a typed-graph approach in which each variant is a discrete node preserves variant-level identity by construction. We evaluated 9 cancer variant pairs with differential FDA-approved therapy indications, variant identity informed by the CIViC clinical variant evidence database and primary clinical literature. The pairs span BRAF, EGFR, KRAS, ERBB2, PIK3CA, and NTRK1, including the canonical EGFR L858R vs T790M sensitivity-versus-resistance pair and KRAS G12C vs G12D (only G12C has an FDA-approved targeted therapy). We computed pairwise cosine similarity across three open-source embedding models (PubMedBERT, MedCPT, BGE-large-en-v1.5) and three text formats, and in this revision added template-matched negative controls, formal separation metrics, variant-specific long-format text, corpus-level ranked retrieval, an exact-ID guardrail baseline, and an end-to-end typed-graph pipeline. Across the medium format (gene + variant + tumor type), **100% of clinically distinct variant pairs (9/9) had cosine similarity [≥] 0.95 under both biomedical encoders** (PubMedBERT, MedCPT; exact binomial 95% CI [66.4%, 100%]); the general-purpose encoder (BGE-large-en-v1.5) conflated 11%. The biomedically pre-trained encoders performed *worse*, not better, than the general-purpose encoder. Template-matched but biologically unrelated negative controls scored lower than the clinically distinct pairs, confirming the high similarities are genuine conflation and not a template artifact, and equivalent-notation positives were not separable from clinically distinct pairs by a cosine threshold (medium-format ROC-AUC [≤] 0.54, below 0.5 for the biomedical encoders). In corpus-level ranked retrieval over a 52-document corpus, the wrong paired variant appeared in the top 5 for 75% to 100% of queries under the biomedical encoders. Adding an exact variant-ID guardrail to cosine retrieval, and routing retrieval through an end-to-end typed-graph pipeline, both reduced wrong-variant retrieval to zero. We argue that, conditional on a normalization layer that resolves variant strings to canonical nodes, typed-graph retrieval, or vector retrieval coupled with strict variant-ID guardrails, should be the default substrate for variant-level clinical decision support. We empirically validate the typed-graph baseline end-to-end on the same nine-pair benchmark, demonstrating 95.8% normalization accuracy and a 0% wrong-variant retrieval rate.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究揭示了当前基于向量检索（RAG）的临床决策支持系统在处理癌症变异时的严重缺陷：由于余弦相似度算法倾向于语义接近而非实体精确匹配，导致临床意义截然不同（如敏感性 vs 耐药性）的突变在向量空间中无法区分。研究提出并验证了“类型图检索（Typed-Graph Retrieval）”作为替代方案，以解决实体混淆问题。

## 为什么相关
在基因组学和临床微生物学领域，区分特定位点的变异（如耐药基因的单碱基突变）至关重要。本文证明了即便使用专门的生物医学语言模型（如PubMedBERT），传统的向量检索也无法可靠区分如 EGFR L858R 和 T790M 这样关键的变异。这对于开发基于AI的病原体鉴定、耐药性预测及精准医疗工具具有重要的警示意义。

## 新颖度判断
新颖度较高。研究并未盲目追求更强大的LLM，而是从底层检索架构出发，量化了生物医学编码器在实体辨析上的失效（100%的混淆率），并对比了通用模型与医学专用模型的表现，提出了结合知识图谱实体节点的“类型图”改进方案。

## 方法与证据
- **实验对象**：9对具有临床差异的变异对，涉及BRAF、EGFR、KRAS、ERBB2、PIK3CA和NTRK1基因。
- **模型与指标**：测试了PubMedBERT、MedCPT和BGE-large-en-v1.5。在生物医学编码器下，9/9的变异对余弦相似度 ≥ 0.95，ROC-AUC ≤ 0.54（接近随机）。
- **检索测试**：在52份文档的语料库中，Top-5检索结果中错误变异的出现率在75%到100%之间。
- **解决方案验证**：采用类型图管道后，变异规范化准确率达到95.8%，错误检索率降至0%。

## 应用价值
直接指导精准肿瘤学决策支持系统的架构设计。建议在处理NGS报告和临床证据匹配时，必须在向量检索之上增加一层基于规范化ID（如CIViC数据库标准）的硬性过滤护栏，或直接采用图检索架构，以避免因模型“幻觉”或语义模糊导致的错误用药建议。

## 局限与风险
- **样本规模**：实验仅基于9对典型的变异对，虽然具有代表性，但覆盖的变异类型有限。
- **前置依赖**：类型图检索高度依赖于变异规范化层（Normalization Layer）的准确性，如果无法将非标字符串准确映射到规范节点，系统仍会失效（摘要提到其准确率为95.8%）。
- **计算复杂性**：相比纯向量检索，构建和维护类型图及规范化流程增加了系统的工程复杂度。

papers.title: Sequence-based Drug-Target Binding Site Pre-training Enables Cryptic Pocket Detection and Improves Binding Affinity and Kinetics Prediction
papers.text:
title: Sequence-based Drug-Target Binding Site Pre-training Enables Cryptic Pocket Detection and Improves Binding Affinity and Kinetics Prediction
source: bioRxiv
topics: 
category: methods
why: 这篇工作更像方法创新，可能直接关联 metagenomics、long-read 或 pathogen identification 流程优化。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: Predicting protein-ligand binding characteristics, such as affinity and kinetics, is critical for accelerating drug discovery. However, many existing computational methods face key limitations, including insufficient integration of comprehensive databases, inadequate representation of protein structural dynamics, and incomplete modeling of microscale protein-ligand interactions. To address these challenges, we introduce ProMoNet, a sequence-based pre-training and fine-tuning framework to enhance the prediction of protein-ligand binding characteristics. ProMoNet leverages protein and molecular foundation models to expand data coverage and enhance diversity. It also introduces a pre-training strategy based on protein-ligand binding site prediction, which bridges protein- and ligand-level representations to support downstream prediction tasks involving protein-ligand complexes. Our pre-training module effectively models microscale protein-ligand interactions and captures the dynamic nature of proteins, including binding site crypticity, without relying on 3-dimensional structural inputs. Notably, this module surpasses or matches state-of-the-art structure-based methods in identifying exposed and cryptic binding sites while maintaining high efficiency. Our fine-tuning module then efficiently transfers the pre-trained knowledge to downstream tasks such as binding affinity and binding kinetics prediction, achieving superior performance. The combination of ProMoNets strong performance and demonstrated efficiency across multiple tasks highlights its potential for broad applications in drug discovery. Scientific ContributionWe propose ProMoNet, a sequence-based pre-training and fine-tuning framework for protein-ligand binding characteristic prediction, where protein-ligand binding site prediction is introduced as a pre-training strategy to bridge independent protein- and ligand-level representations for downstream complex-level tasks. We design two dedicated modules, including a pre-training module that models microscale protein-ligand interactions and captures protein dynamics, as well as a fine-tuning module that efficiently integrates the pre-trained representations for downstream tasks. Even compared to structure-based methods, ProMoNet matches state-of-the-art performance in exposed and cryptic binding site identification and delivers superior results in binding affinity and kinetics prediction, making it a promising tool for drug discovery.

papers.title: FLAG: Foundation model representation with Latent diffusion Alignment via Graph for spatial gene expression prediction
papers.text:
title: FLAG: Foundation model representation with Latent diffusion Alignment via Graph for spatial gene expression prediction
source: arXiv
topics: 
category: methods
why: 这篇工作更像方法创新，可能直接关联 metagenomics、long-read 或 pathogen identification 流程优化。
abstract_zh: 从常规H&E染色切片预测空间基因表达可实现大规模分子分析，但现有模型多将其视为孤立的点对点任务，忽略了基因协调和空间分布等关键生物结构。为保留这些关系，本研究提出了FLAG框架，这是一种基于扩散模型的方法，将预测任务重新定义为结构化分布建模。研究识别了“基因维度诅咒”挑战，即在高维空间中联合建模基因表达及其空间相互作用时容易失效。FLAG通过集成空间图编码器以维持拓扑一致性，并利用基因基础模型（GFM）对齐来确保生成过程中的基因间保真度，从而解决了这一难题。此外，研究提出了基因结构相关性（GSC）和空间结构相关性（SSC）等新型评估指标。实验结果表明，FLAG在传统准确性指标（PCC/MSE）上具有竞争力，且在捕捉基因-基因及基因-空间关系的结构保真度方面显著增强。
abstract: Predicting spatial gene expression from routine H\&E enables large-scale molecular profiling, yet current models treat this as isolated pointwise tasks, thereby overlooking essential biological structures like gene coordination and spatial distribution. To preserve these relationships, we introduce \textbf{FLAG}, a diffusion-based framework that redefines this task as structured distribution modeling. At the same time, we identify the critical \textbf{Gene Dimension Curse}, where joint modeling gene expression and their spatial interactions fail in high-dimensional spaces, and FLAG solves this challenge by integrating a spatial graph encoder for topological consistency and utilizing Gene Foundation Model (GFM) alignment for gene-gene fidelity in the generation process. To rigorously assess model performance, we propose a set of novel structural evaluation metrics, including Gene Structural Correlation (\textbf{GSC}) and Spatial Structural Correlation (\textbf{SSC}). Our experiments demonstrate that FLAG is highly competitive in traditional accuracy (PCC/MSE) while achieving significantly enhanced structural fidelity in capturing both gene-gene and gene-spatial relationships. The code is available at https://github.com/darkflash03/FLAG.
analysis_zh: ## 核心内容
该研究开发了名为 FLAG 的扩散模型框架，旨在通过 H&E 病理图像预测空间基因表达。其核心是将该任务从传统的点对点回归转变为结构化分布建模，重点解决高维空间下基因表达与空间结构耦合建模的失效问题（即“基因维度诅咒”）。

## 为什么相关
在病原生信与临床微生物学领域，理解宿主组织在感染过程中的空间转录组变化至关重要。FLAG 能够从廉价的 H&E 图像中恢复复杂的分子空间结构，这为大规模分析病原体诱导的组织微环境改变提供了高性价比的工具，尤其是在无法进行高昂空间转录组测序的临床场景下。

## 新颖度判断
新颖度较高（6.34）。该工作不仅引入了潜扩散模型（Latent Diffusion），还首次识别并命名了“基因维度诅咒”这一具体技术瓶颈。其创新点在于结合了空间图编码器（Graph Encoder）和基因基础模型（GFM）的对齐技术，从拓扑和生物学先验两个维度约束生成过程。

## 方法与证据
- **模型架构**：FLAG 框架，包含空间图编码器（用于拓扑一致性）和基因基础模型对齐模块（用于基因间保真度）。
- **任务定义**：将空间基因预测定义为结构化分布建模，而非独立的像素级回归。
- **评估指标**：除了传统的皮尔逊相关系数（PCC）和均方误差（MSE），还提出了 GSC（基因结构相关性）和 SSC（空间结构相关性）。
- **实验结论**：摘要指出 FLAG 在保持传统指标竞争力的同时，在 GSC 和 SSC 等结构保真度指标上表现显著优于现有模型。

## 应用价值
1. **临床病理增强**：使常规 H&E 切片具备“虚拟空间转录组”分析能力，辅助识别肿瘤微环境或感染病灶。
2. **生物发现**：通过更准确的基因协调性建模，帮助研究者发现新的空间共表达模块。
3. **计算效率**：利用 GFM 对齐，可能减少了对大规模标注空间数据的依赖。

## 局限与风险
- **数据依赖**：摘要未说明训练所使用的具体数据集规模及组织类型，模型在不同器官或病理状态下的泛化性有待验证。
- **计算开销**：扩散模型通常比简单的 CNN 或 Transformer 回归模型推理速度慢，可能影响临床实时部署。
- **弱 AI 交叉说明**：该研究属于典型的计算生物学与生成式 AI 交叉，侧重于算法架构创新，而非直接的病原鉴定或长读段序列分析。

papers.title: A pan-cancer regulatory atlas of 6,983 GWAS variants prioritizes recurrent regulatory annotations and candidate programs at cancer risk loci
papers.text:
title: A pan-cancer regulatory atlas of 6,983 GWAS variants prioritizes recurrent regulatory annotations and candidate programs at cancer risk loci
source: medRxiv
topics: 
category: dataset
why: 这篇工作偏数据集或基准构建，适合判断是否能作为病原组学训练或评测资源。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: O_FIG O_LINKSMALLFIG WIDTH=200 HEIGHT=159 SRC="FIGDIR/small/26353369v1_ufig1.gif" ALT="Figure 1"> View larger version (64K): org.highwire.dtl.DTLVardef@1b34e41org.highwire.dtl.DTLVardef@d6a3d1org.highwire.dtl.DTLVardef@19cf2dforg.highwire.dtl.DTLVardef@10d3126_HPS_FORMAT_FIGEXP M_FIG C_FIG Genome-wide association studies have identified thousands of cancer risk variants in non-coding regions, yet their regulatory mechanisms remain largely uncharacterized. Here we present a regulatory annotation atlas of 6,983 genome-wide significant variants across 23 cancer types, scored using multimodal AlphaGenome predictions and integrated with ENCODE-4, Roadmap Epigenomics, and JASPAR 2024 annotations. Most variants (70.5%) fall outside annotated cis-regulatory elements; 27.7% overlap enhancers and 1.4% overlap promoters. Comparison with 6,626 position-matched eQTL control variants suggests that enhancer-classified variants carry 1.86-fold higher predicted effects (P = 10-) and promoter variants 7.84-fold (P = 2.5 x 10-{superscript 1}). A composite prioritization score (RegVar-basic, excluding GWAS-derived pleiotropy and TF disruption, AUC = 0.650; RegVar-full, AUC = 0.675) outperforms CADD (0.499) and LINSIGHT (0.558) in this cancer-gene discrimination benchmark. Within-locus ranking across 2,626 GTEx DAP-G eQTL credible sets shows that RegVar identifies the highest-posterior-probability variant in 47.3% of loci (P = 7.0 x 10-{superscript 1}3), while CADD performs at chance. Predicted target genes show 67.7% concordance with GTEx eQTL assignments. Permutation-controlled motif analysis highlights NFKB1/NF-{kappa}B, STAT1, IRF1, and ARNT as exploratory permutation-enriched candidate transcription factors at cancer risk loci. This atlas provides a resource for interpreting non-coding cancer susceptibility variants. Because AlphaGenome uses expression-related training data, GTEx-based validations should be interpreted as partially orthogonal rather than fully independent.

papers.title: Can Broad Biomedical Knowledge be Contextualized into Scenario-Grounded Propositions?
papers.text:
title: Can Broad Biomedical Knowledge be Contextualized into Scenario-Grounded Propositions?
source: arXiv
topics: 
category: clinical_application
why: 这篇工作更接近临床/监测落地，适合评估其对快速识别、预警或治疗辅助的实际价值。
abstract_zh: 
abstract: Biomedical discovery often requires connecting broad biomedical knowledge with specific experimental or clinical data. Background knowledge suggests relevant mechanisms but is usually too general to map directly onto dataset variables, while data-driven patterns can be dataset-specific and hard to interpret mechanistically. We study this missing link as knowledge contextualization: transforming broad biomedical knowledge into evidence-supported, scenario-grounded propositions that domain experts can inspect, replay, and validate. We propose SCENE, a bi-level multi-agent framework that treats knowledge contextualization as iterative search. The upper level converts broad knowledge into search directions and grounds them in the dataset schema. The lower level executes these directions through multi-objective optimization to identify concrete propositions that balance evidential strength and data support. Feedback between the two levels progressively refines the search. We evaluate SCENE in two settings: discovering patient subgroups with heterogeneous treatment benefits in clinical trial scenarios, and identifying context-specific biological responses in LINCS L1000 studies. In clinical trials, SCENE discovers specific, well-supported subgroups and outperforms existing baselines. In L1000 studies, SCENE identifies perturbational contexts with strong target-response matching and high positive rates. These results show that SCENE bridges broad knowledge and scenario-specific evidence, producing traceable, inspectable hypotheses for follow-up validation.
